name: Fundraisly
tagline: AI fundraising agent that finds investors and books meetings
tagline_zh: AI 融资代理，寻找投资者并预约会议
description: Fundraisly: ultimate AI agent for fundraising. It analyzes 300K+ investors and millions of deals, identifies the relevant ones actively investing in your space, maps warm paths to them from your own network, then covers the rest with targeted cold outreach. The result: 20-40 qualified investor meetings. Built by founders who raised over $1B.
description_zh: Fundraisly：终极 AI 融资代理。它分析 30 万+ 投资者和数百万笔交易，识别出积极投资您所在领域的目标对象，从您的现有网络中建立联系路径，其余部分则通过精准的外展覆盖。结果：获得 20-40 场合格的投资者会议。由累计融资超过 10 亿美元的创始人打造。

name: Brew
tagline: Like Claude design for email marketing
tagline_zh: 类似 Claude 的电子邮件营销设计工具
description: Brew is the fastest way to design and send beautiful, on-brand emails and automations that render perfectly in every inbox. Describe a campaign or a multi-step automation in plain English, and Brew builds the whole thing in seconds: copy, design, audience, and logic. Works with any AI agent: paste our docs into OpenClaw, Viktor, Claude, or Lovable. No lock-in: send from Brew or export to your ESP. Free to get started.
description_zh: Brew 是设计和发送精美、符合品牌调性且能在任何收件箱完美渲染的电子邮件及自动化流程的最快方式。用自然语言描述营销活动或多步骤自动化流程，Brew 会在几秒钟内构建全部内容：文案、设计、受众和逻辑。适用于任何 AI 代理：将我们的文档粘贴到 OpenClaw、Viktor、Claude 或 Lovable 即可使用。无锁定：可从 Brew 发送或导出到您的 ESP。免费开始使用。

name: StoreClaw
tagline: Grow your store profits with agents that know how to sell
tagline_zh: 利用懂销售的代理提升店铺利润
description: StoreClaw is the first AI commerce platform with agents that know how to sell, so you can make more money with less effort and less stress. Connect StoreClaw to your existing store and it will study your numbers, current sales figures, and growth trajectory, and then offer proactive suggestions that it can execute on your behalf — once you give it your approval. Ask StoreClaw how your business is doing any time, anywhere. Sell more with less stress: StoreClaw.
description_zh: StoreClaw 是首个拥有销售专长代理的 AI 商务平台，让您以更少的精力和压力赚取更多收益。将 StoreClaw 连接到您的现有店铺，它将研究您的数据、当前销售情况和增长趋势，然后提供主动建议并在您批准后代表您执行。随时随地询问 StoreClaw 业务状况。卖得更多，压力更小：StoreClaw。

name: Unabyss
tagline: MCP-native self-updating context layer for your AI
tagline_zh: 面向 AI 的 MCP 原生自更新上下文层
description: Set it up once and never re-explain yourself to AI again. Connect the apps you use daily - Unabyss will extract, structure, and update your context automatically. Share it with any AI tool via MCP, with granular control over what each tool can see.
description_zh: 一次性设置，永不再向 AI 重复解释。连接您日常使用的应用程序——Unabyss 将自动提取、结构化并更新您的上下文。通过 MCP 与任何 AI 工具共享，并对每个工具可见的内容进行细粒度控制。

name: Bond
tagline: The AI to-do list that does itself
tagline_zh: 自我执行的 AI 待办事项列表
description: Bond is an AI Chief of Staff for executives. It connects to your tools, learns how your company works, and turns scattered tasks into a self-managing to-do list that always knows what you need to do next. You can ask Bond to prepare you for your next meeting, draft a follow-up, send an email, create action items, identify blockers, surface risks, or delegate tasks to team members.
description_zh: Bond 是为高管打造的 AI 幕僚长。它连接您的工具，学习公司的运作方式，将零散的任务转化为自我管理的待办事项列表，始终清楚您下一步需要做什么。您可以让 Bond 为您准备下一次会议、起草跟进邮件、发送电子邮件、创建行动项、识别障碍、揭示风险或将任务委派给团队成员。

name: Goldfish
tagline: Press Option. It knows your work and replies like you
tagline_zh: 按下 Option。它了解你的工作，并以你的风格回复
description: Most AI tools make you explain the context before they can help. Goldfish already has it. It privately remembers what you’ve been working on across your Mac, then helps you write better from any app. Press Option in a text field to draft replies, summarize threads, rewrite sentences, or recall important details from your recent work without copying, pasting, or re-explaining the whole backstory.
description_zh: 大多数 AI 工具要求你先解释背景才能提供帮助。Goldfish 已经掌握了这些信息。它会私密地记住你在 Mac 上跨应用的工作内容，从而帮助你在任何应用中写出更好的内容。在文本字段中按下 Option，即可起草回复、总结对话线程、重写句子或回忆近期工作中的重要细节，无需复制粘贴或重新解释整个背景。

name: Upstream
tagline: The inbox designed for humans and agents
tagline_zh: 为人类和 Agent 设计的收件箱
description: Finally, an inbox you'll look forward to. Agents sort your messages, draft your replies, and clear the grunt work behind the scenes, all in a client so well-crafted that email feels light, fast, fun.
description_zh: 终于有一个让你期待的收件箱了。Agent 会在后台整理你的消息、起草回复并处理繁琐工作，而客户端的精妙设计让邮件体验变得轻松、快速且有趣。

name: Publora
tagline: A publishing API for agents to post on 10 social platforms
tagline_zh: 供 Agent 在 10 个社交平台发布内容的 API
description: Publora is a publishing API for 10 social platforms. One REST API call handles multi-network distribution — no SDKs, no OAuth wiring. The native MCP server with 18 tools gives AI agents like Claude and Cursor a full engagement loop: post, comment, react, pull analytics — across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Bluesky, Mastodon, and Telegram
description_zh: Publora 是一个面向 10 个社交平台的发布 API。一次 REST API 调用即可实现多网络分发——无需 SDK，无需配置 OAuth。内置的 MCP Server 提供 18 种工具，为 Claude 和 Cursor 等 AI Agent 提供完整的互动闭环：发帖、评论、点赞、获取分析数据——覆盖 LinkedIn、X、Instagram、Threads、TikTok、YouTube、Facebook、Bluesky、Mastodon 和 Telegram。

name: mailX by mailwarm
tagline: Email deliverability toolkit for humans and AI agents
tagline_zh: 为人类和 AI Agent 打造的邮件送达率工具箱
description: Your emails go to spam. mailX shows you why, and how to fix it in seconds with clear answers and exact steps. Built for humans and AI agents. API and MCP ready.
description_zh: 你的邮件进入了垃圾邮件箱。mailX 会告诉你原因，并通过清晰的答案和具体步骤在几秒钟内帮你解决。专为人类和 AI Agent 构建。支持 API 和 MCP。

name: Pancake
tagline: OpenClaw in Slack that makes your company autonomous
tagline_zh: Slack 中的 OpenClaw，让你的公司实现自主运营
description: Every other AI product is a tool that makes you more productive. A copilot. An assistant. A coworker. Something you use. Pancake makes your company autonomous. Agents with roles, goals, and a heartbeat working while you sleep. You set direction, approve the irreversible, the rest runs. Prepare yourself to be prompted by Pancake.
description_zh: 其他所有 AI 产品都是让你更高效使用的工具。是副驾驶，是助手，是同事，是你使用的东西。Pancake 让你的公司实现自主运营。拥有角色、目标和心跳的 Agent 在你睡觉时仍在工作。你设定方向，批准不可逆的操作，其余的自动运行。准备好接受 Pancake 的提示吧。

name: Elentaria
tagline: Your GTM: from diagnosis to execution
tagline_zh: 你的GTM策略：从诊断到执行
description: Elentaria is the AI operator for B2B: it analyzes your business, scores 22 channels, ships the plan that fits, and learns what moved revenue so it can make the next week sharper. Every week, on your stack, in your voice.
description_zh: Elentaria是面向B2B的AI运营官：它分析你的业务，对22个渠道进行评分，生成匹配的计划，并学习哪些举措推动了收入增长，从而让下周的表现更精准。每周都在你的技术栈上，以你的声音呈现。

name: SellerClaw
tagline: A team of AI agents that runs your stores across channels
tagline_zh: 一支跨渠道运营你门店的AI代理团队
description: Running even one online store is a full-time job. SellerClaw is a team of AI agents that runs it for you: specialized agents for product sourcing, store management, and advertising, coordinated by a supervisor you direct. Tell it what to sell — the agents build listings, manage ads and pricing, and handle fulfillment and support across Shopify, eBay, and more. You stay in control: every action is visible and approvable, and you set how much runs on its own. Free to start.
description_zh: 运营哪怕一家在线商店也是一份全职工作。SellerClaw是一支AI代理团队，为你代为运营：包括专门负责产品采购、店铺管理和广告推广的代理，由你直接指挥的主管代理进行协调。告诉它你想卖什么——代理们会构建商品列表、管理广告和定价，并在Shopify、eBay等平台处理履约和客户支持。你始终掌控全局：所有操作均可见且需审批，你可以设定自动运行的比例。免费开始使用。

name: Pazi
tagline: Vibe code business operations
tagline_zh: Vibe code 业务运营
description: Pazi is an AI team for that idea you keep coming back to — a book, a shop, an app, a skill you want to sell. Tell Pazi what you're trying to do and it builds a team of agents around your idea and starts making things happen: a website, first outreach, content, the next step. Every time you come back, something has moved. You stay in control; your team does the rest alongside you, one real step at a time. Like vibe coding but for business operations.
description_zh: Pazi 是一个为你念念不忘的想法服务的 AI 团队——无论是书、店铺、应用，还是你想出售的技能。告诉 Pazi 你的目标，它会围绕你的想法组建智能体团队并开始执行：搭建网站、进行初步推广、创作内容、规划下一步。每次回来，都有新的进展。你保持掌控；团队在你身边协同工作，脚踏实地地推进。就像 vibe coding，但专为业务运营而生。

topics.name: Productivity
topics.description: If time is most precious, this collection of lifehacks is so so precious. Be more productive and optimize your life.

topics.name: Artificial Intelligence
topics.description:
Artificial intelligence powers products that can write, reason, analyze data, and take action for you. These categories cover the main ways AI is being built and used today.

- **[AI Agents](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-agents)** – Tools that use AI to plan, reason, and take actions across tools and workflows, often completing multi-step tasks with minimal human input.
- **[LLMs](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/llms)** – Platforms and tools built around large language models that enable text generation, understanding, and reasoning across many applications.
- **[AI Infrastructure](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-infrastructure)** – Products that support training, deploying, scaling, and evaluating AI models, including hosting, inference, data pipelines, and observability.
- **[AI Chatbots](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-chatbots)** – Applications that use AI to power conversational experiences for support, productivity, research, and user interaction.
- **[Predictive AI](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/predictive-ai)** – AI-powered tools that analyze data to forecast outcomes, detect patterns, and support decision-making.

topics.name: Vibe coding
topics.description: Vibe coding turns ideas into web apps fast: AI tools generate UI and full stacks for rapid prototypes, dashboards, and sites for devs, founders, designers.

name: Tycoon AI
tagline: Run one-person companies entirely with AI agents
tagline_zh: 完全利用AI代理运营一人公司
description: Tycoon.us enables you to run an entire company with AI agents, powered by Astra, an AI CEO, and 10+ ready-to-use AI agents you can choose from, from CMO who manages X to CTO who codes. Astra also manages Claude Code/Hermes. Give Astra a KPI or project, like “10x traffic this month,” or “launch onboarding flows.” She creates a plan, assigns agents, tracks progress, and asks for approval when needed. Every agent is out of box, so no setup, coding, or API keys required.
description_zh: Tycoon.us让你能够利用AI代理运营整家公司，由AI首席执行官Astra驱动，并提供10多个开箱即用的AI代理供你选择，从管理X平台的CMO到负责编码的CTO。Astra还能管理Claude Code/Hermes。只需给Astra一个KPI或项目，例如“本月流量提升10倍”或“启动用户引导流程”，她就会制定计划、分配代理、跟踪进度，并在需要时请求批准。每个代理均为开箱即用，无需设置、编码或API密钥。

name: Honen
tagline: Automated teaching + learning infrastructure for any company
tagline_zh: 为任何公司构建自动化教学与学习基础设施
description: Create employee training that keeps up with your company. Honen turns team knowledge into interactive AI-led courses in seconds, complete with adaptive lessons, simulations, and learner insights. When your docs, tools, or processes change, courses update automatically.
description_zh: 创建能跟上公司发展步伐的员工培训。Honen能在几秒钟内将团队知识转化为由AI主导的交互式课程，包含自适应课程、模拟演练和学习者洞察。当文档、工具或流程发生变化时，课程会自动更新。

name: ClawTeams
tagline: The first goal-driven, proactive AI team for e-commerce
tagline_zh: 首个面向电商的目标驱动型、主动型 AI 团队
description: ClawTeams is an AI employee platform for e-commerce sellers. Instead of hiring specialists—or doing everything yourself—you get a coordinated AI team that thinks, plans, and executes like real employees. One goal. One team. Zero micromanagement. Tell your team lead what you want—"Increase Q4 revenue by 20%"—and they break it down, assign specialists, and run the plan. You get updates in Slack or Discord. High-stakes decisions wait for your approval. Everything else just happens.
description_zh: ClawTeams 是一个面向电商卖家的 AI 员工平台。与其雇佣专家——或者亲力亲为——不如获得一个协同的 AI 团队，它像真实员工一样思考、规划和执行。一个目标，一个团队，无需微观管理。告诉你的团队负责人你的目标——“将第四季度收入提高 20%”——他们会拆解任务、分配专家并执行计划。你会在 Slack 或 Discord 收到更新。关键决策等待你的批准，其余一切自动完成。

name: Stitch 3.0 by Google
tagline: Generate and iterate UI screens with AI on a live canvas
tagline_zh: 在实时画布上用AI生成和迭代UI界面
description: Stitch generates UI screens for mobile and web from text prompts, with streaming edits, in-place AI changes, and one-click export to Figma, Netlify, Lovable, and Bolt. For product designers and developers prototyping fast.
description_zh: Stitch通过文本提示为移动端和Web端生成UI界面，支持流式编辑、就地AI修改，以及一键导出至Figma、Netlify、Lovable和Bolt。专为需要快速原型设计的产品设计师和开发人员打造。

name: Fuzzy AI
tagline: We warm your prospects before reaching out
tagline_zh: 我们在联系前先预热您的潜在客户
description: Cold outreach gets ignored because prospects do not know you yet. Fuzzy warms them before you ever reach out by finding people already engaging in your market, helping you stay visible through content and thoughtful comments, then launching personalised LinkedIn and email campaigns in your voice. Research, enrichment, sequences, replies and team workflows live in one place. Customers call it intuitive, seamless and more comprehensive than the tools they used before.
description_zh: 冷 outreach 会被忽略，因为潜在客户还不认识你。Fuzzy 在你联系他们之前就先预热，通过找到已经在你的市场中参与的人，帮助你通过内容和深思熟虑的评论保持可见，然后以你的口吻发起个性化的 LinkedIn 和邮件活动。研究、丰富、序列、回复和团队工作流程都集中在一个地方。客户称它直观、无缝，比他们以前使用的工具更全面。

name: minimi
tagline: Your ambient memory for Claude
tagline_zh: 你的 Claude 环境记忆库
description: Every great Claude response starts with context. minimi listens across your Mac - docs, calls, messages, tabs - and gives Claude the full picture. No prompting. All on-device and private.
description_zh: 每一个出色的 Claude 回复都始于上下文。minimi 在你的 Mac 上监听文档、通话、消息和标签页，为 Claude 提供全景视图。无需提示词。全本地运行，隐私安全。

name: Velo 3.0
tagline: AI video infrastructure to explain, train, and sell faster.
tagline_zh: AI视频基础设施，用于更快地解释、训练和销售。
description: Velo 3.0 is here, our third and biggest launch yet. Start with a screen recording or a prompt. Describe the video you need, and Velo writes the script, narrates it in your own voice, and builds the finished cut. It stays grounded in your company knowledge, from your docs and tools you connect through connectors and MCP. Edit by typing changes. Localize the finished video into 25+ languages in one click. Recording or prompt, Velo turns either into a polished video you can ship anywhere.
description_zh: Velo 3.0现已推出，这是我们迄今为止的第三次也是最大的一次发布。从屏幕录制或提示开始。描述您需要的视频，Velo 会编写脚本，用您的声音进行旁白，并制作完成后的剪辑。它基于您公司的知识，来自您的文档以及您通过连接器和MCP连接的工具。通过键入更改进行编辑。一键将完成后的视频本地化为25种以上语言。无论是录制还是提示，Velo 都能将其转换为可随处发布的精美视频。

topics.name: Video
topics.description: Video includes tools to meet, record screens, generate clips, transcribe speech, and make interactive demos—helping teams, creators, and devs collaborate.

name: Framer 3.0
tagline: With Agents, Branching, Community, and an all-new design
tagline_zh: 新增智能体、分支功能、社区及全新设计
description: Agents bring AI to the canvas to help you design, write, analyze, and organize your sites. We’re also launching Branching, a new way for teams to explore ideas before they go live, and unveiling the new Framer Community, where creators can share and earn. Together, these launches change how teams create, maintain, and scale websites. We think you’ll love it.
description_zh: 智能体将 AI 带入画布，助你设计、撰写、分析和组织网站。我们还推出了“分支”功能，让团队在上线前探索创意；并揭幕全新的 Framer 社区，创作者可在此分享并获利。这些发布将改变团队协作、维护和扩展网站的方式。我们相信你会爱上它。

name: Honestly
tagline: See what Reddit and TikTok honestly think about your product
tagline_zh: 看看 Reddit 和 TikTok 对你的产品有何真实评价
description: As bots and AI agents overrun the internet, finding real customer opinions is only getting harder. Honestly cuts through the chaos by discovering verified conversations about your product across Reddit, TikTok, X, YouTube, Instagram, & Facebook then turning them into insights your team can act on.
description_zh: 随着机器人和 AI 代理泛滥互联网，寻找真实客户意见变得愈发困难。Honestly 通过挖掘 Reddit、TikTok、X、YouTube、Instagram 和 Facebook 上关于你产品的已验证对话，并将其转化为团队可执行的洞察，从而拨开混乱。

name: Prefactor
tagline: Evaluate your AI Agents in real-time
tagline_zh: 实时评估您的AI智能体
description: Most agents pass their evals and fail in production. Prefactor is the evaluation layer that closes the gap. We score every agent run in real time, surface quality regressions and drift as they happen, and show engineering teams exactly how their agents are performing at scale. Built for the teams shipping agents to customers.
description_zh: 大多数智能体通过评估但在生产环境中失败。Prefactor是弥合这一差距的评估层。我们实时为每次智能体运行打分，在质量退化和漂移发生时立即发现，并展示工程团队其智能体在大规模运行时的确切表现。专为向客户交付智能体的团队设计。

name: VC Boom
tagline: Score your deck, meet investors who fit, and raise more
tagline_zh: 评估你的演示文稿，匹配契合的投资人，筹集更多资金
description: VC Boom scores your pitch deck in under 90 seconds and tells you the single fastest fix, matches you with the right investors from 47,000+ (each with a one-line reason they fit), then drafts personalized cold emails you send from your own inbox. Prep for each investor, then book the calls. Founders using VC Boom have already raised $95M. Built by an 8-year VC who raised hundreds of millions and deployed across 47 startups. Free to start, no subscription.
description_zh: VC Boom 在 90 秒内为你的路演幻灯片评分，指出最快改进方案，从 47,000 多位投资人中为你匹配最合适的对象（每位均附有一句话的匹配理由），然后起草个性化冷邮件供你从自己的邮箱发送。为每位投资人做准备，随后预约会议。使用 VC Boom 的创始人已筹集 9,500 万美元。由一位拥有 8 年风投经验、筹集数亿美元并投资 47 家初创企业的专家打造。免费开始，无订阅费。

name: Vokal
tagline: A collaboration space for 10x teammates with their Al agents
tagline_zh: 10 倍速团队成员与其 AI 代理的协作空间
description: Your Codex and my Codex can’t talk, so we play human telephone in Slack: copy prompts, paste summaries, ask for reviews, and lose the run. Vokal brings 10x teammates and their agents into one live workspace in minutes, whether they run local Codex, Claude Code, or Hermes — or in the cloud. Name your agents, give them roles, access, and memory, and work will happen in a shared collaboration space instead of through copy-paste handoffs.
description_zh: 你的 Codex 和我的 Codex 无法互通，所以我们只能在 Slack 里玩真人传话游戏：复制提示词、粘贴摘要、请求审查，最终迷失方向。Vokal 能在几分钟内将 10 倍速团队成员及其代理整合到一个实时工作空间中，无论他们使用的是本地运行的 Codex、Claude Code 或 Hermes，还是云端版本。为你的代理命名，赋予其角色、访问权限和记忆，让工作在一个共享的协作空间中完成，而非通过复制粘贴进行交接。

name: Unabyss for Claude
tagline: Shared memory across all apps and LLMs. In Claude
tagline_zh: 跨所有应用和LLM的共享内存。在Claude中
description: Claude doesn't know what happens in GPT. Neither one really knows who you are or what your company does. Now they can. Unabyss gives Claude memories from your other AI agents and everyday apps: email, Drive, GitHub, Notion, meeting recorders, and 20+ more. It saves new memories too, so GPT and Cursor stay in sync with the exact same context - sharper than wiring each tool into Claude one by one. Finally, a real memory that follows you. Private. Portable.
description_zh: Claude不知道GPT中发生了什么。它们都不知道你是谁或你的公司做什么。现在它们可以了。Unabyss为Claude提供来自其他AI代理和日常应用的记忆：电子邮件、Drive、GitHub、Notion、会议记录器等20多个应用。它也保存新的记忆，这样GPT和Cursor就能与完全相同的上下文保持同步——比逐个将每个工具连接到Claude更清晰。终于，一个真正跟随你的记忆。私密。可移植。

name: Wandesk
tagline: Build Your Own AI Desktop
tagline_zh: 构建你自己的 AI 桌面
description: Wandesk is an AI desktop. Build the apps you need just by describing them. Plug in Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek, OpenAI, Kimi, Qwen — anything OpenAI-compatible. Apps share context. AI remembers you. All local. No signup.
description_zh: Wandesk 是一款 AI 桌面。只需描述需求即可构建所需应用。接入 Claude Code、Codex、DeepSeek、OpenAI、Kimi、Qwen 等任何兼容 OpenAI 的服务。应用间共享上下文，AI 记住你的习惯。全部本地运行，无需注册。

name: Browse.sh
tagline: Give your agents muscle memory for automating the web
tagline_zh: 赋予你的智能体自动化浏览网页的肌肉记忆
description: browse.sh — an open catalog of browser automation skills for any website. Find reusable SKILL.md recipes that teach AI agents to complete tasks online, and install them with the browse CLI.
description_zh: browse.sh —— 面向任意网站的浏览器自动化技能开源目录。查找可复用的 SKILL.md 配方，教 AI 智能体在线完成任务，并通过 browse CLI 一键安装。

name: Mina Meeting Assistant
tagline: Your AI Teammate now responds and executes during your calls
tagline_zh: 你的 AI 同事现在能在通话中实时响应并执行操作
description: Mina is an AI meeting assistant that actively participates in meetings, responds in real time, pulls context from your tools, and helps move work forward while the conversation is still happening. Unlike traditional meeting tools, Mina can speak during calls, use skills, generate outputs, and support sales calls, interviews, standups, customer conversations, and team workflows before, during, and after meetings.
description_zh: Mina 是一款 AI 会议助手，能积极参与会议、实时回应、从你的工具中获取上下文，并在对话进行时推动工作进展。与传统会议工具不同，Mina 可在通话中发言、调用技能、生成输出，支持销售通话、面试、站会、客户沟通及团队工作流，覆盖会前、会中和会后全场景。

name: TestSprite 3.0
tagline: Let a fleet of parallel agents test your app in minutes
tagline_zh: 让并行智能体舰队几分钟内完成你的应用测试
description: TestSprite generates and runs end-to-end tests for your app, autonomously. For backend, we can now generate complex integration tests with dynamic variables, auto-cleanup, and Data Flow debugging. For frontend, we now send a fleet of parallel AI agents to explore your app first — clicking through every feature like real users, then feeding results into testing. We're the first to do this. 3.0 also adds auto-heal for UI drift, auto-auth for regression, and a CLI for Claude Code, Codex users.
description_zh: TestSprite 自主为你的应用生成并运行端到端测试。后端方面，我们现在可以生成带有动态变量、自动清理和数据流调试的复杂集成测试。前端方面，我们率先派遣并行 AI 智能体舰队探索你的应用——像真实用户一样点击体验所有功能，然后将结果反馈给测试系统。3.0 版本还增加了 UI 漂移自动修复、回归测试自动认证，以及面向 Claude Code 和 Codex 用户的 CLI。

name: V2Fun
tagline: Generate 3D character with 8K textures and AI motion capture
tagline_zh: 使用8K纹理和AI动作捕捉生成3D角色
description: V2Fun is an AI 3D creation platform built with self-developed 3D modeling and AI motion capture models. It helps creators turn images, prompts, and videos into high-quality 3D models, enhance assets with advanced 8K texture generation, and create motion-ready characters without switching between separate modeling, texturing, and mocap tools. V2Fun also supports image generation through models including Nano Banana and others, so creators can explore visual concepts and bring them into 3D faster.
description_zh: V2Fun 是一个AI 3D创作平台，采用自主研发的3D建模和AI动作捕捉模型构建。它帮助创作者将图像、提示和视频转换为高质量的3D模型，通过先进的8K纹理生成增强资产，并创建具备动作准备的角色，无需在独立的建模、纹理和动作捕捉工具之间切换。V2Fun 还支持通过包括Nano Banana在内的模型进行图像生成，因此创作者可以探索视觉概念并更快地将它们带入3D。

name: Clipto
tagline: Fully local, natural language search over terabytes of media
tagline_zh: 完全本地化，对 TB 级媒体进行自然语言搜索
description: Like Google Photos, but fully local. Turn the terabytes of video, audio, meetings, and files you work with into searchable memories, without uploading anything to the cloud. Clipto automatically tags people, dialogue, and scenes, so you can instantly find any moment buried in your media just by describing what you're looking for. It's fast too: on a MacBook Pro M5, Clipto indexed 2TB of videos in just 24 hours.
description_zh: 就像 Google Photos，但完全本地运行。将你处理的视频、音频、会议记录和文件等海量数据转化为可搜索的记忆，无需上传至云端。Clipto 自动标记人物、对话和场景，让你只需描述寻找的内容，即可瞬间找到埋没在媒体中的任何片段。速度同样惊人：在 MacBook Pro M5 上，Clipto 仅需 24 小时即可完成 2TB 视频的索引。

name: PlugThis
tagline: Create your own Chrome Extensions by chatting with AI
tagline_zh: 通过和AI聊天来创建你自己的Chrome扩展
description: You wanted a Chrome extension that would save you 15 minutes a day. You searched the Chrome Web Store, and it's not there. Now you can just describe it in plain English, and PlugThis builds it for you. The code is yours. Want changes? Chat. Need login or a database? Connect Supabase. Ready to publish? We generate the icons, screenshots, and listing copy the store asks for. Everyone else builds web apps. We build Chrome extensions.
description_zh: 你曾想要一个能每天节省你15分钟的Chrome扩展。你在Chrome应用商店里搜索过，但没找到。现在，你只需描述你的需求，PlugThis就会为你构建它。代码归你所有。想要修改？直接对话。需要登录或数据库功能？连接Supabase即可。准备好发布了吗？我们会生成商店所需的图标、截图和文案。别人都在构建Web应用，而我们专注于Chrome扩展。

name: Asmi AI
tagline: AI that handles your personal chores in the real world
tagline_zh: 在现实世界中处理个人琐事的AI
description: Asmi calls you every morning. You talk - it handles the day. It calls services (dentist, salon, plumber, bank, insurance) or people (friends, colleagues) to coordinate, book or resolve things. Updates you on iMessage or WhatsApp when done. It can navigate IVRS, wait on hold and handle complex conversations well.
description_zh: Asmi每天早上都会给你打电话。你只需交谈，它就能为你打理一天。它可以联系服务（牙医、美容院、水管工、银行、保险公司）或人员（朋友、同事）来协调、预订或解决问题。完成后会通过iMessage或WhatsApp向你更新。它能导航IVRS系统，等待通话保持，并很好地处理复杂的对话。

name: Adomate
tagline: Turn data into winning ads. At scale.
tagline_zh: 将数据转化为制胜广告。规模化。
description: With Adomate you create ads from data, at scale. Take data from your Meta ad account, the ad library and reviews from Trustpilot and Amazon. Build creative research workflows that create branded ad concepts, the way you want. Fully traceable to their original data trigger, no blackbox.
description_zh: 使用 Adomate，您可以从数据中创建广告，规模化。从您的 Meta 广告账户、广告库以及 Trustpilot 和 Amazon 的评论中获取数据。构建创意研究工作流程，按照您想要的方式创建品牌广告概念。完全可追溯至其原始数据触发器，没有黑箱。

tagline: Pay per use, no subscription, 18 model providers supported

description: TypingMind is the most popular app to use LLM AI models with API keys. It brings you all the best models across 18 providers in one powerful AI workspace without having to pay for subscriptions to each one. TypingMind also provides the best AI experience ever with features focused on pro users like Projects, Fork/Parallel chat, Plugins/MCP/Skills, and a wide range of customizable options that you literally cannot find anywhere else! Go give it a try at www.typingmind.com :)
description_zh: TypingMind是使用带有API密钥的LLM AI模型的最流行应用。它将来自18个提供商的所有最佳模型集中在一个强大的AI工作空间中，无需为每个提供商支付订阅费用。TypingMind还通过专为专业用户设计的功能（如项目、分叉/并行聊天、插件/MCP/技能以及一系列其他平台无法找到的可定制选项）提供前所未有的最佳AI体验！去www.typingmind.com试试 :)

name: Slashy
tagline: The AI assistant that does email for you
tagline_zh: 为你处理邮件的AI助手
description: Slashy is an AI-native email client and assistant that drafts replies in your voice, triages what matters, and makes sure no follow-up slips, so you spend less time in your inbox and more time on what matters. It connects to your email, calendar, CRM, and meeting notes and learns how you work, so you can ask Slashy to prep you for your next meeting, draft a follow-up, clear your inbox to zero, track who still owes you a reply, or fire off an email from iMessage or Slack while you're on the go.
description_zh: Slashy是一款AI原生电子邮件客户端和助手，它以你的语气起草回复，筛选重要事项，并确保没有后续事项被遗漏，让你花更少的时间在收件箱中，花更多的时间在重要的事情上。它连接到你的电子邮件、日历、CRM和会议笔记，并学习你的工作方式，因此你可以要求Slashy为你准备下一次会议、起草后续跟进、将收件箱清零、跟踪谁仍欠你回复，或者在你外出时从iMessage或Slack发送电子邮件。

name: Prelint
tagline: Prevent product drift in AI-written code
tagline_zh: 防止AI编写代码中的产品漂移
description: AI writes your code at 10× speed. Prelint makes sure it's the right code - it reviews every PR against your ADRs, docs and past decisions, and catches product drift before it ships. On teams using several AI reviewers, ~40% of the issues fixed before merge are caught by Prelint.
description_zh: AI以10倍速度编写您的代码。Prelint确保这是正确的代码 - 它对照您的ADR、文档和过往决策审查每个PR，并在发布前捕获产品漂移。在使用多个AI审查者的团队中，约40%在合并前修复的问题由Prelint捕获。

An army of offensive pentesters and bounty hunter agents that discovers complex chained vulnerabilities, an independent validator layer drives false positives to near-zero, and AI-fix agents deliver remediation as native Cursor, Copilot, and Claude Code prompts. The reactive pentest era is over.
description_zh: Astra Autonomous Pentesting 使自愈合软件成为新标准，这是我们在 8 年和 5,000 多次真实渗透测试后定义的一个类别。一支由进攻性渗透测试人员和赏金猎人智能体组成的大军，能够发现复杂的链式漏洞；独立的验证层将误报率降至接近零；AI 修复智能体则以原生 Cursor、Copilot 和 Claude Code 提示词的形式提供修复方案。反应式渗透测试时代已结束。

tagline: AI social media copilot for teams and agents
tagline_zh: 面向团队和智能体的AI社交媒体副驾
description: SocialEcho is an AI social media copilot for teams managing social campaigns across multiple brands, accounts, and channels. See what’s trending, create content that resonates, optimize posts for every platform, publish from one workspace, manage every conversation, and track what drives engagement. Built on official social APIs, SocialEcho gives AI agents like OpenClaw, Hermes, and custom automations a secure way to manage connected social accounts without brittle scraping or risky workarounds.
description_zh: SocialEcho是一款面向团队的AI社交媒体副驾，专为跨多个品牌、账号和渠道管理社交活动的团队打造。洞察热门趋势，创作引发共鸣的内容，为每个平台优化帖子，从一个工作区发布，管理每一场对话，并追踪驱动互动的关键因素。基于官方社交API构建，SocialEcho为OpenClaw、Hermes等AI智能体及自定义自动化流程提供了安全的方式来管理已连接的社交账号，无需依赖脆弱的爬虫或存在风险的黑客手段。

Campus is organized around the thing you are building, so humans and agents can pick up where the work left off.
description_zh: Campus 为构建者提供了一个与团队成员和AI代理共同构建的共享空间。将您的仓库、终端、项目知识、对话和代理工作集中在一个持久的工作空间中，而不是将上下文分散在Slack线程、文档、工单、画布和一次性AI聊天中。Campus 围绕您正在构建的内容进行组织，因此人类和代理可以接续未完成的工作。

description: Yanshu learns from the work you already do. It spots repeated tasks across files, messages, and workflows, then turns the best patterns into apps and automations. No process mapping or blank canvas—just the routines worth systemizing. Use it to automate recurring work, build lightweight internal tools, and speed up daily ops without writing code.
description_zh: Yanshu 从你已完成的工作中学习。它跨文件、消息和工作流发现重复性任务，然后将最佳模式转化为应用和自动化流程。无需流程映射或空白画布——只需将值得系统化的常规工作自动化。用它来自动化重复性工作、构建轻量级内部工具，并在不编写代码的情况下加速日常运营。

name: /monitor by Firecrawl
tagline: Notify your AI agent when the web changes
tagline_zh: 当网页发生变化时通知你的 AI Agent
description: /monitor notifies your agent via webhook the moment pages or sites change. Use up to 90% fewer LLM tokens by only ingesting what changes on a page.
description_zh: /monitor 通过 webhook 在页面或网站发生变化的瞬间通知你的 Agent。仅摄入页面发生变化的内容，从而最多减少 90% 的 LLM token 消耗。

name: Ava 2.0
tagline: Your AI BDR that runs outbound sales autonomously
tagline_zh: 自主运行出站销售的 AI BDR
description: Ava is an AI BDR that runs your entire outbound on autopilot. She sources leads from 250M+ professionals, runs multi-channel outreach, and books qualified meetings. Fully autonomously.
description_zh: Ava 是一个 AI BDR，以全自动模式运行你的整个出站销售流程。她从 2.5 亿多名专业人士中挖掘潜在客户，执行多渠道 Outreach，并预约合格会议。完全自主运行。

name: Databox MCP
tagline: Chat with your business data inside Claude, ChatGPT and more

description: Databox MCP connects your business data to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and n8n. Ask about revenue, campaigns, or pipeline in plain language and get answers grounded in your real metrics and business context.
description_zh: Databox MCP 将你的业务数据连接到 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor 和 n8n。用自然语言询问关于收入、活动或管道的问题，并获得基于你真实指标和业务背景的答案。

- **[AI Chatbots](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-chatbots)** – Applications that use AI to power conversational experiences for support, productivity, research, and user interaction.

name: Vaani
tagline: Lip-synced AI dubbing for creators, brands and studios
tagline_zh: 面向创作者、品牌和工作室的口型同步AI配音
description: Vaani is a voice-preserving AI dubbing tool to help you dub in 40+ languages, in one go, at a fraction of the cost of a traditional dub session. Where other tools give you a generic AI voice and lips that drift off-beat, Vaani clones your voice, preserves your music, and holds the meaning across languages, with frame-accurate lip sync. Built for anyone creating videos, from creators and brands to media companies, OTTs and studios.
description_zh: Vaani是一款保留原声的AI配音工具，可一次性以传统配音成本的一小部分将视频配音至40多种语言。与其他工具提供通用AI声音且口型不同步不同，Vaani能克隆您的声音，保留背景音乐，并在跨语言翻译中保持语义准确，实现帧级精准口型同步。专为所有视频创作者打造，涵盖个人创作者、品牌方、媒体公司、OTT平台及影视工作室。

name: CartAI
tagline: The AI agent that handles checkout.
tagline_zh: 处理结账的AI代理
description: Checkout is the hard part, and most solutions clear it only where the merchant has integrated. CartAI completes checkout on any live merchant surface with no merchant-side work, cooperating with bot detection instead of evading it. One developer-first API, four products: Catalog (search and live pricing across merchants), Checkouts (clear and track orders to confirmation), Payments (PCI off your stack via Visa and Mastercard agent rails), Monetization (commissions on every agent sale).
description_zh: 结账是难点，大多数解决方案只在商家集成的位置处理。CartAI可在任何活跃的商家界面上完成结账，无需商家端工作，与机器人检测合作而非规避。一个以开发者为中心的API，四个产品：目录（跨商家的搜索和实时定价）、结账（清除并跟踪订单至确认）、支付（通过Visa和Mastercard代理通道将PCI从您的堆栈中移除）、变现（每笔代理销售的佣金）。

description_zh: MCP应用是新一代网站：它们是真实、可交互的应用程序，直接在ChatGPT和Claude等AI助手内部运行。由于缺乏构建此类应用的工具，我们打造了它。介绍Skybridge——一款React框架，负责处理基础设施和开发流程，让您专注于功能开发：MCP服务器、视图渲染、客户端兼容性、测试隧道等。一次编写，处处部署。下载量已超50万，商店中已有数十款应用！

The built-in AI tutor analyzes your playing to provide personalized feedback, custom practice routines, and answers to any guitar question.
description_zh: SoundGate Guitar是一款真正聆听您演奏的AI练习伴侣。在交互式指板上获得即时视觉反馈，具有零延迟的音符检测。内置AI导师分析您的演奏，提供个性化反馈、定制练习计划和任何吉他问题的答案。

Generate slides from a prompt and file attachments, then refine them via chat. Agent lives inside Pitch, the workspace where teams collaborate on and deliver presentations.
description_zh: 大多数AI工具仅将您的品牌颜色应用于通用模板便宣称“符合品牌调性”。Pitch Agent则基于您的模板、设计语言和图像风格进行构建。通过提示词和文件附件生成幻灯片，并通过对话进行优化。Agent内置于Pitch工作区，团队可在此协作并交付演示文稿。

name: Kimi K2.7 Code
tagline: Kimi’s most capable coding model yet
tagline_zh: Kimi迄今最强大的编程模型
description: Kimi K2.7 Code is Moonshot AI’s latest coding-focused agentic model, built for long-horizon software engineering, 256K context, multi-step tool use, multimodal inputs, and around 30% lower reasoning-token usage than K2.6. Available in Kimi Code, Kimi API, and as open weights/code.
description_zh: Kimi K2.7 Code是Moonshot AI最新推出的专注代码生成的智能体模型，专为长周期软件工程、256K上下文窗口、多步骤工具调用、多模态输入而设计，推理Token消耗较K2.6降低约30%。可通过Kimi Code、Kimi API获取，并提供开放权重/代码。

name: Tabstack Dev Tools
tagline: Ditch your scraper. Make one API call with any tool.
tagline_zh: 告别爬虫。任意工具仅需一次API调用。
description: Ditch your scraper. One API gives your code everything it needs from the web: structured JSON, clean markdown, cited research, and browser automation. No browser, LLM, or pipeline for you to run. Use it from the tools you already work in: an MCP server, CLI, Raycast extension, or as an Agent Skill. Grab a key and make your first call in less than three minutes. Mozilla-backed. Your data is never sold, never trained on.
description_zh: 告别爬虫。一个API为您的代码提供从网络获取的一切所需：结构化JSON、纯净Markdown、引用研究数据以及浏览器自动化能力。无需您自行运行浏览器、LLM或搭建管道。可直接在您常用的工具中使用：MCP服务器、CLI、Raycast扩展或作为Agent Skill。快速获取密钥，三分钟即可完成首次调用。由Mozilla支持。您的数据永不出售，永不用于训练。

name: zero.xyz
tagline: Give your AI agent access to ~8k tools, APIs and services
tagline_zh: 为您的 AI 智能体提供约 8000 个工具、API 和服务的访问权限
description: **Product Hunt: Claim $5 at zero.xyz, the free power tool for AI agents** Zero unblocks your agents so they can discover services to accomplish tasks, no APIs keys or config. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenClaw, Hermes and most other CLI agents. Make your agents better with Zero.
description_zh: **Product Hunt：在 zero.xyz 领取 5 美元，这是专为 AI 智能体打造的免费强力工具** Zero 解锁您的智能体，使其能够发现服务以完成任务，无需 API 密钥或配置。兼容 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini、OpenClaw、Hermes 及大多数其他 CLI 智能体。使用 Zero 让智能体更强大。

name: Auriko
tagline: Trading desk for LLM calls
tagline_zh: LLM 调用的交易台
description: Auriko treats LLM providers as trading venues and arbitrages the spread. Built by ex-quant traders, Auriko’s cost-arbitrage engine calibrates to each user’s request patterns and selects optimized inference paths based on token price, cache behavior, latency, reliability, and request quality. Auriko benchmarks show average 30% cost reduction against industry peers and direct providers. See the source: https://www.auriko.ai/reports/llm-cost-arbitrage
description_zh: Auriko 将 LLM 提供商视为交易场所并进行套利。由前量化交易员打造的 Auriko 成本套利引擎会根据每个用户的请求模式进行校准，并基于令牌价格、缓存行为、延迟、可靠性和请求质量选择优化的推理路径。Auriko 基准测试显示，与行业同行和直接提供商相比，平均成本降低 30%。查看源代码：https://www.auriko.ai/reports/llm-cost-arbitrage

tagline: Self-updating knowledge bases
tagline_zh: 自更新知识库
description: Keep your docs moving as fast as your product. Mintlify Workflows lets teams turn on pre-built automations that update knowledge bases, generate changelogs, maintain translations, and handle repetitive documentation tasks whenever triggered. Instead of chasing every product change manually, teams can set up Workflows once and let Mintlify keep docs accurate, current, and ready for users.
description_zh: 让您的文档与产品迭代同步加速。Mintlify Workflows 让团队能够启用预构建的自动化流程，在触发时自动更新知识库、生成变更日志、维护翻译并处理重复性的文档任务。团队只需设置一次 Workflows，即可让 Mintlify 确保文档准确、最新且随时可供用户使用，无需手动追踪每一次产品变更。

name: Rezonant
tagline: Talk, spec, ship: get your product ideas into production
tagline_zh: 对话、规范、交付：将您的产品创意投入生产
description: Rezonant helps product teams turn messy ideas into code-ready specs, tickets, and engineering tasks. Collaborate with PMs, engineers, designers, and AI agents in one shared workspace. Ground decisions in your actual codebase, keep everyone aligned on the same version, and create work that humans and coding agents can confidently ship.
description_zh: Rezonant 帮助产品团队将杂乱的想法转化为可直接用于编码的规范、工单和工程任务。在统一的共享工作空间中与产品经理、工程师、设计师和 AI 智能体协作。基于实际代码库做出决策，确保所有人对同一版本保持对齐，并创建人类和编码智能体都能放心交付的工作成果。

name: ZeroGPU
tagline: The compute efficient layer for AI inference
tagline_zh: 面向 AI 推理的计算高效层
description: The world can't build compute fast enough to keep up with AI demand. So we took a different path. ZeroGPU is AI infrastructure powered by small language models running on a hybrid edge network reusing compute that already exists. Not every task needs a frontier model. Our purpose-built, edge-optimized models run 10x faster, 50% cheaper and offload 70–80% of production tasks to small models with frontier-level accuracy.
description_zh: 世界无法以足够的速度构建算力来满足 AI 需求。因此我们选择了不同的路径。ZeroGPU 是由运行在混合边缘网络上的小型语言模型驱动的 AI 基础设施，它复用了现有的计算资源。并非所有任务都需要前沿模型。我们专门设计、针对边缘优化的模型运行速度快 10 倍，成本低 50%，并能以前沿级别的准确率将 70-80% 的生产任务卸载给小模型。

name: ExploreYC
tagline: Open-source API for Y Combinator & a16z company data
tagline_zh: 面向 Y Combinator 和 a16z 公司数据的开源 API
description: One open-source API for startup data across Y Combinator AND a16z - 6,600+ companies with funding, stage, IPO/M&A exits, and founders. Filter by VC (yc/a16z/all), batch, industry, country, or search. Grab a free API key, read the docs (curl/Node/Python + Swagger), and build in 30 seconds. Plus the full web app: map, analytics, funding data, a live hiring board, and AI tools.
description_zh: 一个涵盖 Y Combinator 和 a16z 初创企业数据的开源 API——收录 6,600 多家公司的融资、阶段、IPO/M&A 退出及创始人信息。支持按 VC（yc/a16z/all）、批次、行业、国家筛选或搜索。获取免费 API key，阅读文档（支持 curl/Node/Python + Swagger），30 秒即可上手。此外还提供完整的 Web 应用：地图、分析、融资数据、实时招聘看板及 AI 工具。

name: FetchSandbox
tagline: API integration testing that remembers what breaks
tagline_zh: 能够记住故障点的 API 集成测试。
description: Most API tests stop at 200 OK. FetchSandbox lets developers and AI agents verify what happens next—webhooks, retries, state changes, async workflows, and failure scenarios. It reproduces the real bug, proves the fix, and remembers what breaks—so your agent catches it before production. Connect via MCP to Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, VS Code, and Codex. Explore 60+ APIs—Stripe, GitHub, Clerk, Resend, Twilio, Descope, OpenAI—without burning real API quota or waiting on staging.
description_zh: 大多数 API 测试仅止步于 200 OK。FetchSandbox 让开发者和 AI 代理验证后续情况——包括 Webhooks、重试、状态变更、异步工作流和失败场景。它能复现真实 Bug、验证修复效果，并记录故障点，以便你的代理在上线前拦截它。通过 MCP 连接 Cursor、Claude Code、Windsurf、VS Code 和 Codex。无需消耗真实 API 额度或等待 Staging 环境，即可探索 60+ 个 API（Stripe、GitHub、Clerk、Resend、Twilio、Descope、OpenAI）。

tagline_zh: 语音智能体的自我改进循环
description: Cekura is the testing, observability, and self-improvement platform for production voice and chat AI agents. It simulates thousands of scenarios, catches failures, diagnoses the root cause, rewrites prompts and config, then re-validates with a full regression sweep. Unlike tools that hand failures back to your team, Cekura closes the loop by fixing the agent itself and proving the fix holds without overfitting.
description_zh: Cekura是用于生产语音和聊天AI智能体的测试、可观测性和自我改进平台。它模拟数千种场景，捕获故障，诊断根本原因，重写提示和配置，然后通过完整的回归扫描重新验证。与将故障交还给团队的工具不同，Cekura通过修复智能体本身来闭环，并证明修复有效而不会过拟合。

name: Empromptu AI
tagline: Train Fine Tuned Models With AI Apps You're Already Building
tagline_zh: 使用你正在构建的 AI 应用训练微调模型
description: Most AI apps launch on someone else’s model and stay there forever. Empromptu AI turns live AI features into custom models you own. As your app runs, Empromptu AI captures real-world usage, human corrections, and edge cases from live AI workflows, then uses that signal to train a custom model you own. Improve accuracy, lower inference costs, and stop depending forever on rented intelligence from the same providers moving into your category.
description_zh: 大多数 AI 应用都基于他人的模型启动并永远停留在那里。Empromptu AI 将实时 AI 功能转化为你可拥有的定制模型。随着应用的运行，Empromptu AI 会捕获来自实时 AI 工作流的真实世界使用情况、人工修正和边缘案例，然后利用这些信号来训练你可拥有的定制模型。提高准确性，降低推理成本，并停止永远依赖那些正进入你所在领域的同一提供商的租赁式智能。

name: Pushary
tagline: Approve AI requests from your lock screen
description: One command connects your AI agents to your lock screen. When Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Hermes, or Claude Cowork stops to ask, you tap yes from your phone and the run keeps moving. New in this launch: native iPhone and Android apps. Pairing is a QR code you scan from the terminal, no key to paste. Per-tool policies auto-approve the safe reads. Every decision lands in an audit trail.

tagline: Point at any UI to send exact context to your AI
tagline_zh: 指向任意 UI 元素，向你的 AI 发送精确上下文
description: I kept wasting AI tokens describing UI changes to agents that edited the wrong element. So I built Qursor. Point at any element, copy structured context (selectors, classes, styles, fonts, colors), paste into your AI agent. No vague screenshots. No burned credits. - Inspect fonts, colors, spacing - Copy AI-ready element context - Extract components as HTML/CSS/JSX - Color picker and font detector - Download assets from any page
description_zh: 我浪费了太多 AI token 去描述 UI 变更，结果 Agent 编辑了错误的元素。所以我构建了 Qursor。指向任意元素，复制结构化上下文（选择器、类名、样式、字体、颜色），粘贴到你的 AI Agent 中。无需模糊的截图，无需浪费积分。- 检查字体、颜色和间距 - 复制 AI 就绪的元素上下文 - 将组件提取为 HTML/CSS/JSX - 颜色选择器和字体检测器 - 从任何页面下载资源

name: discode.ai
tagline: 100+ AI models, one interface. ECO friendly.
tagline_zh: 100+ AI 模型，一个界面。环保友好。
description: discode is your EU-friendly AI router: one interface for 100+ models, with every prompt auto-routed to the best one for the job. Or fine-tune it yourself along Smarter, Speed and Eco. It shows you which model answered and why, redacts your personal data on-device before anything leaves, checks the hard answers across multiple models, and estimates the CO₂, water and energy footprint of every request. Built in Vienna 🇦🇹. Your AI, your rhythm.
description_zh: discode 是你的欧盟友好型 AI 路由器：一个界面集成 100+ 模型，每个提示词自动路由到最适合该任务的最佳模型。或者你自己沿着更智能、更快速和更环保的方向进行微调。它会显示哪个模型回答了问题以及原因，在数据离开设备前在本机删除你的个人数据，通过多个模型交叉验证硬性答案，并估算每次请求的二氧化碳、水和能源足迹。维也纳制造 🇦🇹。你的 AI，你的节奏。

tagline: The missing menu bar app for local LLMs on Mac.
tagline_zh: Mac 上本地 LLM 缺失的菜单栏应用。
description: ModelHub is a native macOS menu bar app for developers working with local LLMs. It helps you discover models from Hugging Face, download the right local build, manage your model library, and use Hugging Face models with Ollama, MLX, LM Studio, llama.cpp, and the tools you already have without bouncing between browser tabs, terminal commands, model cards, and local folders. Ollama, MLX, and LM Studio are great tools. ModelHub is the missing discovery and management layer around them.
description_zh: ModelHub 是一款面向开发者的原生 macOS 菜单栏应用，用于处理本地 LLM。它帮助你从 Hugging Face 发现模型，下载正确的本地构建版本，管理你的模型库，并在 Ollama、MLX、LM Studio、llama.cpp 和你已有的工具中使用 Hugging Face 模型，无需在浏览器标签页、终端命令、模型卡片和本地文件夹之间来回切换。Ollama、MLX 和 LM Studio 都是很棒的工具。ModelHub 是围绕它们缺失的发现和管理层。

name: WorkClaw
tagline: Collaborative, proactive AI coworkers who work in Slack
tagline_zh: 协作式、主动式的 AI 同事，在 Slack 中工作
description: Meet the AI team for your team. WorkClaws are collaborative, proactive AI coworkers who work in Slack and Microsoft Teams just like every other colleague. They're fully customizable to get work done your way by learning skills and routines. Unlike most AI products that pair one person with one assistant, WorkClaws can collaborate 24/7 with your whole team. Each Claw has a job title, a manager in your org chart, and a cloud-hosted ClawOS computer with the ability to access more than 3,000 apps.
description_zh: 为你团队遇见 AI 团队。WorkClaws 是协作式、主动式的 AI 同事，它们在 Slack 和 Microsoft Teams 中像其他每位同事一样工作。它们完全可定制，通过学习技能和例行程序以你的方式完成工作。与大多数将一个人配对一个助手的产品不同，WorkClaws 可以全天候与你整个团队协作。每个 Claw 都有职位名称、组织架构图中的经理，以及一台托管在云端、能够访问超过 3,000 个应用的 ClawOS 计算机。

name: Webhound
tagline: A research engine for your agent
description: Research has no natural finish line. An agent can spend ten minutes or ten hours on the same question, and both answers can look finished. Webhound lets you choose how much work the question deserves. Give it a question and a dollar budget. It follows leads and checks weak claims until the budget is consumed, then returns a cited report or sourced dataset with the sources and working documents behind it. Run Webhound yourself or call it from your agent through MCP or the API.

tagline: Automate any Mac app with $0 recurring run cost

description: Freu AI is an AI agent for Mac that automates any desktop app with natural language. It “sees” your UI to compile a cross‑app workflow once, then runs it locally via a deterministic DSL—no brittle coordinates/selectors and no recurring token bills. Bonus: we’re open‑sourcing freu-cli (our browser automation engine) today.
description_zh: Freu AI 是一款面向 Mac 的 AI 智能体，可通过自然语言自动化任何桌面应用。它“观察”你的界面以编译跨应用工作流，然后通过确定性 DSL 在本地运行——无需脆弱的坐标/选择器，也无需持续的 Token 账单。附加福利：我们今天开源了 freu-cli（我们的浏览器自动化引擎）。

name: folk
tagline: the AI in your texts that gets stuff done
tagline_zh: 你短信中的 AI，助你高效完成任务
description: Folk is your AI friend that lives in any messaging app: iMessage, Telegram, Discord, and more. It joins meetings, plans your date, knows where you are, and gets smarter with every conversation. The longer you use it, the more it knows you. And now it's multiplayer, so you and your friends can team up and reach your goals together.
description_zh: Folk 是你生活在任何消息应用中的 AI 朋友：iMessage、Telegram、Discord 等。它会加入会议、计划你的约会、知晓你的位置，并随着每次对话变得更聪明。你使用的时间越长，它对你的了解就越深。现在它支持多人模式，你可以和朋友组队，共同实现目标。

name: Wave
tagline: Turn your voice into text — local or cloud, your choice
tagline_zh: 将你的语音转化为文字——本地或云端，由你选择
description: Wave lets you invoke an AI model anywhere on macOS using just your voice. Hold a hotkey, speak, and release—your speech is transcribed, processed, and the result appears exactly where you need it. If you're typing, it replaces or inserts text. If you're reading, it shows a floating answer. Works across all apps with selected text as context.
description_zh: Wave 让你只需通过语音即可在 macOS 上的任何位置调用 AI 模型。按住热键、说话、松开——你的语音会被转录、处理，结果会精确出现在你需要的位置。如果你正在打字，它会替换或插入文本；如果你正在阅读，它会显示浮动答案。支持在所有应用中运行，并以选中的文本作为上下文。

name: Zernio WhatsApp API
tagline: One API for WhatsApp: messaging, calling, and AI agents
tagline_zh: WhatsApp 的一站式 API：消息、通话和 AI 智能体
description: You knew Zernio as the API for social media. Now it does WhatsApp too, the whole thing. Connect a number and you've got the entire WhatsApp Business API behind it: messaging and broadcasts, in-chat forms, calls you can route to AI agents, chatbots, group chats, and numbers in 53 countries. Whatever you need to build on WhatsApp, it's one integration. Made for developers and the agents they build: REST, SDKs, CLI, and a hosted MCP server. Official WhatsApp Business API. Zero markup on usage.
description_zh: 你熟悉 Zernio 作为社交媒体 API。现在它也能处理 WhatsApp，而且是全套功能。连接一个号码，你就拥有了整个 WhatsApp Business API：消息和广播、聊天内表单、可路由至 AI 智能体的通话、聊天机器人、群聊以及 53 个国家的号码。无论你需要在 WhatsApp 上构建什么，都只需一次集成。专为开发者和他们构建的智能体打造：REST、SDK、CLI 以及托管的 MCP 服务器。官方 WhatsApp Business API。使用零加价。

name: ChatCut
tagline: Your AI video editor in ChatGPT, desktop, and web
tagline_zh: ChatGPT、桌面端和网页版的AI视频编辑器
description: ChatCut is a lightweight, professional-grade AI video editor anyone can use, even without editing experience. It’s like having a personal video editing assistant that understands your footage, intent, and timeline. Make structural edits, fine-tune cuts, add captions, B-roll, music, voiceover, motion graphics, stock footage, and AI-generated video in one place. Every edit stays editable on a real timeline, with XML export when you want to keep working elsewhere.
description_zh: ChatCut是一款轻量级、专业级的AI视频编辑器，任何人都可以使用，即使没有编辑经验。它就像一位了解你的素材、意图和时间线的个人视频编辑助手。在一个地方完成结构编辑、精细剪辑、添加字幕、B-roll、音乐、旁白、动态图形、库存视频和AI生成视频。每次编辑都保留在真实的时间线上，并支持XML导出，以便你在其他地方继续工作。

tagline: Persistent memory for Claude, ChatGPT & Cursor. Free.

description: Every AI conversation starts from zero. Your projects, decisions, and preferences disappear as soon as you close the chat. Second Brain fixes that. It is a self-hosted memory layer that works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and any MCP client. You can store context once and recall it by meaning instead of keywords. description_zh: 每一次 AI 对话都从零开始。一旦关闭聊天窗口，你的项目、决策和偏好就会消失。Second Brain 解决了这个问题。它是一个自托管的记忆层，可与 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor 以及任何 MCP 客户端配合使用。你可以一次性存储上下文，并通过语义而非关键词进行检索。它包括重复检测、语义搜索和 Web UI。基于 Cloudflare 构建，提供免费层级，且数据始终归你所有。采用 MIT 许可证。

tagline: Your ads, managed by AI that gets smarter daily.

description_zh: 每个媒体购买者都深谙此道：盯着五个仪表板，花三个小时写报告，却依然不知道下一步该做什么。Creatify AI Media Buyer 连接您的 Meta、Google、AppLovin 和 TikTok 广告账户，执行人类买家的操作：审核活动、发现悄无声息流失的广告支出、识别正在增长的内容并采取行动。它能从实际表现优异的广告中生成新创意并发布，全部通过聊天完成。此外，它还会记住您的账户历史，因此其建议会随着时间的推移不断积累。

description: Kastra is the runtime authorization layer for AI agents. Use one control plane to govern agents and policies across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenClaw, the Anthropic SDK, the OpenAI SDK, and more. description_zh: Kastra 是 AI 代理的运行时授权层。它在执行操作前决定代理可以和不可以做什么，以低于 1 毫秒的延迟在工具、提示、输入和输出之间执行策略。使用一个控制平面来管理 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、OpenClaw、Anthropic SDK、OpenAI SDK 等代理和策略。在它们成为事件之前，防止未经授权的工具使用、提示注入和敏感数据泄露。相信规则，而不是代理。

V2 automatically links related memories, follows those connections during recall, and distinguishes settled decisions from drafts and stale context. Open source and self-hosted in your Cloudflare account.

tagline_zh: 你的 Claude AI 视频编辑器，专为 Premiere Pro 打造
description: AutoEdit helps content creators edit their videos 10x faster by turning raw footage into a clean rough cut in minutes. It works directly inside Adobe Premiere Pro as an AI Plugin. Claude AI understands content, automatically removing silences, filler words, bad takes, restarts, and repeated sections while generating captions and structuring timelines. Editors stay in control of creative decisions while AutoEdit handles the repetitive, boring work.
description_zh: AutoEdit 帮助内容创作者将原始素材在几分钟内转化为整洁的粗剪版本，使视频编辑速度提升 10 倍。它作为 AI 插件直接在 Adobe Premiere Pro 内运行。Claude AI 能够理解内容，自动移除静音、填充词、糟糕的镜头、重启片段和重复部分，同时生成字幕并构建时间线。编辑人员保留创意决策的控制权，而 AutoEdit 处理那些重复且枯燥的工作。

name: Lottie Creator 2.0
tagline: After Effects for the web, built on Lottie
tagline_zh: 基于Lottie构建的网页版After Effects
description: Yes, we're calling it: After Effects for the web. Design vector animations from scratch in your browser, move faster with Motion Copilot AI, wire up interactivity with State Machines, and export production-ready Lottie + dotLottie. No desktop app. No dev handoff.
description_zh: 是的，我们称之为：网页版After Effects。在浏览器中从头开始设计矢量动画，使用Motion Copilot AI加速工作，通过State Machines连接交互性，并导出生产就绪的Lottie + dotLottie。无需桌面应用。无需开发交接。

tagline: AI for Software Engineering
tagline_zh: 软件工程领域的 AI
description: Revolte is for engineering teams to turn intent into production-ready software faster, safer, and with more control. Its agents plan changes, generate code, run quality and security checks, create PRs, support deployment, monitor runtime behavior, and surface risks early. Engineers approve the important decisions. Revolte handles the delivery heavy lifting. Built for higher delivery throughput across SDLC, stronger governance, and more value shipped per engineer.
description_zh: Revolte 专为工程团队设计，旨在以更快速度、更高安全性和更强控制力，将意图转化为可投入生产环境的软件。其智能体负责规划变更、生成代码、执行质量和安全检查、创建 PR、支持部署、监控运行时行为并提前暴露风险。工程师审批关键决策，Revolte 承担交付的重任。旨在提高整个 SDLC 的交付吞吐量，加强治理，并为每位工程师创造更多价值。

name: Runtime
tagline: Sandboxed coding agents for everyone on your team
tagline_zh: 面向团队所有成员的安全沙箱编码智能体
description: Turn coding agents into teammates anyone can use from Slack, Linear, CLI, API or your browser. Ship features, query data, build dashboards, automate workflows. All within your company's context, skills, integrations, and security guardrails.
description_zh: 将编码智能体转变为团队成员，任何人都可通过 Slack、Linear、CLI、API 或浏览器直接使用。在公司的上下文、技能、集成和安全护栏范围内，实现功能开发、数据查询、仪表板构建和工作流自动化。

name: Memdex
tagline: Turn every AI conversation into reusable local memory
tagline_zh: 将每次 AI 对话转化为可复用的本地记忆
description: Memdex is a Chrome extension that turns every AI conversation into reusable memory. It auto-captures your chats across ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, stores them encrypted on your laptop (IndexedDB, never uploaded), and underlines reusable context in your next prompt like Grammarly underlines typos. One click to inject when you need it just like grammarly. Free for your 10 most recent chats. Pro for unlimited.
description_zh: Memdex 是一款 Chrome 扩展程序，可将每次 AI 对话转化为可复用的记忆。它自动捕获你在 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Gemini 上的聊天记录，并将其加密存储在你的笔记本电脑上（使用 IndexedDB，绝不上传）。在下一次提示中，它会像 Grammarly 标记拼写错误一样，高亮显示可复用的上下文。只需一键即可注入所需内容，就像 Grammarly 一样。前 10 条最近聊天记录免费，Pro 版无限使用。

name: Rerun
tagline: The easiest way to build AI agents for all your tasks
tagline_zh: 为所有任务构建AI代理的最简单方法
description: Most AI agents are black boxes. Rerun isn't. Build no-code agents that run 24/7, chasing invoices, qualifying leads, clearing your inbox, and watch every step in real time. They pause for approval before anything sensitive. Each workspace gets its own private server. Start with the included model, or connect your own API key or subscription
description_zh: 大多数AI代理都是黑箱。Rerun不是。构建无需代码的代理，24/7运行，追发票、筛选线索、清理收件箱，并实时观察每一步。在处理敏感操作前会暂停等待批准。每个工作区都有自己的专用服务器。从内置模型开始，或连接您自己的API密钥或订阅。

description: Kickbacks.ai helps developers get paid for AI-agent wait states. Advertisers bid for a tiny sponsored status line; users get 50% of ad revenue.

name: Google Antigravity 2.0

tagline_zh: 从桌面应用编排多代理工作流
description: Google Antigravity 2.0 is a standalone desktop app for orchestrating multiple AI agents in parallel, with scheduled background tasks, subagent workflows, and native integrations with AI Studio, Firebase, and Android. Built for developers building production apps.
description_zh: Google Antigravity 2.0 是一款独立的桌面应用，用于并行编排多个 AI 代理，支持计划后台任务、子代理工作流以及与 AI Studio、Firebase 和 Android 的原生集成。专为构建生产级应用的开发者打造。

name: Co-Invest
tagline: Trade 500+ markets directly from ChatGPT & Claude
tagline_zh: 直接从 ChatGPT 和 Claude 交易 500 多个市场
description: Co-Invest by Liquid lets you research and place real trades inside ChatGPT or Claude. Access 500+ markets across crypto, equities, FX, commodities, and prediction markets—24/7. Fund in-chat, use on-chain signals (wallet activity, positioning, funding, order flow), and execute in plain language with stops/targets. Your AI also handles support with full context.
description_zh: Co-Invest by Liquid 让您能够在 ChatGPT 或 Claude 内部进行研究并执行真实交易。全天候访问涵盖加密货币、股票、外汇、商品和预测市场的 500 多个市场。在聊天中充值，使用链上信号（钱包活动、持仓、资金费率、订单流），并用自然语言执行带有止损/目标价的交易。您的 AI 还会在完整上下文支持下处理客户服务。

name: Veltrix AI
tagline: AI finance copilot for cash flow, margins, and growth
tagline_zh: 面向现金流、利润率和增长的 AI 财务副驾驶
description: Veltrix AI gives founders and finance teams instant clarity on cash flow, profitability, burn, and business performance. Connect QuickBooks, Xero, Shopify, Square, and HubSpot, then ask finance questions in plain English to get source-backed answers, anomalies, and recommended next steps. Replace spreadsheet chaos and static dashboards with real-time financial intelligence built to help you make faster, smarter business decisions.
description_zh: Veltrix AI 为创始人和财务团队提供对现金流、盈利能力、烧钱率和企业表现的即时清晰洞察。连接 QuickBooks、Xero、Shopify、Square 和 HubSpot，然后用自然英语提出财务问题，获取基于数据源的答案、异常检测和推荐下一步行动。用实时财务智能取代电子表格的混乱和静态仪表板，助您做出更快、更明智的商业决策。

name: Oasis Browser for Mac
tagline: A privacy-first AI browser you can train anonymously
tagline_zh: 一个可匿名训练的隐私优先 AI 浏览器
description: Oasis is a refuge from noisy, scattered browsing. Privacy comes first, in an elegant experience that AI makes feel lighter and more capable, not busier. Your data is your data. Period. As you train Oasis on what matters to you, it grows sharper, quicker, and truer to your everyday flow.
description_zh: Oasis 是喧嚣、分散浏览体验的避风港。隐私至上，通过优雅的体验让 AI 使浏览变得更轻松、更强大，而非更繁忙。您的数据归您所有。别无其他。随着您训练 Oasis 关注对您重要的内容，它将变得愈发敏锐、快速，并更贴合您的日常流程。

name: PandaProbe Cloud
tagline: Agent Engineering, Fully Managed.
tagline_zh: Agent 工程，全托管。
description: PandaProbe Cloud gives your team full-stack tracing, evals, and monitoring for agents with zero infrastructure to manage. Ship better agents without the ops overhead.
description_zh: PandaProbe Cloud 为您的团队提供零基础设施管理负担的 Agent 全栈追踪、评估和监控。以更低的运维开销打造更优质的 Agent。

name: Agently
tagline: Your whole stack, running itself!
tagline_zh: 您的整个技术栈，自动运行！
description: Every other tool answers, retrieves, or runs brittle rules. Agently holds your whole company in context and does the work. 100+ connectors flow into one brain that never forgets. It links a Stripe event to a Slack thread to a Linear ticket on its own. When something needs doing, Jarvis routes it to an agent that runs it end to end: triggered, running, shipped. The work lands without you, nothing falls through the cracks. Connecting takes minutes. The layer between today's AI and tomorrow's AGI.
description_zh: 其他工具都是回答、检索或执行脆弱的规则。Agently 持有您整个公司的上下文并完成工作。100多个连接器流入一个永不忘记的大脑。它会自行将Stripe事件链接到Slack线程，再到Linear工单。当需要做某事时，Jarvis将其路由到从头到尾运行的代理：触发、运行、交付。工作无需您干预即可完成，不会遗漏任何环节。连接只需几分钟。这是当今AI与明天AGI之间的层次。

tagline: Evaluate AI agent, pinpoint issues, and fix with one click.
tagline_zh: 评估 AI Agent，定位问题，一键修复。
description: Evaluate AI agents before they fail. Create test suites, run evaluations, and pinpoint issues before they reach production. AgentX provides full observability and traceability for your AI agents. AI analysis not only identifies problems but also suggests fixes-like an AI doctor for your agents. Simulate run your agents across multiple LLM providers to compare performance, cost, and latency, helping you make better decisions about which LLM to go. Run eval before deploy. Like CI/CD for AI agents.
description_zh: 在 AI Agent 出错前进行评估。创建测试套件，运行评估，在问题进入生产环境前将其定位。AgentX 为您的 AI Agent 提供全面的可观测性和可追溯性。AI 分析不仅能识别问题，还能建议修复方案——就像您 Agent 的 AI 医生。模拟跨多个 LLM 提供商运行您的 Agent，以比较性能、成本和延迟，帮助您做出更明智的 LLM 选择。部署前进行评估。如同 AI Agent 的 CI/CD。

tagline: Give Claude Code and Codex a voice
tagline_zh: 为 Claude Code 和 Codex 提供语音功能
description: Heard is a macOS voice layer for your agentic workflows. It connects to Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor and turns their output into intelligent summaries you can hear. Full commentary when your eyes are elsewhere, or silence until something errors or needs a decision. Run 'box new' in your terminal, in 2s get a beefy ubuntu VM, with admin rights, a desktop, ssh access. At $0.036/hr it is 10x less expensive than the likes of E2B, Daytona, Modal, so you can run more agents, or run them longer. Run up to 1000 concurrent boxes fully self-served, or ask us for more, with same-day support from the founders.

tagline: AI email client built for focus. Runs locally on your Mac
tagline_zh: 专为专注打造的AI邮件客户端。在您的Mac上本地运行
description: Quartz turns Gmail into a focused inbox. It sorts every message by importance, and learns what matters to you over time. When you reply, it drafts in your own voice. And the AI runs entirely on your own Mac, so your mail stays end-to-end encrypted and never shared with AI providers.
description_zh: Quartz将Gmail转变为专注收件箱。它根据重要性对每封邮件进行分类，并随着时间的推移学习对您重要的内容。当您回复时，它会以您自己的语气起草邮件。AI完全在您的Mac上运行，因此您的邮件保持端到端加密，且永远不会与AI提供商共享。

tagline: Generate and edit images with precise scene control
tagline_zh: 通过精确的场景控制生成和编辑图像
description: MAI-Image-2.5 is a text-to-image and image editing model that handles localized edits, identity preservation, and text rendering. Available via Foundry and OpenRouter for developers building production image workflows.

name: Daemons by Charlie Labs
tagline: Keep PRs, issues, CI, and docs moving with AI agents
tagline_zh: 使用 AI 代理让 PR、Issue、CI 和文档持续流转
description: Charlie Labs gives engineering teams always-on AI daemons that keep work moving after coding agents create it. Define recurring roles in your repo, then let Daemons monitor PRs, issues, CI, docs, and Sentry errors over time. Instead of waiting for another human prompt, Daemons leave reviewable updates where your team already works: GitHub, Linear, Slack, and Sentry.
description_zh: Charlie Labs 为工程团队提供全天候运行的 AI 守护进程，确保编码代理完成任务后工作继续推进。在仓库中定义循环角色，让守护进程随时间监控 PR、Issue、CI、文档和 Sentry 错误。无需等待人类再次提示，守护进程会在你团队日常工作的地方（GitHub、Linear、Slack 和 Sentry）留下可审查的更新。

name: Elvin
tagline: Proactive AI that finds and finishes work before you ask
tagline_zh: 主动式 AI，在你开口前发现并完成工作
description: Stop acting as the routing layer between AI and your actual work. Elvin is proactive AI that finds coordination work across your tools, handles the messy multi-step parts, and asks before taking action. It turns scattered context from messages, meetings, docs, and task tools into ready-to-approve drafts, follow-ups, updates, and next steps.
description_zh: 停止充当 AI 与实际工作之间的路由层。Elvin 是主动式 AI，它能跨工具发现协调工作，处理繁琐的多步骤环节，并在采取行动前征求同意。它将来自消息、会议、文档和任务工具的分散上下文转化为可随时审批的草稿、后续行动、更新和下一步计划。

name: Spira

tagline_zh: 助力社交媒體增長的 AI 代理，為你的品牌積累動能
description: Drop your Product Hunt link and unlock your brand agent, persona clones of your founding team and AI Influencers that autonomously plan, create, and publish across TikTok, IG, X and Linkedin. It's your biggest launch day, don't let it slide away!

tagline_zh: 面向网页数据的向前部署智能体
description: An experimental Forward Deployed Agent for web data from Firecrawl. Describe the web data you need and it writes Firecrawl code to collect it. Run it yourself or let us host and automatically maintain it as pages change.
description_zh: 一个来自 Firecrawl 的用于网页数据的实验性向前部署智能体。描述你需要的网页数据，它将编写 Firecrawl 代码来收集这些数据。你可以自行运行，也可以让我们托管并自动维护，即使页面发生变化也能持续更新。

name: Toyo
tagline: Exec assistant who lives in iMessage and calls your phone
tagline_zh: 居住在 iMessage 中并可拨打您电话的执行助理
description: Toyo is a personal AI assistant that lives in your messages and can call you on the phone. Talk to it like you'd message a coworker. Toyo triages your inbox, preps you for calls, can help keep your projects moving, and pulls answers and context from your company's tools. It works over text and voice: Have it call you when you want to get updates or just talk through some work. It lives in iMessage, so there's no new apps, and no new tabs to manage.
description_zh: Toyo 是一个个人 AI 助理，它存在于您的消息中，并可以给您打电话。像给同事发消息一样与它交谈。Toyo 会对您的收件箱进行分类，为您准备通话，帮助推动项目进展，并从公司的工具中提取答案和上下文。它支持文本和语音：当您想要获取更新或只是讨论工作时，让它给您打电话。它位于 iMessage 中，因此无需安装新应用，也无需管理新标签页。

name: agmsg
tagline: Stop copy-pasting between your AI coding agents
tagline_zh: 停止在 AI 编程智能体之间复制粘贴
description: Stop being the copy-paste relay between your AI coding agents. agmsg lets Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Copilot CLI message each other directly through a shared SQLite database — no daemon, no network, no Python. Just bash + sqlite3, installed as an Agent Skill. Unlike built-in subagents (single-vendor, ephemeral) or MCP (an agent calling tools), agmsg is vendor-agnostic and persistent. Run several agents — even multiple Claude Code instances — in one room, working together.
description_zh: 不再充当 AI 编程智能体之间的复制粘贴中转站。agmsg 让 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 和 Copilot CLI 通过共享的 SQLite 数据库直接相互通信——无需守护进程、无需网络、无需 Python。只需 bash + sqlite3，作为 Agent Skill 安装。与内置的子智能体（单一供应商、临时存在）或 MCP（智能体调用工具）不同，agmsg 是供应商无关且持久化的。在一个房间中运行多个智能体——甚至是多个 Claude Code 实例——协同工作。

name: Replicas
tagline: Run Claude Code and Codex in the cloud
tagline_zh: 在云端运行 Claude Code 和 Codex
description: Run background coding agents from anywhere. Spawn Claude Code or Codex in a VM with code and tooling ready to go. Hand off tasks from Slack, Linear, or GitHub Replicas runs Claude Code, Codex, or any coding agent in the cloud. Agents run in isolated VMs with real dev environments, and you can bring your own subscriptions and API keys. Trigger tasks from Slack, Linear, or GitHub and come back to a PR ready to review.
description_zh: 随时随地运行后台编程智能体。在已准备好代码和工具的 VM 中启动 Claude Code 或 Codex。通过 Slack、Linear 或 GitHub 交接任务，Replicas 可在云端运行 Claude Code、Codex 或任何编程智能体。智能体在具有真实开发环境的隔离 VM 中运行，你可以自带订阅和 API 密钥。从 Slack、Linear 或 GitHub 触发任务，回来时即可审查已准备好的 PR。

name: Willow Frontier Pro
tagline: The fastest, most accurate dictation model in the world
tagline_zh: 全球最快、最精准的语音转写模型
description: Willow is launching two new voice AI models: Willow Frontier Pro and Willow Frontier Mini. Frontier Pro is our most powerful dictation model. It is built for people who want fast, accurate, and polished writing anywhere they work. Frontier mini is lightweight and completely free to use. On our free plan, users get unlimited access to this model. It's faster and more accurate than other AI dictation tools.
description_zh: Willow 推出两款全新语音 AI 模型：Willow Frontier Pro 和 Willow Frontier Mini。Frontier Pro 是我们最强大的语音转写模型，专为希望在任何工作场景下快速、精准且优雅地写作的人士打造。Frontier Mini 轻量且完全免费。在免费计划中，用户可无限使用该模型。它比其他 AI 语音转写工具更快、更准确。

name: CrustRecruiter
tagline: Turn Claude into a recruiter that thinks like you
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 化身像您一样思考的招聘官
description: Recruiting is half judgment, half grunt work. Claude brings the judgment, i.e. the reasoning and the memory, while Crustdata brings 800M+ candidate profiles and 5 recruiting skills via MCP, meaning the manual work runs itself and you get genuinely personalized recruiting at scale, all inside one chat.
description_zh: 招聘工作一半靠判断力，一半靠繁琐执行。Claude 提供判断力（即推理能力和记忆），而 Crustdata 通过 MCP 提供超过 8 亿份候选人档案和 5 项招聘技能。这意味着手动工作自动运行，您可以在一个聊天窗口中以规模化方式获得真正个性化的招聘服务。

name: iPromise
tagline: Bring "Body Doubling" to your Mac notch
tagline_zh: 将“身体共在”功能带入您的 Mac 刘海屏
description: Freedom kills focus. iPromise is a new deep work protocol built on the principle of Body Doubling, the idea that having a "witness" boosts accountability. // Your AI Buddy lives elegantly in your Mac notch. It understands your active window’s context. When you drift into distractions, it gently nudges you back. // Make a promise. Your buddy helps you keep it.
description_zh: 自由会扼杀专注力。iPromise 是一种基于“身体共在”原则的全新深度工作协议，该理念认为有“见证者”能提升责任感。// 您的 AI 伙伴优雅地驻留在您的 Mac 刘海屏中。它能理解当前活动窗口的上下文。当您分心时，它会轻轻提醒您回归。// 许下一个承诺。您的伙伴帮您坚守。

name: Second Brain for Mac and Windows
tagline: Your AI memory, everywhere you work
tagline_zh: 您的 AI 记忆，在您工作的任何地方
description: The Second Brain desktop app gets you running in five minutes. No terminal. No git. Just download, set a password, and sign into Cloudflare. Then the real magic starts. Persistent memory across every AI tool you use. Recall that just got a lot smarter. Surfaces the right memory, not just the newest one. A knowledge graph that builds itself. Your data in your own Cloudflare account, not ours. Mac and Windows. You asked for the app. You asked for better recall. We shipped both.
description_zh: Second Brain 桌面应用让您在五分钟内开始运行。无需终端。无需 git。只需下载、设置密码并登录 Cloudflare。然后真正的魔法开始了。在您使用的每个 AI 工具中保持持久记忆。回忆功能变得更加智能。展示正确的记忆，而不仅仅是最新的记忆。一个自动构建的知识图谱。您的数据在您自己的 Cloudflare 账户中，而不是我们的。Mac 和 Windows。您要求了这个应用。您要求了更好的回忆功能。我们两者都提供了。

Available on every Buffer plan, including Free.

name: MCP Bridge by Appfactor
tagline: Connect any API to any AI agent
tagline_zh: 将任意API连接至任意AI代理
description: Point MCP Bridge at any REST, GraphQL, SOAP, or gRPC API. It auto-generates MCP tool definitions with typed schemas, auth, rate limiting, and response processing. Your LLM agents call enterprise APIs through one standard interface.
description_zh: 将MCP桥接指向任何REST、GraphQL、SOAP或gRPC API。它会自动生成带有类型化模式、身份验证、速率限制和响应处理的MCP工具定义。您的LLM代理通过单一标准接口调用企业级API。

name: Opper AI
tagline: The european AI gateway for agents
tagline_zh: 面向智能体的欧洲 AI 网关
description: One API key to 300+ models, hosted in the EU. Drop-in compatible with the OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google SDKs: switching is a base URL change. What's different: ~half our 30+ providers run inference in Europe, one EU sub-processor covers every model, no prompts stored by default. Add the control plane for routing, PII masking, per-team spend caps, and audit trails. Agent-native: paste one line into Claude Code or Cursor and it sets up Opper for you. No markup on tokens, 3% fee on credit top-ups.
description_zh: 一个 API 密钥连接 300+ 模型，托管于欧盟。与 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Google SDK 完全兼容：切换仅需更改基础 URL。不同之处：我们 30 多家提供商中约一半在欧洲运行推理，一个欧盟子处理器覆盖所有模型，默认不存储提示。添加路由、PII 屏蔽、每团队支出上限和审计轨迹的控制平面。原生支持智能体：将一行代码粘贴到 Claude Code 或 Cursor 中，即可为您设置 Opper。令牌无加价，充值手续费 3%。

name: Firecrawl Research Index
tagline: An index for agents pushing the frontier of AI/ML research
tagline_zh: 为推动AI/ML研究前沿的代理打造的索引
description: AI/ML research moves fast, and the work that matters is split between new papers and the code that implements them. Most search providers omit or misrank key papers, leaving you to review sources by hand without ever being sure you've caught everything. So we built an index for it. Firecrawl's index includes all 3M+ arXiv papers, as well as GitHub artifacts from top research repos, refreshed daily so agents always stay current.
description_zh: AI/ML研究进展迅速，而重要的工作分散在新论文及其实现代码之间。大多数搜索引擎会遗漏或错误排名关键论文，迫使用户手动审查来源，且无法确保已涵盖所有内容。因此我们构建了专用索引。Firecrawl的索引包含所有300多万篇arXiv论文以及顶级研究仓库中的GitHub资源，并每日更新，确保代理始终掌握最新信息。

name: Openstatus MCP Health Checker
tagline: Test MCP servers like a real AI client, not just a ping
tagline_zh: 像真正的AI客户端一样测试MCP服务器，而非仅发送ping请求
description: Most monitors just send an HTTP ping. But a 200 OK is useless if the JSON-RPC handshake fails. Our tool is different because it performs a true protocol-level check, acting exactly like a real AI client. Key features: Full Handshake: Executes the spec-defined initialize, ping, and tools/list sequence. Deep Visibility: Inspect exact JSON-RPC payloads and negotiated versions. Smart Auth: Parses RFC 9728 headers on 401s to surface exact token requirements.
description_zh: 大多数监控工具仅发送HTTP ping。但如果JSON-RPC握手失败，返回200 OK也毫无用处。我们的工具与众不同，因为它执行真正的协议级检查，行为完全模拟真实的AI客户端。主要功能：完整握手：执行规范定义的initialize、ping和tools/list序列。深度可见性：检查确切的JSON-RPC负载和协商版本。智能认证：解析401状态码下的RFC 9728头部，明确显示令牌要求。

name: Slideshot
tagline: Product demo videos, recorded by your AI agent
tagline_zh: 产品演示视频，由您的 AI 代理录制
description: Give your AI agent a product flow to record. Slideshot drives your web app through MCP, captures the walkthrough, and returns a polished demo video and GIF with zooms, cursor motion, and custom intro animation. No manual recording or editing.
description_zh: 为您的 AI 代理提供产品流程以进行录制。Slideshot 通过 MCP 驱动您的 Web 应用，捕获演示过程，并返回带有缩放、光标移动和自定义开场动画的精美演示视频和 GIF。无需手动录制或编辑。

name: Bluerails Discovery
tagline: The rails AI agents use to find and pay you
tagline_zh: AI 代理用于发现您并向您付款的轨道
description: Most "AI visibility" tools stop at telling you if AI mentions your brand. Bluerails goes further. We make you discoverable to AI agents and ready to get paid by them, on the rails we already run for marketplaces. What stands out: • Discovery: a peer-reviewed AI-visibility score from 400 samples, not a one-off guess. Free, no signup. • Agent-ready checkout + global settlement • Compliance built in Try your free Discovery report today; agent payments roll out next.
description_zh: 大多数“AI 可见性”工具仅停留在告诉您 AI 是否提及您的品牌。Bluerails 更进一步。我们使您的品牌在 AI 代理中可被发现，并准备好通过我们已经为市场运行的轨道获得报酬。亮点：• 发现：基于 400 个样本的同侪评审 AI 可见性评分，而非一次性猜测。免费，无需注册。• 面向代理的结账 + 全球结算 • 内置合规性 立即尝试您的免费发现报告；代理支付将于下月推出。

name: Routine AI
tagline: Control work with your voice. The Siri for work.
tagline_zh: 用语音控制工作。工作的Siri。
description: Routine AI lets you control your tasks, calendar, notes and projects using your voice. Just talk naturally to schedule meetings, add reminders, capture ideas, write notes, search your knowledge, update projects and automate repetitive work.
description_zh: Routine AI让您可以用语音控制任务、日历、笔记和项目。只需自然地说话即可安排会议、添加提醒、捕捉想法、写笔记、搜索知识、更新项目和自动化重复工作。

One API call gives each of your customers their own always-on agent, from $3.44/mo. Founders use it to ship vertical agents to their own clients without babysitting servers.

tagline: Virtual AI School: Upskill in AI and Become Great at it Fast
tagline_zh: 虚拟 AI 学校：提升 AI 技能并快速精通
description: Build Club Campus is a fun, gamified and community-driven virtual AI school for learning AI by building with it. Static courses get old fast in AI, so Campus helps you stay current through bite-sized courses, real projects, role-based use cases and community templates that evolve with the tools. Earn certifications in OpenAI, Claude, Copilot and more, and become great at AI fast - for work, startups or side hustles. It’s 100% free, as part of our mission to enable anyone to build with AI.
description_zh: Build Club Campus 是一个有趣、游戏化且由社区驱动的虚拟 AI 学校，旨在通过构建来学习 AI。静态课程在 AI 领域很快会过时，因此 Campus 通过精简课程、真实项目、基于角色的用例以及随工具演进的社区模板帮助您保持最新状态。获得 OpenAI、Claude、Copilot 等认证，并快速精通 AI——无论是为了工作、创业还是副业。它是 100% 免费的，作为我们使命的一部分，让任何人都能利用 AI 进行构建。

name: AppWizzy
tagline: Rent a private VM with Codex to build production apps
tagline_zh: 租用搭载 Codex 的私有虚拟机，构建生产级应用
description: AppWizzy gives you a private VM with Codex installed where you build, run, and host production web apps by chatting with AI. Your code is yours, the workspace persists, and the app lives in the same environment where it was created. Pay only for AI usage, hosting days, and optional templates
description_zh: AppWizzy 提供预装 Codex 的私有虚拟机，让你通过对话 AI 来构建、运行和托管生产级 Web 应用。代码归你所有，工作区持久保存，应用与创建环境一致。仅需为 AI 使用量、托管天数及可选模板付费。

name: Acti
tagline: Agentic keyboard for mobile commands and search
tagline_zh: 面向移动设备指令与搜索的 Agentic 键盘
description: Type what you need. Hold Acti Bar. Acti understands your intent and brings back the right result, link, or action - right where you are. Use Acti for live sports schedules, nearby restaurants, Notion docs, LinkedIn profiles, Meet links, Calendar actions, and custom workflows - without leaving the conversation.
description_zh: 输入所需内容，按住 Acti Bar。Acti 理解您的意图并返回正确的结果、链接或操作——就在您所在的界面。使用 Acti 查询实时体育赛事赛程、附近餐厅、Notion 文档、LinkedIn 个人资料、Meet 会议链接、日历操作和自定义工作流——无需离开当前对话。

Build from focused templates, preview on real paper, tailor versions by role, and let agents draft safely. And share it all on a clean tiny.cv url. Your agents can also use Tiny CV entirely by themselves, no human actions needed. Supports X402 and MPP out of the box.

tagline: Work across 20+ apps in Slack with multiplayer collaboration
tagline_zh: 在 Slack 中跨 20 多个应用进行多人协作
description: Slackbot’s new MCP Client ends fragmented AI work by connecting 20+ apps (Atlassian, Linear, Canva, Zoom) to one conversational interface. Ask Slackbot in plain language to act across tools—sign docs, update tickets, view dashboards—then share results in team channels for true multiplayer collaboration.
description_zh: Slackbot 的新 MCP 客户端通过将 20 多个应用（Atlassian、Linear、Canva、Zoom）连接到一个对话界面，终结了碎片化的 AI 工作。用自然语言要求 Slackbot 跨工具执行操作——签署文档、更新工单、查看仪表板——然后在团队频道中共享结果，实现真正的多人协作。
