tagline_zh: 快速、精准的语音识别，适用于生产级语音助手
description: Introducing Parrot: Ringg’s speech-to-text model for production-grade voice agents. Capture Hindi-heavy and noisy real-world conversations with low-latency inference, stronger transcript quality, and Hindi validation built for downstream workflows.
description_zh: Parrot 登场：Ringg 专为生产级语音助手打造的语音转文本模型。以低延迟推理、更优的转录质量以及专为下游工作流设计的印地语验证功能，精准捕捉充满印地语口音及嘈杂的真实对话场景。

name: Tabstack Structured Extraction
tagline: Extract web data into structured JSON, no scraper required.
tagline_zh: 无需爬虫即可将网页数据提取为结构化 JSON。
description: Define a schema, pass a URL, get back JSON that matches. Tabstack's extract endpoint turns any web page into structured output, no parsing code and no LLM call to maintain. generate endpoint adds AI instructions for reasoned answers, not raw fields. Both enforce your schema on every call, even when the page changes. Tune speed with effort levels, target any country with geo_target. Mozilla-backed: your data is never sold or used to train models. 10,000 free credits to start.
description_zh: 定义 Schema，传入 URL，即可获得匹配的结构化 JSON。Tabstack 的 extract 端点可将任意网页转化为结构化输出，无需维护解析代码或调用 LLM。generate 端点则添加 AI 指令以生成有理有据的答案，而非原始字段。无论页面如何变化，每次调用均强制执行您的 Schema。通过 effort levels 调节速度，利用 geo_target 定位任意国家。由 Mozilla 提供支持：您的数据永不出售，也不用于模型训练。注册即送 10,000 免费额度。

name: Edgee Fallback Models
tagline: Claude Code that never stops
tagline_zh: 永不休眠的 Claude Code
description: Your Claude Code session shouldn't die when Anthropic goes down or your plan runs out. Edgee Fallback Models keeps coding assistants running by routing to alternative models like Kimi K2.6, Gemma, GLM, or Qwen when Claude is unavailable, rate-limited, or just too expensive. Or one-click fallback to your own Bedrock, Vertex, or Azure account. Same Claude Code, different backend, zero code changes. Built for teams that can't afford to stop shipping.
description_zh: Anthropic 服务中断或套餐用尽时，您的 Claude Code 会话不应终止。Edgee Fallback Models 通过在 Claude 不可用、受限或成本过高时，自动路由至 Kimi K2.6、Gemma、GLM 或 Qwen 等替代模型，确保编码助手持续运行。也可一键回退至您自己的 Bedrock、Vertex 或 Azure 账户。相同的 Claude Code 体验，不同的后端支持，零代码修改。专为无法承受停摆的团队打造。

name: Napkin Math
tagline: personalized AI food journal + nutrition coach
tagline_zh: 个性化 AI 饮食记录与营养教练
description: Napkin Math is the personalized AI food journal that helps people achieve their health goals. as simple as taking a photo of your food so cute you'll share it with a friend
description_zh: Napkin Math 是一款个性化的 AI 饮食记录工具，助力用户达成健康目标。操作简便如拍摄食物照片，可爱到让你忍不住分享给朋友。

name: AskCodi
tagline: Orchestrate agents at scale while reducing cost
tagline_zh: 大规模编排代理同时降低成本
description: Tell Codi what you want to build. It writes the plan, runs AI agents in parallel across all your projects, and picks the cheapest model that can do each task, so you ship more and spend less. When you add a project it writes the charter and task list itself, and only pulls you in when a decision needs you, through one inbox.
description_zh: 告诉 Codi 你想要构建什么。它会制定计划，在所有项目中并行运行 AI 代理，并为每个任务选择最便宜的模型，这样你可以发布更多产品并减少支出。当你添加一个项目时，它会自行编写章程和任务列表，只有在需要决策时才会通过一个收件箱将你拉入。

topics.name: Mac
topics.description: The legendary foundations of Apple Computers. They're easy to use and easy to love. Go ahead, hop on the 🍎 bandwagon.

topics.name: Productivity
topics.description: If time is most precious, this collection of lifehacks is so so precious. Be more productive and optimize your life.

topics.name: Artificial Intelligence
topics.description:
Artificial intelligence powers products that can write, reason, analyze data, and take action for you. These categories cover the main ways AI is being built and used today.

- **[AI Agents](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-agents)** – Tools that use AI to plan, reason, and take actions across tools and workflows, often completing multi-step tasks with minimal human input.
- **[LLMs](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/llms)** – Platforms and tools built around large language models that enable text generation, understanding, and reasoning across many applications.
- **[AI Infrastructure](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-infrastructure)** – Products that support training, deploying, scaling, and evaluating AI models, including hosting, inference, data pipelines, and observability.
- **[AI Chatbots](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-chatbots)** – Applications that use AI to power conversational experiences for support, productivity, research, and user interaction.
- **[Predictive AI](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/predictive-ai)** – AI-powered tools that analyze data to forecast outcomes, detect patterns, and support decision-making.

name: Agent Mode on Arena
tagline: Get real-world tasks done with autonomous AI agents
tagline_zh: 利用自主 AI 智能体完成现实世界任务
description: Most AI benchmarks test models in controlled environments. Agent Mode tests them on complex tasks to get more work done. Run autonomous agents that browse, research, code, use files, and complete multi-step workflows from a single prompt. Then watch each workflow unfold step by step. Every run contributes to the Agent Arena Leaderboard, ranking frontier models by real-world agentic performance.
description_zh: 大多数 AI 基准测试在受控环境中评估模型。Agent Mode 则在复杂任务中测试模型，以完成更多工作。运行自主智能体，通过单一提示词即可实现浏览、研究、编程、文件处理及多步骤工作流。随后观察每个工作流的逐步展开过程。每次运行都将贡献于 Agent Arena 排行榜，根据前沿模型在真实世界中的智能体表现进行排名。

name: Notra Image Generation
tagline: Turn merged PRs into on-brand marketing visuals
tagline_zh: 将已合并的 PR 转化为符合品牌调性的营销视觉素材
description: Notra turns shipped work into changelogs, launch posts, and social updates in your voice.
description_zh: Notra 将已完成的工作转化为符合你个人风格的更新日志、发布博文和社交媒体动态。

name: API to MCP
tagline: Turn any API into an MCP server for AI agents
tagline_zh: 将任意 API 转换为供 AI 智能体使用的 MCP 服务器
description: API To MCP turns REST, GraphQL, SaaS, and internal business APIs into hosted MCP servers that AI agents can use in minutes. Build visually from the dashboard, or let an AI agent create, test, and deploy tools from API docs. End users can connect live MCP servers to ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Antigravity, or custom agents with OAuth, secure auth, workflows, and forkable snapshots.
description_zh: API To MCP 可将 REST、GraphQL、SaaS 及内部业务 API 快速转换为托管的 MCP 服务器，让 AI 智能体在几分钟内即可调用。通过仪表盘进行可视化构建，或让 AI 智能体根据 API 文档创建、测试并部署工具。最终用户可通过 OAuth、安全认证、工作流及可分叉快照，将实时 MCP 服务器连接至 ChatGPT、Claude、Codex、Cursor、VS Code、Antigravity 或自定义智能体。

name: Tamadoggo
tagline: A living journal for your pet's life, with AI insights
tagline_zh: 记录宠物一生的动态日记，辅以 AI 洞察
description: Most pet apps are clinical trackers. Tamadoggo is a living journal, a warm place to hold every walk, meal, vet visit and milestone. What stands out: gentle AI that never nags or diagnoses. It surfaces patterns across the timeline, gives breed and age-aware suggestions, scans a vet doc (photo or PDF) into auto-filled records, and writes a warm monthly letter. Each pet gets a "Crib", an illustrated home for their whole life. The free tier is also genuinely complete. PRO adds the AI magic.
description_zh: 大多数宠物应用仅是临床数据追踪器。Tamadoggo 则是一本充满温情的生活日记，珍藏每一次散步、用餐、兽医就诊和成长里程碑。其独特之处在于温和的 AI 助手：从不唠叨，也不做诊断。它能从时间线中梳理出规律，提供基于品种和年龄的建议，将兽医病历（照片或 PDF）扫描并自动填充为记录，还能撰写一封温暖的月度家书。每只宠物都拥有一个名为“Crib”的插画式人生主页。免费版功能已十分完整，PRO 版则解锁 AI 魔法。

name: Deliveryman.ai
tagline: Cold email infrastructure on autopilot without Gsuite
tagline_zh: 无需 Gsuite 即可实现冷邮件基础设施的全自动运行
description: Deliveryman.ai automates the hardest parts of cold email infrastructure mailbox setup, DNS records, warmup, email verification, sending systems, blacklist monitoring, reply management, and routing. Instead of spending weeks setting up your own cold email infrastructure and fixing deliverability issues, you can launch faster, scale confidently, and focus on what actually drives revenue. No G-suite required. Warmup, email list verification, Blacklist monitoring, etc. all included in one tool.
description_zh: Deliveryman.ai 自动化处理冷邮件基础设施中最棘手的环节，包括邮箱设置、DNS 记录配置、预热、邮箱验证、发送系统、黑名单监控、回复管理及路由转发。与其花费数周时间搭建自己的冷邮件基础设施并解决送达率问题，不如快速上线、自信扩展，并将精力集中在真正驱动收入的核心业务上。无需 Gsuite。预热、邮箱列表验证、黑名单监控等功能均已集成于单一工具中。

name: Edgee Turbo Models
tagline: Use Claude Code with Kimi K2.7 Code, MiniMax M2.7, and more
tagline_zh: 在 Kimi K2.7 Code、MiniMax M2.7 等模型中配合使用 Claude Code
description: Run state-of-the-art open-source models (GLM 5.1, Kimi K2.7 Code, MiniMax M2.7, and more) in Claude Code at up to 4× the speed (up to 200 tok/s) for a flat $29/month. Set up in minutes, no code changes.
description_zh: 以每月固定费用 29 美元，在 Claude Code 中运行最先进的开源模型（如 GLM 5.1、Kimi K2.7 Code、MiniMax M2.7 等），速度最高提升 4 倍（达 200 tok/s）。几分钟内即可完成设置，无需修改代码。

name: Athenic 2.0
tagline: A faster, smarter Athenic. Analyze on autopilot.
tagline_zh: 更快的、更聪明的 Athenic。自动分析。
description: Athenic is an AI agent for analyzing data and automating work. Connect your data, chat in plain English, and ship dashboards, reports, and automations. Built for startups to Fortune 500.
description_zh: Athenic 是一款用于数据分析和工作自动化的 AI 智能体。连接您的数据，用自然语言聊天，并生成仪表板、报告和自动化流程。适用于从初创公司到财富 500 强的各类企业。

name: Firecoach AI
tagline: AI roleplays that turn reps into top performers
tagline_zh: 让销售代表蜕变为顶尖高手的 AI 角色扮演
description: FireCoach.ai is the fastest way to clone your sales methodology and coach every rep on your team — at scale, without adding headcount. Build custom AI sales bots trained on your playbook, run rep roleplays, get scored feedback, and identify coaching gaps before they show up on a lost deal.
description_zh: FireCoach.ai 是克隆您的销售方法论并为团队每位代表提供规模化辅导的最快方式——无需增加人手。构建基于您销售手册训练的定制 AI 销售机器人，运行代表角色扮演，获取评分反馈，并在丢单前识别辅导差距。

name: Uiverse Design
tagline: De-slop your AI generated websites
tagline_zh: 去除 AI 生成网站的“AI味”
description: You can tell when an app was vibecoded. So can your users. That generic purple gradient, the pills and badges, emojis everywhere, it all screams: "an AI made this in 20 minutes." Uiverse Design is a library of AI-first design systems you can drop into any project. Each one defines real typography, spacing, color, images and component treatment. All of them ship with a DESIGN.md instructions file, so that your agent knows exactly how to use it. You just sit back, and watch your app transform.
description_zh: 你能一眼看出哪些应用是“氛围编码”出来的。你的用户也能。那种通用的紫色渐变、药丸形状的按钮和徽章、满屏的 emoji，都在大喊：“这是 AI 在 20 分钟内生成的。”Uiverse Design 是一套可嵌入任何项目的 AI 优先设计系统库。每个系统都定义了真实的排版、间距、颜色、图像和组件处理方式。所有系统均附带 DESIGN.md 说明文件，以便您的 AI 代理确切知道如何使用它。您只需坐享其成，看着您的应用焕然一新。

name: Step 3.7 Flash
tagline: Flash-speed agents model that can see and act
tagline_zh: 具备视觉感知和行动能力的闪电级智能体模型
description: An Apache 2.0 open-weight Flash model for real-world agents. Step 3.7 Flash combines vision, coding, search, tool use, 256K context, ~11B active params, and up to 400 TPS.
description_zh: 一款用于现实世界智能体的 Apache 2.0 开源权重 Flash 模型。Step 3.7 Flash 结合了视觉、编码、搜索、工具使用、256K 上下文、约 11B 活跃参数以及高达 400 TPS 的速度。

name: Kimi Work
tagline: The AI desktop for knowledge work
tagline_zh: 知识工作的 AI 桌面端
description: Kimi Work is a desktop agent for knowledge work. It connects to local files, uses WebBridge for browser automation, runs scheduled tasks, coordinates agent swarms, creates PPT/Excel/Word/PDF outputs, and includes native finance data tools.
description_zh: Kimi Work 是一款面向知识工作的桌面智能体。它可连接本地文件，通过 WebBridge 实现浏览器自动化，运行定时任务，协调智能体集群，创建 PPT/Excel/Word/PDF 输出，并包含原生金融数据工具。

name: Agentic videos by D-ID
tagline: Interactive videos that talk back
tagline_zh: 会回话的互动视频
description: Turn any video into an interactive AI experience. With Agentic Videos, viewers don't just watch - they pause, ask questions, get real-time answers, and interact with the presenter inside the video itself. Viewers experience content in a fully personalized way. Creators gain a new world of insight into knowledge gaps and intent: a viewer who asks three questions tells you more than a thousand passive completions ever could. Now on the D-ID platform, built with industry-leading expressive avatars.
description_zh: 将任何视频转化为互动式 AI 体验。通过 Agentic Videos，观众不再只是被动观看——他们可以暂停、提问并获得实时回答，甚至与视频中的演示者直接互动。观众以完全个性化的方式体验内容。创作者则能洞察知识盲区和用户意图：一个提出三个问题的观众所透露的信息，远超一千次被动完成的数据。现已登陆 D-ID 平台，采用行业领先的表达型虚拟人技术。

name: Zoona AI
tagline: Automated support that learns from docs + past conversations
tagline_zh: 基于文档和历史对话自动学习的智能客服
description: Sluggish, bloated, legacy support tools are dead. Zoona is support for modern teams — it learns from your docs and past conversations, then resolves 60%+ of tickets the second they land. No backlog. No burnout. No endless hiring to keep up. When it does need a human, it hands off with full context so the customer never repeats themselves. This is support that scales with you, not against you. Train it, go live, done.
description_zh: 笨重臃肿的传统支持工具已死。Zoona 专为现代团队打造——它能从你的文档和过往对话中学习，并在工单到达后的第一时间解决 60% 以上的问题。没有积压，没有倦怠，无需无休止地招聘来维持运转。当确实需要人工介入时，它会移交完整的上下文信息，让客户无需重复陈述。这是一种与你共同扩展的支持系统，而非与你对抗。训练它，上线，搞定。

name: ChatGPT Work
tagline: Partner for your most ambitious work
tagline_zh: 成就宏大愿景的合作伙伴
description: ChatGPT Work is an agent that can take action across your apps and files, stay with a project for hours if needed, and turn a goal into finished work.
description_zh: ChatGPT Work 是一款 Agent，可在你的各类应用与文件间跨平台执行操作，必要时可长时间跟进项目，并将目标转化为最终成果。

topics.name: Artificial Intelligence
topics.description:
Artificial intelligence powers products that can write, reason, analyze data, and take action for you. These categories cover the main ways AI is being built and used today.

- **[AI Agents](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-agents)** – Tools that use AI to plan, reason, and take actions across tools and workflows, often completing multi-step tasks with minimal human input.
- **[LLMs](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/llms)** – Platforms and tools built around large language models that enable text generation, understanding, and reasoning across many applications.
- **[AI Infrastructure](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-infrastructure)** – Products that support training, deploying, scaling, and evaluating AI models, including hosting, inference, data pipelines, and observability.
- **[AI Chatbots](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-chatbots)** – Applications that use AI to power conversational experiences for support, productivity, research, and user interaction.
- **[Predictive AI](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/predictive-ai)** – AI-powered tools that analyze data to forecast outcomes, detect patterns, and support decision-making.

name: AVTR-1 Real-Time Open Weights Model
tagline: Generating uncanny AI avatars is now open source
tagline_zh: 生成逼真 AI 虚拟人已开源
description: The best real-time avatar model in the world is now open source with open weights. Take the model, tweak it, and use it at $0 cost. What's unique: our model listens while you speak — full-duplex; the avatar reacts in real-time, with minimal latency. • Every frame is generated, avoiding annoying animation loops from pre-rendered playback. • Full streaming infrastructure included so you can get started right away.
description_zh: 全球最佳的实时虚拟人模型现已开源并开放权重。获取模型，进行调整，并以零成本使用。其独特之处在于全双工模式：模型在你说话的同时进行监听——虚拟人能以极低延迟做出实时反应。• 每一帧均由生成，避免了预渲染播放带来的令人厌烦的动画循环。• 包含完整的流媒体基础设施，助你即刻上手。

name: VoiceOS
tagline: Say it and it's done. JARVIS for your computer
tagline_zh: 口述即成，你的电脑专属 JARVIS
description: VoiceOS is the universal voice → action for your computer. Eliminates app-hopping, maximizes focus and productivity. Speak naturally, and VoiceOS instantly executes workflows while keeping you in control with a quick confirmation step. Works system-wide on Mac and Windows.
description_zh: VoiceOS 是面向你电脑的通用语音到操作转换工具。消除应用间切换，最大化专注力与生产力。自然说话，VoiceOS 即可即时执行工作流，并通过快速确认步骤让你保持掌控。支持 Mac 和 Windows 全系统运行。

name: Spectron
tagline: Agent memory you can trust
tagline_zh: 值得信赖的智能体记忆
description: Spectron is agent memory built on one ACID substrate. Graph, vectors, documents, and structured rows commit in one transaction. Every fact carries provenance. Corrections supersede, never overwrite. Hybrid retrieval fuses vectors, graph, BM25, and keywords. Traces feed back into ranking. Tri-temporal facts, multi-tenant scopes, and MCP support. No stitched stores. No sync pipelines.
description_zh: Spectron 是基于单一 ACID 底层的智能体记忆系统。图、向量、文档和结构化行在一个事务中提交。每个事实都带有溯源信息。修正覆盖原记录，而非简单覆盖。混合检索融合向量、图、BM25 和关键词。追踪反馈至排序机制。支持三重时间事实、多租户范围和 MCP 协议。无拼凑存储，无同步管道。

name: Lispr
tagline: Hold a key, speak, and Lispr writes it anywhere
tagline_zh: 按住一个键，说话，Lispr 将其输入到任意位置
description: Lispr is a free voice dictation and translation app for Mac and Windows. Hold a key, speak, release. Your words land in whatever app your cursor is in. Speak in ~99 languages and switch mid-sentence. Hold your translation key as well, and the translation lands instead, in any of 32 languages. Median latency 346 ms. The mic is off until you hold the key, and we never store your audio. No account, no model download, free.
description_zh: Lispr 是一款适用于 Mac 和 Windows 的免费语音听写和翻译应用。按住按键，说话，松开。你的文字会出现在光标所在的任何应用中。支持用约 99 种语言说话，并可在句子中间切换语言。同时按住翻译键，即可在 32 种语言中进行翻译。中位延迟为 346 毫秒。麦克风在未按住按键时处于关闭状态，且我们从不存储您的音频。无需账户，无需下载模型，完全免费。

name: Viktor for Microsoft Teams
tagline: The most powerful AI employee, now in Microsoft Teams
tagline_zh: 功能最强大的 AI 员工，现已登陆 Microsoft Teams
description: An autonomous AI employee that lives in Microsoft Teams and does real work across 3,000+ tools: reports, reconciliations, approvals, recurring ops. Not a copilot that drafts and waits. It ships. Live today, $100 in credits, no card.
description_zh: 一位居住在 Microsoft Teams 中的自主 AI 员工，可在 3,000 多种工具中执行实际工作：报告、对账、审批、常规运营。它不是起草后等待指令的 Copilot，而是直接交付成果。今日上线，赠送 $100 额度，无需信用卡。

name: GPT-Live
tagline: Full-duplex voice for ChatGPT
tagline_zh: ChatGPT 的全双工语音功能

API-first products make it easy for developers to build, integrate, and scale software. Check out these categories to explore the tools and platforms teams use to ship and adopt APIs:

- **[Unified APIs](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/unified-api)** – APIs that abstract multiple services behind a single interface, making integrations faster and reducing maintenance overhead.
- **[Platforms](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/platforms)** – Developer platforms that expose APIs as the primary way to access infrastructure, data, or services.
- **[AI Infrastructure](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-infrastructure)** – Infrastructure products that provide APIs for model inference, embeddings, data pipelines, and AI system orchestration.
- **[Authentication & Identity](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/authentication-identity)** – APIs for handling user authentication, authorization, identity management, and access control.

topics.name: Artificial Intelligence
topics.description:
Artificial intelligence powers products that can write, reason, analyze data, and take action for you. These categories cover the main ways AI is being built and used today.

- **[AI Agents](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-agents)** – Tools that use AI to plan, reason, and take actions across tools and workflows, often completing multi-step tasks with minimal human input.
- **[LLMs](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/llms)** – Platforms and tools built around large language models that enable text generation, understanding, and reasoning across many applications.
- **[AI Infrastructure](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-infrastructure)** – Products that support training, deploying, scaling, and evaluating AI models, including hosting, inference, data pipelines, and observability.
- **[AI Chatbots](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-chatbots)** – Applications that use AI to power conversational experiences for support, productivity, research, and user interaction.
- **[Predictive AI](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/predictive-ai)** – AI-powered tools that analyze data to forecast outcomes, detect patterns, and support decision-making.

name: Integuru
tagline: Generate fast, reliable APIs for any platform. No browsers
tagline_zh: 为任何平台快速生成可靠的 API。无需浏览器
description: Integuru generates fast, reliable APIs for any platform, without browsers or RPA. API calls complete in ~3 seconds with 99.9%+ success. Most agents today use browser automation to control web apps that lack official APIs, but this is slow and brittle. Integuru replaces browsers entirely and connects directly with the backend. Integuru covers authentication and edge cases. Integrations get auto-healing, API docs, and a 24/7 on-call maintenance team. Each API is generated end-to-end in minutes.
description_zh: Integuru 为任何平台快速生成可靠的 API，无需浏览器或 RPA。API 调用在约 3 秒内完成，成功率超过 99.9%。目前大多数 AI 代理使用浏览器自动化来控制缺乏官方 API 的 Web 应用，但这既缓慢又脆弱。Integuru 完全取代了浏览器，直接与后端连接。Integuru 涵盖身份验证和边缘情况处理。集成具备自愈能力，提供 API 文档，并拥有 24/7 的待命维护团队。每个 API 均在几分钟内端到端生成。

name: HarnessRouter
tagline: Bring the world's best AI agents into your app, with one API
tagline_zh: 通过一个 API 将世界最好的 AI 代理引入您的应用
description: Building an AI agent backend yourself takes months: sandboxes, orchestration, retries, cost controls. HarnessRouter runs it for you. One API in, finished work out: code, files, videos, games. Trusted by top medical research institutions, leading healthcare companies, and cutting-edge startups in multiple domains.
description_zh: 自己构建 AI 代理后端需要数月时间：沙箱、编排、重试、成本控制。HarnessRouter 为您运行它。一个 API 输入，完成的工作输出：代码、文件、视频、游戏。受到顶尖医学研究机构、领先医疗保健公司和多个领域前沿初创公司的信任。

description_zh: 认识 Mellum，这是一个快速语言模型家族，其中包括一款用于超低延迟和高性能推理的下一代模型。

name: Linear Diffs
tagline: A new way to review PRs, directly inside Linear
tagline_zh: 一种全新的 PR 审查方式，直接在 Linear 中进行
description: Introducing Linear Diffs to make reviewing code a fast and fluid experience native to Linear. You can now review diffs from any issue with a PR, iterate on further changes with agents, and ship code from Linear. All reviews in Linear sync back to GitHub, so the current state of review work is always clear. Linear Diffs is available now on all plans.
description_zh: 隆重推出 Linear Diffs，旨在让代码审查成为 Linear 原生中快速流畅的体验。你现在可以从任何带有 PR 的问题中审查差异，与代理协作迭代后续更改，并从 Linear 发布代码。Linear 中的所有审查都会同步回 GitHub，因此审查工作的当前状态始终清晰可见。Linear Diffs 现已在所有计划中可用。

name: AI Emaily
tagline: Your AI inbox that writes like you + replies on autopilot
tagline_zh: 像您一样写作并自动回复的 AI 收件箱
description: AI Emaily is the AI-native inbox that runs like your chief of staff. It reads every message, triages what actually needs you, and quiets the noise. It drafts replies in your own voice — not generic AI text — then schedules and sends across Gmail, Outlook, and any provider from one inbox. Three modes: Manual, Copilot, Autopilot. You approve, it acts, with undo and a full audit trail on everything. Your mail is never used to train models. Start free.
description_zh: AI Emaily 是一个原生的 AI 收件箱，运作方式如同您的首席幕僚。它阅读每一条信息，分类出真正需要您处理的内容，并过滤掉噪音。它以您自己的语气起草回复——而非通用的 AI 文本——然后从单一收件箱跨 Gmail、Outlook 及任何提供商安排并发送邮件。三种模式：手动、Copilot、Autopilot。您批准，它执行，并对所有内容提供撤销功能和完整的审计追踪。您的邮件绝不会用于训练模型。免费开始使用。

tagline: Your 24/7 AI Chief of Staff for commitments and follow-ups
tagline_zh: 你全天候的 AI 幕僚长，负责承诺事项和后续跟进
description: Your team’s work lives in project management tools and CRMs. Your exec work is scattered. readywhen catches every decision and commitment across Slack, email, meetings, and docs. Without being asked, it drafts what’s needed next: the brief, the email response, the update. You just approve. It's like having your own Chief of Staff, 24/7.
description_zh: 你团队的工作存在于项目管理工具和 CRM 中，而你的高管工作却分散各处。readywhen 能捕捉 Slack、电子邮件、会议和文档中的每一个决策和承诺。无需询问，它会自动起草下一步所需的内容：简报、邮件回复或更新。你只需批准即可。这就像拥有一位 24/7 在线的专属幕僚长。

name: HAQQ Legal AI on Mobile
tagline: Bringing legal understanding to anyone with a phone
tagline_zh: 将法律理解带给任何拥有手机的人
description: We built HAQQ because understanding legal situations shouldn’t depend on who you know or whether you can afford to “just ask a lawyer.” Today, HAQQ Legal AI is available on mobile. Upload a contract. Ask a legal question. Get structured, jurisdiction-aware legal work with risk flags and exportable outputs. Not generic chat. Legal reasoning powered by Justinian®. Know exactly where you stand, wherever you are.
description_zh: 我们构建 HAQQ 是因为理解法律状况不应取决于你认识谁或是否负担得起“直接问律师”的费用。如今，HAQQ Legal AI 已登陆移动端。上传合同。提出法律问题。获取结构化、具备司法管辖区意识且带有风险标记和法律 AI 推理（由 Justinian® 驱动）的输出结果，并支持导出。这不是通用的聊天机器人。无论身在何处，都能确切知晓你的法律立场。

name: CreateOS Sandbox
tagline: Instant, hardware Isolated Sandboxes for AI agents
tagline_zh: AI智能体的即时硬件隔离沙箱
description: CreateOS Sandbox gives AI agent builders their own fast, secure, hardware isolated, sandbox in ~30ms (p90). We have suit of CLI, SDK, 50+ SDK real world examples, claude plugins, computeSDK integration, and more
description_zh: CreateOS Sandbox为AI智能体构建者提供自己的快速、安全、硬件隔离的沙箱，约30毫秒内（p90）。我们提供CLI套件、SDK、50多个SDK实际应用示例、claude插件、computeSDK集成等。

tagline_zh: 让你的代理进行交易
description: Customers can connect their own AI agents to Robinhood to help manage and automate trading and credit card purchases, with built-in safety controls and a real-time activity feed. Trade in a dedicated agentic account to stay in control of every trade your agent makes.
description_zh: 客户可以将自己的 AI 代理连接到 Robinhood，以帮助管理和自动化交易及信用卡购买，内置安全控制功能和实时活动流。在专用的代理账户中进行交易，掌控代理执行的每一笔交易。

name: Cotypist
tagline: Local AI Autocomplete in your voice, anywhere on your Mac
tagline_zh: Mac 上任意位置的本地 AI 语音自动补全
description: Cotypist is smart autocomplete for the Mac apps you already write in: Mail, Slack, Notes, docs, even AI prompts. Press Tab when a suggestion fits, or keep typing and watch it update in real time. Runs locally on your Mac. No cloud, no API calls.
description_zh: Cotypist 是为你已在使用的 Mac 应用程序（如 Mail、Slack、Notes、文档，甚至 AI 提示词）提供的智能自动补全工具。当建议符合需求时按下 Tab 键，或继续输入并观察其实时更新。在 Mac 本地运行。无需云端，无需 API 调用。

name: MonoCloud for Startups
tagline: One identity layer for your customers, APIs, and agents
tagline_zh: 面向客户、API和智能体的统一身份层
description: MonoCloud is one identity layer for your customers, your APIs, and your agents. Most tools stop at a login box. We go past login into authorization and accountability: decide exactly what every user, service, and AI agent can access, prove what it did, and revoke it in an instant. Fine-grained Cedar authorization, passkeys and SSO, API protection, M2M, and mTLS with certificate-bound trust, all on one platform. Startups get the full platform free for one year.
description_zh: MonoCloud是面向您的客户、API和智能体的统一身份层。大多数工具只停留在登录框层面。我们超越登录进入授权和责任领域：精确决定每个用户、服务和AI智能体可以访问什么，证明其操作，并即时撤销。细粒度Cedar授权、passkeys和SSO、API保护、M2M和具有证书绑定信任的mTLS，全部在一个平台上。初创公司可免费获得完整平台一年。

description: Memori launched its new agent-native memory infrastructure, enabling agents to create structured, long-term memory directly from agent trace — including execution paths, tool results, workflow steps, outcomes, and decision-making logic. This allows memory to also be generated from what an agent actually does. Benchmark results: 81.95% accuracy on LoCoMo using only 1,294 tokens per query, roughly 5% of full-context cost, saving users 95%+ on inference spend. 15K GitHub stars, 200000+ downloads
description_zh: Memori 推出了全新的智能体原生记忆基础设施，使智能体能够直接从智能体轨迹（包括执行路径、工具结果、工作流步骤、结果和决策逻辑）中创建结构化的长期记忆。这意味着记忆也可以从智能体的实际行为中生成。基准测试结果：在 LoCoMo 上仅使用每查询 1,294 个 token 即达到 81.95% 的准确率，约为完整上下文成本的 5%，为用户节省 95% 以上的推理支出。GitHub 星标数 15K，下载量超过 200,000

description: Juno is a local, open-source voice writing app for Mac. It is the only voice dictation tool with live transcriptions. No login, runs offline and free forever.
description_zh: Juno 是一款适用于 Mac 的本地开源语音写作应用。它是唯一支持实时转录的语音输入工具。在邮件、Slack、备忘录、Cursor 或你正在使用的任何应用中自然说话；Juno 会生成整洁的文字，重写选定的段落，使用片段，并创建备忘录、提醒事项和闹钟。无需登录，离线运行，永久免费。

tagline: Give your AI agent live market signals
tagline_zh: 为你的AI智能体提供实时市场信号
description: MentionDrop MCP connects Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, and other MCP-aware agents to live brand monitoring. Your agent pulls brand mentions, competitor conversations, and public customer pain from bounded high-signal sources (Reddit, Google News, search, selected public web), triages them, and drafts replies for your review. 11 tools, account-scoped API keys, nothing auto-posted. Ask "what should I pay attention to today?" and get an answer you can act on.
description_zh: MentionDrop MCP将Claude、Cursor、Windsurf及其他支持MCP的智能体连接到实时品牌监控。你的智能体从限定高信号源（Reddit、Google新闻、搜索、精选公共网络）抓取品牌提及、竞争对手对话和公开客户痛点，进行分类处理，并起草供你审核的回复。11个工具，账户级API密钥，绝不自动发布。询问“我今天应该关注什么？”并获得可执行的答案。

description_zh: GitHits 让编程代理能够访问你的应用程序所依赖的开源代码。获取真实的实现示例、依赖项源码导航、包检查和文档。代理可以搜索和阅读你的代码库，但它们无法搜索和阅读你的应用程序所依赖的开源代码，而这正是它们开始猜测、重试和陷入循环的地方。GitHits 按需构建版本感知的索引。代理可以搜索、导航和检查其依赖项背后的代码。CLI：npx githits@latest init

name: Retina
tagline: Screen recorder w/ auto-zoom, smooth cursors, + AI graphics
tagline_zh: 带自动缩放、平滑光标及 AI 图形的屏幕录制工具
description: Retina is a Mac screen recorder built for polished demos. Auto-zoom into the action. Cursor paths cleaned into smooth arcs. 4K export, optimized file sizes. Recordings look cinematic out of the box — no post-production needed. Built for product demos, tutorials, and feature walkthroughs that need to look professional without hours in editing. Currently in beta. Free. No watermark. Made by BlendPixel.
description_zh: Retina 是一款专为制作精美演示而设计的 Mac 屏幕录制软件。自动聚焦关键操作区域。光标轨迹优化为平滑弧线。支持 4K 导出与文件体积优化。录制效果自带电影质感，无需后期制作。专为需要专业外观的产品演示、教程和功能导览设计，免去数小时的编辑时间。目前处于测试阶段。免费使用，无水印。由 BlendPixel 开发。

name: SlimSnap
tagline: Your AI doesn't know which button you mean
tagline_zh: 你的 AI 不知道你说的是哪个按钮
description: The AI reads your screenshot as a pixel blob and guesses which button you meant. SlimSnap converts the screenshot plus your annotation into structured JSON: every element has coordinates, an ID, and your arrow points at a specific one. Around 700 tokens vs 1,568 raw on Sonnet. Free Mac app. Schema and Claude Code skill are open MIT. Runs entirely on-device.
description_zh: AI 将你的截图视为像素块并猜测你指的是哪个按钮。SlimSnap 将截图和你的标注转换为结构化 JSON：每个元素都有坐标、ID，且你的箭头指向特定元素。在 Sonnet 上仅需约 700 个 token，而原始数据为 1,568 个。免费 Mac 应用。Schema 和 Claude Code 技能采用 MIT 开源协议。完全在本地运行。

name: pumaDB
tagline: a small hosted memory layer for AI agents
tagline_zh: 面向 AI Agent 的小型托管记忆层
description: Most AI agent workflows lose useful context between sessions, tools, and chats. The usual fixes are either too manual, like copying notes into docs, or too heavy, like setting up a database, vector store, or custom RAG stack. pumaDB gives agents a simple shared place to save and reuse notes, facts, preferences, project context, transcripts, task state, and other useful memory. No database setup, vector DB, or infrastructure to manage
description_zh: 大多数 AI Agent 工作流在会话、工具和聊天之间丢失有用的上下文。常见的解决方案要么太手动（如将笔记复制到文档中），要么太重（如设置数据库、向量存储或自定义 RAG 栈）。pumaDB 为 Agent 提供了一个简单的共享空间，用于保存和重用笔记、事实、偏好、项目上下文、转录内容、任务状态和其他有用记忆。无需数据库设置、向量数据库或基础设施管理。

name: Nugget AI
tagline: Turn customer interviews into your product roadmap
tagline_zh: 将客户访谈转化为你的产品路线图
description: Nugget AI turns customer interviews into product evidence. Record or upload calls → AI extracts pain points and feature requests → synthesis surfaces themes → auto-generated PRDs with real customer quotes → dev-ready handoff to Linear & GitHub. NEW: MCP server. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or Codex — your AI agent can search every interview and draft specs grounded in real evidence. No more copy-pasting. Half the price of Dovetail.
description_zh: Nugget AI 将客户访谈转化为产品证据。录制或上传通话 → AI 提取痛点和功能请求 → 综合呈现主题 → 自动生成包含真实客户引语的 PRD → 准备就绪后移交至 Linear 和 GitHub。新功能：MCP 服务器。连接 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor 或 Codex —— 你的 AI Agent 可以搜索每次访谈，并基于真实证据起草规范。不再需要复制粘贴。价格仅为 Dovetail 的一半。

name: Axol
tagline: Automate physical work with a powerful robot
tagline_zh: 用强大的机器人自动化物理工作
description: Axol is a dual-arm robot designed for teams automating real work with physical AI. Easy data collection, long reach, and a high range of motion means you can automate work that matters.
description_zh: Axol 是一款双臂机器人，专为团队利用物理 AI 自动化实际工作而设计。轻松的数据采集、长臂展和高自由度意味着你可以自动化真正重要的工作。

name: Enshittifier
tagline: Chrome extension that replaces "AI" with 💩
tagline_zh: 将“AI”替换为 💩 的 Chrome 扩展程序
description: The Mac app started as a dumb question: can you use font ligatures to turn AI into 💩? Turns out yes. Ironically, I used AI to figure out how. The Chrome extension came after — web fonts don't always cooperate. So mostly this is me poking fun. It's also a small nudge to be a little more mindful of the din around AI. Starting, apparently, with your font files.
description_zh: 这个 Mac 应用源于一个愚蠢的问题：你能用字体连字把 AI 变成 💩 吗？事实证明可以。讽刺的是，我用了 AI 来找出方法。Chrome 扩展程序随后推出——网页字体并不总是配合。所以这主要是我在开玩笑。这也是一个小提醒，让我们对 AI 的喧嚣保持一点觉察。显然，从你的字体文件开始。

name: Bob's CLI
tagline: A local-first AI coding CLI that adapts to you
tagline_zh: 一款以本地优先的 AI 编码 CLI，随你而变
description: Bob's CLI runs on your own hardware with zero API costs, zero data leaving your machine. Bob lives in your terminal, sees your actual files, and writes code only with your explicit approval. What makes it different: auto-detect local AI models, behavioral DNA profiling that adapts to how YOU work, autonomous code review + auto-fix, conversation forking, deep dives, and SovereignLink — remote execution from any device while your code stays home. Free to start. Sovereign by design.
description_zh: Bob 的 CLI 运行在您自己的硬件上，零 API 成本，数据绝不离开您的设备。Bob 驻留在您的终端中，查看您的实际文件，仅在您明确批准的情况下编写代码。它的独特之处：自动检测本地 AI 模型、根据您的工作习惯进行行为 DNA 画像分析、自主代码审查与自动修复、对话分支、深度探索以及 SovereignLink——在您的代码保留本地的同时，可从任何设备进行远程执行。免费开始使用。天生主权设计。

name: Web Clipper for NotebookLM
tagline: Your ultimate NotebookLM's Chrome Extension
tagline_zh: NotebookLM 的终极 Chrome 扩展程序
description: NotebookLM, supercharged from both ends. • Clip in: one click saves any web page, PDF, AI chat, Reddit thread, tweet or a YouTube video, channel, or playlist (cherry-pick which videos to include). • Export out: NotebookLM's flashcards to Anki, mind maps to Obsidian, reports to Word/PDF, full chats to Markdown. • Stay in sync: Google Drive sources auto-refresh in the background. • UI blends in like Google built it.
description_zh: NotebookLM，两端增强。• 输入：一键保存任何网页、PDF、AI 聊天、Reddit 帖子、推文或 YouTube 视频、频道或播放列表（可选择包含哪些视频）。• 输出：将 NotebookLM 的抽认卡导出至 Anki，思维导图导出至 Obsidian，报告导出至 Word/PDF，完整聊天记录导出为 Markdown。• 保持同步：Google Drive 源在后台自动刷新。• 界面风格与 Google 原生产品无缝融合。

name: MemoryCustodian
tagline: Repo-native memory for coding agents
description: MemoryCustodian gives Codex, Claude Code, Gemini, and other coding agents durable project memory—without a hosted service or bloating every prompt. Decisions, constraints, rejected approaches, and project context live as plain Markdown in your repo, where they can be reviewed, versioned, shared, and deleted like code. A manifest loads only the memory relevant to each task. Open source, local-first, and cross-agent.

description: Town is the unusually helpful AI assistant. It learns how you work, not the other way around: your voice, your people, your patterns. It works where you do, across email, calendar, docs, and messages. It drafts your replies, handles your scheduling, and builds routines for the work you repeat. The more it learns, the more it does on its own, so your time goes to the work only you can do.o big ideas.
description_zh: Town 是一款格外有用的 AI 助手。它学习您的工作方式，而非让您适应它：您的声音、您的同事、您的习惯。它在您工作的地方发挥作用，涵盖电子邮件、日历、文档和消息。它起草您的回复，处理您的日程安排，并为您的重复性工作建立常规。它学得越多，独立承担的工作就越多，从而让您的时间专注于只有您能完成的重要工作。

name: Novus
tagline: Catch and fix usability issues automatically as you ship
tagline_zh: 在发布过程中自动捕获并修复可用性问题
description: Novus is the product agent built for teams that ship fast. Connect your codebase and Novus automatically instruments, analyzes, and improves your product — no manual setup. It monitors continuously, flags usability issues proactively, and delivers intelligence for engineers and PMs.
description_zh: Novus 是专为快速交付产品的团队打造的产品智能体。连接你的代码库，Novus 会自动进行仪器化、分析和改进——无需手动设置。它持续监控，主动标记可用性问题，并为工程师和 PM 提供情报支持。

name: UnitPay
tagline: Price, bill, and prove value for your AI product
tagline_zh: 为您的 AI 产品定价、计费并证明其价值。
description: UnitPay is the monetization OS for AI companies. Design pricing, run usage-based billing, track inference costs and margins in real time, and show every customer the value they're actually getting — all in one system. Built ground-up for AI-native products: credits, hybrid pricing, per-token metering, cost tracking. Free until you hit $500K ARR.
description_zh: UnitPay 是 AI 公司的变现操作系统。您可以在此设计定价策略、运行基于使用量的计费、实时跟踪推理成本和利润率，并向每位客户展示他们实际获得的价值——所有功能集成在一个系统中。专为 AI 原生产品从头构建：支持积分、混合定价、按 token 计量及成本追踪。在达到 50 万美元 ARR 之前免费。

description_zh: 最佳 AI 语音，现已赋予形象。在一个地方，通过脚本、语音和虚拟形象创建工作室级别的口播视频。

name: Basedash Suggestions
tagline: Your AI data analyst, now with ideas of its own.
tagline_zh: 您的 AI 数据分析师，现在有了自己的想法。
description: Basedash now suggests the analysis before you ask. It studies your connected data, your past chats, and the dashboards you've built, then generates personalized suggestions — questions worth asking, dashboards worth building, automations worth scheduling. Click one and the work starts. Used ideas are replaced with fresh ones, so the well never runs dry. Every suggestion is generated per person, for growth, finance, and ops alike. No more blank page. Your analyst makes the first move.
description_zh: Basedash 现在会在您询问之前提供建议。它研究您的连接数据、过去的聊天记录和您构建的仪表板，然后生成个性化建议 — 值得提出的问题、值得构建的仪表板、值得安排的自动化。点击一个，工作就开始了。使用过的想法会被新的想法取代，因此灵感永不枯竭。每个建议都是为每个人生成的，适用于增长、财务和运营。不再有空白页面。您的分析师迈出第一步。

tagline: Your voice-supported AI financial planning partner
tagline_zh: 你的人工智能财务规划伙伴，支持语音交互
description: One voice conversation. Free financial plan. We built Warren because financial planning was broken for anyone without a six-figure portfolio. IFAs charge £200/hr. Spreadsheets go stale. Generic apps tell you what you already know. Warren shows you two futures: what happens if you do nothing and what changes if you act. Then Warren gives you a set of next steps, tracks your progress, and monitors your plan against economic changes. Join 3K+ Brits already using Warren. 10 mins to start.
description_zh: 一次语音对话，免费获得财务规划方案。我们创建 Warren 是因为对于没有六位数的投资组合的人来说，财务规划曾经非常糟糕。IFA（独立财务顾问）收费高达 200 英镑/小时。电子表格容易过时。通用应用只会告诉你已知信息。Warren 为你展示两种未来：如果什么都不做会发生什么，以及采取行动后会有什么改变。然后，Warren 会给你一系列下一步行动建议，跟踪你的进展，并根据经济变化监控你的计划。已有 3000 多名英国用户使用 Warren。只需 10 分钟即可开始。

name: Monogram AI
tagline: AI with a visual and interactive interface
tagline_zh: 具有可视化交互界面的 AI
description: We want to share our new iOS App. Ask anything and Monogram responds with a visual, interactive interface instead of a wall of text. We created a technology that generates an entire user interface on the fly, in just a few seconds. With a consistent and crafted user experience. We designed Monogram for everyday use cases, whether you’re looking for something to watch, finding a recipe, planning a trip, or anything else on your mind.
description_zh: 我们要分享我们的新 iOS 应用。提出任何问题，Monogram 都会以可视化、交互式的界面作为回应，而不是一堆文字。我们创造了一种技术，能够在短短几秒内即时生成整个用户界面，并提供一致且精心设计的用户体验。Monogram 专为日常使用场景设计，无论您是在寻找观看内容、查找食谱、规划旅行，还是有其他想法。

name: SeaTicket
tagline: Al agent that resolves issues across all your channels
tagline_zh: 能够解决所有渠道问题的 AI 代理
description: Software teams are drowning in a sea of fragmented issues across GitHub, Discourse and emails. Valuable feedback is often buried under noise. SeaTicket transforms community support by syncing these into a single workspace. What makes it different? Full Context: Bring related issues and documents when solving an issue. AI Agents: Built-in agents autonomously suggest resolutions using existing documents and previous issues. Stop digging for context. Start resolving.
description_zh: 软件团队正淹没在 GitHub、Discourse 和电子邮件中碎片化问题的海洋里。宝贵的反馈往往被噪音掩盖。SeaTicket 通过将这些内容同步到一个单一的工作区来变革社区支持。它的不同之处在哪里？完整上下文：解决问题时关联相关问题与文档。AI 代理：内置代理利用现有文档和历史问题自主建议解决方案。停止挖掘上下文，开始解决问题。

name: MockPilot
tagline: Turn live websites into editable mockups
tagline_zh: 将实时网站转化为可编辑的线框图
description: MockPilot turns any live webpage into an editable mockup on your desktop. Use natural language - no design or coding skills needed. 📸 Capture full pages or single components from any URL 🎨 Auto-extracts typography, colors, components & icons into a reusable asset library 💬 Edit in plain English — just tell the AI what to change, and it uses your assets to keep everything on-brand 📦 Export as clean, standalone HTML Free & open source. macOS + Windows.
description_zh: MockPilot 将任何实时网页转化为桌面上可编辑的线框图。使用自然语言——无需设计或编码技能。📸 从任意 URL 捕获整页或单个组件 🎨 自动提取排版、颜色、组件和图标到可重用的资产库 💬 用纯英语编辑——只需告诉 AI 要更改什么，它会使用您的资产保持品牌一致性 📦 导出为干净、独立的 HTML 免费且开源。macOS + Windows。

name: Tabstack Browser Automation
tagline: Automate the web in your app or agent, no browser to host
tagline_zh: 在您的应用或 Agent 中自动化网页操作，无需托管浏览器
description: Give /automate a task in plain English and it drives a real browser to do it: navigate a site, click through a multi-step flow, fill a form, reach a page that only renders after interaction. The result streams back in one API call. It's an API you call, not a framework you install. Browser and LLM included, nothing to host, no concurrency ceiling. Accessibility-tree automation spends 60 to 80% fewer tokens than screenshot-based agents. Built by Mozilla. Ephemeral, no training on your data.
description_zh: 用自然语言描述任务，它即可驱动真实浏览器执行：导航网站、完成多步骤流程、填写表单、访问需交互后才能渲染的页面。结果通过单次 API 调用返回。这是一个您调用的 API，而非您安装的框架。内置浏览器与 LLM，无需托管，无并发上限。基于无障碍树（Accessibility tree）的自动化比基于截图的 Agent 节省 60% 至 80% 的 Token 消耗。由 Mozilla 打造。临时运行，不对您的数据进行训练。

description: Manta AI is an autonomous testing agent for web applications. Give it a URL and it explores your app the way a real user would — mapping flows, finding bugs, and generating self-healing test cases. Describe a flow in plain English and Manta tests it for you, no script required. When your UI changes, the tests adapt on their own. Run the agent locally on any machine or server — test apps behind a firewall, on a private network, or even on localhost. Free tier open. No card required.
description_zh: Manta AI 是一个 Web 应用自主测试代理。给它一个 URL，它会像真实用户一样探索您的应用程序 — 映射流程、发现错误并生成自愈测试用例。用简单的英语描述一个流程，Manta 会为您测试，无需脚本。当您的 UI 发生变化时，测试会自行适应。在任何机器或服务器上本地运行代理 — 测试防火墙后、私有网络上甚至 localhost 上的应用程序。免费层开放。无需信用卡。

name: Manifest
tagline: Turn any webpage into an action manifest for AI agents
tagline_zh: 将任何网页转化为 AI 代理的行动清单
description: Manifest turns any webpage into a structured JSON map of what an AI agent can click, fill, and submit. One API call, no fragile selectors. Every action comes with resolved CSS/role locators, plus a requires field that encodes dependencies between elements (e.g. "select a plan before this button is clickable"). That's context aria snapshots don't give you. Python SDK, LangChain support, and an MCP server included. Built for anyone shipping browser agents.
description_zh: Manifest 将任何网页转化为 AI 代理可点击、填写和提交内容的结构化 JSON 地图。一次 API 调用，无需脆弱的选择器。每个操作都附带解析后的 CSS/角色定位器，以及一个编码元素间依赖关系的 requires 字段（例如“在按钮可点击之前选择一个计划”）。这是 aria 快照无法提供的上下文信息。包含 Python SDK、LangChain 支持和 MCP 服务器。为所有正在开发浏览器代理的人打造。

description: Most inbox tools make you build rules first. PureBox skips that - it's personalized from your first scan using AI and your own Gmail history (which senders you open, reply to, or let pile up), so suggestions fit your routine on day one. Every suggestion shows why, and nothing moves until you approve - no black box, no silent deletions. It surfaces what needs your attention, not just what to trash. Your data is never sold; Pro subscriptions fund it.
description_zh: 大多数收件箱工具都需要您先建立规则。PureBox skips 这个步骤 - 它是使用 AI 和您的 Gmail 历史（您打开、回复或让积压的发送者）进行个人化的，从第一扫描开始，因此建议符合您的日常习惯。每个建议都会显示原因，并且不会在您批准之前移动任何内容 - 没有黑盒子，没有静默删除。它会表面需要您的注意事项，而不是只是要丢弃的内容。您的数据永远不会出售；专业订阅资金它。

name: uwait
tagline: Get paid while AI thinks
tagline_zh: AI 思考时，你也能赚钱
description: Every time you use ChatGPT or Claude, you wait. Usually 3 to 8 seconds. That's it. That's the idea. uwait is a Chrome extension that shows a curated ad during that loading screen. You get a small cut. The publishers whose content trained the AI get a cut too. The advertiser gets your attention at a moment when you're actually paying attention. The split: 50% to users, 30% to publishers, 20% to us. We're picky about advertisers. Just brands that make sense in that context.
description_zh: 每次使用 ChatGPT 或 Claude 时，你都需要等待，通常是 3 到 8 秒。这就是核心理念。uwait 是一款 Chrome 扩展程序，在加载界面期间展示精选广告。你能获得少量分成，训练 AI 内容的出版商也能获得分成。广告商则在你真正专注的时刻获取你的注意力。分成比例为：用户 50%，出版商 30%，我们 20%。我们对广告主有严格筛选，只选择在该语境下合理的品牌。

name: OpenArt Director
tagline: Direct cinematic videos through chat
tagline_zh: 通过聊天直接生成电影级视频
description: OpenArt Director lets you create cinematic AI videos simply by chatting. Generate videos up to 5 minutes long with consistent characters, scenes, voice, music, and visual style throughout. Director develops story arcs, plans scenes, maintains continuity, and helps refine videos through natural conversation - acting more like a creative director than a traditional video generator. You're not generating clips anymore - you're directing stories.
description_zh: OpenArt Director 让你只需通过聊天即可创建电影级 AI 视频。生成长达 5 分钟的视频，保持角色、场景、配音、音乐和视觉风格的一致性。Director 负责发展故事线、规划场景、维持连续性，并通过自然对话帮助优化视频——其作用更像创意总监而非传统的视频生成器。你不再是在生成片段，而是在导演故事。

tagline_zh: 您的个人健康伴侣，由 ChatGPT 驱动。

Connect your health data, medical records, and wellness apps to get more personalized insights, track changes over time, prepare for appointments, understand results, and build healthier routines — all while staying in control of what you share.
description_zh: Health in ChatGPT 帮助您通过将健康信息整合到一个对话中来更好地理解和应对您的健康状况。连接您的健康数据、医疗记录和健康应用，获取更个性化的见解，跟踪变化趋势，为就诊做准备，理解检查结果，并建立更健康的生活规律——同时保持对您分享内容的控制权。

tagline: Ad-free Pinterest Alternative with AI content filtering
tagline_zh: 无广告 Pinterest 替代品，具备 AI 内容过滤功能
description: Moodloom is an ad-free visual discovery platform for those fed up of Pinterest. Save and explore fashion, decor, and art - without the noise. We have built Save to Moodloom Extension as well using which you can Import all your Pinterest pins/boards to Moodloom.
description_zh: Moodloom 是一个无广告的视觉发现平台，专为受够了 Pinterest 的用户打造。保存并探索时尚、家居装饰和艺术作品——远离噪音。我们的不同之处：纯净的信息流——无广告，无赞助帖子；AI 内容过滤器——隐藏或显示 AI 生成的图像。为希望 Pinterest 变得更好的时尚爱好者、装饰师和数字艺术家而建。我们还开发了“保存到 Moodloom”扩展程序，通过它你可以将所有 Pinterest 图钉/画板导入 Moodloom。

tagline: Describe your shot. Rodeo builds your first cut.
tagline_zh: 描述你的镜头。Rodeo 为你生成初剪。
description: Rodeo by TwelveLabs is the AI video intelligence platform for creators and teams who produce at scale. Stop wasting hours scrubbing footage. Unlike transcript-first tools, Rodeo's multimodal AI understands visuals, audio, speech, and text simultaneously, making it perfect for visual-first content. Your video library is now instantly queryable for humans and agents.
description_zh: TwelveLabs 旗下的 Rodeo 是面向大规模内容创作者和团队的 AI 视频智能平台。别再浪费数小时手动拖拽素材了。使用自然语言，几分钟内即可从原始片段生成初剪。这是结构化的创作流程，而非人工审核。与仅依赖转录的工具不同，Rodeo 的多模态 AI 能同时理解视觉、音频、语音和文本，非常适合以视觉为主的内容。现在，你的视频库可被人类和智能体即时查询。

description: Bolna's Agent Studio lets any business build and deploy a production-grade voice AI agent in minutes, no prompt engineering. Upload a doc or answer a few guided questions, and Studio assembles a call-ready agent from production-tested modules. Sign up and start calling on Day 0.
description_zh: Bolna 的 Agent Studio 让任何企业都能在几分钟内构建和部署生产级语音 AI 智能体，无需提示词工程。上传文档或回答几个引导性问题，Studio 便会利用经过生产测试的模块组装出一个可通话的智能体。注册后即可开始拨打电话。

description: One API call replaces the entire document processing pipeline. You send multiple documents and a desired output schema; you get back resolved values, flagged contradictions, and full lineage down to the source words, pages, and documents, with bounding boxes you can embed directly into your own UI for human validation. No parsing, classification, stitching, or custom verification interface to build or maintain.
description_zh: 一次 API 调用即可取代整个文档处理流程。你发送多个文档和期望的输出模式；返回解析后的值、标记的矛盾点以及完整的溯源信息（精确到源词、页面和文档），并提供可直接嵌入你自己 UI 中的边界框以供人工验证。无需构建或维护任何解析、分类、拼接或自定义验证界面。

Fudge combines measured design evidence with screenshots, runs locally through MCP, and remembers references you save with its Chrome extension. description: Start a real LLM training in 10 minutes. Tell Claude Code or Codex what the model is for; they prepare the datasets and create the training project. Click "Run Training" in the local studio. Arkor runs the training, and deploys the trained model as an OpenAI-compatible API. name: MindReader v1
tagline: Read minds (simulated fMRI data, channeled to neuro-metrics)
tagline_zh: 读取思维（模拟fMRI数据，转化为神经指标）
description: How do you feel? It is the oldest question in art and the newest one we can answer in technology. MindReader takes your content and simulates, region by region, how a brain responds to it. Completely Open Source - we encourage you to tinker. Exploring sales evals, neural evals for datasets and other esoteric product experiments w/ madhat founders. MindReader is built on Meta FAIR's TRIBE v2 + 35yrs of neuro research. Inviting collab from the academics et all.
description_zh: 你感觉如何？这是艺术中最古老的问题，也是我们在技术领域能回答的最新问题。MindReader 将你的内容逐区域模拟大脑对其的反应。完全开源——我们鼓励你进行折腾。探索销售评估、数据集的神经评估以及与其他 madhat 创始人的其他神秘产品实验。MindReader 基于 Meta FAIR 的 TRIBE v2 和 35 年的神经科学研究构建。邀请学术界等各方合作。

name: AEVS
tagline: proof-of-execution for AI agents
tagline_zh: AI 智能体的执行证明
description: AEVS (Agent Execution Verification System) is a drop-in SDK that records every AI agent tool call and gives agents verifiable execution receipts. It captures the tool, inputs, outputs, status, and timing as tamper-evident proof, so teams can verify what an agent actually executed without relying on chat history or fragile logs.
description_zh: AEVS（智能体执行验证系统）是一个即插即用的 SDK，记录每个 AI 智能体的工具调用，并为智能体提供可验证的执行收据。它以防篡改的方式捕获工具、输入、输出、状态和时间，使团队无需依赖聊天记录或脆弱的日志即可验证智能体实际执行的操作。

name: MailAdept by mailwarm
tagline: AI Agents & Email deliverability experts on your team
tagline_zh: AI 代理与邮件投递专家，融入您的团队
description: Email deliverability on autopilot. A subscription-based, AI-native email deliverability service where AI agents and human experts work as an extension of your team to audit your infrastructure, fix issues, monitor email health daily, and improve inbox placement with weekly reporting.
description_zh: 邮件投递全自动。这是一款基于订阅的 AI 原生邮件投递服务，AI 代理与人类专家作为您团队的延伸，审计您的基础设施、修复问题、每日监控邮件健康状况，并通过每周报告提升收件箱投放率。

description: Wispro turns your voice into writing, instantly. Just talk, messy or unfiltered, and Wispro pastes clean, ready-to-use text directly into whatever you're working on. It adapts to how you think, not just how you speak. Basic Mode captures every word exactly as said. Smart Mode cuts filler words and rambling, formatting it into polished prose. Command Mode turns a spoken instruction into finished writing, emails, replies, whole drafts, on the spot. One voice. Three ways to write.
description_zh: Wispro 瞬间将你的语音转化为文字。只需说话，无论混乱或未经过滤，Wispro 都会将干净、即用型的文本直接粘贴到你正在进行的任何工作中。它适应你的思维方式，而不仅仅是你的说话方式。基础模式精确捕捉所说的每一个词。智能模式剔除填充词和啰嗦，将其格式化为润色后的文章。指令模式将口头指令转化为完成的写作、邮件、回复、整份草稿，即时完成。一个声音，三种写作方式。

description: Memoriq is your private AI memory for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok. Save the conversations that matter in an end-to-end encrypted vault that only you can access. Open source, self-hostable, and built for people who don't want to lose valuable AI chats or trust another plaintext cloud service. Search, organize, and keep your AI knowledge under your control.
description_zh: Memoriq 是 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 和 Grok 的私人 AI 记忆。将重要的对话保存在只有你能访问的全端到端加密保险库中。开源、可自托管，专为不希望丢失有价值的 AI 聊天或不信任明文云服务的人打造。搜索、整理并让你的 AI 知识掌握在自己手中。

name: Thumbmagic
tagline: AI thumbnail generator trained on top-performing thumbnails
tagline_zh: 基于表现最佳的缩略图训练的 AI 缩略图生成器
description: Most thumbnail tools give you generic templates. Thumbmagic gives you data. Before generating a single pixel, Thumbmagic analyzes 200+ top-performing thumbnails, studying what drives clicks for tech reviewers, finance creators, and more. The result? Thumbnails that don't just look good, they're engineered to perform.
description_zh: 大多数缩略图工具只提供通用模板。Thumbmagic 提供数据。在生成任何像素之前，Thumbmagic 分析 200 多个表现最佳的缩略图，研究驱动科技评论员、金融创作者等点击的因素。结果如何？生成的缩略图不仅美观，更是为高性能而设计。

name: CircleChat
tagline: Give your AI agents a slack, a task board, and a boss
tagline_zh: 为你的AI智能体提供Slack、任务板和老板
description: CircleChat is a workspace where a team of AI agents does real work. Set a goal: the team breaks it into tasks on a kanban board, claims the work, and reports in channels you can read. An LLM judge verifies every deliverable before a task can close, so you get output instead of chatter. Watch our own agents work in public at live.circlechat.co. Self-host free (MIT license), or we run it for you from $29/mo flat per workspace. Bring your own model keys. We never mark up tokens.
description_zh: CircleChat是一个AI智能体团队从事实际工作的空间。设定目标：团队在看板板上将其分解为任务，认领工作，并在你可阅读的频道中汇报。LLM裁判在任务关闭前验证每项交付物，因此你获得的是产出而非闲聊。在live.circlechat.co公开观看我们自己的智能体工作。免费自托管（MIT许可证），或由我们托管，每个工作区每月29美元固定费用。自带模型密钥。我们从不加价收取token费用。

Close deals 5x faster. 50M+ verified B2B contacts across the Arab world. Built for sales teams in UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Jordan and the Middle East. أول منصة ذكاء اصطناعي للمبيعات في الشرق الأوسط. اكتشف صانعي القرار، أتمتة التواصل عبر واتساب ولينكدإن والبريد الإلكتروني، وأغلق صفقاتك أسرع بـ 5 مرات. 50M+ جهة اتصال موثقة.

name: LocalClicky
tagline: Control your Mac with your voice locally
tagline_zh: 通过语音在本地控制你的 Mac
description: LocalClicky is a Mac menubar app that lets you have a real conversation with your computer - completely offline. Say "Computer" to start a session. It stays listening. You chain commands back to back. Say "goodbye" when you're done. Everything runs on your machine: voice transcription, LLM multi models, VAD, macOS say No API keys. No subscription. No data leaving your Mac. MIT licensed.
description_zh: LocalClicky 是一款 Mac 菜单栏应用，让你能与电脑进行真正的对话——完全离线。说“Computer”即可开始会话。它持续监听。你可以连续下达指令。完成后说“goodbye”。所有功能均在本地运行：语音转录、LLM 多模型、VAD、macOS say。无需 API 密钥。无需订阅。数据不会离开你的 Mac。MIT 许可。

name: Orchestria
tagline: AI music engine with granular stem control
tagline_zh: 具备细粒度音轨控制的 AI 音乐引擎
description: Existing music AIs are black boxes. Orchestria flips the script, generating music as separate stems with natural language agentic control. 100% royalty-free: you own everything you create. Key features: • Stem Control: Edit or regenerate instruments separately without ruining the mix. • Agentic Commands: Tweak sounds (e.g. "make bass pluckier") with natural language. • Pro Audio: Studio-grade 24-bit / 44.1kHz WAV outputs. • Sync Player: Beautiful, sample-accurate visualizer.
description_zh: 现有的音乐 AI 都是黑盒。Orchestria 颠覆了这一模式，将音乐生成为独立的音轨，并通过自然语言进行智能体控制。100% 免版税：你拥有创作的一切。主要功能：• 音轨控制：单独编辑或重新生成乐器，而不破坏混音效果。• 智能体命令：使用自然语言调整声音（例如“让贝斯更有拨弦感”）。• 专业音频：工作室级 24-bit / 44.1kHz WAV 输出。• 同步播放器：精美且采样精度的可视化器。

name: Coasty
tagline: A Computer-Use-Agent that runs legacy software like a human
tagline_zh: 像人类一样运行传统软件的 Computer-Use-Agent
description: Coasty is a computer use agent that operates real desktop software end to end. Started with healthcare prior auth, automating payer portals and legacy EHRs, and data removal for data privacy but now we're expanding into insurance and tax & accounting. Coasty does that work autonomously, with human takeover and full audit trails. Independently verified at 82.81% on OSWorld Verified (359 tasks), near the top of the leaderboard. No APIs required. If software has a screen, Coasty can run it.
description_zh: Coasty 是一个计算机使用代理，可端到端地操作真实的桌面软件。最初专注于医疗预授权，自动化支付方门户和传统电子健康记录（EHR），以及数据删除以满足隐私保护需求，如今我们正扩展到保险和税务/会计领域。Coasty 能够自主完成这些工作，并提供人工接管功能和完整的审计追踪。在 OSWorld Verified（359 项任务）上独立验证准确率达 82.81%，位居排行榜前列。无需 API。只要有屏幕的软件，Coasty 就能运行它。

name: The Eureka Database
tagline: Turn a Reddit complaint into your next company
tagline_zh: 将 Reddit 上的投诉转化为你的下一个创业公司
description: AI will happily generate a thousand startup ideas. It can't tell you which one people will actually pay for. The Eureka Database is a library of ideas mined from real complaints on Reddit, reviews, and forums. Every idea comes with the receipts: who wants it, who's already profitable, and a working demo. Connect over MCP and your AI agent pulls the full build spec for any saved idea: the problem, the stack, the schema, even the design taste, no prompt engineering needed.
description_zh: AI 很乐意生成一千个创业点子，但它无法告诉你哪一个真正有人买单。Eureka Database 是一个从 Reddit、评论和论坛上的真实投诉中挖掘出的点子库。每个点子都有确凿的证据：谁想要它、谁已经盈利，以及一个可运行的演示。通过 MCP 连接，你的 AI 代理可以获取任何已保存点子的完整构建规范：问题、技术栈、架构模式，甚至设计偏好，无需提示词工程。

tagline_zh: 一种有趣的新方式来创建和管理品牌。
description: Branda turns a name and idea into a complete brand identity in minutes: strategy, logo, palette, type, and full brand kit. Use visual prompts to keep every generation consistent, extract elements, vectorize to SVG, upscale, export, and share a public showcase.
description_zh: Branda 能在几分钟内将名称和创意转化为完整的品牌标识：策略、标志、配色、字体和全套品牌套件。从零开始或导入现有素材。✨ 注册即送 200 个免费积分 ✨ 让 AI 通过 Lucky 引领，或亲自指导策略、草图和矢量概念。使用视觉提示确保每次生成的一致性，提取元素，矢量化为 SVG，放大，导出并分享公共展示。

tagline: Turn talking, pics, or scribbles into clean, structured data

description: Voice, photos, messy notes — DodoForm turns however people communicate into clean structured data. 100+ templates, AI-powered analytics, native integrations, and branded forms. Done in seconds, not minutes. 14-day Pro trial, no card.
description_zh: 语音、照片、杂乱笔记——DodoForm 能将人们沟通的任何形式转化为清晰的结构化数据。100+ 模板，AI 驱动的分析，原生集成以及品牌化表单。秒级完成，而非分钟。14 天 Pro 试用，无需信用卡。

name: Granite
tagline: A vault for every document that matters
tagline_zh: 存放每一份重要文档的安全库
description: Drop your paperwork. Granite reads every document the moment you upload, files it correctly, and remembers it indefinitely. Find anything later by asking in plain English.
description_zh: 上传你的文件。Granite 会在你上传的瞬间阅读每份文档，正确归档并永久记忆。稍后只需用自然语言提问，即可找到任何内容。

name: TravelMind
tagline: AI-powered city discovery built on taste, not reviews
tagline_zh: 基于品味而非评论的 AI 城市探索
description: You land in a new city. You open every app you know. Two hours later you're still scrolling, still unsure, still guessing. TravelMind was built for that moment. Swipe through places, tell us what you love — the AI does the rest. It learns your taste and finds the right spot before you even know to look. Your taste. Every city. Live now on iOS and Android.
description_zh: 你抵达一座新城市。打开所有你知道的应用。两小时后，你仍在浏览，仍不确定，仍在猜测。TravelMind 就是为此刻而生。滑动浏览地点，告诉我们你的喜好——剩下的交给 AI。它会学习你的品味，在你意识到之前就能找到合适的地方。你的品味。每座城市。现已在 iOS 和 Android 上线。

name: LLMTest
tagline: Use the right LLMs in your apps. Setup fallbacks. Be happy.
tagline_zh: 在应用中选用合适的 LLM。配置降级策略。尽享愉悦体验。
description: "OpenRouter + Intelligence" LLMTest helps devs and vibe coders automatically: ✅ Pick better models for AI-powered features (faster, cheaper, better, sometimes all 3 combined) ↪️ Automatically add fallbacks when LLM providers fail (API is overloaded or JSON format isn't respected) All through one single API and MCP functions so you can just tell Claude or Codex to optimize everything.
description_zh: "OpenRouter + Intelligence" LLMTest 帮助开发者和 Vibe Coders 自动完成以下操作：✅ 为 AI 驱动的功能挑选更优模型（更快、更便宜、效果更好，有时三者兼得）↪️ 当 LLM 提供商出现故障时（API 过载或 JSON 格式不被遵守）自动添加降级方案 全部通过单一的 API 和 MCP 函数实现，你只需告诉 Claude 或 Codex 来优化一切。

name: PopTask for Apple
tagline: Turn to-dos into scheduled tasks
tagline_zh: 将待办事项转化为计划任务
description: PopTask just went universal. type a messy thought like "gym mon wed fri 6am" and it becomes a scheduled task in about 3 seconds, no pickers, no forms. on iphone + ipad you get home and lock screen widgets, a live activity + dynamic island counting down your next task, control center, and hands-free siri even in the car. on mac it lives in the menu bar (⌘⌃P). everything syncs across your devices through your own icloud, near-instant. on-device, private, 9 languages. free to start
description_zh: PopTask 现已全面普及。输入杂乱的思绪，如“健身房 周一三五 早上6点”，它会在约3秒内将其转化为计划任务，无需选择器，无需表单。在 iPhone 和 iPad 上，您可获得主屏幕和锁屏小组件、实时活动 + 动态岛倒计时显示您的下一个任务、控制中心功能，以及在车内免提使用 Siri。在 Mac 上，它位于菜单栏（⌘⌃P）。所有设备通过您自己的 iCloud 实现近乎即时的同步。本地运行，隐私保护，支持9种语言。免费开始使用

As people join, change teams, or leave, users, groups, and organization memberships stay current—reducing app-by-app cleanup and helping leaders answer who still has access. Together with SSO, RBAC, and RLS, it gives enterprise teams more confidence to roll Basedash out without turning identity administration into a bottleneck. Your org changes. Access keeps up.

Built for real estate, hotels, restaurants, dental clinics, and more. Create your own AI agent assistant in under 3 minutes.

tagline: Voice dictation that adapts to what’s on your screen
tagline_zh: 根据屏幕内容自适应的语音听写功能
description: Typing on the web has not evolved. Tapfree fixes that. Tapfree is a voice-first keyboard for Chrome text fields and ChromeOS that lets you write messages, notes, docs, and emails by speaking naturally - without dictation errors, awkward formatting, or constant corrections. It understands context, not just words.
description_zh: 网页输入体验尚未进化。Tapfree 对此进行了改进。Tapfree 是一款面向 Chrome 文本字段和 ChromeOS 的语音优先键盘，让你能够通过自然说话来撰写消息、笔记、文档和电子邮件——无需听写错误、格式尴尬或频繁修正。它理解语境，而不仅仅是单词。

name: Koji by Brilliant
tagline: A world-class personal tutor for every home
tagline_zh: 每个家庭的世界级私人导师
description: This isn’t just a feature launch, it’s an evolution of our entire product experience. Brilliant is now a superintelligent tutor designed to work like the best human tutors. It asks the right questions, sketches right on your screen, and adapts to how you learn best.
description_zh: 这不仅仅是一次功能发布，而是我们整个产品体验的进化。Brilliant 现已成为一位超级智能导师，其工作方式堪比最优秀的真人导师。它会提出恰当的问题，直接在屏幕上绘图，并适应你的最佳学习方式。

name: OpenCode Superapp
tagline: The power of Codex with local, self-hosted models and voice
tagline_zh: 本地、自托管模型和语音带来的 Codex 力量。
description: OpenCode Superapp brings the agentic power of Codex to the models and infrastructure you choose. Run cloud, local, or self-hosted models in a native workspace where agents understand your projects, work with files, Git, and terminals, speak with you through voice, and operate Mac apps through supervised Computer Use. Private by design and extensible through skills and MCPs, it gives you capable agents without giving up model choice or control. Built from the ground up with Codex and GPT-5.6.
description_zh: OpenCode Superapp 将 Codex 的智能体能力带到你选择的模型和基础设施中。在原生工作空间中运行云、本地或自托管模型，其中智能体理解你的项目，处理文件、Git 和终端，通过语音与你交谈，并通过受监督的计算机操作运行 Mac 应用。设计为私有且通过技能和 MCP 可扩展，它在不放弃模型选择或控制的情况下为你提供能力强大的智能体。从零开始构建，基于 Codex 和 GPT-5.6。

name: SuprSend AI
tagline: AI-first platform for multi-channel notifications
tagline_zh: 面向多渠道通知的 AI 优先平台
description: SuprSend now ships six AI-native interfaces for notification infrastructure. MCP Server with 24 tools in your IDE, CLI for notification config as code versioned in Git, Agent Skills so AI knows your schemas instead of hallucinating your API, an AI Copilot inside the dashboard, a Slack Agent to trigger and debug from Slack, and a Claude Extension. Works across Cursor, Claude, Windsurf, and Slack. Used by 500+ companies. Free tier available.
description_zh: SuprSend 现推出六款 AI 原生接口用于通知基础设施。IDE 中的 MCP Server（含 24 个工具）、用于将通知配置作为代码在 Git 中版本控制的 CLI、让 AI 了解你的 Schema 而非对 API 产生幻觉的 Agent Skills、仪表盘内的 AI Copilot、可从 Slack 触发和调试的 Slack Agent，以及 Claude 扩展。兼容 Cursor、Claude、Windsurf 和 Slack。已有 500 多家公司使用。提供免费套餐。

name: Composer
tagline: Multiplayer markdown for you, your team, and your agents.
tagline_zh: 为你、你的团队和你的 Agent 提供的多人协作 Markdown。
description: Composer is a real-time, multiplayer markdown editor where people and agents can work side-by-side. Instantly share markdown generated by your agent with teammates, edit in real time, leave comments, suggestions, and share context. Your agents join as true collaborators, working directly alongside you and your team.
description_zh: Composer 是一款实时的多人协作 Markdown 编辑器，人和 Agent 可以并肩工作。即时分享由你的 Agent 生成的 Markdown 给团队成员，进行实时编辑，留下评论和建议，并共享上下文。你的 Agent 作为真正的协作者加入，直接与你和你的团队并肩工作。

name: Keen Code
tagline: A context-efficient CLI coding agent built by agents
tagline_zh: 一个由智能体构建的上下文高效的CLI编码代理
description: Keen Code is an open-source, context-aware and efficient CLI coding agent written in Go. Three aspects stand it out from other similar products: - It was built from scratch by coding agents, with the full prompt/design trail preserved and shared in the repo. - It uses turn memory to keep multi-turn sessions lean which saves context significantly. - It maps MCP servers to lazy-loaded Skills instead of stuffing large schemas into context upfront. This again saves context in mult-MCP setting.
description_zh: Keen Code 是一款开源、上下文感知且高效的 CLI 编码代理，使用 Go 语言编写。它在三个方面优于其他类似产品：- 它完全由编码代理从零构建，并在仓库中保留和共享了完整的提示词/设计轨迹。- 它使用轮次记忆（turn memory）来保持多轮会话的精简，从而显著节省上下文空间。- 它将 MCP 服务器映射为按需加载的 Skills，而不是将大型模式预先填充到上下文中。这在多 MCP 设置下再次节省了上下文。

name: Fonda
tagline: Your AI co-founder that remembers decisions + plans for you
tagline_zh: 记得你的决策并为你规划的人工智能联合创始人
description: Most "AI startup tools" give you a blank chat box. Fonda is different — it's a structured AI co-founder that runs a proven 14-step journey with you: Discover, Validate, Launch, Scale. It remembers every decision, interview, and pivot across sessions. It kills weak ideas before you waste months on them. It ships your landing page, business case, and MVP plan once validated. One clear next move, every day. Free to start.
description_zh: 大多数“AI 初创工具”只给你一个空白的聊天框。Fonda 不同——它是一个结构化的 AI 联合创始人，与你一起执行经过验证的 14 步旅程：发现、验证、启动、扩展。它会记住跨会话的每一个决策、访谈和调整。它会在你浪费数月时间之前扼杀薄弱的想法。一旦通过验证，它会交付你的着陆页、商业案例和 MVP 计划。每天一个清晰的下一步。免费开始。

name: Solaris
tagline: Your company’s AI adoption and upskilling platform
tagline_zh: 贵公司的 AI 采用和技能提升平台
description: Solaris is an AI-native transformation platform that helps organisations build AI fluency across every team. Start with a fluency test to understand where people are today, then give each team tailored learning, practical use cases, workflow challenges, champions and adoption tracking. Solaris helps companies move from scattered AI experiments to measurable capability, so AI becomes part of how work actually gets done.
description_zh: Solaris 是一个原生 AI 转型平台，帮助组织在各个团队中建立 AI 能力。从能力测试开始，了解员工当前的水平，然后为每个团队提供定制化的学习资源、实用案例、工作流挑战、冠军用户以及采用情况跟踪。Solaris 帮助企业从分散的 AI 实验迈向可衡量的能力，使 AI 真正融入日常工作流程。

name: Brand Context API
tagline: Ship AI that stays on-brand
tagline_zh: 交付符合品牌调性的 AI
description: Brand Context API keeps your AI on-brand by returning a company's brand identity in one call: voice, mission, products, audience. With this structured data, your product ships output that's grounded from the first prompt.
description_zh: Brand Context API 通过一次调用返回公司的品牌身份（语气、使命、产品、受众），让你的 AI 保持品牌一致性。利用这些结构化数据，你的产品从第一个提示开始就能生成基于品牌基调的输出。

name: Branda
tagline: Turn any domain into on-brand ads, MIT Open Source
tagline_zh: 将任何网站转化为品牌广告，MIT 开源
description: Branda turns any website URL into scroll-stopping, on-brand ads in seconds. Paste a link and Branda pulls the brand's real logo, colors, and campaign imagery via Context.dev's Brand API, reads the homepage so the copy sounds like the brand, and generates ready-to-ship creatives for LinkedIn and X. No login, no design skills, no assets to upload. Open-source and self-hostable.
description_zh: Branda 可在几秒钟内将任何网站 URL 转化为吸睛的品牌广告。粘贴链接后，Branda 会通过 Context.dev 的 Brand API 获取品牌的真实 logo、颜色和营销素材，阅读主页内容以使文案符合品牌风格，并为 LinkedIn 和 X 生成可发布的创意。无需登录，无需设计技能，无需上传素材。开源且可自托管。

name: Claude Overlay
tagline: A floating Claude Code chat that sees your screen
tagline_zh: 一个能看见你屏幕的浮动式Claude Code聊天窗口
description: Claude Overlay is a frameless, always-on-top chat window for Claude Code that floats over everything you do. Summon it with a hotkey, ask about whatever's on screen, and Claude captures and reads your monitors before answering. It runs the full Claude Code agent on your own subscription - no API key - so it can edit files and run commands, not just chat. Open source (MIT), Windows.
description_zh: Claude Overlay是一个无边框、始终置顶的Claude Code聊天窗口，悬浮在你所做的一切之上。通过热键召唤它，询问屏幕上的任何内容，Claude会在回答前捕获并读取你的显示器。它使用你自己的订阅运行完整的Claude Code代理 - 无需API密钥 - 因此它可以编辑文件和运行命令，而不仅仅是聊天。开源(MIT)，Windows平台。

name: Kogvio
tagline: Understand anything online without leaving the page.
tagline_zh: 无需离开页面即可理解任何在线内容。
description: Every time I didn't understand something online, I had the same workflow: Copy. Open ChatGPT. Paste. Come back. It completely broke my focus. So I built Kogvio. Highlight anything on a webpage or PDF, ask questions instantly in context, and continue learning without leaving the page. Whether it's documentation, research papers, medical textbooks, or technical diagrams, Kogvio helps you understand—not just search.
description_zh: 每次我在网上遇到不懂的内容，流程都是一样的：复制、打开 ChatGPT、粘贴、返回。这完全打断了我的专注力。所以我开发了 Kogvio。高亮网页或 PDF 上的任意内容，在上下文中即时提问，并在不离开页面的情况下继续学习。无论是文档、研究论文、医学教科书还是技术图表，Kogvio 都能助您理解——而不仅仅是搜索。

name: Routebase
tagline: Catch API drift before your customers do
tagline_zh: 在客户发现之前捕获 API 变更
description: Your API lives in your design tool, your docs, your mocks, your tests, your monitoring — and every copy drifts. Routebase makes them one living source: change the spec, publish, and it catches what drifted. (Your AI agents read the same source over MCP.)
description_zh: 您的 API 散落在设计工具、文档、模拟数据、测试和监控中——但每次复制都会导致变更。Routebase 将它们整合为一个单一真实来源：更改规格并发布，系统会自动捕获发生变更的部分。（您的 AI 代理通过 MCP 读取同一来源。）

name: Lium AI
tagline: AI for analyzing and querying complex data
tagline_zh: 用于分析和查询复杂数据的AI
description: Lium is a collaborative AI platform that helps domain experts get reliable answers from messy, massive, multimodal datasets. Connect terabyte size data in any format, ask questions in plain English, generate knowledge artifacts, and turn verified analysis into reusable workflows your team can build on. Lium brings together data across geospatial, energy, space, and other complex domains so work that once required weeks of engineering can happen in a single conversation.
description_zh: Lium是一个协作式AI平台，帮助领域专家从混乱、海量、多模态的数据集中获取可靠答案。连接任何格式的TB级数据，用自然语言提问，生成知识产物，并将经过验证的分析转化为可复用的工作流，供团队在此基础上构建。Lium整合了地理空间、能源、航天及其他复杂领域的数据，使原本需要数周工程时间的工作，如今只需一次对话即可完成。

name: veridive
tagline: Find the 30 seconds that matter in any video via chat
tagline_zh: 通过聊天找出视频中最重要的30秒
description: veridive turns YouTube, podcasts, lectures and interviews into cited answers — pinpointed to the exact second the answer is spoken. Ask in any language! veridive searches live, reads the transcripts, ranks sources by who actually knows, and answers with a click-to-play citation on every claim.
description_zh: veridive将YouTube视频、播客、讲座和采访转化为带有引用来源的答案——精确到说出答案的具体秒数。支持任意语言提问！veridive实时搜索、阅读字幕、根据“谁真正了解内容”对来源进行排名，并对每个主张提供点击即播放的引用链接。

name: Reignat
tagline: Privacy-friendly web analytics platform built for makers
tagline_zh: 为创作者打造的隐私友好型网站分析平台
description: Reignat is a privacy-friendly web analytics platform built for founders, startups, and indie makers who want clear insights without the complexity of traditional analytics tools. Track visitors, pageviews, traffic sources, devices, locations, funnels, and user journeys in real time. Get AI-powered insights to understand trends, uncover opportunities, and make better growth decisions—all from a fast, modern dashboard.
description_zh: Reignat是一款隐私友好型网站分析平台，专为希望摆脱传统分析工具复杂性、获得清晰洞察的创始人、初创企业和独立开发者而设计。实时追踪访客、页面浏览量、流量来源、设备、地理位置、转化漏斗和用户旅程。获取AI驱动的深度洞察，理解趋势、发现机会并做出更优的增长决策——全部集成于快速、现代的仪表盘中。

name: Dirac
tagline: The AI inbox that briefs founders every morning
tagline_zh: 每天早晨为创始人提供简报的AI收件箱
description: Founders lose hours everyday to doing email, when they should be spending the time to build and make real progress. Dirac was made to end that. Dirac is an AI-native inbox that scans your threads, drafts replies in your voice, and shows a brief with only what needs your decision, quietly dealing with the 80% of un-important emails in the background. You run your inbox by deciding, not being your own assitant.
description_zh: 创始人每天花费数小时处理邮件，而这些时间本应用于建设和取得实质性进展。Dirac应运而生，旨在终结这一现状。Dirac是一款原生AI收件箱，可扫描你的邮件线程，以你的语气起草回复，并仅展示需要你决策的关键简报，同时在后台静默处理80%不重要的邮件。你通过做决策来管理收件箱，而不是让自己沦为助理。

name: Kadoink AI
tagline: Gather people instantly by AI txt, video, or ringing phones
tagline_zh: 通过AI文本、视频或电话铃声即时召集人员
description: Gather people instantly by AI txt, video, or ringing phones Tell Kadoink Who You Need. AI Gets Them Together. Say Who. Say Why. Kadoink Gathers Everyone. AI-Powered Gathering for Real-Time Communication Kadoink Finds the Best Way to Reach Your People Video, Voice, Text, Push — AI Chooses the Path Stop Chasing People. Let Kadoink AI. Your AI Gathering Engine AI That Knows Who to Reach and How Tell Kadoink the Mission. AI Handles the Outreach.
description_zh: 通过AI文本、视频或电话铃声即时召集人员 告诉Kadoink你需要谁。AI将他们聚集在一起。说出是谁。说出原因。Kadoink聚集所有人。AI驱动的真实时通信聚集 Kadoink找到联系你团队的最佳方式 视频、语音、文本、推送——AI选择路径 别再追逐人员。让Kadoink AI处理。你的AI聚集引擎 AI知道该联系谁以及如何联系 告诉Kadoink任务。AI负责外联。

name: In Parallel MCP
tagline: Your context, available to every agent.
tagline_zh: 你的上下文，随时供所有代理使用。
description: You've explained your company to ChatGPT. Then to Claude. Then to Copilot. Every time you open a new chat, you start from scratch. Paste the notes. Upload the document. Copy in the email thread. Summarize what your team decided two weeks ago — to a tool that could've just known it all along. In Parallel's MCP server ends that. Connect it once, and whichever AI you open already knows your meetings, decisions, and context. Just ask the question. Less prose. More truth.
description_zh: 你已经向 ChatGPT 解释过你的公司，然后是 Claude，再是 Copilot。每次打开新对话，你都要从头开始：粘贴笔记、上传文档、复制邮件线程。总结你的团队两周前做出的决定——而本该有一个工具早就知道这一切。In Parallel 的 MCP 服务器终结了这种重复。连接一次，无论你打开哪个 AI，它都已经知道你的会议、决策和上下文。只需提问。少些废话，多些真相。

name: AccountyCat
tagline: A focus companion that actually gets context
tagline_zh: 真正理解上下文的专注伴侣
description: AccountyCat is a focus companion for macOS that reads context instead of blocking lists. It sits in your menu bar, sees your active app and window title (and a screenshot only when needed), then quietly nudges when you drift. Sometimes YouTube is procrastination, sometimes it's the tutorial — AC tells the difference. Runs fully on-device with Qwen via llama.cpp, or with your own OpenRouter key. Open source, auditable, private. Interrupting legitimate work is treated as a bug.
description_zh: AccountyCat是macOS上的专注伴侣，它读取上下文而非依赖屏蔽列表。它驻留在菜单栏中，监控你的活跃应用和窗口标题（仅在必要时截取屏幕截图），并在你分心时轻声提醒。有时YouTube是拖延，有时则是教程——AC能区分二者。基于Qwen通过llama.cpp在本地运行，或支持你自己的OpenRouter密钥。开源、可审计、注重隐私。干扰正常工作被视为bug。

name: Atomic Mail Agentic
tagline: Let your agents read, send, and react to email autonomously
tagline_zh: 让您的智能体自主读取、发送和回复邮件
description: Atomic Mail Agentic gives autonomous AI agents their own real @atomicmail.ai inbox to manage fully without human setup, verification, or ongoing intervention. Built on JMAP (RFC 8620), the standard mailbox API LLMs already know fluently, so agents read, send, reply, draft, search, and manage threads reliably with fewer retries. Novel proof-of-work signup delivers a real inbox in ~30 seconds—no CAPTCHA, credit card, domain verification, or mail-server ops.
description_zh: Atomic Mail Agentic 为自主 AI 智能体提供专属的真实 @atomicmail.ai 收件箱，无需人工设置、验证或持续干预。基于 LLM 已熟练掌握的标准邮箱 API JMAP (RFC 8620) 构建，使智能体能可靠地读取、发送、回复、起草、搜索和管理线程，减少重试次数。创新的 Proof-of-work 注册方式可在约 30 秒内获得真实收件箱——无需验证码、信用卡、域名验证或邮件服务器运维。

name: BrainFeed
tagline: A personalized learning feed that redirects your scroll
tagline_zh: 个性化学习流，改变您的浏览习惯
description: BrainFeed is a personalized learning feed designed to redirect your scrolling habit and build compounding knowledge. Set a custom goal like "how to get my first 100 users," or drop in a link to that long article or YouTube video you’ve been avoiding. BrainFeed transforms them into a bite-sized, scrollable feed of cards that you can easily get through while waiting in a line. Unlike traditional feeds, BrainFeed uses spaced repetition to ensure you actually retain what you read.
description_zh: BrainFeed是一个个性化的学习流，旨在改变您的浏览习惯并积累知识。您可以设置一个自定义目标，如‘获取第一个100名用户’，或输入您一直避免的长篇文章或YouTube视频的链接。BrainFeed将它们转换为可轻松在等待时阅读的卡片流。与传统流不同，BrainFeed使用间隔重复来确保您真正记住所读内容。

name: OLO Robotics
tagline: Control robots in your browser — no setup needed
tagline_zh: 在浏览器中控制机器人——无需设置
description: OLO is a web-based platform that gives developers, researchers, and academics everything they need to program robots — without the setup hell. Get ROS2 access, robot visualization, simulation and AI-assisted coding all in your browser. Go from idea to working robot in 30 minutes, not two weeks. No Linux installs. No config rabbit holes. Just you, your robot, and a JavaScript or Python SDK playground ready from day one. Now open for sign-ups.
description_zh: OLO 是一个基于 Web 的平台，为开发者、研究人员和学者提供编程所需的一切，彻底告别繁琐的设置过程。在浏览器中即可获取 ROS2 访问权限、机器人可视化、仿真以及 AI 辅助编码功能。从想法到运行中的机器人只需 30 分钟，而非两周。无需安装 Linux，无需陷入配置陷阱。第一天即可使用 JavaScript 或 Python SDK 进行开发。现已开放注册。

name: DevCleaner
tagline: Free the gigabytes your dev tools and AI apps hoard
tagline_zh: 释放您的开发工具和 AI 应用占用的数 GB 空间
description: DevCleaner lives in your Mac's menu bar and frees the gigabytes that 22 dev ecosystems quietly hoard — Xcode, Gradle, npm, plus AI apps like Cursor, Claude & Ollama. Every item is risk-rated, so you always know what's safe to delete. Free, no account, 4 MB.
description_zh: DevCleaner 驻留在 Mac 菜单栏中，释放 22 个开发生态系统悄悄囤积的 GB 级空间——包括 Xcode、Gradle、npm，以及 Cursor、Claude 和 Ollama 等 AI 应用。每项内容均经过风险评估，让您始终清楚哪些可以安全删除。免费、无需账户、仅 4 MB。

name: AGNT.Hub
tagline: Build always-on AI agents without managing servers
tagline_zh: 构建全天候运行的 AI 智能体，无需管理服务器
description: Most AI tools stop at the chat box. AGNT Hub gives you a private AI workspace running inside an isolated cloud container. Add custom skills, connect tools like Notion via MCP, and build workflows once. Let your agents run in the background without touching Docker, AWS, or config files.
description_zh: 大多数 AI 工具止步于聊天框。AGNT Hub 为您提供一个运行在隔离云容器内的私人 AI 工作区。添加自定义技能，通过 MCP 连接 Notion 等工具，并一次性构建工作流。让智能体在后台运行，无需触碰 Docker、AWS 或配置文件。

name: Synopsule
tagline: On device private AI meeting transcripts
tagline_zh: 端侧私密 AI 会议转录
description: Synopsule records and transcribes your conversations on your Mac or iPhone with Whisper, labels every speaker, and only summarizes when you ask. No accounts, no uploads. Now on the App Store — one $4.99 purchase for Mac and iPhone.
description_zh: Synopsule 使用 Whisper 在您的 Mac 或 iPhone 上记录并转录对话，标记每位发言者，仅在您要求时生成摘要。无需账户，无需上传。现已上架 App Store——Mac 和 iPhone 仅需一次 4.99 美元购买。

name: Revyl
tagline: The mobile source of truth
tagline_zh: 移动端的唯一事实来源
description: Revyl gives mobile teams full observability into how their app actually behaves on live cloud devices. Step-level execution traces, performance data (CPU, memory, FPS), a complete network waterfall, and state and file-system diffing across every run. Atlas auto-maps every screen and flow in your app, and revyl dev brings hot reload and device control into your dev loop.

description_zh: 大多数独自独处四小时以上的狗狗会表现出可测量的压力反应。大多数应用仅提供播放列表作为回应。Pawse.ai 是一款专为狗狗设计的声学调节系统。在你外出时，它通过 Apple TV 或 iPad 播放经过科学结构设计的音频，其频率和模式针对犬类听觉校准，而非人类偏好。你可以随时随地通过手机启动或停止它。BETA 测试版 TestFlight 链接位于 https://pawse.ai 五种模式：睡眠、独自在家、噪音、旅行和兽医就诊。
