tagline: A fitness coach with personalized plans
tagline_zh: 提供个性化计划的健身教练
description: Most workout apps give you a generic plan and call it personalized. Whistle actually knows you. It reads your Apple Health data and builds a real training plan around your fitness level, recovery, and goals. Detailed workouts, smart progression, all on your iPhone and Apple Watch. Whether you're just getting started or pushing toward a new personal best, your AI coach figures out what you need and when you need it. Your data. Your plan. Your pace.
description_zh: 大多数健身应用给你通用计划却称之为个性化。Whistle 真正了解你。它读取你的 Apple Health 数据，并根据你的体能水平、恢复情况和目标构建真正的训练计划。详细的训练内容、智能进阶，全部在 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 上呈现。无论你是刚开始锻炼还是冲击新的个人最佳成绩，你的 AI 教练都会找出你需要什么以及何时需要。你的数据。你的计划。你的节奏。

name: LayerProof Vellum
tagline: One canvas for every image asset you need
tagline_zh: 一个画布，满足您所有图像资产的需求
description: Turn unpredictable AI image generations into controlled production pipelines with LayerProof Vellum. Vellum is LayerProof’s drag-and-drop visual canvas for teams who want to engineer their images, not guess them. Plug your subject, background, and effects together on the canvas, and Vellum fuses them into a pixel-perfect final asset.
description_zh: 通过 LayerProof Vellum 将不可预测的 AI 图像生成转化为可控的生产流水线。Vellum 是 LayerProof 推出的拖拽式可视化画布，专为希望精准定制而非盲目猜测图像的团队打造。在画布上将主体、背景和特效组合在一起，Vellum 会将其融合为像素级完美的最终资产。

name: Calling Skills for AI Agents
tagline: Add voice and video calling via your coding agent
tagline_zh: 通过您的编码代理添加语音和视频通话功能
description: HD voice and video calling by CometChat, built to fit into and grow with your platform. Packed with recording, screen sharing, call logs, raise hand, broadcast mode, picture-in-picture, and more. Integrate via UI Kits, SDKs, or a single npx command (npx @cometchat/skills add) using CometChat Skills. Scales with heavy bandwidth, compliant with global standards, and built for developers.
description_zh: CometChat 提供高清语音和视频通话服务，旨在无缝融入并随您的平台共同成长。内置录音、屏幕共享、通话记录、举手功能、广播模式、画中画等丰富功能。支持通过 UI Kits、SDKs 或单个 npx 命令（npx @cometchat/skills add）集成 CometChat Skills。具备高带宽扩展能力，符合全球标准，专为开发者打造。

name: Constellation Gate AI
tagline: Prompt injection and token savings - #1 in benchmarks
tagline_zh: 提示注入与 Token 节省——基准测试排名第一
description: Point your AI agent at Gate. Inherit prompt-injection defense, secret scanning, and a verifiable audit trail. Gate includes prompt compression and caching so you can reduce token usage by 20-40% without changing model output. In AI security benchmarks, Gate ranks #1 across 16 public prompt-injection datasets. Keep your Claude or ChatGPT subscriptions and route them through Gate, or choose from 100+ models pay-as-you-go. Setup is easy: no code changes with our desktop app.
description_zh: 将您的 AI Agent 指向 Gate。继承提示注入防御、密钥扫描和可验证的审计追踪。Gate 包含提示压缩和缓存功能，可在不改变模型输出的情况下将 Token 使用量减少 20-40%。在 AI 安全基准测试中，Gate 在 16 个公共提示注入数据集上均排名第一。保留您的 Claude 或 ChatGPT 订阅并通过 Gate 路由，或从 100 多种模型中选择按量付费。设置简单：使用我们的桌面应用无需更改代码。

description_zh: Eddie Review 是获取剪辑反馈的最快方式，只需几分钟。无需登录，无需重新上传，免费。收集团队精确到帧的评论，获取 AI 对您编辑的审查，并将每条笔记转化为可执行的待办事项列表。

name: LnkFlow
tagline: Agentic click tracking that shows what grows your business
tagline_zh: 显示增长您的业务的代理式点击跟踪
description: See which campaigns, channels, and collabs make you money! With reliable, server-side click tracking that counts the visits, ad blockers hide. Turn any URL into a short, branded link tagged by campaign, channel, or creator. Rank creators and platforms by who actually drove clicks, with bots filtered out by default. And it's fully agentic-ready: your AI assistant can create links, tag them, and pull reports in plain language — no dashboard required. Clean links in, clear answers out.
description_zh: 查看哪些营销活动、渠道和合作伙伴为您赚钱！使用可靠的服务器端点击跟踪，躲避广告拦截器。将任何URL转换为短、带有标签的链接，标签可以是活动、渠道或创作者。按实际点击次数排名创作者和平台，使用默认过滤器排除机器人。并且它完全是代理式准备好的：您的AI助手可以创建链接、标记它们并在自然语言中提取报告——无需使用仪表板。清晰的输入，清晰的输出

name: Task Monki
tagline: Run coding agents through the full development process
tagline_zh: 在整个开发过程中运行编码代理
description: Task Monki is an open-source desktop app for managing coding agents from task to pull request. Run several tasks at once, follow each agent’s progress, preview every result without manually setting up services or containers, send work to another agent for review and fixes, and bring multiple agents into the same discussion, where they can respond to each other, compare approaches, and challenge assumptions.
description_zh: Task Monki是开源桌面应用，用于从任务到拉取请求管理编码代理。同时运行多个任务，跟踪每个代理的进度，预览每个结果，无需手动设置服务或容器，发送工作给另一个代理进行审查和修复，带多个代理进入同一个讨论中，他们可以相互回应、比较方法和挑战假设。

name: tldx
tagline: Fast CLI to bulk-check domains via RDAP & MCP
tagline_zh: 通过 RDAP 和 MCP 快速批量检查域名的 CLI 工具
description: Finding a good domain is half the battle. tldx is a blazing-fast, concurrent CLI tool that generates and checks domain availability in bulk via RDAP. Mix keywords, prefixes/suffixes, or regex, and stream results to stdout, JSON, or CSV. Plus, tldx includes an MCP server, empowering AI agents (like Claude) to brainstorm and verify domains for you automatically! Install via Homebrew (brew install tldx). Say goodbye to rate-limits and legacy whois parsing. 100% Free & Open Source in Go.
description_zh: 找到好域名只是成功的一半。tldx 是一款极速并发 CLI 工具，通过 RDAP 批量生成并检查域名可用性。可混合使用关键词、前缀/后缀或正则表达式，并将结果流式输出至 stdout、JSON 或 CSV。此外，tldx 包含一个 MCP 服务器，赋能 AI 代理（如 Claude）自动为您构思和验证域名！可通过 Homebrew 安装（brew install tldx）。告别速率限制和传统的 whois 解析。完全免费且开源的 Go 语言项目。

name: Slack Data Agent
tagline: Ask about your data without leaving Slack
tagline_zh: 无需离开 Slack 即可查询数据
description: Basedash for Slack is your AI data analyst inside Slack — now in the official Slack Marketplace. Mention @Basedash in any channel and it queries your real data sources, thinks in the thread, and replies with an answer and a chart, right where your team is talking. Automations deliver scheduled reports to your channels, and insights surface anomalies automatically — charts included. Ask in Slack. Answered by your data.
description_zh: Basedash for Slack 是位于 Slack 内的 AI 数据分析师——现已正式上架 Slack 应用目录。在任何频道中提及 @Basedash，它便会查询您的真实数据源，在对话线程中进行思考，并直接在团队交流的地方回复答案和图表。自动化功能可将定时报告发送至您的频道，并自动揭示异常数据——附带图表。在 Slack 中提问，由您的数据作答。

name: MiMo Code
tagline: A coding agent with explicit long-term memory architecture
tagline_zh: 具有显式长期记忆架构的编码代理
description: MiMo Code is an open-source terminal AI coding agent built on OpenCode. Optimized for long-horizon tasks, it uses an independent checkpoint subagent to manage unbounded context windows, executes sandbox workflows, and evolves via scheduled maintenance.
description_zh: MiMo Code 是一款基于 OpenCode 构建的开源终端 AI 编码代理。针对长周期任务进行了优化，它使用独立的检查点子代理来管理无限上下文窗口，执行沙箱工作流，并通过定期维护不断进化。

name: Devin Desktop
tagline: Manage fleets of local and cloud agents from one surface
tagline_zh: 从统一界面管理本地和云端智能体集群
description: Manage fleets of local and cloud agents from one surface. Plan, delegate, review, and ship without leaving your editor.
description_zh: 从统一界面管理本地和云端智能体集群。在编辑器内完成规划、委派、审查和发布。

name: MashuPack
tagline: Turn codebases into a clean file for Claude and ChatGPT
tagline_zh: 将代码库转换为适合 Claude 和 ChatGPT 使用的整洁文本文件
description: Select the exact parts of a repository and compile them into one clean text file for ChatGPT and Claude or Gemini. MashuPack is built for browser-based AI workflows where file-count limits, upload friction, and messy context assembly keep getting in the way. It makes code context portable, intentional, and easy to control.
description_zh: 精确选择仓库中的特定部分，并将其编译为 ChatGPT、Claude 或 Gemini 可用的单一整洁文本文件。MashuPack 专为基于浏览器的 AI 工作流设计，解决了文件数量限制、上传摩擦以及上下文组装混乱等问题。它使代码上下文具备可移植性、意图明确且易于控制。

name: Fred
tagline: AI-orchestrated UX research with behavioural tracking
tagline_zh: AI 编排的用户体验研究，附带行为追踪功能
description: Fred now turns UX research into an AI-orchestrated workflow: plan studies, recruit and manage participants, run tests, analyze sessions, detect patterns, and build reports in one place. This launch adds full AI orchestration, real-time and replay-based eye tracking, gaze heatmaps, smarter analysis, and a broader research suite for teams that need faster evidence without losing methodological control.
description_zh: Fred 现在将用户体验研究转化为由 AI 编排的工作流：在一个地方规划研究、招募和管理参与者、运行测试、分析会话、检测模式并构建报告。此次更新增加了完整的 AI 编排功能、实时和回放式眼动追踪、注视热力图、更智能的分析以及更广泛的研究套件，帮助团队在保持方法论控制的同时获取更快的证据。

name: Universal Dictation on Stream
tagline: Private Voice Ring for dictation across iOS & Mac
tagline_zh: 私人语音环绕dictation，跨iOS & Mac
description: Introducing Universal Dictation on Stream. Push-to-talk across iOS and Mac: Instantly. No app switching, no reconnection. We built Notes so nothing gets lost, and Chat so you can think out loud. With Dictation, your voice goes anywhere. Notes, Chat, Dictation—in one voice ring
description_zh: 欢迎使用Stream上的Universal Dictation。跨iOS和Mac的推送语音：即刻。无需切换应用，无需重新连接。我们为Notes设计了不丢失任何内容，Chat设计让您可以随意思考。使用Dictation，您的声音可以到达任何地方。Notes、Chat、Dictation——在一个语音环中

description_zh: Cohere 迄今为止最快、最强大的语言模型：一款开源模型，旨在以最高效率运行高性能企业智能体。

name: Grok by SpaceXAI for Word
tagline: Draft, restructure & tighten wording from panel inside Word
tagline_zh: 在 Word 面板内起草、重构和优化措辞
description: Work with an AI Agent directly in your Word documents. The add-in enables a conversation-based agent sidebar that can search the web, update paragraphs, or build professional documents. Simply type what you want into the conversation pane and let the Agent handle research and execution. Ask it to rewrite paragraphs, summarize long reports, improve clarity and tone, generate outlines, create tables, or expand ideas, all without leaving Word.
description_zh: 直接在 Word 文档中与 AI 智能体协作。该插件提供了一个基于对话的智能体侧边栏，可以搜索网络、更新段落或构建专业文档。只需在对话窗格中输入您的需求，让智能体处理研究和执行。要求它重写段落、总结长篇报告、提高清晰度和语气、生成大纲、创建表格或扩展想法，所有操作均在 Word 内完成。

name: Deep Work Plan
tagline: Models matter. Context matters more. Give your agent a plan.
tagline_zh: 模型很重要，上下文更重要。给你的智能体一个计划。
description: Deep Work Plan turns any repo into a harness with the context of your best engineer — so any AI agent codes like your smartest model and can't drift from the plan. Not a chat window it forgets, a spec written into the repo: atomic tasks, acceptance criteria, validation gates, resumable state. Long runs survive context resets; any agent picks up where the last left off. Point an agent at it, walk away, come back to work you can verify. Any agent, any repo, no lock-in. Open Source, MIT.
description_zh: Deep Work Plan 将任何代码库转化为拥有你最佳工程师上下文的框架——让任何 AI 智能体都能像你最聪明的模型一样编码，且不会偏离计划。这不是一个会被遗忘的聊天窗口，而是写入代码库的规范：原子化任务、验收标准、验证关卡、可恢复状态。长时运行不受上下文重置影响；任何智能体都能从上一次中断处继续。只需指向智能体，然后去忙别的，回来即可验证工作成果。适用于任何智能体和代码库，无锁定。开源，MIT 协议。

name: Graft AI
tagline: Turn company operations into a living map for agents
tagline_zh: 将公司运营转化为代理人的动态地图
description: Most agent tools assume clean APIs. Graft starts where companies actually work: legacy apps, internal tools, and workflows trapped behind screens. It learns how the work gets done, turns it into a living operational map, and gives agents stable tools with permissions, approvals, audit trails, and verification built in. When the underlying UI changes, Graft detects the drift and repairs the workflow without breaking the agent interface.
description_zh: 大多数代理工具都假设拥有干净的 API。Graft 从公司实际工作的地方开始：遗留应用、内部工具以及被屏幕困住的工作流程。它学习工作是如何完成的，将其转化为一个动态运营地图，并为代理提供内置了权限、审批、审计追踪和验证功能的稳定工具。当底层 UI 变化时，Graft 会检测到偏差并修复工作流程，而不会破坏代理界面。

name: Lunen.ai
tagline: Build AI agents your whole team can run, and control
tagline_zh: 构建供整个团队运行和控制的 AI 代理
description: You've used ChatGPT and Claude for real work. They just do the task. No record of what they touched, no approval on the risky step, nothing you could hand your security team. Great UX, zero governance. Enterprise tools flip it: total control, an interface nobody wants to open. Lunen is what automated AI should be, the clean UX and the full transparency, not one or the other. Now in early access.
description_zh: 你已经在 ChatGPT 和 Claude 上处理过实际工作。它们只是完成任务，没有留下操作记录，没有对风险步骤的审批，也没有任何可供安全团队审核的内容。拥有优秀的用户体验，却缺乏治理。企业工具则恰恰相反：拥有完全的控制权，却提供了没人愿意打开的界面。Lunen 是自动化 AI 应该有的样子——既有干净的用户体验，又有完全的透明度，而非二选一。现已开放早期访问。

name: Insta360 Luna Ultra
tagline: A gimbal camera that sees with you
tagline_zh: 一款与你同视的云台相机
description: Insta360 Luna Ultra is an 8K gimbal camera with a 1" Leica Summicron main lens, 1/1.3" telephoto lens, 3-axis stabilization, detachable 2" OLED touchscreen, AI tracking, 10-bit I-Log, built-in storage, and POV shooting accessories.
description_zh: Insta360 Luna Ultra 是一款 8K 云台相机，配备 1 英寸徕卡 Summicron 主镜头、1/1.3 英寸长焦镜头、3 轴防抖、可拆卸 2 英寸 OLED 触摸屏、AI 追踪、10-bit I-Log、内置存储以及第一人称视角（POV）拍摄配件。

name: Backgrind
tagline: Run your AI agents over any app, even games.
tagline_zh: 在任何应用中运行你的 AI 智能体，即使是游戏。
description: Your AI agent shouldn't chain you to a terminal. Backgrind floats it in an always-on-top window over any app — even a fullscreen game — and pings you only when it actually needs a decision. Bring your own (Claude Code, Cursor) or use Grindy, the built-in agent with zero setup. Multi-agent tabs, voice, Build/Plan, click-through, local-first — your login, your history.
description_zh: 你的 AI 智能体不应将你束缚在终端前。Backgrind 将其悬浮在任何应用（包括全屏游戏）上方的始终置顶窗口中，仅在真正需要决策时才通知你。自带（Claude Code、Cursor）或使用零配置的内置智能体 Grindy。支持多智能体标签页、语音、Build/Plan、点击穿透、本地优先——你的登录信息，你的历史记录。

name: Mark by Airtop
tagline: Vibe automation for solo marketers
tagline_zh: 面向独立营销人员的氛围式自动化
description: Give Mark your website and it researches your business, creates a personalized GTM plan, and builds web agents that automate lead gen, enrichment, outbound, SEO, and Google Ads campaigns. Using Mark is like vibe coding, but for sales and marketing campaigns. Built on Airtop's Agent Builder platform, Mark compiles every automation into deterministic code, so its agents run reliably and 10-100X cheaper than LLM-per-step agents. Real marketing automations, built just by typing.
description_zh: 将您的网站交给 Mark，它会研究您的业务，制定个性化的 GTM 计划，并构建 Web 代理以自动化潜在客户生成、数据丰富、外展、SEO 和 Google Ads 活动。使用 Mark 就像进行“氛围编码”，但适用于销售和营销活动。Mark 基于 Airtop 的 Agent Builder 平台构建，将每项自动化编译为确定性代码，因此其代理运行可靠，成本比按步骤运行的 LLM 代理低 10-100 倍。只需输入文字，即可构建真实的营销自动化。

description: Basedash now has groups and access controls. Bundle users into groups — internal teams, external clients, leadership — and give each one access to exactly what it needs: data sources, MCP servers, dashboards, chats, and automations. Set a group's AI context so the assistant answers differently per audience, and row-level security applies to every question. The right people see the right data.
description_zh: Basedash 现已支持用户组和访问控制。将用户捆绑到组中——内部团队、外部客户、管理层——并为每个组授予其所需的确切权限：数据源、MCP 服务器、仪表板、聊天和自动化。设置组的 AI 上下文，使助手针对不同受众给出不同的回答，并且行级安全适用于每个问题。让对的人看到对的数据。

tagline: The most accurate STT model from AssemblyAI.
tagline_zh: AssemblyAI 最准确的语音转文字（STT）模型。
description: Universal-3.5 Pro is AssemblyAI's most accurate speech-to-text model, now available at our Realtime & Async endpoints. It transcribes every conversation exactly as it's heard—code-switching across 18 languages, our most accurate speaker diarization yet, and contextual prompting to steer results.
description_zh: Universal-3.5 Pro 是 AssemblyAI 最准确的语音转文字模型，现已在我们的 Realtime 和 Async 端点上线。它能精确转录每一次对话——支持 18 种语言的代码切换、我们迄今为止最准确的说话人分离功能，以及通过上下文提示来引导结果。

tagline_zh: 输入杂乱无章的内容，瞬间获得润色
description: Most tools force you to edit. Clarafy is a zero-suggestion chaos translator. Type or dictate a messy stream-of-consciousness, hit a hotkey, and it instantly rewrites perfect text in place. Standout Features: App-Aware: Formats contextually for Gmail, Slack, or ChatGPT. Hold-to-Dictate: Ramble out loud; release to inject polished prose. Tone Matching: Learns and mirrors your unique voice. No suggestions, no underlines. Just one-and-done clarity.
description_zh: 大多数工具强迫您进行编辑。Clarafy 是一个零建议的混乱翻译器。输入或口述杂乱的意识流，按下热键，它会在原位即时重写为完美的文本。突出功能：应用感知：为 Gmail、Slack 或 ChatGPT 进行上下文格式化。按住以口述：大声唠叨；松开以注入润色后的散文。没有建议，没有下划线。只需一键即可清晰明了。

name: Cloudskill
tagline: Govern the AI skills your team depends on
tagline_zh: 治理您的团队所依赖的 AI 技能
description: Bring order to the AI agent skills your team depends on. Cloudskill turns scattered skill files into a managed catalogue in seconds, complete with version control, per-person access policies, and a full audit log. When skills are created or updated, every change is reviewed, approved, and tracked.
description_zh: 为您团队所依赖的 AI 代理技能带来秩序。Cloudskill 在几秒钟内将散乱的技能文件转变为受管理的目录，并附带版本控制、个人访问策略和完整的审计日志。当创建或更新技能时，每一项更改都会经过审查、批准和跟踪。

name: Stella
tagline: Local natural language search across all your files
tagline_zh: 跨所有文件的本地自然语言搜索
description: You know the file exists. Spotlight can't find it. Stella can. Just describe it, "my cheat sheet for the final exam," "the product spec from last week's meeting" and Stella finds it. Then drag it straight into Gmail, open it, or launch any app from the same bar. One shortcut for your whole Mac. Free. Private. No account. Bad filenames welcome.
description_zh: 您知道文件存在，但 Spotlight 找不到。Stella 可以找到。只需描述它，“我期末考试的速查表”、“上周会议的产品规格”，Stella 就能找到它。然后将其直接拖入 Gmail、打开它，或从同一栏启动任何应用程序。Mac 上的一个快捷键。免费。私密。无需账户。欢迎使用糟糕的文件名。

description: A macOS workbench where Claude, Codex, and Hermes run on your specs, research, and Figma files.
description_zh: 一个 macOS 工作台，Claude、Codex 和 Hermes 根据您的规格、研究和 Figma 文件运行。

name: marpy.io
tagline: AI coding platform built specifically for the Python stack
tagline_zh: 专为 Python 技术栈打造的 AI 编码平台
description: Marpy is a web-based IDE and AI coding assistant built specifically for the Python stack. It helps you go from idea to deployed app without wrestling infra, glue code, or half-baked JS-focused tools. Get Python-native autocomplete, refactors, and AI-generated modules that actually understand Django, FastAPI, and real-world backends. Marpy lets you prototype, iterate, and ship production-grade Python apps faster, all from your browser.
description_zh: Marpy 是专为 Python 技术栈打造的基于 Web 的 IDE 和 AI 编码助手。它助您从构思到部署应用，无需与基础设施、胶水代码或半成品的 JS 工具搏斗。获得原生 Python 自动补全、重构以及真正理解 Django、FastAPI 和真实后端场景的 AI 生成模块。Marpy 让您能在浏览器中更快地原型设计、迭代并交付生产级 Python 应用。

name: Rixx
tagline: The Perplexity alternative that organizes your research
tagline_zh: 整理您研究的 Perplexity 替代方案
description: AI search engines lie. Rixx doesn't. Search the web and get answers backed by real citations so you can verify every claim, not just trust it. → See data visually with charts and graphs → See images inline with your results → Upload PDFs, docs, and links as context → Multimodal search: text, images, docs together → Organize research into Insights folders Stop guessing. Start knowing.
description_zh: AI 搜索引擎会撒谎。Rixx 不会。搜索网络并获得带有真实引用的答案，以便验证每个声明，而非盲目信任。→ 通过图表和图形可视化数据 → 在结果中内联查看图片 → 上传 PDF、文档和链接作为上下文 → 多模态搜索：文本、图像、文档结合 → 将研究组织到 Insights 文件夹中 停止猜测。开始确知。

name: Claude Science
tagline: Your research partner for rigorous science
tagline_zh: 严谨科学的科研伙伴
description: Claude Science is your AI workbench for scientific research. Works through your research like a skilled scientist, running the analysis and tracing every step. Spend less time stitching pipelines together, and more time on the science.
description_zh: Claude Science 是您的 AI 科学研工作台。它像熟练的科学家一样处理您的研究，执行分析并追踪每一步。减少拼接流程的时间，将更多精力投入科学研究本身。

description: ProtoFlow is the new step zero for electronic design, built for individual engineers and teams. Through its powerful AI assistant, universal component search, custom component generation, and multiplayer collaboration tools, ProtoFlow optimizes the PCB design process, slicing hours off development. The service is free to use, offers a full-suite platform, and exports smoothly to software like KiCad and Altium, allowing users at any skill level to fully optimize their hardware designs.
description_zh: ProtoFlow 是电子设计的新起点，专为个人工程师和团队打造。借助其强大的 AI 助手、通用组件搜索、自定义组件生成以及多人协作工具，ProtoFlow 优化了 PCB 设计流程，大幅缩短了开发周期。该服务免费使用，提供全套平台，并支持无缝导出到 KiCad 和 Altium 等软件，让各技能水平的用户都能充分优化其硬件设计。

tagline: Safe AI chat for kids
tagline_zh: 专为儿童设计的安全AI聊天
description: Yoggi is the AI assistant built for children aged 3–15. Age-adapted answers, live voice chat, image generation, strict content filtering, and parental controls. Free on iOS and Android.
description_zh: Yoggi 是专为 3–15 岁儿童设计的 AI 助手。提供根据年龄调整的回答、实时语音聊天、图像生成、严格的内容过滤和家长控制。iOS 和 Android 免费使用。

name: Liminal
tagline: A workspace & 2nd brain for you, your agent, and your team
tagline_zh: 工作空间和第二脑部
description: Your agent writes files locally in markdown and HTML, the formats it already speaks. Liminal renders them as clean UI instantly and syncs to your team in real time. Share a link and everyone sees the same live workspace, editable in the browser. No sending markdown over Slack, no hosting your own HTML, no waiting on Google Drive. No MCP calls, no proprietary formats, no wasted tokens. Over time, it becomes a shared second brain for your team and every agent working with you.
description_zh: 您的代理在本地以 markdown 和 HTML 格式写入文件，它们已经说了这些格式。Liminal 立即渲染它们并实时同步到您的团队。分享一个链接，所有人都可以看到同一个活跃工作空间，浏览器中可编辑。没有发送 markdown 到 Slack，没有托管自己的 HTML，没有等待 Google Drive。没有 MCP 调用，没有专有格式，没有浪费令牌。随着时间的推移，它将成为您的团队和每个与您合作的代理的共享第二脑部。

tagline: Run Claude Code and Codex in your own cloud environment
tagline_zh: 在您自己的云环境中运行 Claude Code 和 Codex
description: Cloud dev environments for agentic coding. Run each Claude Code or Codex chat on its own computer in the cloud, connect from mobile and desktop, and code from anywhere.
description_zh: 面向智能体编码的云开发环境。让每个 Claude Code 或 Codex 聊天在云端独立的计算机上运行，支持从移动设备和桌面连接，随时随地编码。

name: agentcad
tagline: A CAD design tool for coding agents (free + open source)
tagline_zh: 面向编码智能体的 CAD 设计工具（免费且开源）
description: Give your coding agent the ability to design real, manufacturable parts. Hand Claude Code or Codex a prompt, a sketch, or image. It writes build123d or CadQuery scripts, then runs agentcad to check its own work, catching broken code, confirming the geometry is watertight and dimensionally correct, and rendering it from every angle so your agent fixes its mistakes before you ever see them. You get back an interactive viewer plus STEP / STL / GLB files — ready to inspect, edit, or print.
description_zh: 赋予您的编码智能体设计可制造的真实零件的能力。向 Claude Code 或 Codex 提供提示词、草图或图像。它编写 build123d 或 CadQuery 脚本，然后运行 agentcad 检查其自身工作，捕获错误代码，确认几何体密闭且尺寸正确，并从各个角度渲染，以便您的智能体在您看到之前修正错误。您将得到一个交互式查看器以及 STEP / STL / GLB 文件——随时可供检查、编辑或打印。

name: Knock agent for Slack
tagline: Build, manage, and ship customer messaging from Slack
tagline_zh: 从 Slack 构建、管理和发送客户消息
description: Knock is the agent-led customer engagement platform for managing all the messages your users receive across channels. After connecting Knock to Slack, simply tag @Knock in any channel, describe what you want, and let the agent work in the background to build campaigns, draft messaging, and update lifecycle workflows. The agent gathers the context from your account, posts progress updates in the thread as it works, and provides a link to the resource when it's ready to review.
description_zh: Knock 是由智能体驱动的客户参与平台，用于管理您的用户跨渠道收到的所有消息。将 Knock 连接到 Slack 后，只需在任何频道中标记 @Knock，描述您的需求，智能体便会在后台工作以构建活动、起草消息并更新生命周期工作流。智能体会从您的账户收集上下文，在工作过程中在线程中发布进度更新，并在资源准备好时提供链接供您审查。

name: Notion Agents iOS app
tagline: Chat with Notion Agents anytime
tagline_zh: 随时与 Notion 代理聊天
description: A voice note. A photo of a napkin sketch. A question at 11pm. All handled before you're back at your desk. Get answers from all your connected tools and Notion docs, databases, and projects on the go. Capture ideas with text, voice, or photos, and let agents organize them for you. Take quick actions like creating pages, drafting updates, or searching across your connected tools—all from a simple chat.
description_zh: 一条语音备忘录。一张餐巾纸草图的照片。一个深夜11点的问题。在您回到办公桌之前全部处理完毕。随时随地从您连接的所有工具和 Notion 文档、数据库及项目中获取答案。通过文本、语音或照片捕捉想法，让代理为您整理它们。执行快速操作，如创建页面、起草更新或在您连接的工具中搜索——全部通过简单的聊天完成。

tagline: Your hardware idea, inspected. Verdict, BOM, 3D model.
tagline_zh: 您的硬件想法，经过检查。判决，BOM，3D模型。
description: Have a hardware idea? Describe it in a sentence. You get back a verdict (Buildable / Buildable with changes / Heavy lift / Not viable), a bill of materials costed at 100, 1,000 and 10,000 units, subsystem risk ratings, certification gates for your market, and a 3D concept model. Two minutes, no signup. Criteria come from 23 years of hardware building. Running on GPT-5.6 Terra.
description_zh: 有一个硬件想法？用一句话描述它。您会得到一个判决（可行 / 可行但需要修改 / 重大升级 / 不可行），一张成本为100、1000和10000单位的物料清单，子系统风险评级，市场认证门槛以及一个3D概念模型。两分钟，无需注册。标准来自23年的硬件构建经验。运行在GPT-5.6 Terra上。

Forgeon is a platform where authors create interactive stories with choices, RPG mechanics, music, illustrations, and more. We don't build AI authors—we build better tools for creators. We believe books can be as engaging as any game, movie, or series.

tagline: AI agents purpose-built for Hospitality

description: Conduit automates guest conversations and the work behind it. Conduit agents reply across email, WhatsApp, OTAs and social, voice calls. Agents dispatch subagents to act inside your PMS and tech stack: dispatching cleaners, updating calendars, closing the loop. Agents learn from every interaction, and you can inspect every step. 140+ languages, SOC 2 Type II. 50M+ conversations and $3B+ in reservation value for 300+ brands including Marriott, Hilton, Nobu and Fairmont.
description_zh: Conduit 自动化客人对话和背后的工作。Conduit 代理在电子邮件、WhatsApp、OTA 和社交媒体上回复。代理分派子代理在您的 PMS 和技术堆栈内执行：分派清洁工，更新日历，关闭循环。代理从每次交互中学习，您可以检查每一步。140+ 种语言，SOC 2 Type II。300+ 品牌，包括 Marriott、Hilton、Nobu 和 Fairmont，总共 50M+ 次对话和 3B+ 美元的预订价值。

name: fort
tagline: One command to audit and fix your Mac's security
tagline_zh: 一条命令审计并修复 Mac 的安全设置
description: Most Mac security tools need agents, signups, or MDM. fort doesn't. One command checks 15+ security settings: FileVault, SIP, firewall, screen lock, local admin rights, Gatekeeper, SSH, AirDrop and more. Reports a score and fixes most issues automatically. Single binary. No telemetry. MIT licensed. Perfect for developers hardening their own Mac, and for teams preparing for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 without the MDM overhead. brew install djadmin/tap/fort
description_zh: 大多数 Mac 安全工具需要安装代理、注册账号或使用 MDM。fort 不需要。一条命令即可检查 15 多项安全设置：FileVault、SIP、防火墙、屏幕锁定、本地管理员权限、Gatekeeper、SSH、AirDrop 等。它会给出安全评分并自动修复大部分问题。单个二进制文件，无遥测数据，采用 MIT 许可证。非常适合希望加固自身 Mac 的开发者，以及希望在无需 MDM 负担的情况下为 SOC 2 或 ISO 27001 合规做准备的团队。brew install djadmin/tap/fort

name: Lumo Studios
tagline: Build Decks that Speak for Themselves
tagline_zh: 打造会“说话”的演示文稿
description: Great ideas deserve great slides. LUMO uses AI to turn your thinking into polished decks instantly, beautifully, and exactly the way you want them. LUMO turns your ideas into beautiful presentations in seconds. Generate slides from a prompt, refine them in the canvas editor, and share with your team - all in one place.
description_zh: 伟大的创意值得精美的幻灯片。LUMO 利用 AI 将您的思路瞬间转化为精美且完全符合您预期的演示文稿。LUMO 能在几秒钟内将您的想法转化为精美的演示。从提示词生成幻灯片，在画布编辑器中精炼内容，并与团队分享——一切尽在一处。

name: Reader Alive
tagline: Translate, listen to, and ask questions about your ebooks
tagline_zh: 翻译、收听并提问关于您的电子书
description: Reader Alive is an AI ebook reader for iPhone and iPad. Import EPUB, PDF, AZW3, and MOBI, then translate chapters, listen with natural text-to-speech, summarize dense sections, and ask questions grounded in the book.
description_zh: Reader Alive 是一款适用于 iPhone 和 iPad 的 AI 电子书阅读器。支持导入 EPUB、PDF、AZW3 和 MOBI 格式，随后您可以翻译章节、使用自然的文本转语音功能收听、总结密集段落，并提出基于书本内容的问答。

name: Banger Mail
tagline: Shared mailboxes for teams and AI agents
tagline_zh: 面向团队和 AI 智能体的共享邮箱
description: Banger is a native Mac app for teams running shared inboxes like support@, sales@, and founder@. You and AI agents work the same mailboxes: agents triage, label, and draft with scoped access, while you review before anything sends. Connect your own domain or Google Workspace accounts, search everything, assign threads, and track work on a board. Early access: 14 days free, 2 mailboxes, 100 AI credits, no card. 500 spots now. Mac first, Windows and mobile next.
description_zh: Banger 是一款原生 Mac 应用，专为使用共享收件箱（如 support@、sales@、founder@）的团队设计。您和 AI 智能体可以操作相同的邮箱：智能体在受限范围内进行分类、打标和起草邮件，而您在发送前进行审核。连接您自己的域名或 Google Workspace 账户，搜索所有内容，分配线程，并在看板中追踪工作进度。早期访问：14 天免费，2 个邮箱，100 个 AI 积分，无需信用卡。仅限 500 个名额。优先支持 Mac，Windows 和移动端即将推出。

name: Owlish
tagline: Reduce support volume with AI agents trained on your docs
tagline_zh: 通过基于文档训练的 AI 智能体减少客服工作量
description: Owlish turns your website, FAQs, docs, and PDFs into an AI customer support agent that answers common questions, cites sources, uses approved replies, and hands off to a human when needed. It helps businesses reduce repetitive support volume, reply faster outside business hours, and give support teams the context they need to resolve harder conversations.
description_zh: Owlish 将您的网站、常见问题解答、文档和 PDF 转化为 AI 客户支持智能体，能够回答常见问题、引用来源、使用批准的回复，并在必要时转接人工。它帮助企业减少重复性的客服工作量，在非工作时间更快响应，并为支持团队提供解决复杂对话所需的上下文信息。

name: InstaVM
tagline: Instant computers for AI agents
tagline_zh: AI 智能体的即时计算资源
description: The production control plane for AI agents. Run agents like production servers: isolated, observable, and controlled. Firecracker microVMs with sub-200ms boot.
description_zh: AI 智能体的生产级控制平面。像运行生产服务器一样运行智能体：隔离、可观测且受控。采用 Firecracker 微虚拟机，启动时间低于 200 毫秒。

name: TongueType for macOS
tagline: Local dictation for macOS without the subscription
tagline_zh: macOS 本地听写，无需订阅
description: TongueType is a macOS voice dictation app powered by Whisper AI running locally on Apple Silicon. No cloud, no accounts, no subscriptions. Hold a key, speak, release. Your words appear. Supports 12 languages and audio file transcription. TongueType gives you a configurable press-to-talk hotkey, audio and video file transcription, and configurable post-processing rules. It's customizable and fun (try Rainbow Mode!) and it's built to be the fastest dictation workflow possible.
description_zh: TongueType 是一款基于本地 Apple Silicon 运行 Whisper AI 的 macOS 语音听写应用。无需云端、无需账号、无需订阅。按住按键，说话，松开。文字即刻呈现。支持 12 种语言及音频文件转录。TongueType 提供可自定义的按键说话热键、音视频文件转录功能以及可配置的后处理规则。它高度可定制且充满趣味（试试彩虹模式！），旨在打造极速的听写工作流。

name: Crew44
tagline: Turn coding agents into specialist teams
tagline_zh: 将代码智能体转化为专家团队
description: Crew44 — a crew of specialist AI agents in one local-first workspace. Each role on the model that wins its job, with memory and skills that compound. No account, free, open source.
description_zh: Crew44 —— 一个本地优先工作区内的专家 AI 智能体团队。每个角色各司其职，记忆与技能不断累积。无需账号，免费，开源。

name: Zingle
tagline: Learn words in context with AI
tagline_zh: 在语境中借助 AI 学习单词
description: Learn words where they make sense. Read stories and your own content, understand words in context with AI, and remember them through a connected learning loop.
description_zh: 在单词有意义的情境中学习。阅读故事及您的个人内容，借助 AI 理解语境中的单词，并通过关联学习循环加深记忆。

name: Laguna by Poolside
tagline: Foundation models for agentic coding and long-horizon work
tagline_zh: 面向智能体编码与长周期任务的基础模型
description: Poolside is a foundation model company bringing intelligence to everywhere work gets done. Their mission is to drive abundance for humanity by creating artificial general intelligence.
description_zh: Poolside 是一家基础模型公司，致力于将智能融入所有工作场所。其使命是通过创造通用人工智能来推动人类社会的丰裕。

name: Locofy: design-to-code agents
tagline: Agentic frontend layer between Figma and Cursor & Claude
tagline_zh: Figma 与 Cursor & Claude 之间的智能体前端层
description: Locofy is the agentic frontend layer between Figma and Cursor & Claude. Using proprietary design-aware models combined with LLMs, Locofy converts Figma designs into structured, responsive, pixel-perfect frontend code and works directly from the CLI, Cursor, Claude Code, and others. While coding agents excel at logic and iteration, they still struggle with UI precision and Figma structure — Locofy provides the frontend foundation they can reliably build on.
description_zh: Locofy 是 Figma 与 Cursor & Claude 之间的智能体前端层。结合专有设计感知模型与大语言模型，Locofy 可将 Figma 设计稿转换为结构化、响应式、像素级精准的前端代码，并可直接通过 CLI、Cursor、Claude Code 等工具使用。虽然代码智能体擅长逻辑与迭代，但在 UI 精度和 Figma 结构方面仍面临挑战——Locofy 为其提供了可靠的前端基础。

name: Sequence Agentic
tagline: Money movement for AI agents
tagline_zh: AI 代理的资金流转工具
description: Sequence is the financial execution layer for AI agents. Unlike read-only tools, your agent uses the Sequence API to send, split, and route real money across all your bank accounts, cards, apps, and loans. tagline_zh: 您使用的所有 AI 工具，一个订阅即可享受
description: Krater turns AI from something you try into something you use. Every AI model, every modality, every app you use, combined into one chat and driven by one agent. Tell it what you need in plain language and it gets it done; whatever you're building, studying, running or creating. The same agent that chats with you can generate an image, edit a video, produce a song, automate your apps, and publish a full website, all in one flow. 70K+ users. API access. Replaces $100+/mo in subscriptions.
description_zh: Krater 将 AI 从“尝试使用”转变为“日常使用”。它将您使用的每种 AI 模型、每种模态和每个应用整合到一个聊天界面中，并由单一代理驱动。用自然语言告诉它您的需求，它便能为您完成；无论您是在构建项目、学习、运营还是创作。同一个代理不仅能与您聊天，还能生成图像、编辑视频、制作歌曲、自动化您的应用并发布完整网站，所有操作均在同一流程中完成。70K+ 用户。支持 API 访问。取代每月 100 美元以上的订阅费用。

name: Pixlie
tagline: AI video studio: text & image to video, with real control
tagline_zh: AI视频工作室：文本与图像生成视频，实现精准控制
description: Pixlie is an AI video studio for creators who want control—not a black-box generator. Browse your library, queue jobs in the cloud, and track renders in the app. Same account on pixlys.com and iOS.What makes it different: Text2Video, Image2Video, library & cloud queue Granular creative workflow not just “type and pray” Live on iOS App Store; Google play web at pixlys.com -Built solo by a refugee founder in Helsinki shipped fast, iterated in production
description_zh: Pixlie是一款面向创作者的AI视频工作室，旨在提供控制权而非黑盒式生成。浏览您的素材库，在云端排队任务，并在应用中跟踪渲染进度。pixlys.com与iOS端账号互通。核心亮点：Text2Video、Image2Video、素材库与云端队列。精细化的创意工作流，告别“盲打祈祷”式操作。已在iOS App Store上线；Google Play网页版访问pixlys.com。由赫尔辛基的一位难民创始人独立开发，快速迭代并投入生产环境。

name: Microsoft MAI-Voice-2
tagline: Expressive TTS with voice cloning in 15 languages
tagline_zh: 支持15种语言的语音克隆 expressive TTS
description: Microsoft's most expressive TTS model yet — voice cloning from short samples, fine-grained emotional control, and consistent voice identity across 15 languages. Now live in Azure AI Foundry at $22 per million characters, with integrations rolling out in VSCode, Dynamics 365 Contact Center, and Teams. For builders shipping voice agents who need production-grade prosody without the OpenAI Realtime API price tag.
description_zh: 微软迄今为止最具表现力的TTS模型——支持从短样本进行语音克隆，提供细粒度的情感控制，并在15种语言中保持声音身份的一致性。现已在Azure AI Foundry上线，价格为每百万字符22美元，并正在VSCode、Dynamics 365 Contact Center和Teams中逐步推出集成。专为需要生产级韵律效果但又不愿承担OpenAI Realtime API高昂费用的语音智能体开发者打造。

name: Hush
tagline: Open-source noise suppression for voice AI agents
tagline_zh: 面向语音AI智能体的开源降噪方案
description: Hush removes competing voices, background noise, and audio interference from real-time calls so your voice AI agents always hear what matters.
description_zh: Hush可消除实时通话中的竞争人声、背景噪音和音频干扰，确保您的语音AI智能体始终能捕捉关键信息。

name: Phantom
tagline: Voice-first AI agent that operates your Mac
tagline_zh: 语音优先的AI助手，可操作你的Mac
description: Phantom is a voice-first AI agent for macOS that is always accessible via the Mac notch. Instead of opening a chatbot window and moving work into a separate conversation, users speak or type from anywhere on their Mac, without interrupting their work. Phantom understands the relevant screen and app context and completes tasks directly within the user's workflow. The possibilities are only limited by the imagination of the user.
description_zh: Phantom是macOS的语音优先AI助手，始终可通过Mac刘海屏访问。用户无需打开聊天机器人窗口并将工作转移到单独的对话中，可以在Mac的任何地方通过语音或输入进行操作，而不会中断工作。Phantom能够理解相关的屏幕和应用程序上下文，直接在用户的工作流程中完成任务。可能性仅受用户想象力限制。

name: Epilude
tagline: Local voice dictation for Mac for polished text
tagline_zh: Mac本地语音 dictate，生成精美文本
description: Hold a key, speak, release: polished text lands in any app on your Mac. Epilude transcribes, punctuates, cleans up, and matches your tone in about a second. Runs fully on-device, so audio never leaves your Mac.
description_zh: 按住一个键，发言，释放：精美文本出现在你的Mac上。Epilude进行转录、标点、清理和匹配你的语气，仅需一秒钟。完全在设备上运行，因此音频永远不会离开你的Mac。

name: Agent Browser Shield
tagline: Block prompt inject & cut token costs for AI browser agents
tagline_zh: 阻止提示词注入并降低AI浏览器智能体的Token成本
description: AI agents browsing the web have a problem: they read everything — cookie banners, hidden instructions, dark patterns — and can't tell real content from a trap. Agent Browser Shield sits between your agent and the web, stripping prompt injections, masking PII, removing dark patterns, and filtering page noise that burns tokens. Free, source-available, works with browser-use and Browserbase.
description_zh: 在Web上浏览的AI智能体面临一个问题：它们会阅读所有内容——包括Cookie横幅、隐藏指令和暗黑模式——却无法区分真实内容与陷阱。Agent Browser Shield位于智能体与Web之间，剥离提示词注入，屏蔽个人身份信息（PII），移除暗黑模式，并过滤消耗Token的页面噪音。免费且源码可用，兼容browser-use和Browserbase。

name: Basedash Semantic Layer
tagline: Define metrics once. Use them everywhere.
tagline_zh: 一次定义指标，处处通用
description: The Basedash semantic layer lets teams create reusable SQL metrics and models that AI can reference across chat, charts, dashboards, insights, and automations.
description_zh: Basedash语义层让团队能够创建可复用的SQL指标和模型，供AI在聊天、图表、仪表板、洞察分析和自动化流程中跨场景调用。

name: Kim Personal Health Assistant
tagline: The intelligence layer for Apple Health
tagline_zh: Apple Health 的智能层
description: Meet Kim, a personal health assistant that turns your health data into simple conversations and personal experiments, helping you understand what actually works for your body. Kim becomes more personalized the more data you provide.
description_zh: 认识 Kim，一位个人健康助手，它将您的健康数据转化为简单的对话和个人实验，帮助您了解什么对您的身体真正有效。您提供的数据越多，Kim 的个性化程度就越高。

name: DCP
tagline: Give your AI agents encrypted permission and keys
tagline_zh: 为您的 AI Agent 提供加密权限和密钥
description: Today, many agents read keys and sensitive info from dotenv files, configs, or memory. One bad prompt or compromised tool can drain your wallet, API bill, or private data. DCP makes agents safe for real work: your wallets and API keys stay encrypted on your own machine. Give each agent only the scopes it needs; it asks, you approve from Telegram or App. Daily budgets, logs, and instant revoke keep you in control. Open source, non-custodial, and works with Claude, Cursor, OpenClaw, and Hermes.
description_zh: 如今，许多 Agent 从 .env 文件、配置文件或内存中读取密钥和敏感信息。一个糟糕的提示词或被攻陷的工具可能会耗尽您的钱包余额、API 费用或泄露私人数据。DCP 让 Agent 能够安全地用于实际工作：您的钱包和 API 密钥始终在您自己的机器上保持加密状态。为每个 Agent 仅授予其所需的范围；它发起请求，您通过 Telegram 或 App 批准。每日预算、日志和即时撤销功能让您掌控全局。开源、非托管，并兼容 Claude、Cursor、OpenClaw 和 Hermes。

name: Glimpse
tagline: The competitive intelligence agent
tagline_zh: 竞争情报 Agent
description: Your competitors move every day. Glimpse is the AI agent that keeps up. It tracks every competitor across ads, pricing, hiring, content, reviews and AI search, then turns each move into your next one: always-current battle cards, your real win rate, and the demand you lose in AI answers before a deal exists. Delivered to Slack and your inbox. It runs the whole competitive program for you, so a team of one moves like a team of ten. Start free in minutes.
description_zh: 您的竞争对手每天都在行动。Glimpse 是紧跟其步伐的 AI Agent。它跟踪所有竞争对手在广告、定价、招聘、内容、评论和 AI 搜索方面的动态，并将每一次动作转化为您的下一步策略：提供始终最新的竞争卡片、您的真实胜率，以及在交易达成前您在 AI 回答中流失的需求。结果发送至 Slack 和您的邮箱。它为您运行整个竞争情报项目，让单人团队拥有十人团队的效能。几分钟内免费开始。

name: Cito
tagline: Hybrid academic search over 236M papers, built for agents
tagline_zh: 混合学术搜索，覆盖 2.36 亿篇论文，专为智能体构建
description: Cito is a hybrid search engine over the Semantic Scholar corpus: 236M papers in the keyword index, 146M with SPECTER2 dense vectors, fused with RRF and reranked by a cross-encoder. Free web search with no signup, a plain JSON API, and a native MCP endpoint so agents like Claude Code can run deep literature research without upstream rate limits. Built because every academic API throttled my agents to death.
description_zh: Cito 是一个基于 Semantic Scholar 语料库的混合搜索引擎：关键词索引包含 2.36 亿篇论文，1.46 亿篇拥有 SPECTER2 稠密向量，通过 RRF 融合并由交叉编码器重排。提供免费网络搜索、无需注册、纯 JSON API 和原生 MCP 端点，让 Claude Code 等智能体能够进行深度文献研究，而无需担心上游限流。构建此工具是因为之前的学术 API 都把我的智能体限流到崩溃。

name: Basement
tagline: Shopping browser with agentic checkout
tagline_zh: 具有代理式结帐功能的购物浏览器
description: Basement is now a shopping browser. Today we launch agentic checkout: your AI shopper finds the best price across the web and buys it for you. Every purchase runs on a single-use card scoped to one order, so your real card is never exposed and nothing goes beyond the budget you set. Every payment lands in one place. Powered by Crossmint. It knows what you like. Now it can buy it. Live on iOS and Chrome.
description_zh: 地下室现在变成了购物浏览器。今天我们推出代理式结帐：您的AI购物者在整个网络中找到最佳价格并为您购买。每笔购买都使用一个单次使用的卡，范围仅限于一个订单，因此您的真实卡不会暴露，且不会超出您设置的预算。每笔付款都在一个地方。由Crossmint驱动。它知道您喜欢什么。现在它可以为您购买。

name: Comms
tagline: Launch iMessage agents in seconds
tagline_zh: 秒级启动 iMessage 代理
description: Getting an iMessage line for your business used to mean sales calls, carrier paperwork, weeks of waiting, and $225+ a month before your first text. Comms puts a live agent on a real iMessage line in about 30 seconds. Describe it in plain English or make one API call. It handles support, bookings, onboarding, and payments inside the thread people actually read. Free to start with 3,000 messages a month, then a flat $50.
description_zh: 获取一条 iMessage 线路用于您的业务曾经意味着销售电话、运营商文件、等待几个星期以及每月 225 美元以上的费用，直到您收到第一条短信。 Comms 在大约 30 秒内将一个活跃的代理人放在一个真实的 iMessage 线路上。用简单的语言描述它，或者发出一个 API 请求。它处理支持、预订、入职和支付，所有这些都在人们实际阅读的线程中。免费，初始 3,000 条消息，然后每月 50 美元的固定费用。

name: GhostSnap
tagline: Multiple screenshots - Single paste - Auto compressed for AI
tagline_zh: 多张截图 - 单次粘贴 - 自动压缩以适配 AI
description: Taking multiple screenshots & pasting one by one, to share context with AI or any apps? Every image eats tokens or makes file larger. GhostSnap fixes that. Snap multiple screenshots → auto-compressed up to 80% & copied to clipboard the moment they're taken → paste everything at once with a single Cmd+V. Also: · Extract text from multiple screenshots into one clean block · Annotate before you paste · All via native Mac shortcuts One-time $6.99 (for two macs). Lives in your menu bar.
description_zh: 需要截取多张截图并逐一粘贴，以便与 AI 或任何应用共享上下文吗？每张图像都会消耗 token 或使文件变大。GhostSnap 解决了这个问题。一次性截取多张截图 → 截图瞬间自动压缩高达 80% 并复制到剪贴板 → 只需按一次 Cmd+V 即可全部粘贴。此外：· 将多张截图中的文本提取到一个整洁的块中 · 粘贴前进行标注 · 全部通过原生 Mac 快捷键完成。一次性付费 $6.99（支持两台 Mac）。常驻菜单栏。

name: KugelAudio
tagline: Real-time text-to-speech model you can self-host
tagline_zh: 您可自托管的实时文本转语音模型
description: Most natural real-time TTS with voice cloning and sub-60ms latency, on-prem or via API. Grammar-aware normalization reads phone numbers, IBANs, addresses, and medications naturally across 25+ languages, with word-level timestamps and IPA support. Adapters for LiveKit, Pipecat, and Vapi. Built by 4 in Berlin.
description_zh: 最自然的实时 TTS，支持语音克隆和低于 60ms 的延迟，可本地部署或通过 API 使用。具备语法感知的规范化功能，能自然地在 25 多种语言中读取电话号码、IBAN、地址和药物名称，并提供单词级时间戳和 IPA 支持。提供 LiveKit、Pipecat 和 Vapi 的适配器。由柏林的 4 人团队打造。

name: Vidrunner
tagline: Publish YouTube videos faster with AI
tagline_zh: 利用 AI 更快地发布 YouTube 视频
description: Generate accurate YouTube timestamps, keyword-rich tags, and Amazon product links from any video. Paste a URL, pick what you need, copy and paste into YouTube. Start free.
description_zh: 从任何视频中生成准确的 YouTube 时间戳、富含关键词的标签以及亚马逊产品链接。粘贴 URL，选择您需要的项目，复制并粘贴到 YouTube 中。免费开始使用。

name: Clawd
tagline: A context-aware browser mascot with 100% local offline AI
tagline_zh: 具有100%本地离线AI的上下文感知浏览器吉祥物
description: Meet Clawd, the context-aware browser pet that truly understands your vibe. Clawd crawls your screen, reacts to website sentiment, and levels up to unlock 140+ animations. He’s more than just a mascot. Use the new voice-enabled Chat to talk to him in custom personas (Sarcastic, Gen Z), complete with Markdown support and text-to-speech! Best of all? It’s 100% offline and privacy-first. Your data never leaves your machine. Clawd is your ultimate browsing companion!
description_zh: 认识Clawd，这个真正理解你风格的上下文感知浏览器宠物。Clawd爬取你的屏幕，对网站情绪做出反应，并通过升级解锁140+动画。他不仅仅是吉祥物。使用新的语音支持的Chat，以自定义人格（讽刺、Z世代）与他对话，支持Markdown和文本转语音！最重要的是？它100%离线且隐私优先。你的数据永远不会离开你的设备。Clawd是你终极的浏览伴侣！

name: BugShot
tagline: Discover, fix, capture, and report bugs in one shot
tagline_zh: 一次性发现、修复、捕获并报告错误
description: Catch a bug and file a complete report from Chrome's side panel. Captures, console/network logs, and environment attach automatically. Or tweak the CSS live and send the before/after side by side. AI drafts it for you. Free, no account, straight to your tracker.
description_zh: 从Chrome侧边栏捕获错误并提交完整报告。截图、控制台/网络日志和环境信息会自动附加。或者实时调整CSS并发送前后对比。AI为你起草报告。免费，无需账户，直接发送到你的跟踪系统。

name: Vela
tagline: The AI Recruiting Coordinator
tagline_zh: AI招聘协调员
description: Vela is an AI recruiting coordinator. Cc it on any email thread and it takes over: candidate screens, multi-round loops, and full panels. It offers times, chases people who go quiet, handles reschedules, sends the resume with the invite, books prep calls, and collects feedback. Email, SMS, WhatsApp, Slack, and phone, every time zone, 24/7. No links, no logins, nothing new for your team to learn. Trusted by The World's Best Recruiters, and backed by YC, CRV, and other incredible investors.

description: Deck Builder turns one sentence into a real, editable HTML deck: a single web page you change right in the browser (press E) and download as your own file. tagline: 2× Claude Code Pro's usage at $15/mo
tagline_zh: 15美元/月获得Claude Code Pro使用量的2倍
description: Dropstone 1.5 is our monthly re-baseline release. We test the top AI coding models every month and rebuild the runtime on whichever wins. Roughly twice what Claude Code Pro delivers at $20. Full technical report with the cost math and benchmarks: blankline.org/research/dropstone-1-5
description_zh: Dropstone 1.5是我们每月重新基准的发布版本。我们每月测试顶级AI编码模型，并在获胜者上重建运行时。本月：DeepSeek V4 Flash、V4 Pro和Moonshot Kimi K2.6都在美国托管，我们这边不存储任何内容。15美元/月每周获得约450个深度编码会话。大约是20美元Claude Code Pro提供服务的两倍。包含成本计算和基准测试的完整技术报告：blankline.org/research/dropstone-1-5

tagline: AI support agent, help center & changelogs in a single inbox
tagline_zh: AI支持代理、帮助中心和更新日志集成在一个收件箱中
description: Your team should be building your product not the support infrastructure around it. ReleaseDock provides a unified support inbox, a support agent that can not only answer questions but also take action. A hosted help center and changelog. And a widget that embeds right into your website with announcements, support, etc. P.S. ReleaseDock is currently offering a Lifetime Deal for founding memebers!
description_zh: 你的团队应该构建你的产品，而不是围绕它的支持基础设施。ReleaseDock提供统一的支持收件箱，一个不仅能回答问题还能采取行动的支持代理。一个托管的帮助中心和更新日志。以及一个直接嵌入到你网站的组件，包含公告、支持等。附注：ReleaseDock目前为创始成员提供终身优惠！

tagline: Know what your team actually shipped today

description: Eodly reads Slack, Telegram, Discord, GitHub and Linear, and sends founders one sourced page each evening: who shipped, who's quiet, who's slipping, and any status that doesn't match reality. Your team never logs in. A chief of staff, not surveillance.
description_zh: Eodly 读取 Slack、Telegram、Discord、GitHub 和 Linear 的数据，每晚向创始人发送一份经过筛选的单页报告：谁完成了工作、谁保持沉默、谁进度滞后，以及哪些状态与实际情况不符。你的团队无需登录。它是首席幕僚，而非监控工具。

description_zh: QuickQuill 记录您的会议并将其转换为文字记录和摘要，且不会将任何内容发送到云端。没有机器人加入通话，即使关闭 Wi-Fi 也能继续工作，演示视频就是这样录制的。录制时还显示带翻译的实时字幕，任何应用都有按说即录功能。无需账户，无需订阅。语音输入永久免费，只需 49 美元即可解锁完整的会议工作流程。需要 Apple Silicon 上的 macOS 26。

name: Contextberg
tagline: Turn your work into AI agent memory, served over MCP
tagline_zh: 将你的工作转化为通过 MCP 服务的 AI 代理记忆
description: Contextberg is a local memory app for AI agents. It watches your screens, browser history, and agent conversations in the background — so Claude Code, Cursor, and friends can just remember.
description_zh: Contextberg 是一款面向 AI 代理的本地记忆应用。它在后台监控你的屏幕、浏览器历史和代理对话——让 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具能够自动记住上下文。

name: baz.studio
tagline: Skills library & video editor for AI Agents
tagline_zh: AI 代理的技能库与视频编辑器
description: Baz Studio is an AI-native video production platform for humans and AI agents. Today we’re launching Skills: the world’s largest library of open-source video workflows for AI. Turn pitch decks into videos, codebases into launch videos, and blog posts into content series. Run Baz directly inside Claude, Codex, or any AI coding agent using the CLI, and watch full video productions appear inside the Baz Studio web UI.
description_zh: Baz Studio 是一个为人类和 AI 代理打造的 AI 原生视频制作平台。今天我们发布 Skills：全球最大的开源视频工作流库。将演示文稿转为视频，代码库转为发布视频，博客文章转为内容系列。通过 CLI 直接在 Claude、Codex 或任何 AI 编码代理中运行 Baz，即可在 Baz Studio Web UI 中查看完整的视频制作过程。

name: Vibedock
tagline: Toggle Claude Code MCP servers from your menu bar
tagline_zh: 从菜单栏切换 Claude Code MCP 服务器
description: Every MCP server you have configured injects its tool definitions into your context window on every single message — whether you use it that session or not. Vibedock sits in your macOS menu bar and lets you toggle MCPs on and off in one click. It automatically kills and relaunches your Claude sessions so the change actually takes effect.
description_zh: 你配置的每个 MCP 服务器都会将其工具定义注入到每次消息的上下文窗口中——无论你是否在该会话中使用它。Vibedock 驻留在你的 macOS 菜单栏中，让你只需一键即可开启或关闭 MCP。它会自动终止并重启你的 Claude 会话，使更改生效。

name: Moxie Docs
tagline: Living docs + MCP context for your GitHub repos
tagline_zh: 为你的 GitHub 仓库提供动态文档 + MCP 上下文
description: Moxie Docs indexes your GitHub repo once, then puts that understanding where the work happens: repo context inside your AI agents over MCP, a searchable docs workspace, and PR checks that keep documentation honest.
description_zh: Moxie Docs 对 GitHub 仓库进行一次索引，然后将这种理解带到工作发生的地方：通过 MCP 在 AI 代理内部提供仓库上下文、一个可搜索的文档工作区，以及确保文档真实性的 PR 检查。

name: Signal Recorder SR-7
tagline: On-device voice recorder that transcribes + exports Markdown
tagline_zh: 支持转录并导出 Markdown 的端侧语音录音机
description: Privacy-first voice recorder for Mac and iPhone. Transcripts and AI summaries run on-device via Apple Speech and FoundationModels — no server, no account, nothing leaving your machine. Every recording exports as a Markdown file with YAML frontmatter — yours, on disk, ready for Obsidian or git. A built-in local MCP server lets Claude Code and other AI tools query the archive. Designed experience-first, to keep you in the moment. $7.99, buy once — Mac and iPhone, no subscription.
description_zh: 隐私优先的 Mac 和 iPhone 语音录音机。转录和 AI 摘要通过 Apple Speech 和 FoundationModels 在设备端运行——无需服务器，无需账户，数据绝不离开你的设备。每次录音都导出为带有 YAML 前缀的 Markdown 文件——存储在本地磁盘，随时可用于 Obsidian 或 git。内置的本地 MCP 服务器允许 Claude Code 和其他 AI 工具查询档案。以体验为先设计，让你专注于当下。售价 $7.99，一次性购买——适用于 Mac 和 iPhone，无订阅。

name: Genie Mentions
tagline: AI that gets you *and* the people in your life, together
tagline_zh: 懂你，也懂你生活中的人的 AI
description: Genie was built on the belief that to truly "get" you, a meaningful social product must also "get" the people in your life. introducing Genie Mentions: the first AI that treats your circle as part of who you are. your taste. your friends' taste. what you're all into. Genie keeps you updated on big moves your friends are making, trips they’re taking, dreams they’re conjuring. if you want AI for work, ChatGPT awaits you. if you want to know what's going on in your world, tag Genie in.
description_zh: Genie 基于一个信念：要真正“懂”你，有意义的社交产品也必须“懂”你生活中的人。Genie Mentions 由此诞生——首款将你的社交圈视为你身份一部分的 AI。你的品味、朋友的品味、你们共同的兴趣。Genie 让你随时掌握好友的重大动态、旅行计划和梦想蓝图。若你需要工作用 AI，ChatGPT 等你；若你想了解身边世界，就 @Genie。

name: OASIS 1 Ring
tagline: Whisper to write and touch to edit
tagline_zh: 低语书写，触控编辑
description: OASIS Ring combines our patented ring trackpad with private voice capture, integrated with Wispr Flow. After shipping the most advanced trackpad ever built into a ring this year, we’re launching our next step: an interface on your finger that lets you whisper privately, dictate with Wispr, and edit text with our trackpad without ever touching a keyboard.
description_zh: OASIS Ring 将我们专利的戒指轨迹板与私密语音捕捉相结合，并集成 Wispr Flow。今年，我们在将史上最先进的轨迹板打造为戒指形态后，推出了我们的下一步举措：一款佩戴在手指上的界面，让您能够私密低语、使用 Wispr 进行语音输入，并通过轨迹板编辑文本，全程无需触碰键盘。

It brings PieterPost online mail, API, and payment-link workflows into agent tools.
description_zh: PieterPost MCP 将 AI 智能体连接到邮政邮件。从 ChatGPT、Claude、Codex、Claude Code 或任何 MCP 客户端，智能体可以准备信件和明信片，使用 Mailbook 联系人，上传附件或明信片图片，创建结账链接，并跟踪订单。它将 PieterPost 的在线邮件、API 和支付链接工作流带入智能体工具。

name: AI Agents in Chat
tagline: Your Chat UI Just Got an AI Roommate
tagline_zh: 你的聊天界面刚刚多了一位 AI 室友
description: Your AI agent belongs in the chat you already built. CometChat's iOS UI Kit lets you turn your existing messaging experience into an AI conversation with streaming responses, chat history, and a fully customizable UI built in. Connect your agent, match your brand, and ship without building AI chat from scratch.
description_zh: 你的 AI 代理应该嵌入到你已有的聊天应用中。CometChat 的 iOS UI Kit 让你将现有的消息体验转变为带有流式响应、聊天历史记录和内置完全可定制 UI 的 AI 对话。连接你的代理，匹配你的品牌，无需从零开始构建 AI 聊天即可发布。

tagline: LLM usage tracking that lives in your Mac's notch
tagline_zh: 常驻 Mac 刘海栏的 LLM 用量追踪工具
description: TrackNotch is a native macOS app that shows Claude, OpenAI, Cursor, and Codex usage right in your notch. Context arc, budget tracking, rate limits and all local. No proxies, no telemetry, nothing leaves your machine. Free and open-source.
description_zh: TrackNotch 是一款原生 macOS 应用，直接在刘海栏显示 Claude、OpenAI、Cursor 和 Codex 的使用情况。上下文窗口、预算追踪、速率限制，全部本地处理。无代理、无遥测、数据不出本机。免费且开源。

name: Medicyn
tagline: Your complete medical history privately on your device
tagline_zh: 完全私密存储于你设备上的完整医疗记录
description: The only health app that keeps your medical history completely private—on your device, offline, with no accounts or tracking. Store your complete health record: conditions, medications, prescriptions, allergies, lab reports, surgeries, and more. Scan documents with AI, track symptoms, set reminders, and manage up to 6 family members. 7-day free trial. Then pay once, use forever—no subscriptions, no ads. Your health. Your data. Your control.
description_zh: 唯一一款将医疗记录完全私密保存在你设备上的健康应用——离线运行，无需账户或追踪。存储完整健康档案：病史、药物、处方、过敏史、检验报告、手术记录等。利用 AI 扫描文档，追踪症状，设置提醒，并管理多达 6 位家庭成员。7 天免费试用。之后一次性付费，终身使用——无订阅费，无广告。你的健康。你的数据。你掌控。

name: Carbon Voice Speed Dial
tagline: Get your whole team (humans and agents!) on speed dial
tagline_zh: 让你的整个团队（人类和 AI 智能体！）一键直达
description: Talk to your whole team — people and AI agents — with one tap. Carbon Voice gives you a speed dial for your team. One keystroke on desktop, one tap on mobile, and you're talking to anyone — a teammate, a group, or an AI agent like OpenClaw, Hermes, n8n, Claude Code, or Tasklet. Teams see 60% less time in meetings. Now your agents are just as easy to reach.
description_zh: 轻触即可与整个团队——人和 AI 智能体——对话。Carbon Voice 为你的团队提供快捷拨号功能。在桌面端按一个键，在移动端点一下，即可与任何人交谈——队友、群组，或 OpenClaw、Hermes、n8n、Claude Code、Tasklet 等 AI 智能体。团队会议时间减少 60%。现在，联系你的智能体同样轻松。

name: MoDev
tagline: The AI dev environment built for your phone.
tagline_zh: 专为手机打造的 AI 开发环境。
description: The AI dev environment built for your phone. Connect GitHub, Vercel, Supabase, Gmail, Calendar, and more. Any AI. Any API. Then chat to ship. → Deploy from your phone → Read repos, commit, open PRs → Query your database with natural language → Manage email and calendar by chat → BYOK on dev plans · Claude included on Moonlight One message. Real execution. From anywhere. Built solo. Bootstrapped. Founding members lock in today's price forever — first 100 only.
description_zh: 专为手机打造的 AI 开发环境。连接 GitHub、Vercel、Supabase、Gmail、日历等。支持任意 AI、任意 API。通过聊天实现部署。→ 从手机部署 → 阅读代码库、提交代码、创建 PR → 用自然语言查询数据库 → 通过聊天管理邮件和日历 → 开发计划支持 BYOK · Moonlight 首条消息即含 Claude。真实执行。随时随地。独立开发。自力更生。创始成员锁定今日价格，仅限前 100 名。

name: Tyto by ai-coustics
tagline: Audio insight that predicts voice AI performance
tagline_zh: 预测语音 AI 性能的音频洞察
description: Tyto is a lightweight model that runs on your audio stream and predicts whether the audio reaching your agent will cause downstream failures. It outputs a single score plus a breakdown across six dimensions: noise, speaker reverb, speaker loudness, interfering speech, background media speech, packet loss. Try it here: https://ai-coustics-tyto-demo--ph.modal.run/
description_zh: Tyto 是一个轻量级模型，可在您的音频流上运行，并预测传入代理的音频是否会导致下游故障。它输出一个综合评分以及六个维度的详细分解：噪音、说话人混响、说话人响度、干扰语音、背景媒体语音、丢包率。在此试用：https://ai-coustics-tyto-demo--ph.modal.run/

name: Carbone Skill for AI
tagline: Teach your AI to build document templates
tagline_zh: 教您的 AI 构建文档模板
description: Carbone is a universal document-generation engine: feed it a template file and JSON file, and it produces pixel-perfect documents at scale. The Carbone Skill teaches AI assistants like Claude or ChatGPT the entire Carbone templating language. Describe what you want in plain language and your AI writes correct Carbone syntax, builds templates in DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML or PDF, and validates tags before you render automatically at scale.
description_zh: Carbone 是一款通用的文档生成引擎：向其提供模板文件和 JSON 文件，即可大规模生成像素级完美的文档。Carbone Skill 教会 Claude 或 ChatGPT 等 AI 助手完整的 Carbone 模板语言。用自然语言描述您的需求，AI 将编写正确的 Carbone 语法，在 DOCX、XLSX、PPTX、HTML 或 PDF 中构建模板，并在您大规模渲染前自动验证标签。

name: Compendium
tagline: Keeping your team, agents, and data on one page
tagline_zh: 让你的团队、智能体和数据一目了然
description: Compendium is a company brain for teams working with AI agents. With compendium, all your agents share one memory, so knowledge, decisions, and context are available to everyone, everywhere, instantaneously. Compendium allows you to work in shared sessions where you and your teammates' agents build on the same context instead of siloed threads, get summaries of what changed while you were away (without digging), and have a live view of what your teammates and their agents are building right now.
description_zh: Compendium 是为使用 AI 智能体的团队打造的公司大脑。通过 Compendium，所有智能体共享同一份记忆，知识和决策上下文能够即时、随时随地供所有人获取。Compendium 允许你在共享会话中工作，你和队友的智能体可以在相同的上下文基础上协作，而不是局限于孤立的线程；你可以查看你离开期间发生的变更摘要（无需费力挖掘），并实时查看队友及其智能体正在构建的内容。

name: Forward
tagline: Installs your API into a customer's codebase in one command
tagline_zh: 一条命令即可将您的 API 安装到客户的代码库中
description: Forward is an AI forward-deployed engineer that integrates your API directly into your customers' codebases. Instead of 50-page docs, users run one command. Forward analyzes their repo, writes the integration on a new branch, runs tests, and opens a PR for review. Built for API and SDK companies to eliminate churn between signup and the first successful call. It learns your house style and ensures safety through build validation—all while saving users hours of manual wiring.
description_zh: Forward 是一位 AI 前置部署工程师，可直接将您的 API 集成到客户的代码库中。用户无需阅读 50 页的文档，只需运行一条命令。Forward 会分析其代码仓库，在新分支上编写集成代码，运行测试，并打开 PR 供审查。专为 API 和 SDK 公司打造，旨在消除注册与首次成功调用之间的流失率。它能学习您的代码风格，并通过构建验证确保安全——同时为用户节省数小时的手动配置时间。

name: Conduit
tagline: The local MCP gateway that cuts tokens ~90%
tagline_zh: 本地 MCP 网关，削减约 90% 的 token 用量
description: Every MCP server dumps its whole tool list into your agent's context on every request. 3 servers cost ~24k tokens before you even say hi. Conduit routes them through one local gateway that exposes 3 meta-tools the agent searches on demand. Measured: 97% less tool overhead per request, ~90% fewer tokens, same task success. Works on one AI tool or five, cloud or local. Keys in your OS keychain, live toggles, no cloud, no account. Free and open source.
description_zh: 每个 MCP 服务器都会在每个请求中将整个工具列表转储到代理的上下文中。3 个服务器甚至还没打招呼就消耗了约 24k 个 token。Conduit 通过一个本地网关进行路由，向代理暴露 3 个元工具，供其按需搜索。实测数据显示：每次请求的工具开销减少 97%，token 用量减少约 90%，任务成功率不变。适用于单个或五个 AI 工具，支持云端或本地部署。密钥存储在操作系统钥匙串中，支持实时切换，无需云服务，无需账户。免费且开源。

name: Gemini Omni Flash
tagline: High-quality video generation and conversational editing
tagline_zh: 高质量视频生成与对话式编辑
description: Gemini Omni Flash (gemini-omni-flash-preview) just rolled out to developers via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio, natively supporting high-quality video generation and conversational editing from a combination of text, image and video inputs. This model is priced competitively at $0.10 per second of video output, which is the same as Veo 3.1 Fast.
description_zh: Gemini Omni Flash (gemini-omni-flash-preview) 已通过 Gemini API 和 Google AI Studio 向开发者发布，原生支持结合文本、图像和视频输入的高质量视频生成及对话式编辑。该模型定价极具竞争力，视频输出每秒 0.10 美元，与 Veo 3.1 Fast 相同。

description: Rivault lets you safely and securely provide AI agents and CUA data and context for tasks. Rivault never gets access to your data by default.
description_zh: Rivault 允许您安全地和安全地为任务提供 AI 代理和 CUA 数据和上下文。将数据和上下文存储在零知识保管库中。当 AI 代理需要数据（护照号码或信用卡详细信息）来执行一个任务（如预订航班）时，Rivault 发送一个认证请求，您使用 Face ID/ Passkey 解锁数据，任务完成后数据会确定性地被抹去。Rivault 默认情况下永远不会获得您的数据。

Agent Mode clicks, fills forms, and navigates. Workflows run repeated tasks in one click. Memory means you never re-explain yourself. History is saved per domain. Bring your own Claude API key, or use Apple Intelligence on-device. Your key goes straight to Anthropic. No tracking. No analytics. $29.99/year after a free trial.
description_zh: Claude 曾有 Chrome 扩展，但 Safari 没有。所以我开发了 AlliHat。打开侧边栏，它即可感知您当前浏览的页面。随时提问。高亮文本以获取即时解释。Agent 模式可点击、填写表单并导航。工作流可通过一次点击运行重复任务。记忆功能让您无需反复解释。历史记录按域名保存。自带 Claude API 密钥，或使用 Apple Intelligence 端侧模型。您的密钥直接发送至 Anthropic。无追踪，无分析。免费试用后，年费为 29.99 美元。

name: MD+HTML Reader
tagline: Review AI-generated Markdown and HTML in a focused workspace
tagline_zh: 在专注的工作区中审查 AI 生成的 Markdown 和 HTML
description: AI coding tools produce useful docs, but reviewing them can get messy. One task can leave plans, API notes, QA checklists, handoffs, diagrams, and HTML previews scattered across project folders and buried under source files, builds, logs, and dependencies. MD+HTML Reader gives you a focused macOS workspace to review generated Markdown and HTML in read-only mode before the next prompt, commit, or handoff.
description_zh: AI 编码工具能生成有用的文档，但审查过程往往变得杂乱无章。一个任务可能会留下计划、API 说明、QA 检查表、交接文档、图表和 HTML 预览，散落在项目文件夹中，被源代码、构建文件、日志和依赖项所掩盖。MD+HTML Reader 为您提供了一个专注的 macOS 工作区，以便在下一次提示、提交或交接之前，以只读模式审查生成的 Markdown 和 HTML。

name: OnBrand by SlideSpeak
tagline: Design context for AI agents
tagline_zh: 为 AI 智能体提供设计上下文
description: OnBrand gives AI agents design context through MCP. Add your brand guidelines, logos, colors, icons, imagery and slide rules, so tools like Claude, Codex and ChatGPT can create slides, infographics and design assets that actually match your brand. No more generic AI output, random layouts or off-brand visuals. OnBrand can generate your entire brand guidelines as a design.md from your existing website, existing branding guidelines or even PowerPoint templates.
description_zh: OnBrand 通过 MCP 为 AI 智能体提供设计上下文。添加您的品牌指南、徽标、颜色、图标、图像和幻灯片规则，使 Claude、Codex 和 ChatGPT 等工具能够创建真正符合您品牌的幻灯片、信息图和設計资产。不再出现通用的 AI 输出、随机布局或不符品牌调性的视觉效果。OnBrand 可以从您现有的网站、现有品牌指南甚至 PowerPoint 模板中生成整个品牌指南作为 design.md。

name: scritty
tagline: Shared, searchable memory for every AI coding agent
tagline_zh: 为每个 AI 编码智能体提供共享且可搜索的记忆
description: scritty is a terminal emulator that captures every CLI agent's conversation (Claude, Codex, Copilot, Antigravity, Ollama), indexes it into one searchable corpus you control, and serves it back to your agents over MCP and to you over the CLI. One session across desktop, browser, and mobile. Your captures stay on your machine.
description_zh: scritty 是一个终端模拟器，它捕获每个 CLI 智能体（Claude、Codex、Copilot、Antigravity、Ollama）的对话，将其索引为您控制的可搜索语料库，并通过 MCP 提供给您的智能体，通过 CLI 提供给您。跨桌面、浏览器和移动设备的一个会话。您的捕获数据保留在您的机器上。

description_zh: 与长时间运行的代理聊天不同，AgentLoop启动一个新的Codex工人和批评者每个周期。设置目标和GUIDELINES.md评分标准一次；工人建造，批评者测试，失败变成下一个干净上下文的具体修复注释。项目文件保留记忆。运行在本地，sandboxed，观察和可取消的live仪表板上，通过MCP控制ChatGPT。可以继续在PASS之后的Polish模式中，直到批评者说SHIP。开源和零依赖的Node.js。

tagline: A BI tool that can take action for you

description: Basedash answers questions about your data. Now it acts on them. Ask the agent to extend a trial, fix a record, or seed a demo org — it writes the SQL and runs it against any database an admin has enabled for edits. Ask it to update a Stripe subscription or create a HubSpot lead and it acts through any MCP tool you've connected. Every consequential action pauses for your approval, and every tool has its own permission. Skills chain it all into workflows. From answers to actions.

All AI runs on-device with Qwen, Phi-3, and Gemma — your commands never leave your Mac. Beautiful UI, split panes, tabs, custom themes, grain texture, and slash commands like /ls and /ports.
description_zh: jebi 是一款内置本地 AI 的增强型 Mac 终端——无需 API 密钥，无需订阅，无需云端。每条命令执行后，它都会建议下一步运行什么。遇到错误？jebi 会用通俗英语解释并告诉您如何修复。输入 /ask 即可在终端中与 AI 聊天。所有 AI 均在设备端运行，使用 Qwen、Phi-3 和 Gemma——您的命令永远不会离开您的 Mac。拥有美观的 UI、分屏、标签页、自定义主题、颗粒纹理以及 /ls 和 /ports 等斜杠命令。

tagline: Dictate, rewrite, translate, and an agent in a single device
tagline_zh: 单设备内的语音输入、重写、翻译及智能体功能
description: On-device transcription, plus an agent that actually does things. Transcribe: Parakeet EOU (English), Parakeet TDT (25 European languages), CTC (Chinese), Nemotron (~40), Qwen3-ASR Ask: a local LFM2.5 agent that plans and calls tools, Apple Notes, clipboard, files, MCP support. Fully customizable: remap the dial, hotkeys, three HUD styles, tool approvals, swap any model or any prompt. Gemma 4, Qwen3.6 and Ornith 1.0 are coming next. No cloud, no accounts. Free, MIT. Apple Silicon, macOS 26.
description_zh: 端侧转录，以及真正能执行任务的智能体。Transcribe：Parakeet EOU（英语）、Parakeet TDT（25 种欧洲语言）、CTC（中文）、Nemotron（约 40 种语言）、Qwen3-ASR。Ask：本地 LFM2.5 智能体，负责规划和调用工具、Apple Notes、剪贴板、文件、MCP 支持。完全可定制：重新映射旋钮、热键、三种 HUD 样式、工具审批、替换任意模型或提示词。Gemma 4、Qwen3.6 和 Ornith 1.0 即将推出。无需云端，无需账户。免费，MIT 协议。Apple Silicon，macOS 26。

name: Cynative Security Research Agent
tagline: Ask your cloud anything without breaking prod. Read-only.
tagline_zh: 在生产环境中无需担心云端问题。只读模式。
description: Open-source AI CLI that answers security questions across cloud, code and runtime - GitHub, GitLab, AWS, GCP, Azure, K8s. Ask in plain language: "what's publicly exposed that shouldn't be?" or "can my CI escalate to cloud admin?". Read-only by construction: every call is resolved to its IAM actions and authorized against a read-only policy before credentials attach. It can't modify your infra even if asked. Unlike MCP tools, it writes JS in a sandboxed runtime - a script per turn, not one call.
description_zh: 开源的AI CLI，回答安全问题，涵盖云端、代码、运行时 - GitHub、GitLab、AWS、GCP、Azure、K8s。使用自然语言询问：'什么应该保密而实际上暴露了?' 或 '我的CI是否可以升级到云管理员?'。只读设计：每个调用都被解析为其IAM操作并在只读策略下授权，之后才附加凭证。即使询问修改基础设施，它也无法修改基础设施。与MCP工具不同的是，它在沙盒运行时环境中编写JS - 每次轮询一个脚本，而不是一次调用。

topics.description:
Artificial intelligence powers products that can write, reason, analyze data, and take action for you. These categories cover the main ways AI is being built and used today.

- **[AI Agents](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-agents)** – Tools that use AI to plan, reason, and take actions across tools and workflows, often completing multi-step tasks with minimal human input.
- **[LLMs](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/llms)** – Platforms and tools built around large language models that enable text generation, understanding, and reasoning across many applications.
- **[AI Infrastructure](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-infrastructure)** – Products that support training, deploying, scaling, and evaluating AI models, including hosting, inference, data pipelines, and observability.
- **[AI Chatbots](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-chatbots)** – Applications that use AI to power conversational experiences for support, productivity, research, and user interaction.
- **[Predictive AI](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/predictive-ai)** – AI-powered tools that analyze data to forecast outcomes, detect patterns, and support decision-making.

name: Illume Labs
tagline: 24/7 personalized health companion you can text
tagline_zh: 24小时全天候的个人健康伴侣
description: Illume is a 24/7 personal health companion that connects your wearables, nutrition, workouts, & lab results to give you personalized, actionable insights over text. Sign up: www.illumelabs.ai Illume connects patterns across your data that individual platforms can’t see, giving you a more complete picture of your health instead of another isolated score or dashboard. You can text your Illume agent for quick answers or use the platform to explore your data, trends, and history in depth.
description_zh: Illume是一款24小时全天候的个人健康伴侣，连接您的可穿戴设备、营养、运动和实验室结果，提供个性化、可操作的见解。注册地址：www.illumelabs.ai Illume通过分析您的数据，识别出个别平台无法看到的模式，给您一个更全面的健康状况，而不是另一个孤立的评分或仪表盘。您可以通过短信与Illume智能助手交谈，获取快速答案，或使用平台深入探索您的数据、趋势和历史。

name: Dump Memory
tagline: We fix your memory
tagline_zh: 修复你的记忆
description: Dump is your private second brain. Capture notes, photos, voice memos, documents, screenshots, and X bookmarks in one place. No folders, tags, or filing. Dump enriches information with web context and lets you find anything using on-device semantic search. Everything stays on your device and personal iCloud with zero cloud storage, zero tracking, and zero compromise. Just dump, remember, and instantly recall what matters.
description_zh: Dump 是你的私人第二大脑。在一个地方捕获笔记、照片、语音备忘录、文档、截图和 X 书签。无需文件夹、标签或归档。Dump 利用网络上下文丰富信息，并支持使用设备端语义搜索查找任何内容。所有内容保留在你的设备和个人 iCloud 中，零云存储、零追踪、零妥协。只需倾倒、记住，并即时回忆重要信息。

name: loopclub
tagline: The shared drum machine to jam with strangers or with Claude
tagline_zh: 与陌生人或Claude一起合奏的共享鼓机
description: loopclub is a realtime, onchain drum machine — beat-making turned into a multiplayer, ownable act. Sporting a 16-step, 9-track sequencer running entirely onchain. The grid updates live as other people claim cells around you, so a loop is built collaboratively, in real time. Record a loop you like and every cell owner earns on each copy pressed. Or ask Claude to write you one. Listening and auditioning are free. Fully open source at https://github.com/mintcloud/loopclub
description_zh: loopclub是一个实时、链上鼓机——将节拍制作转变为多人可拥有的行为。配备一个完全在链上运行的16步9音轨序列器。当其他人在你周围占据单元格时，网格会实时更新，因此循环是实时协作构建的。录制你喜欢的循环，每次按下复制时，每个单元格所有者都能获得收益。或者让Claude为你创作一个。收听和试听是免费的。完全开源于https://github.com/mintcloud/loopclub

name: NeuralAgent 3.0
tagline: AI that executes UI actions on your computer in ~285ms
tagline_zh: 在约 285 毫秒内在您的计算机上执行 UI 操作的 AI
description: New in 3.0: our Lightning-Fast computer-use model. NeuralAgent sees your screen and controls your computer to get real work done, now powered by our Fast model that executes UI actions in ~285ms, alongside Fast Model Replays (save a task, re-run it in seconds) and Smart Model Routing. It plans, executes at high speed, and supervises itself for recovery. Desktop + browser. Windows + macOS. The fast model got even faster since we recorded the launch video, check out the comment below.
description_zh: 3.0 新功能：我们的闪电般快速的计算机使用模型。NeuralAgent 能够查看您的屏幕并控制您的计算机以完成实际工作，现在由我们的 Fast 模型驱动，该模型可在约 285 毫秒内执行 UI 操作，同时具备 Fast Model Replays（保存任务并在几秒内重新运行）和 Smart Model Routing 功能。它进行规划、高速执行并自我监督以恢复。支持桌面和浏览器，兼容 Windows 和 macOS。自我们录制发布视频以来，快速模型的速度甚至更快了，请查看下方的评论。

name: Sourclip
tagline: Turn NotebookLM into a complete research workflow
tagline_zh: 将 NotebookLM 打造为完整的研究工作流
description: Sourclip is the research workflow for NotebookLM. It helps you discover high-quality research sources, capture webpages, PDFs, YouTube videos, Reddit posts, and AI chats into NotebookLM with one click. Organize everything with folders, reuse prompts across projects, sync your workspace across devices, and export your research as Markdown, HTML, or PDF. You can also turn NotebookLM Audio Overviews into a private podcast feed for Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Pocket Casts, and other podcast apps.
description_zh: Sourclip 是专为 NotebookLM 打造的研究工作流。它能帮你一键发现高质量研究来源，并将网页、PDF、YouTube 视频、Reddit 帖子和 AI 对话直接捕获至 NotebookLM。通过文件夹整理所有内容，跨项目复用提示词，多设备同步工作区，并将研究成果导出为 Markdown、HTML 或 PDF。你还可以将 NotebookLM 的音频概述转换为适用于 Spotify、Apple Podcasts、Pocket Casts 及其他播客应用的私人播客订阅源。

description_zh: EQK 是首款带有动态 AI EQ 的 Mac 应用——一种每首歌都能实时重新调音的均衡器。为每个应用提供独立的 EQ、耳机校正和输出设备。无需虚拟驱动程序——只需原生 macOS 音频捕获。10 段参数均衡 Tone Desk，3,985+ AutoEq 耳机配置文件，按应用限制器，完整信号链计量，以及一个免费的内置 FLAC 播放器，带有您拥有的歌曲的同步歌词。100% 本地化，无遥测，无订阅。调整您 Mac 上的每个应用。

name: Node Health
tagline: Your private home for every lab result
tagline_zh: 您的所有实验室结果的私人家园
description: Lab results arrive as printouts, PDFs and in portals that differ by provider — and scatter further when you switch labs or move. Node Health brings them into one place you own, your phone: scan, upload, or type in any report, and 150+ biomarkers are matched to reference ranges personalized to your age, sex and, where relevant, life stage. What's different: a doctor-reviewed biomarker database instead of AI-generated content, data encrypted on your iPhone, and core tracking that is free forever.
description_zh: 实验室结果以打印件、PDF 和不同提供商的门户形式到达 — 当您更换实验室或搬家时，结果会更加分散。Node Health 将它们带到您拥有的一处地方：您的手机：扫描、上传或输入任何报告，150+ 个生物标志物会与根据您的年龄、性别以及相关生命阶段定制的参考范围进行匹配。不同之处：使用医生审核的生物标志物数据库而非 AI 生成的内容，数据在您的 iPhone 上加密，并且核心跟踪功能永久免费。

Artificial intelligence powers products that can write, reason, analyze data, and take action for you. These categories cover the main ways AI is being built and used today.

- **[AI Agents](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-agents)** – Tools that use AI to plan, reason, and take actions across tools and workflows, often completing multi-step tasks with minimal human input.
- **[LLMs](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/llms)** – Platforms and tools built around large language models that enable text generation, understanding, and reasoning across many applications.
- **[AI Infrastructure](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-infrastructure)** – Products that support training, deploying, scaling, and evaluating AI models, including hosting, inference, data pipelines, and observability.
- **[AI Chatbots](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-chatbots)** – Applications that use AI to power conversational experiences for support, productivity, research, and user interaction.
- **[Predictive AI](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/predictive-ai)** – AI-powered tools that analyze data to forecast outcomes, detect patterns, and support decision-making.

name: Retrace
tagline: Debug AI agents by replaying and forking runs
tagline_zh: 通过重放和分叉运行来调试 AI 智能体
description: Record, replay, fork & share AI agent executions. See every LLM call, tool invocation, and error your agent makes, then debug and iterate in seconds. Free for 1,000 traces/mo.
description_zh: 记录、重放、分叉并分享 AI 智能体的执行过程。查看智能体发出的每一次 LLM 调用、工具 invocation 和错误，然后在几秒钟内完成调试和迭代。每月免费 1,000 次追踪。

name: DevSwat
tagline: Turn codebases into interactive maps, graphs, and governance
tagline_zh: 将代码库转换为交互式地图、图表和治理
description: DevSwat Code Analysis is a code intelligence platform that turns large codebases into interactive maps, dependency graphs, and governance reports. Unlike traditional static analyzers, it combines scan, compare, trace, and agent workflows so teams can understand architecture, review changes, and act on issues in one place. It also supports GitHub scans, uploads, saved analyses, and AI-assisted governance, making it useful for both local exploration and team-scale code review.
description_zh: DevSwat 代码分析是一个代码智能平台，将大型代码库转换为交互式地图、依赖关系图和治理报告。与传统静态分析器不同，它结合了扫描、比较、跟踪和代理工作流，使团队能够在一个地方理解架构、审查更改并处理问题。它还支持 GitHub 扫描、上传、保存的分析和 AI 辅助治理，适用于本地探索和团队规模的代码审查。

name: Buddy AI Note
tagline: Your daily memo that turns notes into a plan
tagline_zh: 你的每日备忘录，将笔记转化为计划
description: Buddy AI Note is a memo-first daily workspace. Write or speak your day; Buddy organizes it and turns what matters into a small plan it can run for you. Safe steps (reminders, focus time, a research brief...) run on one click; anything sent to others pauses for your review. Plan-then-confirm, not autopilot. Free to start: calendar, daily memo, and Google/Outlook sync. The AI agent (Buddy chat, task plan & execute, voice memos) is the paid upgrade. iOS, Android & web.
description_zh: Buddy AI Note 是一款以备忘录为核心的日常办公空间。记录或口述你的一天；Buddy 会整理内容，并将重要事项转化为可自动执行的小型计划。安全步骤（提醒、专注时间、研究简报等）只需一键即可运行；任何发送给他人的内容都会暂停等待你的审核。先规划后确认，而非全自动模式。免费起步：包含日历、每日备忘录以及 Google/Outlook 同步功能。AI 代理（Buddy 聊天、任务规划与执行、语音备忘录）为付费升级选项。支持 iOS、Android 和网页端。

name: Bamboo
tagline: Markdown notes with AI under your control
tagline_zh: Markdown 笔记，AI 由你掌控
description: Bamboo is a Markdown-first notes app for people who want a simple, portable workspace for ideas, documents, tasks, research, and personal knowledge. It combines a focused editor, collections, wiki links, web clipping, import/export, backups, and cross-device sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. AI is optional and controlled by you: connect supported providers, choose your model, and draft, rewrite, summarize, or brainstorm inside your notes.
description_zh: Bamboo 是一款以 Markdown 为主的笔记应用，适合希望拥有简单、可移植工作空间来管理想法、文档、任务、研究和个人知识的人。它结合了专注的编辑器、集合、Wiki 链接、网页剪藏、导入/导出、备份以及跨 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 的设备同步。AI 是可选的且由你控制：连接支持的提供商，选择你的模型，并在笔记中进行起草、重写、总结或头脑风暴。

name: LogStitch
tagline: Find AWS Lambda failures fast, right on your Mac
tagline_zh: 在 Mac 上快速定位 AWS Lambda 故障
description: Debugging a Lambda failure in CloudWatch is rough. Logs scattered across streams, no timeline, endless scrolling. LogStitch is a native Mac app that stitches your Lambda logs into one clear timeline. It clusters repeating error patterns and surfaces latency outliers, so you find the failure fast. It also ships a built-in MCP server, so AI assistants can query your Lambda logs directly and debug alongside you. One-time price, no subscription. 14-day free trial.
description_zh: 在 CloudWatch 中调试 Lambda 故障非常棘手。日志分散在各个流中，没有时间线，只能无尽地滚动查找。LogStitch 是一款原生 Mac 应用，可将你的 Lambda 日志拼接成清晰的时间线。它会对重复出现的错误模式进行聚类，并突出显示延迟异常值，助你快速找到故障根源。它还内置了 MCP 服务器，使 AI 助手能够直接查询你的 Lambda 日志并与你协同调试。一次性买断，无订阅费用。提供 14 天免费试用。

name: Deckwise
tagline: AI presentation agent for editable decks
tagline_zh: 用于可编辑演示文稿的 AI 代理
description: Deckwise is the AI presentation agent that turns topics, notes, files, and sources into clear, editable decks.Deckwise is an AI presentation agent that turns topics, notes, files, and sources into clear, editable decks. It plans the outline first, creates structured slides, and lets you keep improving them with an agent: select any part with lasso, then ask Deckwise to rewrite, redesign, reorder, or polish it. Not just generated once — improved with you.
description_zh: Deckwise 是一款 AI 演示文稿代理，能将主题、笔记、文件和来源转化为清晰且可编辑的演示文稿。Deckwise 是一款 AI 演示文稿代理，能将主题、笔记、文件和来源转化为清晰且可编辑的演示文稿。它首先规划大纲，创建结构化幻灯片，并允许你通过代理持续优化：使用套索工具选择任意部分，然后要求 Deckwise 重写、重新设计、重新排序或润色。不是一次性生成——而是与你共同改进。

name: Tufte
tagline: CDN and Node package to generate ASCII graphs inline
tagline_zh: 用于内联生成 ASCII 图表的 CDN 和 Node 包
description: Turn CSV into clean Tufte-style ASCII charts with a Mermaid-style `chart` code block. Plain-text bar, line, sparkline & scatter that work in READMEs, terminals & LLMs.
description_zh: 将 CSV 转换为干净的 Tufte 风格 ASCII 图表，采用 Mermaid 风格的 `chart` 代码块。支持纯文本的柱状图、折线图、迷你图和散点图，适用于 README、终端和 LLM。

name: Clusy
tagline: AI notebook platform for modern data science
tagline_zh: 面向现代数据科学的 AI 笔记本平台
description: Clusy is an agent-native notebook platform for researchers and data teams to build, branch, run, and evaluate ML and data science workflows in the cloud. Describe a goal in natural language, and Clusy plans the workflow, sources datasets, preprocesses data, runs parallel experiments in replicated kernels, compares model architectures, and helps produce optimal models through a human-in-the-loop notebook experience.
description_zh: Clusy 是一个代理原生笔记本平台，供研究人员和数据团队在云端构建、分支、运行和评估机器学习及数据科学工作流。用自然语言描述目标，Clusy 规划工作流、获取数据集、预处理数据、在复制的内核中运行并行实验、比较模型架构，并通过人在回路（human-in-the-loop）的笔记本体验帮助生成最优模型。

name: LightTwist
tagline: Record & stream your show in a realistic virtual studio
tagline_zh: 在逼真的虚拟演播室录制并直播您的节目
description: LightTwist lets you record & stream in a realistic virtual studio, even if your guests and co-hosts are remote. LightTwist is a virtual video studio that runs in Chrome, with a backend virtual production platform utilizing realtime computer vision for background removal and compositing, Unreal Engine 5 for rendering, and WebRTC for A/V streaming. It runs in realtime so you can live stream or record "live to tape", with a live preview so you see exactly what's getting streamed or recorded.
description_zh: LightTwist 让您即使在嘉宾和联合主持人远程的情况下，也能在逼真的虚拟演播室中录制和直播。LightTwist 是一款在 Chrome 中运行的虚拟视频演播室，其后端虚拟制作平台利用实时计算机视觉进行背景移除和合成，使用 Unreal Engine 5 进行渲染，并通过 WebRTC 进行音视频流传输。它实时运行，因此您可以直播或录制“实时磁带”，并提供实时预览，让您确切看到正在直播或录制的画面。

Browse job listings, auto-fill applications in seconds on LinkedIn, Indeed, and Workday, track every role in one clean pipeline, and reach hiring managers directly with personalized outreach, so you spend less time applying and more time interviewing.
