Besides the terminal multiplexer itself, it includes: - Built-in file browser and editor - Kanban-like board showing all running agents - Push notifications whenever an agent finishes working or requests your input - Git worktrees on demand to parallelize work - Voice mode

tagline: A platform that teaches how to navigate real-world code.
tagline_zh: 一个教授如何导航现实世界代码的平台。
description: Swenest stands out with real merged GitHub PRs as tasks, not artificial problems, symptom-only descriptions; users find the cause themselves, progressive AI hints that guide without spoiling, AI judge grading against the actual merged fix and XP-gated difficulty progression. Most platforms don't train navigating unfamiliar, real-world codebases with structured guidance with a gamified platform.
description_zh: Swenest 以真实的已合并 GitHub PR 作为任务脱颖而出，而不是人工问题和仅描述症状；用户自己找到原因，渐进式的 AI 提示在不破坏的情况下指导，AI 评判根据实际合并的修复进行评分，以及 XP 限制的难度进度。大多数平台没有通过游戏化平台提供结构化指导，以训练导航不熟悉的现实世界代码库。

name: ReExplain
tagline: Explain what you know to AI and discover what you don't
tagline_zh: 将你知道的东西告诉 AI，发现你不知道的东西
description: Most AI learning tools explain things to you. ReExplain flips that interaction: instead of AI explaining a concept to you, you explain it to AI in your own words. It listens, asks thoughtful follow-up questions, and helps reveal what you truly understand - and where the gaps are. Your sessions become evidence of your learning, generating focused practice and building a mastery map that grows over time.
description_zh: 大多数 AI 学习工具会向你解释概念。ReExplain 反转了这种互动：你用自己的话解释概念给 AI 听，它会聆听，提出深思熟虑的问题，并帮助你揭示你真正理解的东西——以及缺口在哪里。你的会话将成为你的学习证据，生成专注的练习，并在时间推移中构建一个成长的掌握地图。

name: LapuAi
tagline: OS Driver for AI to use computers
tagline_zh: AI 使用计算机的操作系统驱动程序
description: Our bet is the mix nobody ships: a chat agent that lives on your real PC, not a VM with the precision of RPA and the range of a real assistant. Most "computer use" tools: OpenAI's Operator, Anthropic's Computer Use take a screenshot, ask an AI where to click, and move the mouse by coordinates, usually on a cloud VM. Reliable computer use comes from talking to the OS directly through its accessibility and UI-automation APIs, not from a smarter model guessing where a button is.
description_zh: 我们的赌注是 nobody 寄送的混合：一个生活在你的真实 PC 上的聊天代理，而不是一个 VM，具有 RPA 的精确度和一个真实助手的范围。大多数 '计算机使用' 工具：OpenAI 的 Operator、Anthropic 的 Computer Use 会捕获屏幕截图，问 AI 在哪里点击，并通过坐标移动鼠标，通常在云 VM 上。可靠的计算机使用来自直接与 OS 通信，通过其可访问性和 UI 自动化 API，而不是一个更聪明的模型猜测按钮在哪里。

description: Agents keep hitting the same walls: no inbox, no safe credential store, no way past a 2FA gate, no way to pay for a downstream API, no verifiable identity. Mailgent fixes this in one curl call. Every agent gets a real inbox (DKIM, threading), encrypted vault, TOTP/2FA, USDC wallet for x402-priced API payments, verifiable DID (Ed25519), and a calendar. description: For teams and founders shipping agentic AI workflows and features. Drop in your agent's task, business rules, docs, and examples, and Argmin AI builds an evaluation you run before every change.
description_zh: 适用于团队和创始人正在开发 AI 代理工作流程和功能的产品。通用指标无法用您的产品的语言说话，因此一个新提示、模型或 RAG 变化可能会通过它们而仍然推送真实问题。即使有一个快速的手动检查，也会漏掉一些问题。您不需要注释数据、ML 团队或一个月才能安全地避免回归。将您的代理任务、业务规则、文档和示例传入 Argmin AI，它会为您构建一个评估，用于在每次更改之前运行。

name: Wyser
tagline: A mirror for your inner life, not a manual
tagline_zh: 你内心生活的镜子，而非手册
description: We live in an age generous with advice and stingy with understanding. There are apps to fix your habits, track your moods, optimise your mornings, and yet, most of us go to bed unsure of what we felt all day. Because most of what shapes a life is invisible from the inside. Wyser is a quieter proposition: a companion for the slow, unglamorous work of understanding yourself. Not to improve you or fix you, but to help you notice, with a little more kindness, what was there in you all along.
description_zh: 我们生活在一个建议泛滥但理解匮乏的时代。有各种应用来修正你的习惯、追踪你的情绪、优化你的早晨，然而，我们大多数人上床睡觉时仍不确定自己一整天都感受到了什么。因为塑造一个人生活的绝大部分事物，从内部是看不见的。Wyser 提出了一个更安静的选择：一个陪伴你进行缓慢、不 glamorous 的自我理解工作的伙伴。不是为了改善你或修正你，而是用更多的善意帮助你注意到，你内心一直存在的东西。

name: Qlane
tagline: Merge PRs with confidence - AI QA that runs your whole app
tagline_zh: 自信合并 PR —— 运行整个应用的 AI 质量保障
description: Most tools sit on one side of a line. AI code-review tools read the diff but never run it, so they guess "this could be null." Black-box E2E tools drive a real browser but see only the DOM. Qlane boots your whole app in a sandbox and tests it from the inside - browser, shell, source, plus connectable logs and database - so it reports only bugs that actually reproduce, and traces each to its root cause. runs your app, not just your code.
description_zh: 大多数工具只站在一条线的一侧。AI 代码审查工具阅读差异但从不运行它，因此只能猜测“这里可能为空”。黑盒端到端工具驱动真实浏览器，但只能看到 DOM。Qlane 在沙箱中启动你的整个应用，从内部进行测试——包括浏览器、Shell、源代码，以及可连接的日志和数据库——因此它仅报告真正可复现的 Bug，并追溯至根本原因。它运行的是你的应用，而不仅仅是你的代码。

name: Privent 2.0
tagline: Runtime Data Control for n8n Workflows
tagline_zh: n8n工作流程的运行时数据控制
description: AI agents send raw data to LLMs on every run: emails, records, API keys, secrets. n8n's own Guardrails node can redact that, but redaction is permanent, the data never comes back. Privent tokenizes PII and secrets before they reach the LLM, then reverses it safely at a trusted sink. Official n8n Integration Partner, live today. Local mode runs fully offline. Built for teams running agent workflows in production who cannot afford a single leaked record.
description_zh: AI代理将原始数据发送到LLMs：每次运行的电子邮件、记录、API密钥、秘密。n8n的Guardrails节点可以对其进行抹去，但抹去是永久的，数据从来不会回来。Privent将PII和秘密在它们到达LLM之前进行token化，然后在受信任的接收器处安全地恢复。官方n8n集成合作伙伴，今天就可用。本地模式在完全离线下运行。为运行在生产环境中的代理工作流程的团队而设计，无法承受单个泄露记录的损失。

description: One shot to the right code. Atelier is a context runtime and cost-optimization layer for AI coding agents. name: Memora-Swarm
tagline: The TLS for autonomous agent state.
tagline_zh: 自主代理状态的TLS。
description: The AI giants run agent swarms on last-write-wins databases like Redis. Result? Silent state forks and swarm-wide memory poisoning (OWASP ASI06). You can't patch this with middleware. Memora replaces fragile DBs with a 3-layer mathematical engine: L1 CRDTs guarantee fork-free convergence. L3 ACFA uses Q16.16 fixed-point math to auto-ban equivocators without a central coordinator. L2 Epistemic logic detects when agents agree on a lie and forces human escalation.
description_zh: AI巨头们在Redis等最后写入胜出的数据库上运行代理集群。结果？静默状态分叉和集群级内存中毒（OWASP ASI06）。你无法用中间件修补这个问题。Memora用三层数学引擎取代脆弱的数据库：L1 CRDTs保证无分叉收敛。L3 ACFA使用Q16.16定点数学自动禁止作恶者，无需中央协调器。L2认知逻辑检测代理何时一致同意谎言，并强制人工升级。

name: BotCritic
tagline: Stress-test your AI chatbot before your customers do
tagline_zh: 在客户之前对您的 AI 聊天机器人进行压力测试
description: Most chatbot testing tools check if your bot follows a script. BotCritic tests whether it survives a real customer — frustrated, confused, multilingual, or trying to break it. What makes it different: full conversation transcripts as evidence, a rewritten system prompt targeting the exact failures found, and the ability to re-test after fixes to prove they worked. We hold our own product to the same standard — we ran BotCritic on its own pitch and published the result, hallucination included.
description_zh: 大多数聊天机器人测试工具检查您的机器人是否遵循脚本。BotCritic 测试它是否能应对真实客户——沮丧的、困惑的、多语言的，或试图破坏它的。它的不同之处在于：完整的对话记录作为证据，针对发现的精确失败重写的系统提示，以及修复后重新测试以证明其有效的能力。我们对自己的产品也持同样标准——我们在自己的推介上运行了 BotCritic 并发布了结果，包括幻觉。

name: Manipulation — The Card Game
tagline: Build melds, reshape the table, outplay everyone
tagline_zh: 构建组合，重塑牌桌，智胜所有人
description: Manipulation is a free browser card game for 2–8 players using two decks. Build sets or same-suit runs of three or more, then reshape the shared table by moving cards between melds—so long as every pile remains valid. Play timed or untimed, across devices with a room code, against bots, or control several seats yourself. Four rotating rounds and a golf-style scorecard reward the lowest score. No download or ChatGPT sign-in required.
description_zh: Manipulation是一款免费的浏览器卡牌游戏，支持2-8名玩家使用两副牌。构建三张或更多相同花色或同花顺，然后通过在组合之间移动卡牌来重塑共享牌桌——只要每个牌堆保持有效即可。可以计时或非计时游戏，跨设备使用房间代码，与机器人对战，或自己控制多个座位。四个轮换回合和一个高尔夫风格记分卡奖励最低分。无需下载或ChatGPT登录。

name: Nib
tagline: Record, transcribe & turn meetings into AI notes
tagline_zh: 录音、转录并将会议转化为 AI 笔记。
description: Nib is a notes app for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Press record inside a note and your voice becomes searchable text via on-device transcription. Audio never leaves your device and isn't synced to iCloud. After a meeting, AI turns your transcript and handwritten notes into structured minutes: decisions, to-dos with owners, and open questions. Every AI edit is a highlighted diff you approve or discard. Recording, transcription and search are free; cloud AI needs Pro. No ads, no tracking.
description_zh: Nib 是一款适用于 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 的笔记应用。在笔记中点击录音，你的声音将通过设备端转录变为可搜索的文本。音频绝不离开你的设备，也不会同步到 iCloud。会议结束后，AI 将把你的转录稿和手写笔记转化为结构化的会议纪要：决策、带负责人的待办事项以及开放性问题。每一次 AI 编辑都是你可以批准或丢弃的高亮差异。录音、转录和搜索是免费的；云端 AI 需要 Pro 版。无广告，无追踪。

tagline: Expense tracking for people who live in two currencies
tagline_zh: 适合双币种生活人群的记账工具

description_zh: Obolos 是一款面向外籍人士、数字游民和常旅客的记账应用。支持 159 种货币账户，无需强制换算。每次旅行都有独立的预算，货币转账按实时汇率记录。收据和语音输入在本地识别，可选择开启 AI 解析杂乱的收据和账单。支持 Apple 或 Google 登录，数据自动同步。日常记账免费。高级版 ($2.99/月，7 天试用)：无限账户、旅行、AI 识别、导入导出功能。

name: No Excuses
tagline: 6 hooks that stop Claude Code from faking "done"
tagline_zh: 6 个钩子防止 Claude Code 假装“完成”
description: Claude Code's #1 problem: it says "✅ Done!" but never ran the tests. CLAUDE.md rules get ignored — they're just suggestions. No Excuses is 6 Node.js hooks that ENFORCE: 🛑 finish-gate — blocks "done" until tests pass 📋 task-gate — no stopping with unfinished steps ⛔ rule-guard — blocks rm -rf, force-push,env edits 📉 read-guard — stops token waste 🧠 context-keeper — memory survives compaction 🔒 audit-guard — blocks secret leaks Works on Windows. Zero deps. 2-min install.
description_zh: Claude Code 的第一大问题：它显示“✅ Done!”却从未运行测试。CLAUDE.md 规则被忽略——它们只是建议。No Excuses 是 6 个 Node.js 钩子，强制执行：🛑 finish-gate —— 阻止“done”直到测试通过 📋 task-gate —— 不允许在未完成步骤时停止 ⛔ rule-guard —— 阻止 rm -rf、强制推送、环境变量编辑 📉 read-guard —— 阻止 Token 浪费 🧠 context-keeper —— 记忆在压缩后依然存在 🔒 audit-guard —— 阻止密钥泄露。支持 Windows。零依赖。2 分钟安装。

description: SolidState is an open-source runtime for building safe and controllable AI agents. It separates probabilistic reasoning from deterministic execution, giving the runtime control over state transitions, tools, approvals, retries, concurrency, persistence, and limits. The alpha release includes FSM workflows, human-in-the-loop policies, parallel tools, checkpointing, StateGraph orchestration, actor-based concurrency, tracing, and multi-model support.
description_zh: SolidState 是一个用于构建安全可控AI代理的开源运行时。它将概率推理与确定性执行分离，使运行时能够控制状态转换、工具、审批、重试、并发、持久化和限制。Alpha版本包括FSM工作流、人机协同策略、并行工具、检查点、StateGraph编排、基于actor的并发、跟踪和多模型支持。

description: AI agents don't fail loudly. They fail quietly.A node returns success. Passes corrupted data downstream. Wrong outputs. No error. No warning. You find out when a user complains. ARGUS fixes this. Catches silent failures the moment they happen — not four steps later. → Silent failure detection at every node boundary → Root cause tracing — exact node, exact field → Deterministic replay from any node LangGraph today. CrewAI + Google ADK coming next.
description_zh: AI 智能体不会大声报错，而是静默失败。节点返回成功，将损坏的数据传递下游，输出错误结果，无报错，无警告。直到用户投诉你才发现。ARGUS 解决了这个问题。在失败发生的瞬间捕获静默失败——而不是四步之后。→ 每个节点边界的静默失败检测 → 根因追踪——精确到节点和字段 → 支持 LangGraph 任意节点确定性重放，CrewAI + Google ADK 即将上线。

name: Linden
tagline: Validate AI Outputs Before They Reach Your Application
tagline_zh: 在 AI 输出到达您的应用程序之前进行验证
description: LLMs can generate malformed JSON, missing fields, schema violations, and inconsistent outputs that break production applications. Linden is an AI reliability layer that validates structured AI responses before they reach your system. Define schemas and business rules, then receive clear validation decisions: ALLOW, WARN, REGENERATE, or BLOCK. Integrate in minutes using our API and Python SDK.
description_zh: LLM 可以生成格式错误的 JSON、缺失字段、模式违规和不一致的输出，这些会破坏生产应用程序。Linden 是一个 AI 可靠性层，在 AI 响应到达您的系统之前验证结构化的 AI 响应。定义模式和业务规则，然后接收明确的验证决策：允许、警告、重新生成或阻止。使用我们的 API 和 Python SDK，您可以在几分钟内完成集成。

name: Coincidex
tagline: Transfer-aware, replay-free continual learning for PyTorch
tagline_zh: 适用于PyTorch的传输感知、无需回放的持续学习
description: Most continual-learning methods either forget (fine-tuning) or isolate and forfeit transfer (fixed masks, adapters). Coincidex does both: similar tasks share sub-networks for forward transfer, dissimilar ones stay isolated so old skills survive — with no replay buffer. A tiny, drop-in PyTorch layer (torch + numpy, CPU-friendly) that learns task similarity from context. It's also honest: reproducible benchmarks and a clear map of where it works and where it doesn't. Apache-2.0 license.
description_zh: 大多数持续学习方法要么遗忘（微调），要么隔离并放弃传输（固定掩码、适配器）。Coincidex两者兼顾：相似任务共享子网络进行前向传输，不同任务保持隔离以保留旧技能 — 无需回放缓冲区。这是一个微小的即插即用PyTorch层（torch + numpy，CPU友好），可根据上下文学习任务相似性。它也很诚实：可复现的基准测试和清晰的工作范围图。Apache-2.0许可证。

name: Braidkeep
tagline: Catch merge conflicts before your AI agents break main
description: Run several AI coding agents in parallel and their branches collide the moment you merge — and you find out one at a time, after every agent has finished. Braidkeep predicts conflicts between in-flight branches using Git's own merge-tree (read-only, never touches your working tree), enforces per-agent file ownership, and computes a safe merge order: conflict-free batches first, tangles last. Any orchestrator. Single binary, Apache-2.0, free. Predicts mergeability, not correctness.

name: Voyage Health
tagline: Know more. Worry less.
tagline_zh: 了解更多，少些担忧。
description: Most AI health tools treat every conversation like it's your first: no memory, no follow-up, just generic responses. Voyage is different. It remembers your health history across sessions, gives you a structured clinical breakdown after every conversation (risk level, severity score, recommendation), and tracks open issues until they're resolved. No paywalls. No subscriptions. Free on iOS and Android. Built for the gap between 'I feel off' and 'I need to see a doctor.'
description_zh: 大多数 AI 健康工具将每次对话都视为初次：没有记忆，没有跟进，只有通用回复。Voyage 不同。它能跨会话记住你的健康历史，在每次对话后提供结构化的临床分析（风险等级、严重程度评分、建议），并持续跟踪未解决问题直至解决。无付费墙，无订阅费。iOS 和 Android 端免费。专为填补“感觉不对劲”和“需要看医生”之间的空白而打造。

name: GitHub
tagline: Local-first memory for your AI coding agent
tagline_zh: 为你的 AI 编程智能体提供本地优先的记忆
description: Your AI coding agent forgets your project every session. Most memory tools store your context on their servers. PMB keeps it on yours. It captures decisions, lessons and facts as you work and feeds the relevant ones back automatically via MCP hooks, so your agent shows up already knowing the project. Different: 100% local (one SQLite file, no cloud, no API keys), automatic (no "remember" step), cross-agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex), hybrid offline retrieval.
description_zh: 你的 AI 编程智能体每次会话都会忘记你的项目。大多数记忆工具将上下文存储在其服务器上。PMB 将其存储在你的设备上。它在你在工作中时捕获决策、经验和事实，并通过 MCP hooks 自动反馈相关内容，使智能体在启动时即已了解项目。独特之处：100% 本地化（单个 SQLite 文件，无云，无 API 密钥），自动化（无需“记住”步骤），跨智能体兼容（Claude Code、Cursor、Codex），混合离线检索。

name: Tranthor
tagline: Retention on autopilot for e-commerce
tagline_zh: 电商自动留存
description: Tranthor is an AI CRM for B2C ecommerce brands. It watches your store, finds repeat-purchase and churn-risk moments, and drafts retention campaigns for approval before they send. Real retention without the complexity or the headcount. Built for ecommerce brands.
description_zh: Tranthor 是一款面向 B2C 电商品牌的 AI CRM。它监控您的店铺，发现复购和流失风险时刻，并在发送前起草留存活动供您审批。无需复杂操作或增加人手，即可实现真实留存。专为电商品牌打造。

name: Skye
tagline: Your AI travel Concierge
tagline_zh: 您的 AI 旅行管家
description: Skye puts travel in one place you just talk to. She speaks 25 languages and books flights today; for the routes we scan, she shows you the cheapest dates to fly, year round. Hotels and cars are next. The more you talk to her, the better she knows you. Most travel sites are built to squeeze the most profit from every booking. We went the other way: one small flat fee, the lowest in the industry, and a product built for travelers, not margins. 💜
description_zh: Skye 将旅行整合在一个您可以直接对话的地方。她支持 25 种语言，今天就能为您预订航班；在我们扫描的航线上，她会向您展示全年最便宜的出行日期。酒店和租车服务即将上线。您与她交流越多，她越了解您。大多数旅游网站旨在从每次预订中榨取最大利润。我们反其道而行之：收取行业内最低的一笔小额固定费用，打造真正为旅行者而非利润率服务的产品。💜

description: SchemaFit is an MIT-licensed CI linter for LLM structured-output schemas. It catches unsupported keywords, nesting issues, required/optional mismatches, and portability problems across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, and Cohere, so teams can fail PRs instead of production calls.
description_zh: SchemaFit是一款采用MIT许可证的CI代码检查工具，专用于LLM结构化输出模式。它在运行前根据特定提供商的限制条件检查JSON Schema、工具定义和response_format模式。它能发现不受支持的关键词、嵌套问题、required/optional不匹配以及跨OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Mistral和Cohere的可移植性问题，使团队能在PR阶段发现问题，而不是在生产调用中失败。

description: Your agent's worst mistakes won't look like mistakes. They'll be confident actions on cached facts, stored fields, and RAG chunks that quietly went stale. Kaval re-derives the truth the instant before your agent acts and returns a verdict to branch on: act, or don't. One MCP call, a typed pass/block with the proof.
description_zh: 你智能体的最严重错误看起来绝不会像错误。它们会以自信的姿态执行操作，基于缓存的事实、存储的字段和已悄然过时的 RAG 块。Kaval 会在你的智能体行动前的瞬间重新推导真相，并返回一个裁决供你分支选择：执行或不执行。只需一次 MCP 调用，即可获得带有证明的输入类型通过/拦截结果。

name: Make Claude Code cheaper and smarter
tagline: Cuts token waste and fixes loops in agents with no change.
tagline_zh: 无需更改即可减少令牌浪费并修复智能体中的循环问题。
description: DedrooM is a lightweight proxy that automatically: Detects and blocks repetitive failing tool calls Intelligently mutates strategies using self-healing (new approach when stuck) Compresses bloated tool outputs (70-94% reduction in many cases) Just run: Bashpip install dedroom eval "$(dedroom init)" Key Features: dedroom init -> background proxy + shell setup Self-healing -> mutations on loops Real-time dashboard + savings report Works with Claude, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama, OpenCode.
description_zh: DedrooM 是一款轻量级代理，可自动执行以下操作：检测和阻止重复失败的 tool call；利用自愈机制智能调整策略（陷入僵局时采用新方法）；压缩臃肿的 tool 输出（在许多情况下可减少 70-94%）。只需运行：Bash pip install dedroom eval "$(dedroom init)" 主要功能：dedroom init -> 后台代理 + Shell 设置；自愈 -> 循环时的突变；实时仪表板 + 节省报告；兼容 Claude、OpenAI、DeepSeek、Ollama、OpenCode。

name: cngx
tagline: Catch AI agents that claim tests passed when they didn't
tagline_zh: 揪出那些谎称测试已通过实则未运行的AI Agent
description: AI coding agents end tasks with the same line: fixed it, tests pass, ready to merge. Often they never ran anything. cngx is an open source CLI that reads that claim, runs your real checks (pytest, npm test, go test, etc.), and blocks the merge when the story and output do not match. The verdict comes from command output, not regex. `pipx install cngx && cngx quickstart` gets you started in seconds. Built for anyone tired of merge-ready agent output that never touched the test suite.
description_zh: AI编程Agent完成任务时总爱用同一句话收尾：已修复，测试通过，可以合并了。但它们往往根本没运行过任何代码。cngx是一款开源CLI工具，能识别此类声明，自动执行你真正的检查命令（如pytest、npm test、go test等），并在实际结果与声明不符时阻止合并。判定依据是命令行输出而非regex。只需执行 `pipx install cngx && cngx quickstart`，几秒即可上手。专为受够了那些号称可合并却从未触碰测试用例的Agent输出的开发者打造。

name: QuorumRouter
tagline: Fail-closed routing and safe execution for AI agents
tagline_zh: AI 智能体的故障闭锁路由与安全执行。
description: QuorumRouter is a Open source Deno framework with two distinct multi-model paths. Best Route fans prompts out to independent model adapters, validates every response with Zod, requires quorum, and synthesizes the strongest answer. Agent Chat gives different models shared conversation context so they can challenge, revise, and converge across visible turns. Any repository mutation still requires external SafeLoop authority, exact-digest approval, watched execution, and verified artifacts.
description_zh: QuorumRouter 是一个开源 Deno 框架，拥有两条独特的多模型路径。Best Route 将提示词转发给独立的模型适配器，使用 Zod 验证每个响应，要求达成共识并综合出最强答案。Agent Chat 为不同模型提供共享的对话上下文，使它们能够在可见的回合中互相挑战、修改并达成一致。任何代码库变更仍需外部 SafeLoop 权威机构进行精确摘要批准、监控执行以及验证产物。

description_zh: TenTags 是一个开源的声明式文档语言和中间表示 (IR)，用于生成结构化文档。TenTags 不将编程逻辑嵌入模板，而是使用紧凑的语义语法，可由 Python 应用程序和 AI 生成。将相同的文档定义编译为 HTML、PDF、Excel (.xlsx) 和未来的输出格式，同时保持业务逻辑与表现层分离。

name: Axiom
tagline: Local desktop sandbox engine against Client-Side Scanning

description: Axiom Shield (v1.0.1) is a free, open-source desktop workspace engine built as an active defense against Client-Side Scanning and EU Chat Control. Instead of remote servers, Axiom enforces hyper-isolated memory partitions locally on your PC. It encapsulates apps like Discord, ChatGPT, and Meta webgrids, completely partitioning local telemetry loops to blind host OS scanning daemons while maintaining 100% functionality.
description_zh: Axiom Shield (v1.0.1) 是一款免费开源的桌面工作空间引擎，作为对抗客户端扫描和欧盟聊天控制的主动防御而构建。Axiom 不使用远程服务器，而是在您的 PC 上本地强制执行超隔离内存分区。它封装了 Discord、ChatGPT 和 Meta webgrids 等应用程序，完全隔离本地遥测循环，使主机操作系统扫描守护进程无法检测，同时保持 100% 功能性。

name: boccaccioAI - 100% Italian LLM
tagline: A 100% Italian 700M LLM built entirely from scratch.

description: boccaccioAI is a 100% Italian LLM with 700M parameters, built entirely from scratch by De Lauretis Tech. No pre-trained weights, no external wrappers, just a custom tokenizer, architecture, and weights trained on Italian text. Think of it as an elementary school child: it might hallucinate details, but its grammar, syntax, and flow are flawlessly Italian. A proof-of-concept proving that sovereign LLMs are possible at scale. Running on on-demand serverless GPUs. Try it now, using italian :D!
description_zh: boccaccioAI 是一款拥有 700M 参数的 100% 意大利语 LLM，由 De Lauretis Tech 完全从零构建。没有预训练权重，没有外部包装器，只有自定义的分词器、架构和基于意大利语文本训练的权重。可以把它想象成一个小学生：它可能会产生幻觉细节，但其语法、句法和流畅度都是完美的意大利语。一个概念验证，证明主权 LLM 在大规模上是可行的。在按需无服务器 GPU 上运行。现在就试试，使用意大利语 :D！

tagline: The AI that reports the dents instead of retouching them

description: Every AI photo tool "enhances" cars by hiding rust and smoothing dents. Listiq AI does the opposite: it's never allowed to lie about the car. Drop a photo on our homepage and watch four AIs work: Identify it (make, model,generation), check it for damage (every visible flaw, with severity), decode its VIN (specs + open recalls from NHTSA), then let the AI stage it on the background that sells it best — the car itself stays pixel-honest. Free, no signup, photos never stored.
description_zh: 每一个 AI 照片工具都通过隐藏锈迹和抚平凹痕来“增强”汽车。Listiq AI 则恰恰相反：它绝不允许对汽车撒谎。将照片上传到我们的主页，观看四个 AI 的工作过程：识别车型（品牌、型号、代数），检查损伤（所有可见瑕疵及其严重程度），解码 VIN 码（规格 + NHTSA 开放召回信息），然后让 AI 在最能展示它的背景上进行布景——汽车本身保持像素级的真实。免费使用，无需注册，照片永不存储。

name: Stele - Agentic Ledger
tagline: Every Agent, Fluent in your project
tagline_zh: 每个 Agent 都精通您的项目。
description: Your coding agent is great at building. It's bad at remembering why. A codebase records what the software is, never why. That context decays, and every new session starts from zero. Stele is a shared, self-maintaining ledger of the why. It holds the decisions and tradeoffs behind the code, and every agent reads and writes it, across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and more. So your agent helps you steer, not just type.
description_zh: 您的编码 Agent 擅长构建代码，却不擅长记住代码背后的原因。代码库只记录了软件“是什么”，从未记录“为什么”。随着上下文的丢失，每次新会话都仿佛从零开始。Stele 是一个共享的、自维护的“原因”账本。它保存代码背后的决策与权衡，所有 Agent（包括 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等）都会读写它。因此，您的 Agent 帮助您把控方向，而不仅仅是打字。

name: Atelier
tagline: AI for your documents, not just your chat window
tagline_zh: AI 助力您的文档，而不仅仅是聊天窗口
description: Atelier is an open source desktop app that brings AI to the tools people actually work in every day: document editing, mail merge, receipt reading, and more coming (spreadsheets, calendar, tasks). Most AI products are a chat window bolted onto a hosted API. It runs locally, Mac and Linux, so your files never have to leave your machine to get the benefit of AI. Built with Tauri, Rust, React, and SQLite. Licensed AGPL-3.0, fully forkable, and built for people who want AI usage beyond just chat.
description_zh: Atelier 是一款开源桌面应用，将 AI 带入人们日常实际使用的工具中：文档编辑、邮件合并、收据识别等（电子表格、日历、任务即将推出）。大多数 AI 产品只是在托管 API 上附加了一个聊天窗口。它在 Mac 和 Linux 上本地运行，因此您的文件无需离开机器即可享受 AI 的便利。使用 Tauri、Rust、React 和 SQLite 构建。采用 AGPL-3.0 许可证，完全可分叉，专为那些希望 AI 用法超越单纯聊天的人打造。

tagline: Check which model your AI agent is really using

description: Verify LLM API checks whether the model behind your AI agent or API matches its claim. Tell a Codex agent to run verifyllmapi.com/run, or test an OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoint. It reuses the Agent’s login in fresh sessions, samples one-token outputs, and matches their distribution with public fingerprints using Jensen–Shannon distance. Credentials and raw samples stay local. The library covers 161 exact model IDs; unknown or weak matches return INCONCLUSIVE.
description_zh: Verify LLM API 检查您的AI代理或API背后的模型是否与其声明相符。告知Codex代理运行verifyllmapi.com/run，或测试OpenAI或Anthropic兼容的端点。它在新的会话中重用代理的登录信息，采样单令牌输出，并使用Jensen-Shannon距离将它们的分布与公共指纹进行匹配。凭据和原始样本保留在本地。该库涵盖161个确切的模型ID；未知或弱匹配返回INCONCLUSIVE。

description: Open-source memory for AI agents you can actually audit. description_zh: 开源的可审计内存，用于 AI 代理。每个事实都带有源头（它来自哪里），历史是可见的，任何用户的数据都是可证明删除的：forget() 销毁了他们的密钥并发出签名证书—数据不可恢复，审计证据存活。 reconcile GDPR "删除"与欧盟 AI 法案 "保留记录"。零依赖核心，仅使用普通 Postgres 运行。Apache-2.0。

name: Engram
tagline: Agent memory that knows what's still true

description: Engram is a self-hosted MCP server + dashboard that gives Claude Code, Cursor, Hermes, and any MCP agent shared memory over a git-backed folder of markdown. Most agent memory answers "what did I store?" Engram answers "what's still true?" Retire a price or a contract term and search stops surfacing it, then tells the agent what it skipped and why. Per-agent read/write tokens. Every write committed to git and attributed, with diffs. Reads your Obsidian vault as-is. MIT, one container.
description_zh: Engram 是一个自托管的 MCP 服务器和仪表板，通过基于 Git 的 Markdown 文件夹，为 Claude Code、Cursor、Hermes 及任何 MCP 代理提供共享记忆。大多数代理记忆回答“我存储了什么？”，而 Engram 回答“哪些信息依然有效？”。如果您修改了价格或合同条款，搜索将不再展示旧信息，并会告诉代理它跳过了什么以及原因。支持按代理分配读取/写入令牌。每次写入都会提交到 Git 并附带差异记录，且可追溯。按原样读取您的 Obsidian 库。MIT 协议，单容器部署。

name: Obliqo
tagline: Find where your argument bends before it breaks in public.
tagline_zh: 在观点公开破裂前，发现其脆弱的转折点。
description: Obliqo is a private critique layer for high-stakes drafts: launch posts, landing pages, essays, and arguments. Paste your draft and get four independent, blind AI critiques plus a structured synthesis: STANDS, BENDS, GIVES. No automatic rewriting. No voice-flattening. Just pressure-testing before readers or customers find the flaw.
description_zh: Obliqo 是为高风险草稿（如发布文章、落地页、散文和论点）提供的私有批评层。粘贴您的草稿，即可获得四个独立的盲评 AI 反馈以及结构化综合报告：STANDS（立足点）、BENDS（脆弱点）、GIVES（让步点）。无自动重写，无风格抹平。仅在读者或客户发现缺陷之前进行压力测试。

name: Preach
tagline: Agentic Reference Management for Sales Leaders
tagline_zh: 面向销售领导者的智能体参考管理
description: (LOOKING FOR 10 PILOT COMPANIES) Existing tools are Salesforce-only, require manual tagging, and were built before AI. Preach is agentic. It discovers advocates automatically from CRM and usage data, matches them to deals in seconds, monitors fatigue so top customers don't burn out, and proves revenue impact by connecting references to closed deals. It doesn't wait to be asked. It watches your pipeline and acts.
description_zh: （寻找 10 家试点公司）现有工具仅限 Salesforce，需手动标记，且诞生于 AI 时代之前。Preach 采用智能体架构。它从 CRM 和使用数据中自动发现倡导者，在数秒内将其与交易匹配，监控疲劳度以防止顶级客户倦怠，并通过将推荐人与成交订单关联来证明收入影响。它不会被动等待指令，而是监控您的管道并主动行动。

name: Pinhub
tagline: Pin-point feedback on any screenshot or design
tagline_zh: 在任何截图或设计稿上精准反馈
description: Upload a screenshot, drop a pin exactly where you mean, and discuss that spot — no more vague "make the header bigger." Share one link and reviewers comment without signing up. Mark every thread resolved so nothing slips through, and let AI turn a noisy discussion into a clean to-do list. Pinhub makes scattered feedback into one clear, resolvable thread.
description_zh: 上传截图，精准标记问题位置并讨论——告别模糊的“把标题做大点”。分享一个链接，评论者无需注册即可留言。标记每个线程为已解决，防止遗漏，让 AI 将嘈杂的讨论转化为清晰的待办事项列表。Pinhub 将分散的反馈整合为清晰、可解决的单一线程。

name: AIRA
tagline: Fully Autonomous Agentic AI DJ & Music Player
tagline_zh: 完全自主的 Agentic AI DJ 与音乐播放器
description: Most music players play songs. AIRA Mac performs them. It analyzes your local music library for BPM, key, energy, song structure, and vocals, then creates seamless DJ-style transitions using beat-synced, phrase-aware mixing. With 9 intelligent crossfade strategies, vocal clash detection, and heart rate–adaptive Pulse Mode, AIRA acts as an autonomous AI DJ—turning your music collection into a continuously evolving listening experience.
description_zh: 大多数音乐播放器只是播放歌曲，而 AIRA Mac 则是在演绎它们。它分析你本地音乐库中的 BPM、调性、能量值、歌曲结构和人声，然后通过节拍同步和乐句感知的混音技术，创建无缝的 DJ 风格过渡。凭借 9 种智能交叉淡入淡出策略、人声冲突检测和心率自适应 Pulse 模式，AIRA 充当自主 AI DJ——将你的音乐收藏转化为持续演变的聆听体验。

name: Fida
tagline: Let agents read your code, not your secrets.
tagline_zh: 让 Agent 读取你的代码，而不是你的机密。
description: Fida is a local-first secret-leak prevention layer for AI coding agents. It stops credentials from ever reaching model context: when an agent reads aenv or runs a command, Fida returns a redacted view, while the real command still executes with the true secret, so the work succeeds. The agent uses a secret without seeing it. Fail-closed by design, nothing leaves your machine. Not a heavy policy firewall — one focused job, done right.
description_zh: Fida 是一款面向 AI 编程 Agent 的本地优先防密钥泄露层。它确保凭证永远不会进入模型上下文：当 Agent 读取 .env 文件或运行命令时，Fida 返回脱敏视图，而真实命令仍使用真实密钥执行，从而确保工作成功。Agent 使用了密钥却看不见它。设计采用故障关闭机制，数据绝不离开你的设备。这不是沉重的策略防火墙——而是一个专注本职工作、做得恰到好处的工具。

name: Founderside Agents
tagline: The AI operating system for one-person unicorns
tagline_zh: 一人独角兽企业的 AI 操作系统
description: The next billion-dollar company will be run by a single person. But you can't reach unicorn status while doing $20/hr tasks. Founderside is the first autonomous Operating System built for the solo elite. Give us your URL, and in 30 seconds, our agents map your business DNA, build your growth strategy, and start executing your daily content. Stop managing tools. Start leading agents. Your C-suite is already hired.
description_zh: 下一个十亿美元级公司将由单人运营。但你无法在从事 20 美元/小时的低价值任务时达到独角兽地位。Founderside 是首款专为精英单人创业者打造的自主操作系统。只需提供你的网址，30 秒内我们的 Agent 即可映射你的商业 DNA，构建增长策略，并开始执行日常内容创作。停止管理工具，开始领导 Agent。你的高管团队已经就位。

name: Centre Pompidou Remixed
tagline: An App To Remix An Architectural Icon -> Generative Facade
tagline_zh: 一款将建筑地标重新混合为生成式立面的应用
description: Centre Pompidou Remixed is an AI mobile app that lets you point your camera at the Centre Pompidou and transform its iconic architecture. Inspired by architects Renzo Piano and Richard Rogers’ radical inside-out design for the Centre Pompidou, the app turns the facade into a living surface for experimentation, transparency, and play. Remix the pipes, colors, structures, and visual logic of one of the world’s most recognizable buildings, directly through your phone.
description_zh: Centre Pompidou Remixed 是一款 AI 移动应用，让你只需将摄像头对准蓬皮杜中心，即可将其标志性建筑进行改造。受建筑师伦佐·皮亚诺（Renzo Piano）和理查德·罗杰斯（Richard Rogers）为蓬皮杜中心设计的激进“内外翻转”理念启发，该应用将立面转化为用于实验、透明度和趣味性的动态表面。直接通过手机，重新混合这座全球最具辨识度建筑之一的管道、色彩、结构和视觉逻辑。

name: Worknet
tagline: AI agents that build and run your company autonomously
tagline_zh: 自主构建和运营公司的 AI 智能体
description: Most founders fail not because of bad ideas, but because building a team costs $10k+/month. Worknet gives you a full AI crew - Dev, Marketing, Sales, Support, Ops, and Analyst agents - that builds and runs your company autonomously. Describe your idea, and your crew gets to work. No hiring. No management. No overhead. Starting at $49/mo.
description_zh: 大多数创始人失败并非因为想法不好，而是因为组建团队的月成本超过 1 万美元。Worknet 为你提供全套 AI 团队——包括开发、营销、销售、支持、运营和分析智能体，它们能自主构建和运营你的公司。描述你的想法，团队即刻开工。无需招聘，无需管理，无额外开销。起价每月 49 美元。

name: Blazly Local SEO
tagline: Increase Customers by 10x in a Month
tagline_zh: 一个月内客户数量增长 10 倍
description: Blazly Local SEO is an AI-powered platform that helps local businesses rank higher on Google Maps. Audit your Google Business Profile, optimize listings, discover local keywords, analyze competitors, manage reviews, enhance images with AI, and track performance, all from one dashboard. Everything you need to grow your local visibility in one place.
description_zh: Blazly Local SEO 是一款 AI 驱动的平台，帮助本地企业在 Google 地图中获得更高排名。审计你的 Google 商业资料，优化列表，发现本地关键词，分析竞争对手，管理评论，利用 AI 增强图片，并追踪性能表现，所有功能集成在一个仪表板中。一站式满足你提升本地曝光度的所有需求。

name: Maker Design
tagline: Where design engineers build and ship
tagline_zh: 设计工程师构建与交付产品的地方
description: Hot take: the design-to-dev handoff is software's most expensive lie. You mock it in Figma, someone rebuilds it in code, it ships 70% right, and everyone shrugs. Design engineers skip the handoff and build in the real thing. Maker is their canvas: your whole project is live and clickable on one infinite canvas, you point at what's wrong and it edits real code instead of a mockup, and it runs your dev server and maps every route automatically. Stop drawing rectangles and actually ship.
description_zh: 大胆观点：从设计到开发的交接是软件行业最昂贵的谎言。你在 Figma 中制作原型，有人用代码重建它，交付时只有 70% 正确，然后大家耸耸肩了事。设计工程师跳过交接环节，直接构建真实产品。Maker 是他们的画布：你的整个项目在一个无限画布上实时可点击；你指出问题所在，它编辑的是真实代码而非原型；它运行你的开发服务器并自动映射所有路由。停止绘制矩形，真正交付产品。

tagline: Turn the YT videos you watch into your next video idea
tagline_zh: 将你观看的 YouTube 视频转化为下一个视频创意
description: Creators face two problems: you forget what you watch, and you run out of ideas. AI idea tools give generic filler. Analytics tell you what already happened. Note apps become a graveyard you never reopen. Margin connects them. It turns every video you watch into a clean Google Doc notes, timestamps, takeaways then mines your watch history for your next ideas: hooks, titles and angles built for your audience, not generic AI. Built solo, early — honest feedback wanted.
description_zh: 创作者面临两大难题：遗忘观看内容、灵感枯竭。AI 创意工具提供千篇一律的填充物，分析数据仅反映过去，笔记应用沦为从未再打开的坟墓。Margin 将它们连接起来。它将你观看的每个视频转化为清晰的 Google Docs 笔记、时间戳和要点，并挖掘你的观看历史以生成下一个创意：专为你的受众设计的钩子、标题和角度，而非通用的 AI 内容。独立开发，早期版本——欢迎提供诚实反馈。

tagline_zh: 在您睡觉时收集用户证言的AI代理
description: The AI agent that collects testimonials while you sleep. Proofling connects to Stripe and asks every paying customer automatically - one warm ask, one gentle nudge, no chasing. Replies come back with consent attached and a verified-buyer badge tied to a real payment. name: Honey (I Shrunk the AI) by GreenPT
tagline: Cut Claude Code usage: −49% on code, −75% on reads.
tagline_zh: 减少Claude Code使用量：代码减少49%，读取减少75%。
description: AI coding agents burn most of their tokens on waste: code that didn't need to exist, prose nobody reads, bloated agent-to-agent handoffs. Honey fixes all three reflexively, YAGNI/stdlib-first code, answer-first prose, handoffs halved via compact JSON or ESON, plus ~75% cheaper bulk reads as rendered images (pxpipe). Benchmarked head-to-head vs Caveman & Ponytail on Opus and GPT: −49% output tokens at 98% quality, only variant 100% lossless on handoffs. Free, MIT, ships to ten agents from skills.
description_zh: AI编码代理将大部分令牌浪费在无用的代码、无人阅读的文字以及臃肿的代理间交接上。Honey能自动解决这三个问题：遵循YAGNI/标准库优先的代码原则、答案优先的文字、通过紧凑的JSON或ESON将交接减半，以及通过渲染图像（pxpipe）实现约75%更便宜的批量读取。在与Caveman和Ponytail针对Opus和GPT进行的基准测试中，输出令牌减少49%且质量保持98%，它是唯一在交接方面完全无损的变体。免费，MIT许可，从技能包分发至十个代理。

name: Cache-Pot
tagline: A superfast memory layer built for AI agents
tagline_zh: 为 AI 代理构建的超快内存层
description: Cache-Pot is a Redis-compatible in-memory data store, rebuilt for how AI apps and agents use a cache. Speak plain RESP2, your existing Redis client works untouched. On top: native vector search, a semantic cache (skip repeat LLM calls when a question means the same thing), a built-in MCP server so agents like Claude use it as a first-class tool, and a live web dashboard. All in one self-contained binary, no modules, no extra services.
description_zh: Cache-Pot 是一个与 Redis 兼容的内存数据存储，为 AI 应用和代理使用缓存的方式而重建。支持纯 RESP2，您现有的 Redis 客户端无需修改即可使用。额外功能：原生向量搜索、语义缓存（当问题含义相同时跳过重复的 LLM 调用）、内置 MCP 服务器，使 Claude 等代理将其作为一流工具使用，以及实时网页仪表板。所有功能都在一个独立的二进制文件中，无需模块，无需额外服务。

name: Corvin
tagline: AI that debugs your stack, not just talks about it
tagline_zh: 调试您堆栈的 AI，而不仅仅是谈论它
description: Most AI debugging tools are chatbots you paste stack traces into. Corvin is different, it's a CLI agent that plugs into your running services over WebSocket, watches real requests, and traces failures across service boundaries: contract mismatches between services, missing config for an edge-case input, race conditions between timeouts and async completions. Built for multi-service backends where the bug isn't in one file, it's in the seam between two services.
description_zh: 大多数 AI 调试工具是您粘贴堆栈跟踪的聊天机器人。Corvin 不同，它是一个通过 WebSocket 连接到您运行服务的 CLI 代理，监控真实请求，并跨服务边界跟踪故障：服务之间的合同不匹配、边缘情况输入的缺失配置、超时和异步完成之间的竞争条件。专为多服务后端构建，其中错误不在一个文件中，而是在两个服务之间的接缝处。

name: ThreadMine
tagline: JVM thread dump analyzer that catches Loom pinning

description: ThreadMine turns a JVM thread dump into an answer in seconds. The AI assistant, Vein, explains the root cause in plain language and suggests the fix. It reads HotSpot, OpenJ9, Zing and GraalVM. The thing others miss: virtual-thread pinning detection.
description_zh: ThreadMine在几秒钟内将JVM线程转储转换为答案。粘贴或上传一个 — 免费，无需注册 — 它会自动检测死锁、线程泄漏、池耗尽、CPU热点和虚拟线程固定（Project Loom），并给出A-F健康评分。AI助手Vein用通俗语言解释根本原因并建议修复方法。它支持HotSpot、OpenJ9、Zing和GraalVM。其他工具遗漏的功能：虚拟线程固定检测。

name: AI Infrastructure Memory
tagline: AI that remembers every cloud resource, change, & solution.
tagline_zh: 记住每个云资源、变更和解决方案的 AI
description: AI-powered infrastructure memory platform that remembers your entire cloud environment—not just documentation. It tracks AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Linux, RDS, Redis, deployments, incidents, fixes, and infrastructure changes. Ask questions in natural language and instantly get context-aware answers, past history, and solutions—helping DevOps teams troubleshoot faster and never lose operational knowledge.

tagline: AI-powered webhook tunnels inspect, explain and replay in RT

description: Pipehero tunnels your localhost to receive real webhooks from Stripe, GitHub, or any provider - with an AI copilot built in. description_zh: Pipehero 将你的本地主机隧道化，以接收来自 Stripe、GitHub 或任何提供商的真实 webhook - 内置 AI 副驾驶。让 Pipehero 用纯文本解释任何传入的 webhook，按需生成逼真的假事件，并在签名失败或负载与模式不匹配时获得 AI 建议的修复方案。除此之外：实时跟踪，更新时间低于 100 毫秒，一键重放，签名验证，以及在错误率激增或来源静默时发出警报 - 让 AI 为你阅读。

description: Most PDR tools assemble documents. This one runs the numbers underneath them. Import your SRR/SDR package: PDR Generator runs Monte Carlo over every allocation, returns a probability of breach against each committed value, estimates joint cost & schedule confidence, and ranks mitigations by return per $1k. Every figure traces to its source sheet, and where your package has a gap, it says so instead of inventing a number. Runs 100% offline. ITAR/EAR friendly by architecture.
description_zh: 大多数 PDR 工具只是组装文档，而这个工具计算底层数据。导入您的 SRR/SDR 包：PDR Generator 对每个分配运行蒙特卡洛模拟，返回每个承诺值的违约概率，估算联合成本和进度信心，并按每千美元的回报对缓解措施进行排名。每个数字都可追溯到源表，如果您的包中有缺口，它会明确指出而不是编造数字。100% 离线运行。架构上符合 ITAR/EAR 要求。

description: Launch monitors tell you about the shot you just hit, not the last month of them. Every session is a wall of numbers, and by the next one it's gone. description_zh: 发球监测器只告诉你刚刚击中的一杆，而不是过去一个月的数据。每个训练会话都是一个数据墙，过一会儿就消失了。Caddio会读取你的每个训练会话，并横向比较它们。进度快照会告诉你当前的状态。袋子视图会跟踪每个球杆。会话历史让你可以回溯到任何一次练习。这样它就可以找出你的8号铁和9号铁之间的差距，或者捕捉到一个球杆在三个星期内漂移的趋势。六十次击球不再是数字，而是故事。

name: Lyto CLI
tagline: AI that works on your computer while you sleep.
tagline_zh: AI 在你睡觉时在你的电脑上工作
description: Lyto CLI runs on your computer, logs into your accounts, and handles your tasks on a schedule while you sleep. Tell it once, it runs forever. Install it, describe what you want, walk away. Full shell access, Playwright automation, your own API key, your real Chrome profile. OpenClaw without the self-hosting. Same memory and credentials as the Lyto browser extension. Now with full access to your machine. No DevOps, no config files, no babysitting.
description_zh: Lyto CLI 在你的电脑上运行，登录你的账户，并在你睡觉时按计划处理你的任务。告诉它一次，它就会永远运行。安装它，描述你想要什么，然后走开。完全的 shell 访问权限，Playwright 自动化，你自己的 API 密钥，你真实的 Chrome 配置文件。无需自托管的 OpenClaw。与 Lyto 浏览器扩展相同的内存和凭证。现在拥有对你机器的完全访问权限。无需 DevOps，无需配置文件，无需人工干预。

tagline: Track daylight, UV & sunrise. Close the day with gratitude.

tagline: The feature-voting board coding agents build from

description: FeatQ is a feature voting board for founders and teams building with coding agents. Your agent can ship any feature in a day. Picking the right one is the hard part. FeatQ puts requests on one board your users rank. Your agent pulls the top request over MCP as a build-ready spec (Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT). Mark it done, the changelog publishes itself, and every voter gets an email when it ships. Setup: paste one prompt into your agent.
description_zh: FeatQ是为创始人和使用编码代理的团队开发的功能投票板。你的代理可以在一天内交付任何功能。挑选正确的一个是困难的。FeatQ将请求放在一个板上，用户可以排名。你的代理会将排名前一的请求拉取到MCP作为一个可构建的规范（Claude Code、Cursor、ChatGPT）。标记为完成，更新日志会自动发布，所有投票者都会收到一封电子邮件当它交付时。设置：将一个提示粘贴到你的代理中。

name: 0tab AI
tagline: Manage chrome bookmarks, create shortcuts with on-device AI.
tagline_zh: 管理Chrome书签，使用设备内AI创建快捷方式
description: 0tab gives your Chrome Bookmarks a keyboard shortcut. Type 0, press Tab (or spacebar), type a short code, Enter, and any saved page opens from anywhere in Chrome in about two seconds. One code can open a whole folder as a tab group, so your standup dashboard, Slack, and board open together. AI adds smart tags, semantic search, and a chat panel. It runs on-device by default (Gemini Nano), or you can plug in your own OpenAI API key. Free, open source, two-way synced with Chrome's bookmarks.
description_zh: 0tab为您的Chrome书签提供了一个键盘快捷方式。输入0，按Tab（或空格键），输入一个短代码，Enter，然后从Chrome的任何位置打开任何保存的页面，需要约两秒钟。一个代码可以打开一个整个文件夹作为一个标签组，因此您的站立位置仪表板、Slack和板开启一起。AI添加了智能标签、语义搜索和一个聊天面板。它默认使用设备内（Gemini Nano），或者您可以插入自己的OpenAI API密钥。免费，开源，两边与Chrome的书签同步

tagline: One layer for your agents and teams.

description: Most AI gateways stop at access. TarqaAI adds the control layer enterprises and governments actually need. Route 60+ models (Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-4.1, o3, Gemini 2.5 Pro, DeepSeek-R1) plus your own local GPUs through one API key. What's different: - Dual-gate budget limits that hard-block runaway bills (403) - 5-role RBAC + SAML 2.0 SSO, per-seat budgets - Exportable audit trails on every token - GPU tunnels for on-prem inference Start free — no credit card.

tagline: Get your brand recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini & Google AI

description: Search is changing. People no longer just Google-they ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI for recommendations. Yet most businesses have no idea whether AI platforms mention their brand. Rebbiton solves this. Track AI visibility, monitor citations, discover high-impact prompts, analyze competitors, measure AI-driven traffic, and put AEO, GEO, and SEO on autopilot. Built to help brands get found, cited, and recommended in the age of AI search.
description_zh: 搜索方式正在改变。人们不再只是使用Google，而是向ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude、Perplexity和Google AI寻求推荐。然而，大多数企业根本不知道AI平台是否提到了他们的品牌。Rebbiton解决了这个问题。追踪AI可见性，监控引用，发现高影响力提示词，分析竞争对手，衡量AI驱动流量，并将AEO、GEO和SEO自动化。旨在帮助品牌在AI搜索时代被发现、被引用和被推荐。

description: StoryCrew turns a single idea into a finished video, personalized to your brand. How it works: 1. Set up your channel. Paste your website link, drop in a brand guide, or just write down your youtube channel idea. 2. Type a topic. Pick landscape or vertical, choose a length, and hit create. 3. Make it yours. Don't like a scene? Rewrite the line, or regenerate the image or animation, then rebuild. Or just ask. StoryCrew has a built in assistant that can run the whole app for you.
description_zh: StoryCrew将单个想法转化为根据您的品牌定制的成品视频。工作原理：1. 设置您的频道。粘贴您的网站链接，上传品牌指南，或者写下您的YouTube频道创意。2. 输入主题。选择横向或纵向，选择时长，然后点击创建。3. 使其成为您的作品。不喜欢某个场景？重写台词，或重新生成图像或动画，然后重建。或者直接提问。StoryCrew内置助手可以为您运行整个应用。

tagline: From recurring fights to real understanding

description: Our Alcove is an AI-guided coaching app for couples. It helps partners move beyond the same repeating fights by uncovering the deeper emotions and patterns underneath them. Alongside guided conversations for couples, it also offers a private solo space to reflect before bringing something back to the relationship. Instead of generic advice or taking sides, Alcove helps couples reach clearer understanding and take one small step forward.
description_zh: 我们的Alcove是一款由AI指导的伴侣辅导应用。它帮助伴侣超越重复的争吵，揭示其背后更深层次的情感和模式。除了提供伴侣引导对话外，它还提供一个私人的独处空间，供您在将问题带回关系之前进行反思。Alcove不提供泛泛的建议或偏袒任何一方，而是帮助伴侣达成更清晰的理解，并迈出小小的一步向前。

The difference: no blind autopilot and no generic AI spam — just a research → draft → approve workflow for consistent founder-led marketing.
description_zh: Vetta X是一款面向创始人的“人在回路”AI内容引擎。它研究相关文章、帖子和新闻，以您自己的语气起草X帖子，并在发布前让您批准、编辑或否决每一篇草稿。不同之处：没有盲目的自动模式，也没有通用的AI垃圾内容——只有研究→起草→批准的流程，以实现一致的创始人主导型营销。

name: reFrame
tagline: The X-ray of any relationship, situation, or conversation
tagline_zh: 任何关系、情境或对话的 X 光透视
description: What if a product could give you insights your closest friend never could? The hardest conversations are with your spouse, your kid, your boss, or the friend who just blindsided you. reFrame is built for those. It's the X-ray of communication: it reads the patterns in what you send and what you receive. reFrame a message, a situation, or a whole conversation, and rehearse the one you're dreading. Your messages aren't stored by default. You're not the product here, you're who we built it for.
description_zh: 如果有一款产品能为你提供最亲密的朋友都无法给出的洞察，那会怎样？最难开的口往往是面对配偶、孩子、老板或突然让你措手不及的朋友。reFrame 正是为此而生。它是沟通的 X 光：它能解读你发送和接收信息中的模式。重构一条消息、一种情境或整场对话，并排练你一直畏惧的那次谈话。默认情况下，你的消息不会被存储。你不是我们的产品，你是我们为之打造它的人。

name: Heku
tagline: Convert any API to MCP locally, Make agents grow their tools
tagline_zh: 将任何 API 本地转换为 MCP，让智能体扩展其工具集
description: heku turns MCP servers into a config file. No more custom auth, transport, and tool boilerplate for every API you plug into an agent. Point it at an HTTP API, a database, gRPC, or another MCP server. A tiny manifest exposes config dicovery tools first, so the LLM lazily discovers tools only when needed. Context stays lean, credentials stay isolated, tools hot-reload mid-session. Apache 2.0. The boilerplate harness I kept rewriting by hand.
description_zh: heku 将 MCP 服务器转化为配置文件。无需再为接入智能体的每个 API 编写自定义认证、传输和工具样板代码。指向 HTTP API、数据库、gRPC 或另一个 MCP 服务器即可。一个微小的清单优先暴露配置发现工具，使 LLM 仅在需要时懒加载发现工具。上下文保持精简，凭据保持隔离，工具支持会话中热重载。Apache 2.0 协议。这是我反复手动重写的样板框架。

name: Wizard: self-extending coding agent
tagline: Claude Code, faster and leaner: any model, self-extending.
tagline_zh: Claude Code，更快更精简：支持任意模型，具备自我扩展能力。
description: Wizard is a fast, lean terminal coding agent written in Rust: a single ~60MB binary with nearly all of Claude Code's features and some it doesn't have, minus the bloat. Model-agnostic: run any local GGUF (managed for you) or OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, OpenRouter, and Groq, and switch live. Self-extending: hit a wall and it writes its own skills, tools, MCP servers, and subagents, or rebuilds its own binary. One line installs it; everything it learns is plain, editable TOML you own.
description_zh: Wizard 是一款用 Rust 编写的快速、精简的终端编码代理：单个约 60MB 的二进制文件，几乎包含 Claude Code 的所有功能以及一些其不具备的功能，且去除了冗余。模型无关：运行任何本地 GGUF（由我们管理）或 OpenAI、Anthropic、xAI、OpenRouter 和 Groq 模型，并可实时切换。自我扩展：遇到瓶颈时，它会编写自己的技能、工具、MCP 服务器和子代理，甚至重建自身的二进制文件。一行命令即可安装；它所学到的一切都是您可以拥有的、可编辑的纯 TOML 文件。

name: Qcanary — BullMQ Monitoring Dashboard
tagline: Watch your BullMQ queues, not your Redis credentials
tagline_zh: 监控你的BullMQ队列，而不是你的Redis凭证
description: Qcanary is a monitoring dashboard for BullMQ queues. Instead of asking for your Redis connection string, a lightweight agent runs inside your own worker process and listens to BullMQ's built-in events locally, streaming only job metadata (status, duration, errors). name: Commit Intent
tagline: Pre-commit hook that writes an intent doc by mining AI chats
tagline_zh: 通过挖掘AI聊天记录来编写意图文档的预提交钩子
description: Git records what changed, not why. When AI writes a 300-line diff, the reasoning, constraints, and decisions stay behind in chat logs on your disk. That's the newest technical debt: lost context. At commit time, it matches session transcripts to your staged files and uses the Claude Code CLI you already have to distill the intent into docs/intents/, staged into the same commit as the code it explains. The why travels with the what. No new platform, no new workflow, no commit ever blocked.
description_zh: Git记录了什么改变了，而不是为什么改变。当AI编写300行diff时，推理、约束和决策会留在磁盘上的聊天日志中。这是最新的技术债务：丢失的上下文。在提交时，它会将会话记录与您暂存的文件匹配，并使用您已有的Claude Code CLI将意图提炼到docs/intents/中，与它所解释的代码一起暂存到同一个提交中。为什么随同什么一起旅行。没有新平台，没有新工作流程，没有提交被阻止。

Install: pip install auditar-sdk What it does: • Captures inputs/outputs only (Zero-Knowledge) • Works with scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM • Local SQLite queue for air-gapped setups • Sub-ms overhead Built for: • Regulated AI in Indian financial services (RBI 7-Sutras ready) • Teams that cannot share model weights with vendors
description_zh: auditar-sdk 是一个开源 Python 库，可在不接触模型权重的情况下对 AI 推理进行检测。安装：pip install auditar-sdk 功能：• 仅捕获输入/输出（零知识）• 与 scikit-learn、XGBoost、LightGBM 兼容• 针对隔离环境的本地 SQLite 队列• 亚毫秒级开销 适用于：• 印度金融服务中的受监管 AI（符合 RBI 7 条准则）• 无法与供应商共享模型权重的团队

If a message returns a hit, it's logged for your team to review, so no one has to read every payment by hand.
description_zh: Sanction Scanner 现在筛查国际转账的 SWIFT MX 消息。当 MX 消息到达时，系统会读取它，提取发送方、接收方和 BIC，并实时对照制裁、PEP 和负面媒体名单进行检查。如果消息命中，系统会将其记录下来供您的团队审查，从而无需人工阅读每一笔付款。

tagline: Governance for reliable, long-running AI agents

description: AI agents drift during long-running work when they lose their verified state and guess among multiple next actions. It adds a graph-backed backlog, independent worker/QA roles, auditable bypasses, and controlled merge/reconcile flows—so humans provide judgment instead of acting as an expensive GPS.
description_zh: AI代理在长期运行过程中会偏离轨道，当它们失去验证状态并在多个下一步行动中猜测时。Aming Claw是开源治理基础设施，验证代理位置，推送一个合法的下一步入口，并在交接过程中保留因果证据。它添加了基于图的后备队列、独立的工人/QA角色、可审计的绕过以及受控的合并/协调流程——这样人类提供判断，而不是充当昂贵的GPS。

Plan, edit, and ship PRDs, briefs, decks and reports without ever opening a terminal. Every change Claude makes is tracked in git, so you're never blind to what happened. description_zh: Sofos 将你桌面上文档文件夹转化为一个智能工作空间。你在左侧获得一个易读的 Markdown 编辑器，Claude 在同一文件旁边工作。无需打开终端即可规划、编辑和发布 PRD、简报、演示文稿和报告。Claude 的每一次更改都会被记录在 git 中，因此你永远不会对发生的事情一无所知。它支持 Markdown、HTML、PDF、CSV 等，随着 AI 创建输出，你的工作空间会默默成长为一个真正的知识库。

description: Plexara Hub is your AI business OS — 13 skills in one platform. Find leads, run your CRM, draft outreach, track email opens, write blog posts, script videos, create ad copy, and schedule follow-ups. Built for founders. CA$149/mo. 7-day free trial.

name: ComplianceLint
tagline: EU AI Act compliance linter that runs in your IDE
tagline_zh: 在IDE中运行的欧盟AI法案合规性检查工具
description: Scan, attest, and document EU AI Act compliance from your IDE. 247 obligations decomposed from 44 articles, each tied to verbatim EUR-Lex citations. AI scanner handles code-verifiable obligations; Human Gates capture attestations for FRIA, Art. 14 oversight, Art. 26(7) worker notifications. Export audit-ready PDFs (Declaration of Conformity, Technical Documentation) at any time. MCP runs in your IDE — Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf. Free + source-available (BSL 1.1).
description_zh: 从IDE扫描、证明并记录欧盟AI法案的合规性。将44条条款中的247项义务分解，每项均关联EUR-Lex原文引用。AI扫描仪处理代码可验证的义务；人工关卡捕获FRIA、第14条监督、第26(7)条工人通知的证明。随时导出审计就绪的PDF（符合性声明、技术文档）。MCP在IDE中运行——Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf。免费+源码可用（BSL 1.1）。

name: IntentOne
tagline: AI that handles all of your text communication
tagline_zh: 处理所有文本通信的AI
description: Copilot for communication that lives in any text field. Talk to it through text or voice. Dictate your message, it writes or polishes it. Includes context about you, who you're talking to, and where you're writing. Ask it to draft messages. "Help me follow up on that call with Alex." It pulls context from your call and shows a draft. Tracks commitments from messages and calls. Records calls. Finds the right person. Everything stored locally. Try for free at intentone.ai
description_zh: 任何文本字段中的通信助手。通过文字或语音与其交谈。口述你的信息，它负责撰写或润色。包含关于你、对话对象以及写作场景的上下文。让它起草消息：“帮我跟进与Alex的电话。”它会从通话中提取上下文并显示草稿。跟踪来自消息和电话的承诺。记录通话。找到合适的人。所有数据本地存储。在intentone.ai免费试用

name: Yapper
tagline: AI Phone Receptionist for Small Business
tagline_zh: 面向小型企业的AI电话接待员
description: Yapper is an AI phone receptionist for small service businesses. It answers calls 24/7, captures job details, flags urgent calls, and sends the owner a clean summary. Built for trades that lose jobs when calls go to voicemail. a lead.
description_zh: Yapper是专为小型服务型企业设计的AI电话接待员。它全天候接听电话，捕捉工作细节，标记紧急呼叫，并向所有者发送清晰的摘要。专为那些因电话转入语音信箱而流失客户的行业打造。一个潜在客户。

name: MCP Context Budget
tagline: Measure and cap MCP context bloat before agents run
tagline_zh: 在智能体运行前测量并限制MCP上下文膨胀
description: MCP Context Budget is a local-first, MIT-licensed CLI that measures how much context MCP servers and tools consume, selects a lean task-relevant tool set, writes a lockfile, and fails CI when schema or response-token budgets regress.
description_zh: MCP Context Budget是一个本地优先、MIT许可的CLI工具，用于测量MCP服务器和工具消耗的上下文量，选择精简的任务相关工具集，编写锁文件，并在架构或响应令牌预算退化时使CI失败。

name: Shotly - Pre-Production Software
tagline: Pre-production software with AI built in
tagline_zh: 内置AI的生产前软件
description: Shotly is the all-in-one pre-production platform for filmmakers. Script, shot list, scheduling, call sheets, budgeting and more - seamlessly synced in one place. Fully integrated with AI. We built Shotly because pre-production deserves proper tools - not a mess of spreadsheets and disconnected apps. Everything stays in sync, so you spend less time managing documents and more time making something worth watching.
description_zh: Shotly是电影制作人的全方位前期制作平台。剧本、拍摄清单、日程安排、通告单、预算等——在一个地方无缝同步。完全集成AI。我们创建Shotly是因为前期制作值得拥有合适的工具，而不是一堆杂乱的电子表格和不相连的应用程序。所有内容保持同步，让你花更少的时间管理文档，更多的时间创作值得观看的作品。

name: Edos Solutions
tagline: 9 free email, DNS, security, SEO and AI-search scanners
tagline_zh: 9款免费的电子邮件、DNS、安全、SEO和AI搜索扫描工具
description: Nine free, no-signup web tools for the things your domain and email depend on: SPF/DKIM/DMARC check, MX and DNS lookups, HTTP security-headers scan, blacklist and DNSSEC/CAA/MTA-STS checks, a 40+ check website security scan, plus on-page SEO and AI-search (GEO/AEO) scanners. All client-side, nothing logged, no account needed. The GEO/AEO scanner - grading how ready a page is for AI search - is still rare to find free. By Edos Solutions, Sydney IT specialists since 2005.
description_zh: Nine款无需注册的免费网页工具，涵盖域名和电子邮件依赖的各项功能：SPF/DKIM/DMARC检查、MX和DNS查找、HTTP安全头扫描、黑名单及DNSSEC/CAA/MTA-STS检查、40多项网站安全检查，以及页面SEO和AI搜索（GEO/AEO）扫描器。全部在客户端运行，不记录任何数据，无需账户。GEO/AEO扫描器——评估页面针对AI搜索的准备程度——仍然很少见到免费提供的。由Edos Solutions提供，悉尼IT专家，自2005年起。

name: Thinkr
tagline: Run 11 named passes on the PRD you thought was done
tagline_zh: 在你认为已完成的PRD上运行11个指定检查项
description: The AI that reviews your PRD, not just writes it. Take a spec you already shipped and thought was finished. Thinkr reads it like a senior reviewer: 11 named passes, the full rubric published so you can audit every check. Findings come back classified blocker, major, or minor and land as comments on the exact line they concern, each with a suggested rewrite you can accept inline. It ends on a deterministic score, per dimension, computed from the findings rather than a model's gut feel.
description_zh: 审查你的PRD的AI，而不仅仅是撰写它。拿一个你已经发布并认为已完成的规范来说。Thinkr像资深审核员一样阅读它：11个指定检查项，公开完整的评分标准以便你审计每一项检查。发现结果被分类为阻塞、主要或次要问题，并以评论形式出现在相关的具体行上，每条评论都附有可内联接受的改写建议。最终得出基于发现的确定性分数，而非模型的主观感觉。

name: Roleplay
tagline: Social-engineering tests for AI agents
tagline_zh: 针对AI代理的社会工程学测试
description: Most AI agent tests check if your agent gave the right answer. Roleplay tests whether it can be manipulated into doing the wrong thing. Roleplay runs social-engineering attack packs against your agent, captures exploit proof, helps verify the fix, and keeps checking for regressions, so agent security becomes a repeatable workflow, not a one-time vibe check. Try it on roleplay.sh.
description_zh: 大多数AI代理测试检查代理是否给出了正确答案。角色扮演测试它是否能被操纵去做错误的事情。Roleplay对你的代理运行社会工程学攻击包，捕获利用证据，帮助验证修复方案，并持续检查回归问题，使代理安全成为可重复的工作流，而不是一次性的直觉检查。在 roleplay.sh 上试用。

name: Alignbase
tagline: Your company-wide AGENTS.md
tagline_zh: 你公司范围的AGENTS.md
description: The engineers that used to write the code knew the company, product, and policies. Now, the agents writing the code don’t. AGENTS.md can provide this context within a code repository, but these files are static and they don’t cross repo, user, and web agent boundaries cleanly. Alignbase unifies shared context under a single remote repository alongside fine-grained context permissions, reviews, audits, and agent authentication.
description_zh: 以前编写代码的工程师了解公司、产品和政策。现在，编写代码的代理并不了解。AGENTS.md可以在代码仓库中提供这种上下文，但这些文件是静态的，无法干净地跨越仓库、用户和Web代理边界。Alignbase将共享上下文统一在一个远程仓库下，并附带细粒度的上下文权限、审查、审计和代理认证。

name: SpecieSense
tagline: Identify any species from a single photo
tagline_zh: 从单张照片识别任何物种
description: Spotted a bug, plant, or mushroom and wondered what it is? SpecieSense identifies the species from a single photo — and shows you why: the features it matched, where it's recorded worldwide, and an honest confidence level. If it's unsure, it says so. And it never claims something is safe to eat or touch — for that it points you to a local expert. Built for the curious — gardeners, hikers, parents fielding "what's this?". Free to try, and I'd love your feedback on where it gets it wrong.
description_zh: 发现bug、植物或蘑菇，想知道它是什么？SpecieSense从单张照片中识别物种——并展示原因：匹配的特征、全球记录位置以及诚实的置信度。如果不确定，它会明确说明。而且它永远不会声称某物可以安全食用或触摸——为此，它会指引你联系当地专家。专为好奇者打造——园丁、徒步旅行者、应对“这是什么？”问题的父母。免费试用，我很乐意听取你在它出错方面的反馈。

name: ReplayDoc
tagline: One recording → The SOP humans read and AI agents run
tagline_zh: 一次录制 → 人类阅读的SOP和AI代理执行的SOP
description: I use ReplayDoc for three things every week. - Client onboarding docs for the team members joining the apps we shipped. - Workflow context I feed Claude Code when I'm building new features. - SOPs my AI agents can actually execute, not just vague text instructions. Same input every time: a screen recording. ReplayDoc turns it into a Flow: numbered steps, auto-captured screenshots, annotation overlays. Export as Markdown, PDF, or AI Agent SOP.
description_zh: 我每周用ReplayDoc做三件事。- 加入我们已发布应用的团队成员的客户入职文档。- 我在构建新功能时喂给Claude Code的工作流上下文。- 我的AI代理真正可以执行的SOP，而不仅仅是模糊的文本指令。每次输入相同：屏幕录制。ReplayDoc将其转化为Flow：编号步骤、自动捕获的截图、注释叠加层。导出为Markdown、PDF或AI代理SOP。

name: SignalStac
tagline: Find high-intent conversations worth replying to
tagline_zh: 找到值得回复的高意图对话
description: SignalStac is an AI agent that watches Reddit, Hacker News, and forums for conversations where your product is already relevant. It ranks the best threads, explains why they matter, and gives you the context to respond without manually scanning feeds all day. Built for founders doing early distribution, customer discovery, and founder-led sales.
description_zh: SignalStac 是一款 AI 智能体，它会监控 Reddit、Hacker News 和各类论坛，寻找与您的产品高度相关的对话。它会对最佳帖子进行排名，解释其重要性，并提供回复所需的上下文，让您无需整天手动浏览信息流。专为早期推广、客户探索和创始人主导销售的创始人打造。

name: Torqon
tagline: Persistence Context for LLMs with inbuilt Token Reduction
tagline_zh: 为LLM提供持久化上下文，内置Token减少功能
description: Your AI forgets everything when a session ends. Torqon fixes that. It's a persistent memory layer for long-conversation LLM systems. Every session starts with context already loaded: projects, decisions, preferences, tech stack. After each message, it automatically extracts and stores new facts about you and your work. Works with Claude Code via hooks, and any MCP-compatible client. No more re-explaining yourself every session. 71.85% token reduction in heavy usage. Set up in under 2 minutes.
description_zh: 您的AI在会话结束时通常会忘记一切。Torqon解决了这个问题。它是长对话LLM系统的持久记忆层。每次会话开始时，项目、决策、偏好和技术栈等上下文已自动加载。每条消息后，它会自动提取并存储关于您和您的工作的新事实。通过hooks兼容Claude Code及任何MCP兼容客户端。无需在每次会话中重新解释自己。重度使用时Token减少率达71.85%。2分钟内即可设置完成。

name: OKF Skill
tagline: Progressive disclosure and deterministic scaffolders
tagline_zh: 渐进式披露和确定性 scaffolders
description: Most project docs are written for humans. So an agent either rereads whole files every time it needs context, or skips the docs entirely and re-derives everything from source code. Neither scales well. OKF fixes this by giving knowledge a shape an agent can navigate step by step. It gets an index.md it can skim before deciding what to open, type-tagged frontmatter it can filter on, and a log.md it can check for recent history, instead of one big wall of prose it has to read in full every time.
description_zh: 大多数项目文档是为人类编写的。因此，agent 要么每次需要上下文时重读整个文件，要么完全跳过文档并从源代码重新推导一切。这两种方式都不具备可扩展性。OKF 通过赋予知识一种 agent 可以逐步导航的结构来解决这个问题。它提供了一个 index.md，agent 可以在决定打开哪个文件前快速浏览；提供了 type-tagged frontmatter，agent 可以据此进行过滤；还提供了 log.md，agent 可以查看最近的历史记录，而不必每次都通读一大段文字。

tagline: The 1000th dictation app. This one runs your Mac.

description: Yes, the 1000th macOS dictation app. But hold a key and clean text hits your cursor in about a second — fast as hell, and it spells your weird jargon right instead of writing "cubernetties". The twist: a second hotkey runs an agent that actually operates your Mac — sorts files, drafts replies, controls apps. Plug in any MCP server and its tools become the agent's. description_zh: 没错，这是第1000款 macOS 听写应用。但只需按住按键，干净的文本就会在约一秒钟内出现在光标处——速度快得惊人，而且能正确拼写出你那些奇怪的术语，而不是写成“cubernetties”。亮点在于：第二个快捷键会运行一个真正操作你 Mac 的 Agent——它可以整理文件、起草回复、控制应用程序。接入任何 MCP Server，其工具即成为该 Agent 的工具。你的听写应用能做到吗？我想你想不到的。欧盟托管，原生应用，非 Electron。

name: YourTraffic, open-source web analytics
tagline: Cookie-free, privacy-first analytics with an MCP server

description: YourTraffic is open-source, cookie-free web analytics. No cookies and no personal data means no consent banner, so you stay GDPR, CCPA and PECR compliant by default. Run unlimited sites on one account, keep your data in your own Postgres, and pull stats through a documented REST API. It also ships a native MCP server, so an AI agent can sign in with OAuth and read your traffic on demand. Self-host it for free under the MIT license or run it in the cloud. One script tag and you are live.
description_zh: YourTraffic 是一款开源、无 Cookie 的网页分析工具。不使用 Cookie 且不收集个人数据，因此无需同意横幅，默认符合 GDPR、CCPA 和 PECR 合规要求。一个账号即可运行无限数量的网站，将数据保留在你自己的 Postgres 数据库中，并通过文档完善的 REST API 获取统计数据。它还自带原生 MCP 服务器，AI 代理可通过 OAuth 登录并按需读取你的流量数据。在 MIT 许可下免费自托管，或在云端运行。只需添加一行脚本标签即可上线。

description: I got tired of openingmd files in Notepad and seeing raw syntax everywhere, but Obsidian felt like overkill when I just wanted to edit one file. So I built Paperling. There's an optional AI that proposes edits as inline diffs you accept or reject, and it works with any OpenAI compatible endpoint including local models. name: Code Review · Plannotator
tagline: Code review environment for the modern era.

description: A local diff viewer for reviewing agent-written code — git, jj, Perforce, and GitHub/GitLab PRs. Annotate lines and files; your notes feed straight back into your agent session. name: CodeAnswr
tagline: Stack Overflow alternative AI agents can actually talk to
tagline_zh: 可与AI代理真正对话的Stack Overflow替代品
description: CodeAnswr just became AI-agent-ready. New this update: 🤖 MCP server — agents can query/answer questions directly 🌐 DNS-AID — SVCB/HTTPS records so agents discover us via DNS, no scraping 📄 Agent Skills index — modular capability files agents load on demand 🔐 OAuth/OIDC discovery — agents can authenticate with our API safely Still 100% free, still privacy-first (client-side secret scanner + E2E encryption) still works with zero geo-blocking. Built on Cloudflare Workers + D1, ~$1/month to run.
description_zh: CodeAnswr现已全面支持AI代理。本次更新亮点：🤖 MCP服务器——代理可直接查询/回答问题 🌐 DNS-AID——通过SVCB/HTTPS记录让代理通过DNS发现我们，无需爬取 📄 代理技能索引——模块化能力文件，按需加载 🔐 OAuth/OIDC发现——代理可安全地通过我们的API进行身份验证。依然完全免费，坚持隐私优先（客户端密钥扫描器+端到端加密），且无地域封锁限制。基于Cloudflare Workers + D1构建，月运行成本约1美元。

name: Insight IT Solutions PrismGuard
tagline: Prompt-injection firewall for prod LLM apps
tagline_zh: 面向生产环境 LLM 应用的大模型提示注入防火墙
description: PrismGuard is an open-source firewall for LLM apps. Block prompt injection before it hits your model — every allow/block returns resolution_gate (which rule decided), not a probability score your team argues about in Slack. Rules-first: pip install prismguard. Optional local ONNX. Apache-2.0. Cold holdout: 14/14 vs LLM Guard 9/14. Wire at agent entry, RAG chunks, or sidecar. v0.1.6 on PyPI — alpha, feedback welcome.
description_zh: PrismGuard 是一款面向 LLM 应用的开源防火墙。在提示注入触及你的模型之前将其拦截——每次允许/拦截都会返回 resolution_gate（决定规则的 ID），而不是让你在 Slack 上争论的概率分数。规则优先：pip install prismguard。可选本地 ONNX。Apache-2.0 协议。冷启动测试：14/14 对比 LLM Guard 的 9/14。在代理入口、RAG 块或 Sidecar 处接入。PyPI 上 v0.1.6 版本——处于 Alpha 阶段，欢迎反馈。

name: Aurora
tagline: Glass-box Quantitative AI for Humans and Agents
tagline_zh: 人类与智能体可用的透明量化 AI
description: Aurora is glass-box quantitative AI that runs locally. Drop in a dataset and 24+ research-grade methods do the real math — anomalies, causality, regimes, forecasts — then every finding is cited to the method and source behind it. A live "0 fabricated" chip guarantees no invented numbers. Cloud LLMs guess; Aurora computes. Includes an MCP server + Python SDK so AI agents can call it for verified math. 100% local, no cloud, no API keys. Open source, Apache 2.0.
description_zh: Aurora 是本地运行的透明量化 AI。导入数据集，24+ 种研究级方法即可进行实际计算——包括异常检测、因果性分析、状态识别和预测——所有发现都会引用其背后的方法和来源。实时的“零虚构”芯片确保没有编造的数字。云端 LLM 只能猜测，Aurora 才能计算。包含 MCP 服务器 + Python SDK，以便 AI 智能体调用它进行经过验证的计算。100% 本地运行，无云端依赖，无需 API 密钥。开源，Apache 2.0 许可证。

name: Memorist
tagline: An auditable, local-first memory engine for Open WebUI
tagline_zh: 为 Open WebUI 提供可审计的本地存储引擎
description: Long-running LLM work loses continuity: decisions, corrections, and constraints evaporate between sessions. Most fixes summarize old chats into a hidden prompt — invisible, unauditable, easy to poison. Memorist takes a different position: raw messages are evidence, not memory. Every message is preserved unchanged in a local ledger. Deterministic sentence segmentation produces units with exact character offsets, so every memory claim traces back to the exact words that produced it.
description_zh: 长时间的 LLM 工作会丢失连续性：决策、纠正和约束在会话之间会消失。大多数修复方法会将旧聊天摘要为一个隐藏的提示 —— 不可见、不可审计、容易被污染。 Memorist 采取了不同的立场：原始消息是证据，而不是记忆。每个消息都在本地账本中保持不变。确定性的句子分段产生了具有精确字符偏移的单位，因此每个记忆声明都可以追溯到产生它的确切词语。

name: Sorta Game
tagline: Sort five things, then guess the hidden theme
tagline_zh: 排序五个东西，然后猜出隐藏的主题
description: A free daily puzzle with a twist. Sort five things three different ways — oldest→newest, smallest→largest — then name the hidden theme that secretly connects all three rounds. That deduction layer is what sets it apart from other ordering games: no multiple choice, you describe the thread in your own words and it's scored by AI. No login, no app, ~3 minutes a day.
description_zh: 每天免费的谜题，带有一个曲折。排序五个东西三种不同的方式 — 最旧→最新，最小→最大 — 然后命名隐藏的主题，秘密地连接了所有三个轮次。这个推理层次使其与其他排序游戏不同：没有多选项，你用自己的话描述线索，并由AI评分。无需登录，无需应用，~3分钟每天

name: Spancam: AI-Eye Correction Streamer Cam
tagline: Stream 4K, teleprompter with realtime AI eye correction
tagline_zh: 流式4K，实时AI眼部校正的播报器
description: Hey Product Hunt 👋 I’m Aditya, the creator of Spancam-and a streamer myself. I built it to replace expensive webcams and awkward teleprompter setups. Once connected, Spancam appears as a webcam on your system. Simply select “Spancam” in Zoom, Meet, Teams, or Discord—and your phone camera is live. You also get a built-in teleprompter, real-time eye-contact correction, background effects, low-light enhancement, and super-resolution. Everything runs locally with no cloud, accounts, or uploads.
description_zh: Hey Product Hunt 👋 我是Aditya，Spancam的创造者 — 也是一个流媒体者。我为它而建，来替代昂贵的网络摄像头和不自然的播报器设置。一旦连接，Spancam就像一个网络摄像头出现在你的系统中。只需在Zoom、Meet、Teams或Discord中选择“Spancam” — 然后你的手机摄像头就活了。同时，你也获得了内置的播报器，实时眼部接触校正、背景效果、低光增强和超分辨率。所有内容都在本地运行，无需云、账户或上传

name: MergeWarden
tagline: The change-control gate for AI-agent pull requests
tagline_zh: AI 代理 PR 的变更控制门槛
description: AI coding agents open PRs all day. Who checks they stayed in bounds? MergeWarden is a checkout-free GitHub Action and CLI that gates AI-agent PRs against your repo's boundaries: declared scope, agent-control-plane drift (AGENTS.md,mcp.json), and workflow permission escalation. No checkout, no LLM, deterministic replayable evidence. See what it catches in one command, no token or repo: npx mergewarden demo. Built after scanning 2,204 merged agent PRs: zero declared their scope. MIT.
description_zh: AI 编码代理每天都开启 PR。谁检查他们是否仍然在边界内？MergeWarden 是一个无需检出 GitHub Action 和 CLI， gates AI 代理 PR 對你的仓库的边界：声明的范围、代理控制平面漂移（AGENTS.md、mcp.json）和工作流权限升级。无需检出、无需 LLM、可预测可重复的证据。通过一条命令查看它捕获了什么，无需令牌或仓库：npx mergewarden demo。基于扫描 2204 次合并的代理 PR：零声明了他们的范围。MIT。

name: ClipLab Pro
tagline: AI gameplay editor that runs entirely on your PC
tagline_zh: AI游戏编辑器，完全在您的PC上运行
description: I had 247 gameplay clips on my PC and published zero — editing was the bottleneck. So I built ClipLab Pro. Drop in a raw recording: it finds the highlights (scene cuts, audio spikes, speech, a local vision model), cuts a timeline you can edit, burns in captions, and exports an MP4. Everything runs on your own GPU — footage never leaves your machine. No cloud, no account, no per-minute billing. $49 once, free 14-day trial, Windows. If I vanish tomorrow, your copy keeps working.
description_zh: 我有247个游戏剪辑在PC上，发布了零次——编辑是瓶颈。因此，我建造了ClipLab Pro。将原始录制文件插入：它找到了亮点（场景切割、音频峰值、语音、局部视觉模型），创建了一个可以编辑的时间线，添加了字幕，并导出MP4。所有内容都在您的GPU上运行—— footage从未离开您的机器。没有云，没有帐户，没有按分钟计费。$49一次，免费14天试用，Windows。如果我明天消失，您的副本将继续工作。

name: SeqBench
tagline: Sequence workbench for cloning, CRISPR, primers + MCP/API
tagline_zh: 克隆、CRISPR、引物+MCP/API的序列工作站
description: SeqBench is a sequence workbench for molecular and synthetic biology. SeqBench-GPT searches the literature, plans multi-step designs and drives real tool calls across primers, cloning and CRISPR, with mandatory construct verification. SeqStudio is an editable plasmid editor: features remap live as you type, with SnapGenedna/GenBank read-write, Sanger traces and virtual gels. Simulate Gibson, Golden Gate and restriction cloning, design guide RNAs, optimize codons - in batch or via REST API/MCP.
description_zh: SeqBench是一个序列工作站，适用于分子和合成生物学。SeqBench-GPT搜索文献，规划多步骤设计并驱动真实工具调用，包括引物、克隆和CRISPR，具有强制性构建验证。SeqStudio是一个可编辑的质粒编辑器：特征重新映射为您输入时，具有SnapGenedna/GenBank读写、Sanger迹线和虚拟凝胶。模拟Gibson、Golden Gate和限制克隆，设计引导RNA，优化密码子——批处理或通过REST API/MCP。

- **[AI Infrastructure](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-infrastructure)** – Products that support training, deploying, scaling, and evaluating AI models, including hosting, inference, data pipelines, and observability.

tagline: Know your usage pace and resets. Let Codex help you plan.
description: CUAR is a local, read-only Codex plugin that gives Codex your current usage pace, Scheduled and Banked resets, and the facts needed to advise on the work ahead.
