description_zh: SuperAI 是一个远程 AI 工作站控制中心，将 OpenClaw、Codex、Claude Code 和 R-Desktop 整合到一个工作区中。连接你自己的电脑作为 AI 工作站，管理多个账户或项目，运行长期的研究和编码任务，监控节点状态，并在需要手动控制时访问远程桌面。SuperAI 支持 Web、Windows EXE 和 Android APK，帮助团队将分散的 AI 工具和远程机器整合为一个可管理的系统。

name: AIVory Smart Inference
tagline: Cheaper inference. One URL. No code changes.
tagline_zh: 推理成本更低。一个 URL。无需修改代码。
description: Providers cut prices all the time — your bill pays like they don't. Smart Inference reroutes every LLM call to the cheapest provider serving the same model, in real time. Drop-in OpenAI-compatible: swap one URL, keep your SDK, prompts, and streaming. 50+ models, pay-as-you-go from $10, credits never expire, no subscription. Median ~30% savings, up to 89% on open-weight models. Or self-host — spin up spot GPUs in one click and route to them through the same endpoint.
description_zh: 供应商一直在降价——但你的账单却仿佛没降一样。Smart Inference 会实时将每一个 LLM 调用路由到提供相同模型的最便宜供应商。开箱即用的 OpenAI 兼容接口：只需更换一个 URL，保留你的 SDK、提示词和流式传输功能。支持 50+ 种模型，按用量付费，低至 10 美元起，积分永不过期，无订阅费。中位数节省约 30%，开源权重模型最高节省 89%。或者选择自托管——一键启动 Spot GPU，并通过同一端点进行路由。

name: theoinvest
tagline: Turn your idea, codebase or website into a financial model
tagline_zh: 将你的想法、代码库或网站转化为财务模型
description: Describe your startup and Theo builds a bottoms up financial model investors actually trust, a formula driven Excel workbook and a branded PDF, ready to send. It's free. Bring your own AI key, plug into our MCP server, and watch your financials materialize in seconds. Share it with an investor straight from the platform and unlock a hyper tuned AI tool like Theo, powered by hitheo.ai, as your Assistant CFO ready to field every question they throw at you
description_zh: 描述你的创业项目，Theo 会构建投资者真正信任的自下而上财务模型、公式驱动的 Excel 工作簿以及品牌化的 PDF，随时可发送。免费使用。自带 AI Key，接入我们的 MCP 服务器，几秒钟内即可生成财务数据。直接从平台分享给投资者，并解锁由 hitheo.ai 驱动的高级 AI 工具 Theo，作为你的虚拟首席财务官（Assistant CFO），准备好回答他们提出的任何问题。

name: Caspi AI
tagline: Your AI calisthenics coach
tagline_zh: 你的 AI 体操教练
description: Caspi AI is an AI-powered calisthenics coach that analyzes your skills from video and gives instant feedback. Upload a clip of your handstand, planche, front lever, muscle-up, and more to receive scores for form, control, stability, and execution, along with personalized coaching tips. Unlike generic fitness apps, Caspi is built specifically to help athletes improve calisthenics skills through video analysis and progress tracking.
description_zh: Caspi AI 是一款基于 AI 的体操教练，通过分析你的视频技能并提供即时反馈。上传你的倒立、平板支撑、前水平、俄挺等动作片段，即可获得姿势、控制力、稳定性和执行力的评分，以及个性化的指导建议。与通用健身应用不同，Caspi 专为帮助运动员通过视频分析和进度跟踪来提升体操技能而设计。

name: Smart Post Studio —  AI powered Desktop
tagline: Post with confidence - Backed by AI
tagline_zh: 自信发布——由 AI 提供支持
description: Smart Post Studio — the desktop-native social media scheduler for creators on Instagram, Threads, TikTok, X, Facebook, YouTube Shorts, Fanvue. Built-in AI Writing and marketing Studio. AI Writing Studio — caption generation, hashtag research, brand voice memory Visual calendar with drag-and-drop scheduling 7 platforms — Instagram, TikTok, X, Threads, Facebook, YouTube Shorts, Fanvue Local-first** — your posts and credentials live on your machine, not ours Mac + Windows** with native installers
description_zh: Smart Post Studio —— 面向 Instagram、Threads、TikTok、X、Facebook、YouTube Shorts、Fanvue 创作者的原生桌面社交媒体排程工具。内置 AI 写作与营销工作室。AI 写作工作室 —— 自动生成文案、研究标签、记忆品牌语调。可视化日历，支持拖拽式排程。支持 7 个平台 —— Instagram、TikTok、X、Threads、Facebook、YouTube Shorts、Fanvue。本地优先** —— 你的帖子和凭证存储在你的设备上，而非我们这里。Mac + Windows** 原生安装程序

name: Smart CRO Agent - AI Audits for Shopify
tagline: Your AI CRO consultant for Shopify — instant & affordable
tagline_zh: 你的 Shopify AI 转化优化顾问——即时且实惠
description: Smart CRO Agent is your AI conversion consultant for Shopify. Point it at any page — home, collections, products, or CMS — and in ~30 seconds it returns a prioritized, developer-ready action plan ranked by revenue impact, using 5 proven CRO frameworks. Every audit also scores mobile UX, SEO, and your AI search visibility (AEO, GEO & LLMs.txt) so you show up in ChatGPT Search and Google AI Overviews. Share reports via link or PDF. Start free — no consultant fees, no waiting weeks.
description_zh: Smart CRO Agent 是你的 Shopify AI 转化顾问。将其指向任何页面——首页、集合页、产品页或 CMS 页面——在约 30 秒内，它将返回一份按收入影响排序的、开发者可直接执行的优先级行动清单，基于 5 种经过验证的 CRO 框架。每次审计还会对移动端用户体验、SEO 以及你的 AI 搜索可见性（AEO、GEO 及 LLMs.txt）进行评分，确保你在 ChatGPT Search 和 Google AI Overviews 中获得展示。通过链接或 PDF 分享报告。免费开始——无咨询费，无需等待数周。

name: TextShape
tagline: Word art that fills any shape - free, exact, private
tagline_zh: 填充任意形状的字体艺术 - 免费、精准、私密
description: Turn your words into art that fills any shape - a heart, an animal, a logo or your own uploaded photo. TextShape places every word precisely to trace the silhouette, and because it's deterministic (not AI), you stay in control: same input, same result. It runs entirely in your browser, so nothing's uploaded. Free, no signup, no watermarks. Gradients, palettes, word-cloud packing, custom fonts. Export PNG, vector SVG with a Cricut/Silhouette cut mode, or an animated reveal - then put it on merch.
description_zh: 将文字转化为填充任意形状的艺术品——心形、动物、标志或您上传的照片。TextShape 精确放置每个单词以勾勒轮廓，且由于采用确定性算法（非 AI），您始终掌控全局：相同输入，相同结果。它在您的浏览器中完全本地运行，无需上传任何内容。免费、无需注册、无水印。支持渐变、调色板、词云排版、自定义字体。导出 PNG、带 Cricut/Silhouette 切割模式的矢量 SVG，或动态展示效果——然后用于商品定制。

name: DealLock AI
tagline: Smart Marketplace Meetup Booking
tagline_zh: 智能市场聚会预订
description: DealLock AI helps Facebook Marketplace and local sellers turn photos into ready-to-post listings, share a pickup booking link, and reduce back-and-forth with buyers. Sellers set available pickup times, buyers book a slot, and firm-price protection helps keep “firm” prices firm.
description_zh: DealLock AI 帮助 Facebook Marketplace 和本地卖家将照片转化为可直接发布的商品列表，分享取货预订链接，并减少与买家的反复沟通。卖家设定可用的取货时间，买家预订时段，固定价格保护功能有助于维持“一口价”的稳定性。

name: Rapha Protocol
tagline: Compute moves. Patient data stays
tagline_zh: 计算任务迁移，患者数据留存
description: Rapha Protocol is a zero-trust, compute-to-data edge network for clinical AI. Instead of exporting raw patient records and risking massive GDPR/HIPAA liabilities, Rapha routes AI models into air-gapped hardware enclaves directly inside hospital server rooms. Models train locally, and only anonymized weights leave. Key features include Intel SGX/TDX isolation, Policy-as-Code compliance enforcement, and immutable Zero-Knowledge (ZK-SNARK) audit receipts anchored on Polygon Mainnet.
description_zh: Rapha Protocol 是一个面向临床 AI 的零信任、计算到数据边缘网络。与其导出原始患者记录并承担巨大的 GDPR/HIPAA 合规风险，Rapha 将 AI 模型路由至医院服务器机房内直接隔离的硬件安全 enclave 中。模型在本地训练，仅匿名化的权重被传出。关键特性包括 Intel SGX/TDX 隔离、基于代码的策略合规执行，以及锚定在 Polygon Mainnet 上的不可变零知识（ZK-SNARK）审计凭证。

name: Stylus
tagline: Rich, on-brand HTML emails built with Claude
tagline_zh: 使用 Claude 构建丰富且符合品牌调性的 HTML 邮件
description: Most email tools give you a template editor. Stylus is a skill file you upload to a Claude Project. Claude reads it once and knows your entire design system — components, brand tokens, gradients, copy rules. Describe any email you need, get ready-to-send HTML back. Three themes at launch: Pitch, Grove, Axiom (SaaS). Works with most ESP.
description_zh: 大多数邮件工具提供模板编辑器，而 Stylus 是一个您上传至 Claude Project 的技能文件。Claude 读取一次后便掌握您的整个设计系统——组件、品牌标识、渐变、文案规则。描述您需要任何邮件，即可返回可直接发送的 HTML。首发包含三个主题：Pitch、Grove、Axiom（SaaS）。兼容大多数 ESP。

name: Ship Space
tagline: Agent Developing Ecosystem
tagline_zh: 代理开发生态系统
description: ShipSpace is the agent development environment for builders shipping with AI. Run Claude, Codex, Gemini, and Cursor side by side in one workspace with up to 16 agents in parallel. Ship Agent orchestrates your swarm, while a built-in browser, IDE, GitHub integration, and drag-and-drop terminals keep everything in one window. Spin up multi-agent workspaces in under a second. Built by MSH.Tech. Built by agents. Built for builders. Ship faster. 🚀
description_zh: ShipSpace 是为借助 AI 进行开发的构建者打造的代理开发环境。在一个工作区中并行运行 Claude、Codex、Gemini 和 Cursor，最多支持 16 个代理同时运行。Ship Agent 协调您的代理集群，内置浏览器、IDE、GitHub 集成和拖放式终端使所有内容集中在一个窗口中。一秒内启动多代理工作区。由 MSH.Tech 打造，由代理构建，为构建者而生。加速交付。🚀

name: CartAI Upsell
tagline: AI post-purchase upsells with combined shipping
tagline_zh: AI 售后追加销售，支持合并配送
description: CartAI Upsell helps Shopify merchants turn completed orders into a second sale. It matches each purchase with a relevant accessory, writes a personalized follow-up email, and gives the customer a one-click draft order link so the add-on can ship with the original order. Merchants control the accessory catalog and AI tone, while the dashboard tracks sends, conversions, revenue, and the full email audit trail.
description_zh: CartAI Upsell 帮助 Shopify 商家将已完成订单转化为第二笔销售。它根据每次购买匹配相关配件，撰写个性化跟进邮件，并提供一键生成的草稿订单链接，以便附加商品与原订单一起发货。商家可自定义配件目录和 AI 语气，仪表盘则追踪发送量、转化率、收入及完整的邮件审计轨迹。

name: Atlas
tagline: Trading built for the everyday investor
tagline_zh: 为普通投资者打造的交易体验
description: Atlas is a unified trading platform with a built-in smart AI layer called Glob. Glob analyzes tokens and stocks, constructs and executes trading strategies, and supports backtesting before deployment. Glob can trade on your behalf with different strategies such as following breaking news, SMA, and The platform covers all major asset classes: 20,000+ tokens across 90+ networks, 260+ stocks, perpetuals, and 5,000+ prediction markets.
description_zh: Atlas 是一个统一的交易平台，内置名为 Glob 的智能 AI 层。Glob 分析代币和股票，构建并执行交易策略，并在部署前支持回测。Glob 可代表您使用不同策略进行交易，如跟踪突发新闻、简单移动平均线（SMA）等。该平台涵盖所有主要资产类别：跨 90 多个网络的 20,000+ 代币、260+ 只股票、永续合约以及 5,000+ 预测市场。

name: RootNous
tagline: Foundational Intelligence
tagline_zh: 基础智能
description: Research and Development in Artificial Intelligence and related fields, Leading research organization advancing AI technology through cutting-edge research, publications, patents and innovative software solutions.
description_zh: 人工智能及相关领域的研发，领先的 AI 技术研究组织，通过前沿研究、出版物、专利和创新软件解决方案推动 AI 技术发展。

name: Remote Prop View
tagline: Dallas Fort-Worth property intelligence platform
tagline_zh: 达拉斯-沃斯堡房产智能平台
description: Competitors show you a price. We show you what it is actually like to live there. Remote Prop View is an AI property intelligence platform that compiles 45+ hyperlocal signals per Dallas-Fort Worth address, fusing listing data, public records, crime, school, commute, environmental and fraud intelligence into a single verified profile. The kind of depth no national portal will build, because they are not built to win one metro. We are. 200 DFW cities. One verified intelligence layer.
description_zh: 竞争对手向您展示价格。我们向您展示在那里生活的真实情况。Remote Prop View 是一个 AI 房产智能平台，为达拉斯-沃斯堡的每个地址汇编 45 多个超本地化信号，将房源数据、公共记录、犯罪率、学校、通勤、环境和反欺诈情报融合到一个经过验证的综合档案中。这种深度是任何全国性门户无法提供的，因为它们并非为了赢得单一都会区而建。而我们正是为此而生。覆盖达拉斯-沃斯堡地区 200 个城市。一个经过验证的智能层。

name: Tesseract: AI Math Solver
tagline: Snap & Get Video Explanation
tagline_zh: 拍摄并获取视频解释
description: When students get stuck, they're stuck choosing between text-step apps (Photomath, ChatGPT) that build no intuition, or generic YouTube lectures made for everyone — not their exact question. Tesseract turns any question into a personalized, animated video explanation — narrated and drawn out step by step, the way the best 1-on-1 tutor would explain it. Generated for your problem, in seconds. Live worldwide on the App Store. We're shipping, not pitching.
description_zh: 当学生遇到难题时，他们往往陷入两难选择：要么使用 Photomath、ChatGPT 等文本步骤应用，这些应用无法培养直觉；要么观看面向大众的通用 YouTube 讲座，而非针对其具体问题的解答。Tesseract 将任何问题转化为个性化的动画视频解释——由旁白逐步演示绘制，就像最好的 1 对 1 导师那样讲解。几秒钟内为您的问题生成。已在 App Store 全球上线。我们专注交付成果，而非空谈。

name: BidCopy
tagline: Win more freelance jobs with humanized AI proposals.
tagline_zh: 用拟人化的 AI 提案赢得更多自由职业工作。
description: BidCopy generates highly converting, personalized proposals for Upwork and other platforms. We automatically strip away generic AI jargon to make your cover letters sound 100% human, helping you stand out from the crowd and win more contracts.
description_zh: BidCopy 为 Upwork 及其他平台生成高转化率、个性化的提案。我们自动去除通用的 AI 术语，使您的求职信听起来完全像真人，帮助您在竞争中脱颖而出，赢得更多合同。

name: Vibebattle
tagline: Prove you are the best vibecoders among your friends
tagline_zh: 证明你是朋友中最棒的 Vibecoder
description: Vibebattle is a 2-8 players vibecoding game. 2 modes: creative -> text subject reproduction -> website target You have X minutes and Y prompts then there is a voting round.
description_zh: Vibebattle 是一款支持 2-8 人的 Vibecoding 游戏。两种模式：创意 -> 文本主题重现 -> 网站目标。你有 X 分钟和 Y 个提示词，然后进行投票环节。

name: Lite Agent
tagline: Your Browser's new AI intern
tagline_zh: 你浏览器的新 AI 实习生
description: Lite Agent is a privacy-first AI browser extension that clicks, types, remembers, and talks — all inside your browser.
description_zh: Lite Agent 是一款以隐私为先的 AI 浏览器扩展，可在浏览器内完成点击、输入、记忆和对话操作。

name: RankLLM
tagline: Rank Higher in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude & Perplexity
tagline_zh: 在 ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude 和 Perplexity 中排名更高
description: RankLLM helps brands monitor AI visibility, track citations, and get cited in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity answers.
description_zh: RankLLM 帮助品牌监控 AI 可见性，追踪引用情况，并出现在 ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude 和 Perplexity 的回答中。

name: n8n Freelance Autopilot
tagline: AI job hunter that finds freelance work 24/7 while you sleep
tagline_zh: 全天候 AI 求职助手，在你睡觉时为你寻找自由职业工作
description: Tired of checking Upwork daily? n8n Autopilot finds jobs 24/7, scores with AI, generates proposals in 3 languages, sends to Telegram. • Scans Upwork, Malt, Freelancer every 30 min • AI scores jobs 0-100 by your skills • Generates proposals in 3 languages • Sends alerts to Telegram • A/B tests proposals • Weekly reports 💰 €15 one-time • €5/month APIs • No SaaS Self-hosted on Raspberry Pi or VPS 📦 7 workflows • Setup guide • Lifetime updates Built by 17-year-old from Luxembourg 🇱🇺
description_zh: 厌倦了每天检查 Upwork？n8n Autopilot 全天候寻找工作，利用 AI 评分，生成三种语言的提案，并发送到 Telegram。• 每 30 分钟扫描 Upwork、Malt、Freelancer • AI 根据你的技能对工作进行 0-100 分评分 • 生成三种语言的提案 • 将警报发送到 Telegram • A/B 测试提案 • 每周报告 💰 一次性支付 €15 • API 每月 €5 • 无 SaaS 费用 在树莓派或 VPS 上自行托管 📦 7 个工作流 • 设置指南 • 终身更新 由来自卢森堡的 17 岁少年打造 🇱🇺

name: My Next Body
tagline: All-in-one fitness coaching: sport, nutrition & mindset
tagline_zh: 一站式健身教练：运动、营养与心态
description: Most fitness apps make you choose: train or eat well. My Next Body brings it all together. It's a French all-in-one coaching app where 4 AI coaches guide you across everything that actually matters: 🏋️ Martin — training, at home or in the gym, any level 🥗 Solène — nutrition & recipes, without restrictive diets 🧠 JB — mindset & motivation, so you actually stick with it ❤️ Gabriela — health, recovery & injury prevention
description_zh: 大多数健身应用让你二选一：训练或健康饮食。My Next Body 将这一切融为一体。这是一款法国的一站式教练应用，四位 AI 教练指导你关注真正重要的方面：🏋️ Martin — 居家或健身房训练，适合任何水平 🥗 Solène — 营养与食谱，无需限制性节食 🧠 JB — 心态与动力，助你坚持到底 ❤️ Gabriela — 健康、恢复与损伤预防

name: Gaplyze
tagline: Stop guessing. Start building what the market wants
tagline_zh: 停止猜测。开始构建市场所需的产品
description: Gaplyze stands out by turning startup validation into a complete workflow, not just an idea generator. Start with a niche, idea, or competitor URL and receive demand signals, competitor gaps, pricing insights, underserved audiences, idea scoring, strategy maps, business blueprints, execution roadmaps, domain ratings, prompt packs, and investor-ready exports. All of this is designed to help founders validate faster and build smarter.
description_zh: Gaplyze 的独特之处在于将初创企业验证转化为完整的工作流，而不仅仅是一个创意生成器。从细分领域、创意或竞争对手 URL 开始，获取需求信号、竞争对手差距、定价洞察、未受服务的受众、创意评分、战略地图、商业蓝图、执行路线图、域名评级、提示包和面向投资者的导出文件。所有这些设计都旨在帮助创始人更快地进行验证并更聪明地构建产品。

name: TruStar Connect
tagline: All-in-one safety software, built for COR readiness.
tagline_zh: 一站式安全软件，专为 COR 合规准备而建。
description: TruStar Connect is an all-in-one safety and field operations platform that helps companies get and stay COR ready. It replaces paper and spreadsheets with one connected system for inspections and forms, field observations, incident investigations with AI assistance, hazard registers, corrective actions, training tracking, and equipment maintenance. Everything is backed by audit-grade records, role-based access, and analytics. Built by Canadian safety professionals. Free trial available.
description_zh: TruStar Connect 是一站式安全和现场操作平台，帮助企业获得并保持 COR 合规状态。它用单一连接系统取代纸质文件和电子表格，涵盖检查表和表单、现场观察、AI 辅助事故调查、危险登记、纠正措施、培训跟踪和设备维护。所有内容均由审计级记录、基于角色的访问权限和分析功能支持。由加拿大安全专业人士打造。提供免费试用。

name: Haystack
tagline: Get your brand recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity & Gemini.
tagline_zh: 让您的品牌被 ChatGPT、Perplexity 和 Gemini 推荐。
description: Ask ChatGPT for the best tool in your category. It names three companies. You're probably not one of them. Those names aren't random. The model is pulling from a handful of articles it trusts, and your competitors are in them. You're not. Haystack finds the exact prompts buyers use, the exact sources behind every answer, and the journalists who can get you into them. You send the pitch, we watch the engines until your name shows up. Run it free on your own domain.
description_zh: 向 ChatGPT 询问您所在类别的最佳工具。它会列出三家公司。您可能不在其中。这些名字并非随机产生。模型是从它信任的少数文章中提取信息，而您的竞争对手就在其中。Haystack 能找到买家使用的确切提示、每个答案背后的确切来源，以及能将您纳入其中的记者。您发送推介邮件，我们监控引擎，直到您的名字出现。在您的域名上免费运行。

name: OpenMed Labs
tagline: The Infrastructure Layer for Healthcare AI
tagline_zh: 医疗 AI 的基础设施层
description: OpenMed Labs helps healthcare researchers and AI teams build medical AI without moving raw patient data. It combines secure medical datasets with no-code model training and clinical simulation in one platform. Contributors also get transparent ownership and attribution for how their data is used.
description_zh: OpenMed Labs 帮助医疗保健研究人员和 AI 团队在不移动原始患者数据的情况下构建医疗 AI。它将安全的数据集、无代码模型训练和临床模拟结合在一个平台中。贡献者还能对其数据的使用方式获得透明的所有权和归属权。

name: HealthBridge AI
tagline: A calm place to keep everyone's health, together.
tagline_zh: 一个让全家健康安心共处的宁静之所。
description: A beautiful, AI-powered healtHealthBridge AI is a calm, simple health companion for your phone. Add your medicines once and it keeps track of timing and dosage. Keep your family's blood groups, allergies, and emergency contacts in one place. Snap a photo of a prescription and it reads it for you. And when you have a health question at 2am, ask the built-in AI — it only talks health, nothing else. No clutter, no sign-up forms. Open it, and it remembers you.
description_zh: 一款精美、由AI驱动的健康伴侣——HealthBridge AI，专为您的手机打造。只需添加一次药物信息，即可自动追踪服药时间与剂量。将家人的血型、过敏史和紧急联系人集中管理。拍摄处方照片，AI即刻为您识别解读。凌晨两点有健康疑问？直接询问内置AI助手，它只专注健康问题，别无他扰。界面简洁无冗余，无需注册表单。打开应用，它便记得您的一切。

name: reAItro
tagline: Remote sprint retros your team shows up for
tagline_zh: 让您的团队踊跃参与的远程冲刺回顾会议工具
description: reAItro is a free AI retrospective tool built for remote & distributed agile teams. Run real-time boards, let AI cluster the feedback and write the summary. action items, and warm up quiet rooms with 5 built-in team games. No credit card, no signup to join.
description_zh: reAItro是一款专为远程及分布式敏捷团队打造的免费AI回顾工具。支持实时协作看板，利用AI自动聚类反馈并生成总结与行动项，还内置5款团队游戏活跃气氛。无需信用卡，无需注册即可加入使用。

name: Redvibe Multibrowser
tagline: multibrowser, saas, workspace, browser
tagline_zh: 多浏览器, SaaS, 工作区, 浏览器
description: Multi-accounting browser with unlimited profiles and zero complex setup. Redvibe is designed to manage dozens of accounts on a single computer without complex setups and technical hassles. Manage clients, scale advertising campaigns, import accounts in bulk — the AI will automatically sort them into ready-made profiles. No limits or restrictions. Launch work accounts quickly, without a cluttered interface or long preparation.
description_zh: 支持无限配置文件且零复杂设置的多账号浏览器。Redvibe旨在让您在一台电脑上轻松管理数十个账号，无需繁琐配置或技术折腾。管理客户、扩展广告活动、批量导入账号——AI会自动将其分类至预设配置文件中。无限制、无阻碍。快速启动工作账号，告别杂乱界面与漫长准备。

name: MakerMetrics
tagline: An open-source analytics dashboard built for Etsy shops.
tagline_zh: 一款专为Etsy店铺打造的开源数据分析仪表盘。
description: MakerMetrics is an analytics dashboard for Etsy sellers, without API access needed! Import the CSV exports Etsy already gives you and get what Etsy fails to give its sellers: a useful, mobile-friendly dashboard with insights, forecasting, and an ability to connect your own AI API key.
description_zh: MakerMetrics是专为Etsy卖家设计的分析仪表盘，无需API访问权限！直接导入Etsy提供的CSV导出文件，即可获得Etsy未能提供给卖家的实用功能：一个移动友好的仪表盘，包含洞察分析、趋势预测，并支持接入您自己的AI API密钥。

name: Ruki
tagline: A Windows AI assistant you can teach and that does the work
tagline_zh: 一款可教且能代劳的Windows AI助手
description: A minimal Windows desktop AI assistant you can teach and that then does the work for you, under your supervision.
description_zh: 一款极简的Windows桌面AI助手，您可对其进行训练，随后在您的监督下代为完成工作。

name: LearnPilot AI
tagline: The AI university that enforces mastery before you advance
tagline_zh: AI大学：掌握技能后方可进阶
description: LearnPilot AI is an AI university that enforces mastery. Type any skill → AI builds your personalized curriculum → study structured lessons with YouTube videos → pass quizzes to unlock next modules → fail → AI generates targeted revision → retry → pass all modules → take a final exam → graduate. No skipping. No passive watching. Actual mastery enforced. Built with Nuxt 4, Node.js, Groq AI, and YouTube API.
description_zh: LearnPilot AI 是一所强制执行掌握度考核的AI大学。输入任意技能 → AI生成个性化课程 → 结合YouTube视频学习结构化课程 → 通过测验解锁下一模块 → 未通过则AI生成针对性复习内容 → 重试 → 通过所有模块 → 参加最终考试 → 毕业。禁止跳过，禁止被动观看，强制实现真正掌握。基于Nuxt 4、Node.js、Groq AI和YouTube API构建。

name: Scuter
tagline: Ad & product intelligence for e-commerce winners
tagline_zh: 电商爆款广告与产品情报
description: Scruter is an all-in-one e-commerce intelligence platform. Search and analyze millions of live ads across Meta, TikTok and Pinterest, spy on competitors' shops, and uncover winning products before they go viral. Unlike single-platform ad spy tools, Scruter unifies ad research, shop intelligence and product discovery in one place with a shop tracking, email-flow capture, and a full public API + MCP + Chrome extension to research from anywhere.
description_zh: Scruter 是一款一站式电商情报平台。搜索并分析Meta、TikTok和Pinterest上数百万条实时广告，监控竞争对手店铺，在爆款病毒式传播前抢先发现潜力产品。与单一平台广告间谍工具不同，Scruter将广告研究、店铺情报和产品发现整合于一处，提供店铺追踪、邮件流捕获功能，并支持完整的公共API + MCP + Chrome扩展，随时随地开展研究。

name: Zenhook
tagline: Webhook debugging and AI summaries for humans
tagline_zh: Webhook调试与AI摘要，专为人类设计
description: Stop reading raw JSON. ZenHook lets you create webhook endpoints, capture requests in real time, and instantly understand incoming events with AI-powered summaries. Search, filter, and organize webhook traffic to debug integrations faster and spend less time digging through payloads. Built for developers, automation engineers, and API integrators.
description_zh: 停止阅读原始JSON。ZenHook 让你创建Webhook端点，实时捕获请求，并通过AI生成的摘要即时理解传入事件。搜索、过滤和组织Webhook流量，更快调试集成，减少排查负载数据的时间。专为开发人员、自动化工程师和API集成者打造。

name: prospect flow
tagline: Find verified local business leads & launch multi-channel AI
tagline_zh: 获取经过验证的本地商业线索，启动多渠道AI营销
description: Scaling cold outreach is painful. You have to buy a scraper (like D7), a validation service (like ZeroBounce), an email sender (like Instantly), and a CRM. ProspectFlow.ai unifies the entire workflow into a single glassmorphic workspace: 📍 Google Maps Business Scraper: Search any niche and city instantly. 🛡️ Bounce Protection MX Check: Automatically verifies emails 📣 Multi-Channel Sequences: 🎯 Intelligent Lead Scoring: Instantly ranks leads
description_zh: 扩展冷启动外呼流程令人痛苦。你需要购买爬虫（如D7）、验证服务（如ZeroBounce）、邮件发送器（如Instantly）以及CRM系统。ProspectFlow.ai 将整个工作流统一到一个玻璃拟态风格的工作区中：📍 Google Maps 商家爬虫：即时搜索任何细分领域和城市。🛡️ 退信防护MX检查：自动验证电子邮件 📣 多渠道序列： 🎯 智能线索评分：即时对线索进行排名

name: ShBusca
tagline: Dados e IA para vender mais na Shopee
tagline_zh: Shopee销售数据与AI助力
description: SHBusca é uma extensão para Chrome que mostra, direto nas páginas da Shopee, os dados que decidem se um produto vale a pena: faturamento estimado, vendas, concorrência e margem real. Agora ela também ajuda a vender mais: a IA audita sua copy com a estrutura AIDA, detecta objeções nas avaliações e gera campanhas prontas. Tudo sem sair da Shopee. Feito no Brasil, para vendedores da Shopee Brasil.
description_zh: SHBusca 是一款Chrome扩展插件，直接在Shopee页面展示决定产品是否值得运营的关键数据：预估营收、销量、竞争程度和实际利润率。现在它还能助你提升销量：AI根据AIDA结构审计你的文案，识别评论中的异议，并生成现成的营销活动。全程无需离开Shopee。巴西本土开发，专为Shopee巴西卖家打造。

name: TellShots - Social forecasting platform
tagline: Lock predictions. Verify outcomes. Build reputation.
tagline_zh: 锁定预测。验证结果。建立声誉。
description: TellShots lets you lock predictions before events happen and automatically verify outcomes over time. No hindsight edits, no rewriting history, just timestamped proof of what you actually called. Compete with counter predictions, join prediction threads, and earn reputation badges based on accuracy. From sports and crypto to politics and tech, every prediction becomes a shareable proof card of your foresight. Predict. Verify. Prove.
description_zh: TellShots 让您在事件发生前锁定预测，并随时间自动验证结果。没有事后诸葛亮，没有篡改历史，只有带有时间戳的预测证明。与反向预测竞争，加入预测线程，并根据准确率赚取声誉徽章。从体育、加密货币到政治和科技，每一个预测都成为可分享的远见证明卡。预测。验证。证明。

name: LCPath
tagline: Your personalized Socratic AI LeetCode coach
tagline_zh: 您的个性化苏格拉底式 AI LeetCode 教练
description: Grinding LeetCode blindly is a waste of time. LCPath is a Chrome extension that turns LeetCode into a personalized learning platform. Instead of just giving you the answers, our context-aware AI acts as a Socratic coach, reading your current code and providing gentle hints to build your intuition. It analyzes your solve history to recommend the exact problems you need to patch your knowledge gaps, utilizing spaced repetition so you never forget what you learn. Zero setup required.
description_zh: 盲目刷题 LeetCode 是浪费时间。LCPath 是一款 Chrome 扩展程序，将 LeetCode 转变为个性化学习平台。我们的上下文感知 AI 不仅仅提供答案，而是作为苏格拉底式教练，阅读您当前的代码并提供温和的提示以培养您的直觉。它分析您的解题历史，推荐恰好能弥补您知识盲区的题目，利用间隔重复技术确保您永远不会忘记所学内容。无需任何设置。

name: AppZ AU Business Advisor
tagline: AU biz automation blueprints with GST/BAS/super context
tagline_zh: 带有 GST/BAS/养老金上下文的澳大利亚业务自动化蓝图
description: Australian small business? Get a free, personalised automation blueprint from Gemini AI -- with GST, BAS, super, and Fair Work context built in. 30 seconds.
description_zh: 澳大利亚小型企业？获取由 Gemini AI 提供的免费个性化自动化蓝图——内置 GST、BAS、养老金和公平工作上下文。仅需 30 秒。

name: PromptCache
tagline: Version your prompts. Ship faster with your team.
tagline_zh: 版本管理您的提示词。与团队协同加速交付。
description: PromptCache is version control for your AI prompts — built for teams. Get full version history, typed variable templates, role-based collaboration, and a public gallery to share and fork prompts. Integrate via REST API or the typed SDK. Stop losing prompts in Notion and Slack. One source of truth for your whole team.
description_zh: PromptCache 是为团队打造的 AI 提示词版本控制工具。获取完整的版本历史记录、带类型的变量模板、基于角色的协作功能以及用于分享和 Fork 提示词的公共画廊。通过 REST API 或带类型的 SDK 进行集成。别再让提示词散落在 Notion 和 Slack 中。为整个团队提供唯一的事实来源。

name: Oracle NetSuite Industrial
tagline: Artificial Intelligence
tagline_zh: 人工智能
description: AI Oracle NetSuite Industrialsconnected with local LLM to get data from you OracleNetsuite Account and FineTuned LLM will summarize insights and give you better reports than standard one in Oracle NetSuite
description_zh: AI Oracle NetSuite Industrials 连接本地 LLM，从您的 Oracle NetSuite 账户获取数据，经过微调的 LLM 将总结洞察，并提供比 Oracle NetSuite 标准报告更优质的报表。

name: AnswerManiac
tagline: Be The Answer AI Can't Stop Talking About.
tagline_zh: 成为AI热议的答案。
description: Get your free AI visibility report in 60 seconds. See how ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini talk about your brand. No credit card required. After you receive your audit, our team can help you grow your presence across LLM AI Search.
description_zh: 60秒获取免费AI曝光报告。查看ChatGPT、Perplexity和Gemini如何谈论您的品牌。无需信用卡。收到审计后，我们的团队可帮助您在LLM AI搜索中扩大影响力。

name: Redacto
tagline: Local AI redacts. You approve.
tagline_zh: 本地AI自动脱敏。您来审批。
description: Redacto is not another PDF editor. It is a focused Mac app for local AI redaction. Drop in PDFs, scans, images, DOCX, CSV, JSON, RTF or text files; Redacto detects sensitive data, places redaction boxes, and lets you approve or adjust each choice before exporting. No upload, no account, no subscription.
description_zh: Redacto不是另一个PDF编辑器。它是专为本地AI脱敏打造的Mac应用。拖入PDF、扫描件、图片、DOCX、CSV、JSON、RTF或文本文件；Redacto检测敏感数据，放置脱敏框，并在导出前让您审批或调整每项选择。无需上传、无需账户、无需订阅。

name: ExaminerOS
tagline: AI-Powered EdTech Assessments & Analytics for Professionals
tagline_zh: 面向专业人士的AI驱动EdTech评估与分析
description: ExaminerOS is a modern comprehensive AI-powered assessment EdTech platform, designed for generating, managing, conducting, and grading assessments of all kinds including exams, quiz, polls/surveys, GTKY (Get-To-Know-You) in real-time, drastically reducing the time and complexity of traditional assessment creation and administration.
description_zh: ExaminerOS是一个现代化的综合AI驱动评估EdTech平台，旨在生成、管理、执行和评分各类评估（包括考试、测验、投票/调查、GTKY实时互动等），大幅降低传统评估创建和管理的时间与复杂性。

name: Reloop Studio
tagline: Promote Apps with AI UGC Videos
tagline_zh: 用AI UGC视频推广应用
description: Generate high-quality UGC videos powered by AI with cinematic quality. Building a product is easy now. Getting people to notice it isn't. Reloop helps founders turn their product into promo videos quickly, so you can test more creatives instead of betting everything on one expensive video.
description_zh: 生成电影级高质量AI驱动的UGC视频。打造产品已不再困难，但让用户注意到却并非易事。Reloop帮助创始人快速将产品转化为宣传视频，让您能测试更多创意，而非将所有赌注押在一支昂贵的视频上。

name: SceneCraft
tagline: AI-native screenwriting, from blank page to final draft
tagline_zh: AI原生剧本创作，从空白页到终稿
description: SceneCraft is an AI-native screenwriting platform: write, structure, and produce professional screenplays right in your browser. Unlike Final Draft (zero AI) or ChatGPT (zero structure), SceneCraft maintains act structure, character voice, and formatting across a full script. Write in any language, collaborate in real time, and visualize scenes with AI storyboarding. Your co-writer, not your replacement.
description_zh: SceneCraft是AI原生剧本创作平台：直接在浏览器中编写、构建结构并制作专业剧本。与Final Draft（零AI）或ChatGPT（无结构）不同，SceneCraft在整个剧本中保持幕结构、角色语气和格式规范。支持任意语言写作、实时协作，并通过AI故事板可视化场景。您的联合编剧，而非替代品。

name: Leohunt
tagline: The friend who always finds what you want in NYC
tagline_zh: 在纽约市总能找到你所想的朋友
description: Leohunt is an AI-powered spot finder for NYC. Describe what you want in plain English — "not too loud," "cozy vibe," "for 6 people" — and get 3 curated picks in 30 seconds. Includes health inspection grades (NYC DOHMH data), happy hours, vibe analysis, map + list + chat views, save & like, and photo gallery. Block-level NYC knowledge. SoHo ≠ NoHo ≠ West Village. Free. No ads.
description_zh: Leohunt 是一款专为纽约市打造的 AI 智能地点发现工具。用简单的英语描述你的需求——“不要太吵”、“氛围温馨”、“适合6人”——即可在30秒内获得3个精选推荐。包含健康检查评级（基于纽约市卫生局数据）、欢乐时光、氛围分析、地图+列表+聊天视图、收藏与点赞功能以及照片画廊。掌握街区级的纽约市知识。苏荷区≠北苏荷区≠西村。免费，无广告。

name: Lean-dev – Teaching AI coding assistants
tagline: lean-dev – Teaching AI coding assistants to be smart
tagline_zh: lean-dev – 教导 AI 编程助手变得聪明
description: I built lean-dev, an open-source AI skill for coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, and GitHub Copilot. lean-dev attempts to address : 1. Think Before Coding 2. Simplicity First 3. Surgical Changes 4. Goal-Driven Execution 5. Lean Responses One interesting result during testing was a significant reduction in token usage (often around 75%) while still producing useful outputs. GitHub: https://github.com/Vishnu90Coreinn/lean-dev
description_zh: 我开发了 lean-dev，这是一个面向 Claude Code、Cursor、ChatGPT 和 GitHub Copilot 等编程助手的开源 AI 技能包。lean-dev 旨在解决以下问题：1. 编码前思考 2. 简洁优先 3. 精准修改 4. 目标驱动执行 5. 精简响应。测试中的一个有趣结果是，在保持输出有用的同时，显著减少了 Token 使用量（通常减少约 75%）。GitHub: https://github.com/Vishnu90Coreinn/lean-dev

name: VideoGPT Free 2D Video Generator
tagline: prompts to real-time 2D video graphics using HTML canvas.
tagline_zh: 将提示词实时转换为基于 HTML canvas 的 2D 视频图形。
description: Generative video platform that turns natural-language user prompts into structured JSON briefs using LLMs to automatically scaffold animated architecture and explainer videos. TypeScript-based expansion pipeline that turns high-level JSON briefs into complete video projects by injecting precise canvas coordinates, layout grids, act-timing tables, and style easing functions. Shape short-form visuals, prompts, and animated previews in one AI-powered workspace.
description_zh: 生成式视频平台，利用 LLM 将自然语言用户提示转化为结构化 JSON 简报，自动构建动画架构和解说视频的框架。基于 TypeScript 的扩展管道通过将精确的 canvas 坐标、布局网格、分镜时间表和样式缓动函数注入其中，把高层 JSON 简报转化为完整的视频项目。在一个 AI 驱动的工作空间中塑造短视频视觉、提示词和动画预览。

name: Hercules
tagline: What can Hercules build for you?
tagline_zh: Hercules 能为你构建什么？
description: Hercules makes it easy to build apps and websites by chatting with AI. Build SaaS, eCommerce, internal tools, and mobile apps in minutes.
description_zh: Hercules 让通过聊天与 AI 协作来构建应用和网站变得轻而易举。在几分钟内构建 SaaS、电子商务、内部工具和移动应用。

name: CVClaw AI
tagline: Convert job description to ATS-optimized Resume in seconds.
tagline_zh: 几秒钟内将职位描述转换为符合 ATS 优化的简历。
description: CVClaw AI is an AI-powered Resume builder that convert job description to ATS-optimized resume under 60 seconds. It enable job seekers create tailormade resume by just pasting job description.
description_zh: CVClaw AI 是一款 AI 驱动的简历构建工具，能在60秒内将职位描述转换为符合 ATS 优化的简历。求职者只需粘贴职位描述，即可创建量身定制的简历。

name: Resubuild
tagline: Open-source AI JSON Resume editor with PDF import & export
tagline_zh: 开源 AI JSON 简历编辑器，支持 PDF 导入与导出
description: Resubuild is a self-hostable JSON Resume editor with AI PDF import. Upload any PDF → AI extracts clean structured data. Edit with live preview, tailor for jobs, export perfect PDFs. Built with Next.js, NestJS, Supabase & Mastra AI. 100% JSON Resume compliant • MIT licensed. Live demo: https://app.resubuild.dev GitHub: https://github.com/yortyrh/resubuild
description_zh: Resubuild 是一款可自托管的 JSON 简历编辑器，具备 AI PDF 导入功能。上传任意 PDF → AI 提取干净的结构化数据。支持实时预览编辑、针对职位定制、导出完美 PDF。基于 Next.js、NestJS、Supabase 和 Mastra AI 构建。100% 符合 JSON Resume 标准 • MIT 许可。在线演示：https://app.resubuild.dev GitHub：https://github.com/yortyrh/resubuild

name: MyPhotoStudio
tagline: AI-powered photo sharing & studio CRM platform
tagline_zh: AI 驱动的照片分享与工作室 CRM 平台
description: MyPhotoStudio helps photography businesses manage bookings, clients, payments, photo galleries and online orders from a single platform. Features include AI face recognition, QR-code photo delivery, WhatsApp automation, client proofing, digital downloads, print orders and complete studio CRM tools. Designed for photographers, wedding studios and event photography businesses.
description_zh: MyPhotoStudio 帮助摄影企业在一个平台上管理预订、客户、付款、照片画廊和在线订单。功能包括 AI 人脸识别、二维码照片交付、WhatsApp 自动化、客户选片、数字下载、打印订单以及完整的工作室 CRM 工具。专为摄影师、婚礼工作室和活动摄影业务设计。

name: Nivroo
tagline: Build an AI dropshipping store in 60 seconds - and trade too
tagline_zh: 60 秒构建 AI 代发货商店——同时交易
description: Describe your niche in one sentence — Nivroo's AI builds your whole store (brand, products, copy, SEO, checkout) in 60s. It auto-sources products, prices them, fulfils orders, and answers customers. Plus a built-in stock/crypto/forex terminal. Sell on 19 channels.
description_zh: 用一句话描述你的利基市场——Nivroo 的 AI 在 60 秒内构建你的整个商店（品牌、产品、文案、SEO、结账）。它自动采购产品、定价、履行订单并回答客户咨询。此外还内置股票/加密货币/外汇终端。在 19 个渠道上销售。

name: BocadoClaro
tagline: Nutrition for the Spanish market. Adapted to our lifestyle
tagline_zh: 面向西班牙市场的营养方案。适应我们的生活方式
description: Track calories and macros without having to deal with databases: log your meals using text, photos of your plate, barcodes, recipes, and saved foods. -------------------------- Cuenta calorías y macros sin pelearte con bases de datos: registra comida por texto, foto del plato, código de barras, recetas y alimentos guardados.
description_zh: 无需与数据库打交道即可追踪卡路里和宏量营养素：通过文本、餐盘照片、条形码、食谱和保存的食物记录您的饮食。-------------------------- 无需与数据库打交道即可计算卡路里和宏量营养素：通过文本、餐盘照片、条形码、食谱和保存的食物记录饮食。

name: DevBrain
tagline: Git-aware memory for AI coding agents via Obsidian
tagline_zh: 基于 Obsidian 的 Git 感知 AI 编程代理记忆层
description: DevBrain gives AI coding agents a persistent, Git-aware memory layer powered by Obsidian. It automatically detects branch switches, loads branch-specific context, tracks progress, and creates structured handoffs between sessions. Multiple agents can share the same knowledge vault through a single MCP server, so decisions, blockers, and project history never get lost. Stop re-explaining your codebase, let your AI agents build on what they already know.
description_zh: DevBrain 为 AI 编程代理提供由 Obsidian 驱动的持久化、Git 感知记忆层。它自动检测分支切换，加载特定于分支的上下文，跟踪进度，并在会话之间创建结构化交接。多个代理可以通过单个 MCP 服务器共享同一个知识库，因此决策、阻碍因素和项目历史永远不会丢失。停止重新解释您的代码库，让您的 AI 代理基于它们已知的内容进行构建。

name: NeuralRun
tagline: Education AI
tagline_zh: 教育AI
description: NeuralRun is a grounded AI quiz and trivia platform with citation-backed facts and a Challenge AI feature. Built for knowledge seekers, trivia hosts, and educators.
description_zh: NeuralRun 是一个基于事实引用的AI问答与知识竞猜平台，具备“挑战AI”功能。专为知识探索者、竞猜主持人和教育工作者打造。

name: Revisite
tagline: Turn Google Maps reviews into a complete multi-page website
tagline_zh: 将Google地图评论转化为完整的多页面网站
description: Your customers already wrote your best marketing copy. It is buried in your Google reviews. Revisite reads them, finds the real reasons people keep coming back, and turns them into a complete multi-page website: landing, gallery, menu or catalogue, and contact. Pick from 5 hand-crafted themes, add per-page QR codes, and track daily visits. Most tools stop at a single page. Revisite gives you a complete website, live in minutes.
description_zh: 您的客户已经为您撰写了最好的营销文案，只是它们埋没在您的Google评论中。Revisite会阅读这些评论，找出人们反复光顾的真正原因，并将其转化为一个完整的多页面网站：包括着陆页、画廊、菜单或产品目录以及联系方式。从5种手工设计的主题中选择，添加每页的二维码，并追踪每日访问量。大多数工具仅生成单页网站，而Revisite能在几分钟内为您提供一个完整的网站。

name: QuoteMate
tagline: AI quoting & invoicing for Australian tradies
tagline_zh: 面向澳大利亚技工的AI报价与发票服务
description: QuoteMate is an AI-powered quoting & invoicing app built for Australian tradies. Describe any job, get a full materials list with real-time supplier pricing, and send a professional quote in under 2 minutes. Key features: AI material suggestions, live Aussie supplier pricing, section-based quoting, quote-to-invoice in one tap, 9-stage job pipeline, Google Calendar sync, Square tap-to-pay, Xero integration, offline mode, Australian GST built in. Free plan + Pro at $49/mo.
description_zh: QuoteMate 是一款专为澳大利亚技工打造的AI驱动报价与发票应用。描述任何工作，即可获得包含实时供应商价格的完整材料清单，并在2分钟内发送专业报价。主要功能：AI材料建议、澳大利亚供应商实时定价、分区块报价、一键将报价转为发票、9阶段工作管道、Google日历同步、Square扫码支付、Xero集成、离线模式、内置澳大利亚GST。提供免费计划和专业版（$49/月）。

name: Swift Signage
tagline: Turn your screens into a customer retention machine
tagline_zh: 将您的屏幕转化为客户留存引擎
description: Swift Signage is a digital signage SaaS built for restaurants and retail. Manage menus, slideshows, and product showcases on any TV — updated in real time from anywhere. Beyond the screens, a built-in retention engine lets you send push notifications, run loyalty programs, and track customer segments — turning one-time visitors into regulars. No hardware lock-in. Live in minutes.
description_zh: Swift Signage 是一款专为餐厅和零售业打造的数字标牌SaaS。在任何电视上管理菜单、幻灯片和产品展示——随时随地实时更新。超越屏幕显示，其内置的留存引擎允许您发送推送通知、运行忠诚度计划并追踪客户细分——将一次性访客转化为常客。无硬件锁定。几分钟即可上线。

name: Votura 2.0
tagline: Explore 500+ cities with AI audio guides.
tagline_zh: 使用AI语音导览探索500多个城市。
description: Most audio tour apps cost $20+ per city, need Wi-Fi, and only speak English. Votura flips that. 🌍 500+ cities. 🗣️ 12 languages. 📶 Fully offline. 🤖 AI-powered narration turns every street into a story — no tour groups, no roaming bills, no paywalls. Download before you go and explore on your own terms, anywhere in the world. We're an indie team that built the audio guide we always wanted. Votura 2.0 is it.
description_zh: 大多数音频导览应用每个城市收费20美元以上，需要Wi-Fi，且仅提供英语服务。Votura颠覆了这一现状。🌍 覆盖500多个城市。🗣️ 支持12种语言。📶 完全离线。🤖 AI驱动的旁白将每条街道变成故事——无需旅行团，无需漫游费，无需付费墙。出发前下载，在世界任何地方按自己的节奏探索。我们是一个独立团队，打造了我们一直渴望的音频导览。Votura 2.0正是如此。

name: Crelyzor
tagline: Your card, schedule, meetings & tasks — all connected
tagline_zh: 您的名片、日程、会议与任务——全部互联
description: Stop stitching together Calendly, Otter.ai, HiHello, and Todoist. Crelyzor brings everything into one platform: * Digital business cards * AI meeting transcription * Smart scheduling * Task management And unlike disconnected tools, everything works together. Share your card → someone books a meeting → AI generates notes → follow-up tasks are created automatically. The entire workflow in one tab. Built for consultants, freelancers, and founders.
description_zh: 告别在 Calendly、Otter.ai、HiHello 和 Todoist 之间反复切换。Crelyzor 将所有功能整合至一个平台：* 数字名片 * AI 会议转录 * 智能日程安排 * 任务管理 与孤立工具不同，这里的一切协同工作。分享您的名片 → 他人预约会议 → AI 生成会议纪要 → 自动创建跟进任务。整个工作流尽在同一个标签页中。专为顾问、自由职业者和创始人打造。

name: Guidy
tagline: Real-time guidance for any software.
tagline_zh: 适用于任何软件的实时指导
description: Get the next step the moment you're stuck. Guidy is your AI desktop assistant, working in real time across any software.
description_zh: 陷入困境时即刻获取下一步操作指南。Guidy 是您的 AI 桌面助手，可在任何软件中实时工作。

name: Genlook Virtual try-on API
tagline: Add AI virtual try-on to any app in two API calls
tagline_zh: 仅需两次 API 调用，即可为任何应用添加 AI 虚拟试穿功能
description: Genlook is an AI virtual try-on engine behind a simple REST API and TypeScript SDK. Two HTTP calls 1. upload a photo, 2. run the try-on and your users see themselves wearing any product. It works with plain 2D product images. Drop it into any store, app, or custom flow, with an MCP server for AI agents too.
description_zh: Genlook 是一款位于简洁 REST API 和 TypeScript SDK 背后的 AI 虚拟试穿引擎。只需两次 HTTP 调用：1. 上传照片；2. 运行试穿，用户即可看到自己佩戴/穿着任意产品的效果。它支持纯 2D 产品图片。可嵌入任何商店、应用或自定义流程，并提供 MCP server 以支持 AI Agent。

name: 1GEN CATALYST
tagline: AI-Native Fundraising Operating System
tagline_zh: AI 原生筹款操作系统
description: 1GEN CATALYST is the AI-native Fundraising Operating System for nonprofits. Plan smarter campaigns, improve readiness before launch, activate board and community networks, build donor trust through impact storytelling, and create fundraising momentum from one platform. Unlike traditional fundraising tools focused on collecting donations, CATALYST helps mission-driven organizations run better campaigns that inspire action, engagement, and long-term support.
description_zh: 1GEN CATALYST 是为非营利组织打造的 AI 原生筹款操作系统。规划更智能的营销活动，在启动前提升准备度，激活董事会和社区网络，通过影响力故事建立捐赠者信任，并从单一平台创造筹款动力。与传统仅专注于收集捐款的筹款工具不同，CATALYST 帮助使命驱动型组织运行更优质的营销活动，激发行动、参与度和长期支持。

name: CreatorWand AI
tagline: The AI command center for digital product creators
tagline_zh: 数字产品创作者的 AI 指挥中心
description: CreatorWand is the ultimate command center to orchestrate your entire digital product lifecycle. From market validation to multi-platform publishing and revenue optimization.
description_zh: CreatorWand 是统筹您整个数字产品生命周期的终极指挥中心。从市场验证到多平台发布及收入优化。

name: Rectraa
tagline: Turn WhatsApp event leads into structured CRM-ready data
tagline_zh: 将 WhatsApp 活动线索转化为结构化的 CRM 就绪数据
description: Rectraa helps sales teams turn event leads scattered across WhatsApp chats, business cards, audio notes, and personal notes into structured, actionable lead data. Upload your WhatsApp export and Rectraa automatically extracts contacts, identifies companies, classifies lead intent, assigns priorities, generates summaries, and prepares everything for follow-up. What normally takes hours of manual work can be completed in minutes and exported directly to Excel.
description_zh: Rectraa 帮助销售团队将散落在 WhatsApp 聊天、名片、语音笔记和个人笔记中的活动线索，转化为结构化、可操作的线索数据。上传您的 WhatsApp 导出文件，Rectraa 会自动提取联系人、识别公司、分类线索意图、分配优先级、生成摘要，并为后续跟进做好准备。通常需要数小时的手工工作，现在只需几分钟即可完成，并直接导出为 Excel 格式。

name: Affiblast
tagline: Run your whole affiliate content stack from one place.
tagline_zh: 在一个地方管理您所有的联盟营销内容栈。
description: Stop juggling 7 tools. AffiBlast is an all-in-one Affiliate Content OS that lets you research topics, write high-converting multi-GEO articles, auto-publish to WP & Medium, build bonus pages, and force-index everything in under 5 minutes. Save 75% on tech stack costs and start scaling traffic for free.
description_zh: 停止同时使用 7 个工具。AffiBlast 是一款一体化的联盟营销内容操作系统，让您能够研究主题、撰写高转化率的多 GEO 文章、自动发布到 WP 和 Medium、构建奖金页面，并在 5 分钟内强制索引所有内容。节省 75% 的技术栈成本，并开始免费扩展流量。

name: Assistlyai
tagline: Turn WhatsApp Into Your Smart Productivity Assistant
tagline_zh: 将 WhatsApp 转变为您的智能生产力助手
description: Turn WhatsApp into your personal second brain with AssistlyAI. Save reminders, notes, documents, flight details, passwords, bookings, and important information in seconds. Need something later? Just ask and retrieve it instantly. No extra apps, no complicated setup—just a smart AI assistant that helps you remember, organize, and access everything directly from WhatsApp.
description_zh: 通过 AssistlyAI 将 WhatsApp 变成您的个人第二大脑。几秒钟内保存提醒、笔记、文档、航班详情、密码、预订和重要信息。需要查找某些内容？只需询问即可立即检索。无需额外应用，无需复杂设置——只需一个智能 AI 助手，帮助您直接从 WhatsApp 记住、组织和访问所有信息。

name: Capsule
tagline: The flight recorder for AI agents
tagline_zh: AI 代理的飞行记录仪
description: AI agents are powerful, but debugging them is often harder than fixing them. When an agent fails, engineers spend hours digging through logs, prompts, and tool outputs trying to understand what happened. Capsule is the flight recorder for AI agents—recording prompts, tool calls, memory, and execution state into a replayable artifact so teams can replay failures, identify root causes faster, and build more reliable AI systems.
description_zh: AI 代理功能强大，但调试它们往往比修复它们更难。当代理失败时，工程师们花费数小时挖掘日志、提示和工具输出，试图了解发生了什么。Capsule 是 AI 代理的飞行记录仪——记录提示、工具调用、记忆和执行状态，形成可重放的工件，使团队能够重放故障、更快地识别根本原因，并构建更可靠的 AI 系统。

name: Koov
tagline: The all in one intelligence layer for your team
tagline_zh: 您团队的一体化智能层
description: Koov builds voice agents for live meetings, on-screen overlay, customer care & CRM — one platform for conversation AI. Meeting agents support: Zoom, facetime, google meets and more
description_zh: Koov 为实时会议、屏幕叠加、客户支持和 CRM 构建语音代理——一个用于对话 AI 的平台。会议代理支持：Zoom、FaceTime、Google Meet 等

name: StyleMind Autonomous Shopping agent
tagline: Turn browsing into buying with agentic commerce
tagline_zh: 通过智能代理商务将浏览转化为购买
description: StyleMind 2.0 is not a chatbot or recommendation widget. It is an AI sales agent for fashion e-commerce. It understands shopper intent, builds complete outfits, enables virtual try-on, applies discounts at the right moment, adds items to cart, and guides users to checkout. Unlike traditional tools that only suggest or react, StyleMind takes action in real time to increase conversions and reduce cart abandonment.
description_zh: StyleMind 2.0 不是聊天机器人或推荐组件。它是专为时尚电商打造的 AI 销售代理。它能理解购物者意图，构建完整穿搭，支持虚拟试穿，在恰当时机应用折扣，将商品加入购物车，并引导用户完成结账。与传统仅建议或响应的工具不同，StyleMind 实时采取行动以提高转化率并减少购物车放弃率。

name: Truvem
tagline: Persistent memory for AI agents. Two API calls. Any model.
tagline_zh: AI 代理的持久记忆。两次 API 调用。支持任意模型。
description: Truvem is the memory infrastructure layer for AI agents. Two API calls. Any model. Persistent.
description_zh: Truvem 是 AI 代理的记忆基础设施层。两次 API 调用。支持任意模型。持久化。

name: Ai Invoice Maker
tagline: Professional invoices in seconds, not hours
tagline_zh: 秒级生成专业发票，而非耗时数小时
description: AI Invoice Maker helps freelancers, agencies, consultants, and IT businesses create professional PDF invoices in seconds. Simply describe what you need, and AI generates a complete invoice with clients, items, pricing, notes, and payment details. Choose from 15 beautiful invoice templates, manage multiple companies, back up to Google Drive, and work entirely offline. No account required. Your data stays on your device.
description_zh: AI Invoice Maker 帮助自由职业者、代理机构、顾问和 IT 企业快速创建专业的 PDF 发票。只需描述您的需求，AI 即可生成包含客户、项目、定价、备注和付款详情的完整发票。提供 15 款精美发票模板，支持管理多家公司、备份至 Google Drive 以及完全离线工作。无需注册账户，数据保留在您本地设备上。

name: SystemCraft
tagline: Interactive system design practice.
tagline_zh: 交互式系统设计练习
description: SystemCraft is an interactive system design practice platform. Most prep tools give you theory. SystemCraft gives you a canvas. Read deep-dive docs for 100+ real-world systems — then open the practice canvas and design it yourself with a drag-and-drop architecture builder. ✦ 100+ systems with deep documentation ✦ Interactive drag-and-drop canvas ✦ Structured learning roadmap ✦ Progress tracking ✦ AI-assisted generation Free to use. No fluff.
description_zh: SystemCraft 是一个交互式系统设计练习平台。大多数准备工具只提供理论，而 SystemCraft 为您提供画布。阅读 100 多个真实系统的深度文档，然后在练习画布上使用拖拽式架构设计器自行设计。✦ 100+ 个附带深度文档的系统 ✦ 交互式拖拽画布 ✦ 结构化学习路线图 ✦ 进度追踪 ✦ AI 辅助生成。免费使用，无冗余内容。

name: Resuque
tagline: AI Resume Builder That Gets Past ATS
tagline_zh: 能顺利通过 ATS 筛选的 AI 简历构建器
description: Build a tailored, ATS-friendly resume in minutes. Paste a job description, let AI draft your bullets, and export a polished PDF — free.
description_zh: 几分钟内打造量身定制且符合 ATS 要求的简历。粘贴职位描述，让 AI 起草要点，然后导出精美的 PDF 文件——免费。

name: Echoir
tagline: Draw a card. Hear an answer. Not a chatbot.
tagline_zh: 抽一张牌。听见答案。不是聊天机器人。
description: Echoir is an AI divination platform that gives you a reading, not a conversation. Ask one question, draw a card, get a streaming interpretation — then it ends. No chatbot loops, no AI companion, no dependency. Tarot is fully bilingual (EN/ZH). Bazi (Chinese astrology with true solar time correction), dream interpretation, and YUAN — an original 102-card deck with its own sci-fi mythology — are live in Chinese, translating step by step.
description_zh: Echoir 是一个 AI 占卜平台，为你提供解读而非对话。问一个问题，抽一张牌，获取流式解读——然后结束。没有聊天机器人循环，没有 AI 伴侣，没有依赖。塔罗牌完全支持双语（EN/ZH）。八字（采用真太阳时校正的中国占星术）、梦境解析以及 YUAN（一个拥有独立科幻神话的原创 102 张卡牌牌组）已上线中文版，并逐步完成翻译。

name: memory-keeper
tagline: 99.9% DeepSeek cache hit, 3-tier context proxy

description_zh: Lightweight Node.js 项目，介于前端与 DeepSeek AI 之间。实现 99.95% 缓存命中率的单行解决方案。

name: SharkCraw
tagline: Find and discover the best AI tools in one place
tagline_zh: 在一个地方发现和探索最佳 AI 工具
description: I built SharkCraw because I was tired of Googling "best AI tool for X" and getting outdated listicles. SharkCraw is a clean, fast AI tools directory with 500+ tools across 10 categories — Writing, Image, Video, Code, Audio, Marketing, Productivity, Search, Education, and Business. You can filter by category and pricing (Free, Free + Paid, Paid Only) to find exactly what you need in seconds. Would love your feedback on what's missing or what could be better! 🔗 sharkcraw.com
description_zh: 我创建 SharkCraw 是因为厌倦了搜索“X 的最佳 AI 工具”并得到过时的列表文章。SharkCraw 是一个简洁、快速的 AI 工具目录，涵盖 10 个类别中的 500 多个工具——写作、图像、视频、代码、音频、营销、生产力、搜索、教育和商业。你可以根据类别和定价（免费、免费+付费、仅付费）进行筛选，在几秒钟内找到所需内容。非常希望听到你的反馈，告诉我缺少什么或可以改进的地方！🔗 sharkcraw.com

name: Offrrd
tagline: Your AI job-search coach
tagline_zh: 你的 AI 求职教练
description: Offrrd is your AI-powered job search assistant. It doesn't just help you apply, it coaches you. Find matching jobs, tailor your resume and cover letters with AI, prep for interviews, and get a personal AI career coach that tells you exactly what to fix next.
description_zh: Offrrd 是你的 AI 驱动求职助手。它不仅帮助你申请，还为你进行辅导。寻找匹配的工作，利用 AI 定制简历和求职信，准备面试，并获得一位个人 AI 职业教练，明确告诉你下一步需要改进什么。

name: Soilytix
tagline: AI soil intelligence for those who grow, study and restore
tagline_zh: 为种植者、研究者和修复者提供的 AI 土壤智能
description: Advanced soil microbiome analysis, built for those who grow, study, anAdvanced soil microbiome analysis for those who grow, study, and restore. We sequence the DNA in your soil and turn it into clear, decision-ready intelligence: biodiversity, soil health, and yield signals. One method, multiple outcomes. Grounded in science, built for the field and the lab.
description_zh: 先进的土壤微生物组分析，专为种植者、研究者和修复者打造。我们对土壤中的 DNA 进行测序，并将其转化为清晰、可直接用于决策的智能信息：生物多样性、土壤健康和产量信号。一种方法，多种结果。扎根于科学，专为田间和实验室设计。

name: Dawdlo
tagline: Earn when your AI agent's work pays off
tagline_zh: 当您的 AI 智能体的工作产生回报时赚取收益
description: Dawdlo is the outcome exchange for AI agent work. While your coding agent runs, one monospace line — matched on your machine — shows a relevant sponsor. You earn when the work pays off. No tracking, no generic ads, zero added latency. `npx dawdlo`
description_zh: Dawdlo 是 AI 智能体工作的成果交换平台。当您的编码智能体运行时，一行等宽字体代码——在您的机器上匹配显示——会展示一个相关赞助商。当工作产生回报时您即可获利。无追踪、无通用广告、零额外延迟。`npx dawdlo`

name: WealthWise
tagline: ✅ The bilingual portfolio tracker built for Canadians
tagline_zh: ✅ 专为加拿大人打造的双语投资组合追踪器
description: Most portfolio trackers are built for Americans — wrong account types, USD-first, English-only. WealthWise is different: 100% Canadian and fully bilingual (EN/FR). What stands out: • Native RRSP, TFSA, FHSA & RESP tracking with real contribution room • 23 free Canadian calculators (contribution room, capital gains, FIRE, historical S&P 500/TSX/Nasdaq returns) • Projected dividends, FIRE planning & AI portfolio analysis • 14-day Premium trial, no credit card
description_zh: 大多数投资组合追踪器都是为美国人设计的——账户类型不符、以美元为主、仅支持英语。WealthWise 与众不同：100% 加拿大本地化并完全支持双语（英/法）。亮点包括：• 原生支持 RRSP、TFSA、FHSA 和 RESP 追踪，实时显示缴费额度 • 23 款免费加拿大计算器（缴费额度、资本利得、FIRE、历史 S&P 500/TSX/Nasdaq 回报率） • 股息预测、FIRE 规划及 AI 投资组合分析 • 14 天 Premium 试用，无需信用卡

name: Whispeak
tagline: Private meeting transcripts and follow-ups for desktop calls
tagline_zh: 桌面通话的私密会议记录和后续跟进
description: Whispeak is a desktop companion built around user ownership of conversation data, not a cloud-first recording app. Audio stays with the user, and we plan to add end-to-end encryption to strengthen that model further. Beyond transcription, we see Whispeak becoming a private conversation memory layer for AI-native workflows, including a user's own digital twin and local AI agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw working directly with data on the user's computer.
description_zh: Whispeak 是一款围绕用户对对话数据的所有权构建的桌面伴侣应用，而非优先采用云端的录音应用。音频数据保留在用户端，我们计划增加端到端加密以进一步强化这一模式。除了转录功能外，我们将 Whispeak 定位为面向 AI 原生工作流的私密对话记忆层，包括用户的个人数字分身以及直接在用户计算机上处理数据的本地 AI 智能体，如 Claude Code、Codex 和 OpenClaw。

name: Dunningly - on your service
tagline: Automate invoice reminders with AI – get paid faster
tagline_zh: 利用 AI 自动化发票提醒——更快收款
description: Freelancers lose revenue not because clients refuse to pay – but because nobody follows up consistently. Dunningly automates that. Tracks unpaid invoices and sends AI-written reminders that adjust in tone: polite before due date, firmer after. What makes it different: • AI generates each reminder with context – not templates • Scan invoice PDFs to extract data automatically • Bulk import via CSV or Google Sheets • Free up to 5 invoices, $10/mo unlimited
description_zh: 自由职业者收入流失并非因为客户拒绝付款，而是因为缺乏持续有效的跟进。Dunningly 实现了这一自动化。它追踪未付发票，并发送由 AI 撰写的提醒邮件，语气会根据情况调整：到期日前礼貌温和，逾期后则更加坚定。差异化优势：• AI 结合上下文生成每封提醒邮件，而非使用模板 • 扫描发票 PDF 自动提取数据 • 支持通过 CSV 或 Google Sheets 批量导入 • 免费处理最多 5 张发票，无限套餐每月 10 美元

name: GenSpend
tagline: Track your AI spend
tagline_zh: 追踪您的 AI 支出
description: GenSpend automatically tracks your AI-generation spending across tools like Runway, Kling, Midjourney and ElevenLabs, converting every credit system into real dollars. See the true cost of every finished deliverable, not just per generation. Built for creators and studios who need to know what their AI work actually costs.
description_zh: GenSpend 自动追踪您在 Runway、Kling、Midjourney 和 ElevenLabs 等工具上的 AI 生成支出，将各种积分系统转换为实际美元金额。查看每个最终交付物的真实成本，而不仅仅是单次生成的费用。专为需要了解其 AI 工作实际成本的创作者和工作室打造。

name: ZYPHERON
tagline: The Cybersecurity IDE
tagline_zh: 网络安全 IDE
description: AI-native offensive security IDE for red teams. Automate reconnaissance and payload crafting. You approve every attack. All evidence stays local. Built for pentesters who need proof, not theatre.
description_zh: 面向红队的 AI 原生进攻性安全 IDE。自动化侦察与载荷制作。每次攻击均需您批准。所有证据保留在本地。专为需要确凿证据而非作秀的渗透测试人员打造。

name: SnapSend
tagline: Send secrets & files that self-destruct — request one back
tagline_zh: 发送自毁的秘密与文件——并可请求回传
description: Zero-knowledge, one-time secret sharing. Encrypt passwords, API keys, and files in your browser, get a self-destructing link — no account, never AI-trained. And it works in reverse: generate a link so anyone can send you an encrypted secret (or set up an anonymous Ask Board).
description_zh: 零知识一次性秘密共享。在浏览器中加密密码、API 密钥和文件，获取自毁链接——无需账户，永不用于 AI 训练。支持反向操作：生成链接让任何人向您发送加密秘密（或设置匿名问答板）。

name: Vexula
tagline: The all-in-one business platform for freelancers & agencies
tagline_zh: 自由职业者与代理机构的一站式商业平台
description: Vexula is the complete business management platform for freelancers, small businesses, and agencies worldwide. Invoicing, clients, leads, expenses, proposals, time tracking, and AI - free forever.
description_zh: Vexula 是全球自由职业者、小型企业和代理机构的完整业务管理平台。发票、客户、潜在客户、支出、提案、时间追踪及 AI 功能——永久免费。

name: ListFast
tagline: One listing. Nine marketplaces. 30 seconds.
tagline_zh: 一次发布，覆盖九大市场。仅需 30 秒。
description: Turn one description or photo into optimized listings for Amazon, eBay, Etsy, Shopify, TikTok Shop & more — all at once. Free forever. Pro is $49/mo vs. $129-229/mo for single-channel tools.
description_zh: 将一段描述或一张照片转化为亚马逊、eBay、Etsy、Shopify、TikTok Shop 等平台的优化商品列表——一键完成。永久免费。Pro 版每月 49 美元，而单渠道工具需 129-229 美元/月。

name: Piri Piri AI
tagline: Realtime support during meetings
tagline_zh: 会议期间的实时支持
description: PiriPiri AI listens to your meetings in real time — both sides of the call — and quietly drafts the answer before you finish hearing the question. A desktop overlay for macOS & Windows that stays invisible on screen share.
description_zh: PiriPiri AI 实时监听您的会议——包括通话双方——并在您听完问题前悄然起草回复。一款 macOS 和 Windows 桌面覆盖层，在屏幕共享时保持不可见。

name: Knowable

name: Juta
tagline: Daily check-ins for aging parents. Peace of mind for family.
tagline_zh: 每日问候年迈父母，让家人安心无忧
description: 3 warm daily texts to your aging loved one. A quiet recap to the whole family, every evening. No relay calls. Nobody has to wonder. No app. No hardware. Any phone. Juta reaches out to them first with a real conversation around what they actually love. The sibling who never calls suddenly knows dad had a good day. The adult child who has been carrying all the worry does not have to anymore. $19/month. 3-day free trial. No payment info at signup. getjuta.com.
description_zh: 每天向您的亲人发送3条温馨短信。每晚向全家提供一份安静回顾。无需转接电话。无需猜测。无需应用。无需硬件。任何手机均可使用。Juta会主动与他们进行真实对话，聊聊他们真正喜欢的事物。从不打电话的兄弟姐妹突然知道父亲度过了愉快的一天。一直承担所有担忧的成年子女从此可以卸下重担。每月19美元。3天免费试用。注册时无需提供支付信息。getjuta.com。

name: Dewan AI
tagline: Break Down Malaysia Parliament Hansard into Simple Language
tagline_zh: 将马来西亚议会会议记录简化为通俗语言
description: Most Malaysians care about Parliament but can't understand the Hansard — it's dense and full of jargon. Dewan AI analyzes Malaysia's Parliament Hansard into plain language, then pushes relevant policies to you based on your demographics. Unlike news apps, it's personalized. A student sees education policies. A B40 parent sees welfare updates. Everyone gets what matters to them — explained clearly.
description_zh: 大多数马来西亚人关心议会，但无法理解冗长且充满术语的议会会议记录——Dewan AI将马来西亚议会会议记录分析为通俗语言，然后根据人口统计数据向您推送相关政策。与新闻应用不同，它是个性化的。学生看到教育政策，B40家长看到福利更新。每个人都能获得对他们重要的内容——清晰解释。

name: HuzAgent.ai
tagline: AI Lead Qualification & Booking Assistant for Businesses
tagline_zh: 面向企业的AI潜在客户筛选与预订助手
description: HuzAgent helps businesses automatically qualify leads, answer customer inquiries, and book appointments using AI. Instead of manually reviewing every form submission, email, or customer request, HuzAgent analyzes incoming leads, scores them, identifies intent and urgency, generates summaries, and recommends the next action. Businesses can connect website forms, APIs, webhooks, and other lead sources to create automated workflows that save time and improve response speed.
description_zh: HuzAgent帮助企业利用AI自动筛选潜在客户、回答客户咨询并预约会议。无需手动审查每个表单提交、电子邮件或客户请求，HuzAgent会分析传入的潜在客户，对其进行评分，识别意图和紧急程度，生成摘要，并推荐下一步行动。企业可以连接网站表单、API、Webhook和其他潜在客户来源，创建自动化工作流程，节省时间并提高响应速度。

No account required, no extension to install. Great for feeding YouTube content into AI tools, researching topics from educational channels, or archiving your own video scripts. Need more? Unlock up to 50 videos for a one-time $9.95.
description_zh: 粘贴任何YouTube播放列表、频道或视频链接——获取合并后的纯文本字幕并发送至您的收件箱。每次请求最多可免费处理20个视频。无需账户，无需安装扩展。非常适合将YouTube内容输入AI工具、从教育频道研究主题或归档您自己的视频脚本。需要更多？一次性支付9.95美元即可解锁最多50个视频。

Weekly AI reviews tell you what worked and what to post next. Reply suggestions and autopilot keep engagement moving without losing brand context.
description_zh: Cortex is a chat-first AI marketing workspace—not another scheduling dashboard. description_zh: The non-custodial marketplace for AI agents. List your MCP service for free; agents discover and pay per call via x402 on Base. You keep 99%, paid directly to your wallet. We never hold funds.

name: Equipment Tracker Pro

tagline_zh: 面向 HVAC 和设施团队的离线 AI 资产追踪。
description: Offline-first asset management and compliance platform for HVAC and facility teams. Runs on a local SQLite cache that syncs with Firebase so it never fails in concrete basements. Powered by the Gemini AI Scanning Suite for automated nameplate data extraction, condition assessments, and interactive field troubleshooting. Tracks tool inventories, automates EPA Section 608 leak rate math, and generates 13 custom PDF report types.
description_zh: 面向 HVAC 和设施团队的离线优先资产管理与合规平台。基于本地 SQLite 缓存运行并与 Firebase 同步，确保在混凝土地下室等无网环境中永不失效。由 Gemini AI 扫描套件驱动，实现铭牌数据自动提取、状态评估及交互式现场故障排查。支持工具库存追踪、EPA Section 608 泄漏率计算自动化，并生成 13 种自定义 PDF 报告。

description: Run a free AI visibility check on your website in 60 seconds. Nine live signals. Instant score out of 100. No email, no account needed. See exactly what AI engines can and can't find.
description_zh: 在 60 秒内为您的网站运行免费的 AI 可见性检查。九大实时信号。即时生成百分制评分。无需邮箱，无需注册账户。确切了解 AI 引擎能发现什么以及不能发现什么。

tagline: An AI-powered equity analysts for busy value investors
tagline_zh: 面向忙碌的价值投资者的AI驱动股票分析师
description: ValuationBot is stock valuation software that analyses shares for you. It reads the reports, builds the DCF model and presents the investment case, so you can invest with clarity without weeks of manual research. It also gives you the downloadable and editable DCF model. It's been used by 700 investors to analyse 3,800 stocks so far.
description_zh: ValuationBot是一款股票估值软件，为您分析股票。它阅读报告，构建DCF模型并展示投资论点，让您无需数周的手工研究即可清晰地进行投资决策。它还为您提供可下载和编辑的DCF模型。目前已有700名投资者使用它分析了3,800只股票。

name: Kavilo Creative AI
tagline: AI images and videos for ecommerce campaigns
tagline_zh: 为电商活动生成AI图像和视频
description: Kavilo Creative AI is a focused AI creative workspace for ecommerce teams. Start with a rough product idea or reference assets, let Image Prompt Agent clarify the prompt and production settings, then generate campaign-ready product stills and short videos in Quick Create studios with upfront credit estimates and automatic refunds for failed jobs.
description_zh: Kavilo Creative AI是专为电商团队打造的专注型AI创意工作区。从粗略的产品概念或参考素材起步，让Image Prompt Agent明确提示词与生产设置，随后在Quick Create工作室中生成可直接用于营销的产品静帧和短视频，支持预先估算积分并在任务失败时自动退款。

name: Modaic
tagline: Your expert judgment and taste, running at scale.
tagline_zh: 以规模化运行您的专业判断与品味。
description: The fastest way to turn your taste and expertise into automation. Arbiters are language models that make a decision, explain why, and return a (reliable) score for how sure they are -- measured from inside the model. Confident decisions are accepted, unsure decisions go to a human, then their fixes update the instructions automatically. Over time, arbiters align to your judgment and decision rules. Use them to score, classify, route, extract, and moderate -- the way your team would by hand.
description_zh: 将您的品味与专业知识转化为自动化流程的最快方式。仲裁者（Arbiters）是能够做出决策、解释原因并返回内部置信度评分的语言模型。高置信度的决策会被直接采纳，不确定的决策则转交人工处理，人工修正后会自动更新指令。随着时间推移，仲裁者将逐渐与您的判断标准和决策规则保持一致。可用于评分、分类、路由、提取和审核——就像您团队手动操作一样。

name: The One-Person Business AI System
tagline: The complete Claude.ai workflow for one-person businesses
tagline_zh: 面向个人经营者的完整Claude.ai工作流
description: Most solopreneurs use Claude but start from scratch every day. No system. No repeatable process. name: Uttar
tagline: 24/7 Front Desk for repetitive website enquiries
tagline_zh: 全天候前台，处理重复的网站咨询
description: Small businesses spend hours answering the same questions about pricing, services, availability, bookings, and policies over and over again. Uttar gives your website a 24/7 Front Desk that handles these repetitive enquiries instantly using only information your business has reviewed and approved. Unlike AI chatbots that try to answer everything, Uttar never guesses or improvises. Unanswered questions are logged so your coverage improves over time.
description_zh: 小企业花费大量时间一遍又一遍地回答关于价格、服务、可用性、预订和政策等相同的问题。Uttar 为你的网站提供了一个 24/7 前台，仅使用你的业务已审核和批准的信息即时处理这些重复咨询。与试图回答所有问题的 AI 聊天机器人不同，Uttar 从不猜测或即兴发挥。未回答的问题会被记录下来，以便随着时间的推移提高覆盖范围。

name: Valmis
tagline: Open-source alternative to Claude Cowork / OpenClaw for work
tagline_zh: Claude Cowork / OpenClaw 工作的开源替代方案
description: Valmis is an OpenClaw alternative that is designed for work. You can think of it as an open-source alternative to Claude Cowork. You can connect to more than 100 business and productivity apps with your AI agent. The system is designed with security in mind, meaning the agent never gets access to your API credentials. All requests are made via proxy. Agents are dockerized so they can't access your host files. Valmis is designed to run on the cloud and collaborate with humans to get work done.
description_zh: Valmis 是一款专为工作设计的 OpenClaw 替代方案，可视为 Claude Cowork 的开源替代品。你的 AI 智能体可连接 100 多种商业和生产率应用。系统设计注重安全性，智能体无法访问你的 API 凭证，所有请求均通过代理进行。智能体采用 Docker 容器化部署，无法访问宿主机文件。Valmis 设计用于云端运行，并与人类协作完成任务。

name: Loop Engineering
tagline: Design safe, token-aware AI agent loops — free, no sign-up
tagline_zh: 设计安全、令牌感知的 AI 智能体循环——免费，无需注册
description: Loop Engineering is a free, no-signup toolkit for designing the system around an AI agent — not just the prompt. Describe a task and it generates copyable /goal prompts for Claude Code & Codex, a runnable continuous-claude command, and a safe GitHub Actions skeleton. It also has a token-cost calculator, a loop readiness score, AGENTS.md/SKILL.md generators, templates, and a failure-case library. Everything runs in your browser — nothing uploaded or executed.
description_zh: Loop Engineering 是一款免费的免注册工具包，用于设计 AI 智能体背后的系统架构——而不仅仅是提示词。描述一项任务，它即可生成适用于 Claude Code 和 Codex 的可复制 /goal 提示词、可运行的 continuous-claude 命令以及安全的 GitHub Actions 骨架代码。它还提供令牌成本计算器、循环就绪评分、AGENTS.md/SKILL.md 生成器、模板和失败案例库。所有功能均在浏览器中运行，不上传或执行任何内容。

name: Kotopig Visa Photo
tagline: AI passport photos that pass Japan's strict rules, on-device
tagline_zh: 符合日本严格规定的AI护照照片，设备端处理
description: Getting a compliant passport/visa photo in Japan is oddly hard: exact size, precise head height, plain background. One wrong margin = a rejected application. Kotopig Visa Photo turns any selfie into a spec-compliant photo in under a minute — AI background removal + auto face alignment, matched to Japan's visa, zairyu card, driver's license & resume specs. 100% on-device: your photo never leaves the browser until you pay for the print-ready file. 中文/日本語/English, pay-once from ¥300.
description_zh: 在日本获取合规的护照/签证照片出奇地困难：尺寸必须精确，头部高度必须准确，背景必须纯色。一个边距错误就会导致申请被拒。Kotopig Visa Photo能在不到一分钟的时间内将任何自拍转换为符合规格的照片——AI背景移除+自动面部对齐，符合日本签证、在留卡、驾照及简历的要求。100%设备端处理：在付费获取可打印文件之前，你的照片永远不会离开浏览器。支持中文/日本語/English，从¥300起一次性付费。

name: TraceTree
tagline: Open-Source Runtime Malware Analysis and Tracing
tagline_zh: 开源运行时恶意软件分析与追踪
description: TraceTree is an open-source runtime malware analysis tool built for deep behavioral tracing. Instead of just logging execution, it monitors live processes using severity-weighted syscall scoring and precise behavioral signatures to catch malicious activity as it happens. Designed to counter advanced threats like AI-driven runtime injections, it gives security researchers a clear, structured view of how binaries behave under the hood.
description_zh: TraceTree是一款专为深度行为追踪而构建的开源运行时恶意软件分析工具。它不仅仅记录执行日志，而是通过基于严重性加权的系统调用评分和精确的行为特征签名来监控实时进程，从而在恶意活动发生时即时捕获。旨在对抗AI驱动的运行时注入等高级威胁，它为安全研究人员提供了二进制文件底层行为的清晰、结构化视图。

description: Prithv-E is an AI-powered smart bin that automatically sorts waste into four categories — Organic, Recyclable, Metal, and General — using a Pi Camera and a MobileNetV2-based vision model running on-device on a Raspberry Pi 4. No cloud, no manual sorting, just drop your trash and let the bin figure out where it goes. Built as an MSME grant-funded project incubated at IIMT University, Prithv-E aims to make waste segregation effortless at the source, cutting down contamination in recycling streams.
description_zh: Prithv-E 是一款由 AI 驱动的智能垃圾桶，它利用 Pi Camera 和在 Raspberry Pi 4 上本地运行的基于 MobileNetV2 的视觉模型，自动将垃圾分为四类——有机垃圾、可回收物、金属和一般垃圾。无需云端处理，无需人工分拣，只需丢弃垃圾，让垃圾桶自行判断其去向。Prithv-E 是由 IIMT 大学孵化、MSME 资助的项目，旨在从源头实现轻松的垃圾分类，减少回收流中的污染。

name: MergeProtect
tagline: AI review and tests for every pull request.
tagline_zh: 每个 Pull Request 的 AI 审查和测试。
description: Most PR tools review the diff in isolation. MergeProtect builds a call graph of your whole codebase and works from impact. - Reviews each PR against the functions, routes, and DB models it actually affects downstream. - Generates tests (property, boundary, contract, mutation) scoped to the impacted code, with LLM self-healing. - Runs k6 smoke tests on impacted API routes to catch latency regression. - Sandboxed execution, PR-gating GitHub Action, optional prod traffic capture.
description_zh: 大多数 PR 工具孤立地审查差异。MergeProtect 构建整个代码库的调用图，并从影响范围出发工作。- 针对实际影响下游的功能、路由和数据库模型审查每个 PR。- 生成针对受影响代码的属性测试、边界测试、契约测试和变异测试，并具备 LLM 自我修复能力。- 在受影响的 API 路由上运行 k6 冒烟测试，以捕获延迟回归。- 沙箱执行，PR 门禁 GitHub Action，可选的生产流量捕获。

description_zh: 我曾因打折而购买 Steam 游戏，随后却发现价格更低或持平。受够了因错失恐惧症（FOMO）而冲动消费。steamAF 将当前区域 Steam 价格与约两年的历史数据进行对比，并标记为“值得入手”、“不急”或“等待”。仅显示“打折”并不足够。使用 Steam 登录以同步愿望单和列表，可选 AI 处理大型列表，并提供下次促销日历。支持作为渐进式 Web 应用（PWA）运行。

name: Sindook Steward
tagline: Threat-aware key rotation for encrypted files
tagline_zh: 针对加密文件的威胁感知密钥轮换
description: An open-source local workbench for turning recipient changes into reviewable fast or deep key-rotation plans. GPT-5.6 Sol interprets ambiguous threat signals, while deterministic policy controls recipients, approval, and execution. Keys, plaintext, ciphertext, and commands stay outside the model. Run the bundled post-quantum sample vault with Docker, approve with ROTATE, and inspect evidence of what changed and what old copies still retain.
description_zh: 一个开源的本地工作台，用于将接收者变更转换为可审查的快速或深度密钥轮换计划。GPT-5.6 Sol解释模糊的威胁信号，而确定性策略控制接收者、批准和执行。密钥、明文、密文和命令保持在模型之外。使用Docker运行捆绑的后量子示例库，使用ROTATE批准，并检查哪些内容发生了变化以及旧副本仍保留哪些内容。

name: Pipe
tagline: Self-hosted unified inbox + AI that reads it for you
tagline_zh: 自托管统一收件箱 + AI 智能阅读助手
description: Your private second brain. Pipe merges WhatsApp, email, Telegram, Teams and more into one thread per person, then an AI reads it all — summarizing long threads and voice notes, telling you who's waiting on a reply, and drafting replies in your voice. Self-hosted and MIT-licensed: your messages, media and a daily encrypted backup live on your own server, never a company's. Local AI by default — nothing private leaves your box.
description_zh: 您的私人第二大脑。Pipe 将 WhatsApp、电子邮件、Telegram、Teams 等合并为每个人的单一对话线程，随后由 AI 进行阅读——总结长对话和语音笔记，告知您谁在等待回复，并模仿您的语气起草回复。自托管且采用 MIT 许可证：您的消息、媒体和每日加密备份均存储在您自己的服务器上，而非公司服务器。默认使用本地 AI，没有任何隐私数据离开您的设备。

name: Motiscope
tagline: Screen record any animation, get the code
tagline_zh: 屏幕录制任何动画，获取代码
description: You can't describe an animation to an AI in words. "Make it bouncier" is not a spec. Motiscope solves this a different way: you give it a screen recording, it measures the actual motion (the beat, the easing, the transforms) with ffmpeg, and hands your coding agent a spec it can rebuild from. Output targets are GSAP, CSS, Framer Motion, and Lottie. Free, open source, runs locally.
description_zh: 你无法用文字向 AI 描述动画。"让它更有弹性"不是规范。Motiscope 以不同方式解决这个问题：你给它一个屏幕录像，它使用 ffmpeg 测量实际运动（节奏、缓动、变换），并向你的编码代理提供可重建的规范。输出目标是 GSAP、CSS、Framer Motion 和 Lottie。免费、开源、本地运行。

name: Schmess
tagline: Real-time chess: no turns, per-piece cooldowns, half board
tagline_zh: 实时国际象棋：无回合制，每步冷却，半盘对战
description: Schmess is chess with the turns deleted. The idea comes from cooldown chess — but I made the engine much better. How it works: you make TWO moves at a time. Move a piece and it freezes for 8 seconds. Your third move sits in a queue until a cooldown expires. And you capture the king like any other piece — no checkmate, just take it. If you're good at chess this might come easy. If you're just okay, there's a learning curve — and then it gets really fun, and really fast.
description_zh: Schmess 是一种没有回合制的国际象棋。这个想法来自冷却国际象棋——但我改进了引擎。工作原理：一次走两步。移动一个棋子后，它会冻结 8 秒。第三步会在队列中等待，直到冷却时间结束。你可以像吃其他棋子一样吃掉国王——没有将死，直接吃掉。如果你擅长国际象棋，这可能很容易上手。如果你只是普通水平，会有一个学习曲线——然后它会变得非常有趣，也非常快。

name: CoffeeByMe
tagline: Search coffee by how it tastes, not just where it's from
tagline_zh: 按口味搜索咖啡，而不仅仅是产地
description: Getting into specialty coffee is overwhelming. Endless origins, processes, and roast levels, and filters that only help if you're already an expert.CoffeeByMe fixes that. Describe the taste you want and semantic search matches you across 660 coffees from 47 US roasters. Free, no subscription. You also get roaster profiles, capsule picks, a recipe community, and brewing guides I write by hand, so you can find a coffee, understand it, and learn to brew it.
description_zh: 入门精品咖啡令人不知所措。无尽的产地、工艺和烘焙程度，以及只有专家才能理解的筛选器。CoffeeByMe解决了这个问题。描述你想要的口味，语义搜索将在47家美国烘焙商的660款咖啡中为你匹配。免费，无订阅。你还将获得烘焙商档案、胶囊精选、食谱社区以及我亲手撰写的冲泡指南，帮助你找到咖啡、了解它并学会冲泡。

name: Whatsit
tagline: Snip your screen and ask Claude about it
tagline_zh: 截取屏幕并向Claude提问
description: Whatsit is a tiny Windows tray app for Claude CLI users. Press Ctrl+Shift+C, drag a box around anything on screen, and ask Claude about it — the answer pops up in a compact popup right at your cursor, rendered as markdown. It shells out to the Claude CLI you already have logged in, so there are no API keys or extra setup. Built with Tauri + Rust (~9 MB, no Electron), with an in-tray auto-updater. Free & open source (MIT).
description_zh: Whatsit是一款小巧的Windows系统托盘应用，专为Claude CLI用户设计。按下Ctrl+Shift+C，在屏幕上拖拽框选任意内容，然后向Claude提问——答案会以Markdown格式出现在光标附近的紧凑弹出窗口中。它调用你已登录的Claude CLI，因此无需API密钥或额外设置。基于Tauri + Rust构建（约9 MB，无Electron），带有系统托盘自动更新器。免费且开源（MIT）。

description: Every AI tool I used forgot everything the second a session ended. name: Flowcat
tagline: Self-hosted Rust runtime for real-time voice AI agents
tagline_zh: 用于实时语音AI代理的自托管Rust运行时
description: Flowcat is an Apache-2.0 native-Rust runtime for real-time voice AI agents (phone + WebRTC). It runs a full voice pipeline — STT · LLM · TTS, or a single speech-to-speech model — as one self-contained binary you host in your own VPC or fully air-gapped. No hosted control plane, no per-minute billing; bring your own provider keys and a call's audio never leaves your infra. pipecat-compatible pipeline, native SIP/RTP, and dense enough to hold thousands of concurrent calls per box.
description_zh: Flowcat是一个基于Apache-2.0许可的原生Rust运行时，专为实时语音AI代理（电话 + WebRTC）设计。它将完整的语音管道——STT · LLM · TTS，或单个语音到语音模型——打包为一个自包含的二进制文件，您可以在自己的VPC或完全隔离的环境中托管。无需托管控制平面，无需按分钟计费；自带提供商密钥，通话音频绝不会离开您的基础设施。兼容pipecat管道，原生支持SIP/RTP，性能足够强大，每台服务器可容纳数千个并发呼叫。

name: agent-coherence
tagline: Stop AI agents from silently corrupting shared state
tagline_zh: 防止AI代理静默破坏共享状态
description: Two AI agents (two sessions, or an agent and a script) read the same file and both write it back. The later write silently clobbers the first: no error, the work is just gone. agent-coherence is a drop-in guard that catches the stale read before the overwrite lands, so the stale writer is denied and re-reads first. It ships as an MCP server, a LangGraph store drop-in, and a Python library. Single-host today (2+ agents on one machine); cross-host is opt-in, demo-grade. Open source, TLA+-checked.
description_zh: 两个AI代理（两个会话，或一个代理和一个脚本）读取同一文件并都将其写回。后来的写入会静默覆盖先前的写入：没有错误，但工作成果就这样消失了。agent-coherence是一个即插即用的保护机制，在覆盖发生前捕获过时的读取，从而拒绝过时写入者并要求其重新读取。它以MCP服务器、LangGraph存储即插即用组件和Python库的形式提供。目前支持单主机（一台机器上的2+个代理）；跨主机为可选功能，仅用于演示。开源，经TLA+验证。

tagline: Product discovery MCP for AI agents, across the open web

name: TwoHeads
tagline: Turn any decision into a number
tagline_zh: 将任何决策量化为数字
description: Describe a decision in plain language: a job offer, a startup bet, a big purchase, a negotiation. TwoHeads maps out your real options as a decision tree, estimates the probability of each outcome with a cited real-world analogue, and calculates the expected value of each path. Then you argue with it: every probability has a slider, so you can override the AI's assumptions with your own and watch the expected value recalculate live.
description_zh: 用通俗语言描述一项决策：一份工作录用通知、一次创业赌注、一笔大额购买或一场谈判。TwoHeads 将你的真实选项映射为决策树，引用现实世界中的类似案例估算每种结果的概率，并计算每条路径的预期价值。然后你可以与之“辩论”：每个概率都配有滑块，你可以用自己的判断覆盖 AI 的假设，并实时观察预期价值的重新计算。

name: Kelvane
tagline: Run untrusted AI models safely in a WebAssembly sandbox
tagline_zh: 在 WebAssembly 沙箱中安全运行不受信任的 AI 模型
description: Most WebAssembly runtimes are general-purpose. Kelvane is built for one job: running a neural policy you don't fully trust. Every call runs in a fresh sandbox with a hard memory cap, a per-invocation CPU budget, and zero ambient authority (no files, network, or I/O). The model stays host-owned — the module asks for an inference but never touches the weights. You can hot-swap modules live. Honest scope: it's a small, tested integration of proven parts (Wasmtime, ONNX), not a new technique.
description_zh: 大多数 WebAssembly 运行时是通用型的。Kelvane 专为单一任务而构建：运行您不完全信任的神经策略。每次调用都在一个全新的沙箱中运行，具有严格的内存限制、每次调用的 CPU 预算和零环境权限（无文件、网络或 I/O）。模型保持主机所有权——模块请求推理但从不接触权重。您可以实时热交换模块。诚实的范围：这是经过验证的组件（Wasmtime、ONNX）的小型、经过测试的集成，而不是新技术。

name: VernLLM
tagline: The production reliability layer for LLM applications
tagline_zh: LLM 应用的生产可靠性层
description: What happens when your LLM call hits a rate limit, times out, or returns malformed JSON? With VernLLM, it just works. One typed call() wraps retries, timeouts, cancellation, and a self-healing circuit breaker, skipping retries on errors that won't fix themselves, like bad JSON or bad key. Get typed, Zod validated output via native JSON Schema mode. Cache calls, track cost per request, plug in your own logger. One interface across OpenAI, Groq, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, and more. MIT licensed.
description_zh: 当您的 LLM 调用达到速率限制、超时或返回格式错误的 JSON 时会发生什么？使用 VernLLM，一切都能正常工作。一个类型化的 call() 封装了重试、超时、取消和自愈熔断器，跳过那些无法自行修复的错误的重试，例如错误的 JSON 或错误的密钥。通过原生 JSON Schema 模式获取类型化、Zod 验证的输出。缓存调用，跟踪每个请求的成本，插入您自己的日志记录器。一个接口适用于 OpenAI、Groq、Anthropic、Gemini、Bedrock 等更多服务。MIT 许可。

name: Crevia
tagline: AI agent that scrolls TikTok all day, tells you what to post
tagline_zh: 一个整天刷 TikTok 的 AI 代理，告诉你发什么。
description: Businesses and marketing agencies waste hours scrolling TikTok just to find one good idea to film. AI tools like ChatGPT can suggest you ideas but they're made up. No proof they ever worked, and you have no clue on how to actually film them. Crevia fixes that. Every idea comes with a real TikTok that already worked, so you know it's worked and how to film it. description_zh: 企业和营销机构耗费数小时刷 TikTok，只为找到一个好的拍摄创意。像 ChatGPT 这样的 AI 工具虽然能提供创意，但往往是凭空捏造的，没有证据证明其有效，而且你也不知道如何实际拍摄。Crevia 解决了这一痛点。每个创意都附带一个已经成功的真实 TikTok 视频，让你确信其有效性并了解拍摄方法。此外，你还能获得一个展示你所在领域最佳视频的动态流，从中获取灵感，制作出对现有成功内容的复刻版。
