- **[Predictive AI](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/predictive-ai)** – AI-powered tools that analyze data to forecast outcomes, detect patterns, and support decision-making.

name: StelaxAI
tagline: Stop wasting time on routine.
tagline_zh: 停止在例行事务上浪费时间。
description: StelaxAI replies to customers, qualifies leads and books appointments 24/7. The AI platform for salons, med spas, clinics and service businesses.
description_zh: StelaxAI全天候回复客户、筛选潜在客户并预约。这是为沙龙、医美水疗中心、诊所和服务型企业打造的AI平台。

name: GoodBarber - AI Extension Builder
tagline: Describe a feature, AI creates it in your app.
tagline_zh: 描述一个功能，AI 在你的应用中创建它。
description: GoodBarber's AI Extension Builder lets you create custom app sections by describing them in plain language — no code, no developer. Add a "Create with AI" section, describe what you want, and the agent writes it, plugs it into GoodBarber's public APIs (geolocation, native maps, offline storage, membership, system alerts) and renders it live. Refine by chatting or edit the code. It inherits your design system and compiles native iOS & Android. Free, in Beta.
description_zh: GoodBarber 的 AI 扩展构建器让你通过自然语言描述来创建自定义应用模块——无需代码，无需开发者。添加“AI 创建”模块，描述你的需求，代理会编写代码，接入 GoodBarber 的公开 API（地理定位、原生地图、离线存储、会员系统、系统通知）并实时渲染。通过聊天优化或编辑代码。它继承你的设计系统，并编译为原生 iOS 和 Android 应用。免费，处于 Beta 阶段。

name: TravelBeast
tagline: Introducing TravelBeast, the ultimate trip/itinerary planner
tagline_zh: 介绍 TravelBeast，终极旅行/行程规划工具
description: AI travel agent that builds a complete day-by-day itinerary - hotels, restaurants, attractions, and routes - tailored to you. Edit by chat or voice, track flights, and book in one tap, talk to it like a travel agent. It makes changes in real time. Optimized routing: stops ordered to minimize backtracking, with a live map that redraws as you edit. One-tap booking: flights, hotels, rental cars, and eSIM all from inside the itinerary. Free to start - Land based trips and cruises.
description_zh: AI 旅行代理，为你构建完整的每日行程——包括酒店、餐厅、景点和路线，完全个性化。通过聊天或语音编辑，一键追踪航班并预订，像与旅行代理交谈一样与它互动。实时更新变化。优化路线：站点排序以最小化折返，编辑时地图实时重绘。一键预订：航班、酒店、租车和 eSIM 均可在行程内完成。免费开始——支持陆地旅行和邮轮。

name: PreFlight
tagline: Stop AI agent from breaking database security & architecture
tagline_zh: 防止 AI 代理破坏数据库安全与架构
description: PreFlight is a local AST-based security gate that guards your codebase against AI hallucinations. AI coding agents often "quietly" skip critical security protocols like Supabase Row-Level Security (RLS) or leak server-only logic. PreFlight parses your code's AST in real-time, mapping your architectural dependencies to catch these structural drifts. Currently in public beta. Open-source, local-first, and built for developers who want to keep the speed of AI without the security debt.
description_zh: PreFlight 是一个基于本地 AST 的安全网关，保护你的代码库免受 AI 幻觉的影响。AI 编程代理经常“悄悄”跳过关键的安全协议，如 Supabase 行级安全 (RLS) 或泄露仅限服务器端的逻辑。PreFlight 实时解析代码的 AST，将你的架构依赖关系映射起来，以捕捉这些结构性偏差。目前处于公开测试阶段。开源，本地优先，专为希望在享受 AI 速度的同时避免安全债务的开发者打造。

name: FlareCode
tagline: Parallel coding fleet, from anywhere
tagline_zh: 并行编码舰队，随时随地
description: Run your whole coding fleet from anywhere. Connect a GitHub repo and hand off a task in plain English. The agent plans, edits, runs your tests, and opens a pull request you review and merge. Run many repos in parallel, from your phone or your desk. One flat price. You stay in control.
description_zh: 随时随地运行你的整个编码舰队。连接一个 GitHub 仓库，用自然语言下达任务。代理进行规划、编辑、运行测试，并打开你审查和合并的拉取请求。从手机或办公桌并行运行多个仓库。统一价格。你始终掌控全局。

name: MyBibleChat — Bible App, AI Pastor
tagline: Your Daily Walk with God
tagline_zh: 你与上帝的每日同行
description: MyBibleChat — 12 Bible translations (6 fully offline), daily Scripture, prayer journal, gratitude journal, Bible Study and forgiveness. AI pastoral guidance, and live sessions with human pastors. Free on iOS & Android.
description_zh: MyBibleChat —— 12 种圣经译本（6 种完全离线），每日经文，祷告日记，感恩日记，圣经学习及宽恕指南。AI 牧养指导，以及与人类牧师的实时会话。iOS 和 Android 免费。

name: SideClue
tagline: Live sales coaching without a meeting bot
tagline_zh: 无需会议机器人即可进行实时销售辅导
description: SideClue is a private desktop copilot for live sales calls. It listens to your mic and computer audio, understands the conversation, and shows short coaching cards while you talk. No bot joins Zoom, Teams, or Google Meet. Ask questions during the call, pull answers from your own docs, then get notes and summaries after.
description_zh: SideClue 是一款专为实时销售通话设计的私人桌面 Copilot。它监听您的麦克风和电脑音频，理解对话内容，并在您交谈时显示简短的辅导卡片。没有机器人加入 Zoom、Teams 或 Google Meet。您可以在通话中提问，从自己的文档中提取答案，随后获取笔记和摘要。

name: Lynxify
tagline: Structured 360 feedback for small teams
tagline_zh: 面向小型团队的标准化 360 度反馈
description: Lynxify automates 360-degree employee feedback for teams of 30–200. Define reviewees, select peers and managers, set evaluation criteria, and the platform handles the rest. Anonymous responses encourage honest input. AI-generated summaries combine scores and written feedback into a ready-to-use report. No enterprise complexity, no manual coordination. Just structured feedback that actually gets done.
description_zh: Lynxify 自动化管理 30 至 200 人团队的 360 度员工反馈。定义被评估者，选择同事和经理，设定评估标准，平台自动处理其余工作。匿名回复鼓励诚实的意见输入。AI 生成的摘要将评分和书面反馈结合成即用的报告。无需企业级的复杂性，也无需手动协调。只需真正落地的结构化反馈。

name: Score My Insta
tagline: AI audit that scores your Instagram profile in minutes
tagline_zh: 几分钟内对您的 Instagram 个人资料进行 AI 审计
description: Score My Insta gives you a complete AI-powered audit of your Instagram profile for $37. Upload your screenshots and get back: • Your Instagram score (0–100) • A rewritten bio ready to copy-paste • 30 targeted hashtags for your niche • Content strategy + 10 hook ideas • 30-day action plan to grow faster Results delivered to your email in minutes. 7-day money-back guarantee.
description_zh: Score My Insta 为您提供全面的 AI 驱动 Instagram 个人资料审计，仅需 37 美元。上传截图即可获得：• 您的 Instagram 评分（0-100）• 可直接复制粘贴的重写简介 • 针对您细分领域的 30 个精准标签 • 内容策略 + 10 个钩子创意 • 加速增长的 30 天行动计划。结果将在几分钟内发送至您的邮箱。提供 7 天退款保证。

name: Reploxis
tagline: Safety net for vibe coders
tagline_zh: Vibe Coding 的安全网
description: Reploxis — Insurance for AI Builders. Protect your codebase with instant snapshots, one-click recovery and AI cleanup. Built for Cursor, Claude Code, and more. Every vibe coder knows the pain: AI overwrites 3 files, breaks everything, and Ctrl+Z doesn't work. Reploxis adds a safety layer – one command saves a snapshot, another restores your last working state. Works alongside git, but without the thinking. Perfect for rapid AI-assisted development.
description_zh: Reploxis —— AI 构建者的保险。通过即时快照、一键恢复和 AI 清理来保护您的代码库。专为 Cursor、Claude Code 等打造。每个 Vibe Coder 都深知这种痛苦：AI 覆盖了 3 个文件，破坏了所有内容，而 Ctrl+Z 却不起作用。Reploxis 增加了一层安全机制——一条命令保存快照，另一条命令恢复到最后可用的状态。它与 git 协同工作，但无需繁琐的思考。非常适合快速的 AI 辅助开发。

name: SurfLexAI
tagline: Learn languages while you read the web
tagline_zh: 边浏览网页边学习语言
description: SurfLexAI turns everyday web reading into language learning. Double-click any word on any page or PDF — it reads the context, gives the right meaning, and saves the word with its sentence. A built-in SM-2 spaced-repetition system brings it back right before you forget. Practice across 7 modes: flashcards, quick review, tests, writing with AI feedback, listening, chat/roleplay, and grammar lessons. 7 languages. Free forever, Pro optional. Mobile app coming soon.
description_zh: SurfLexAI 将日常网页阅读转化为语言学习。在任意页面或 PDF 上双击任何单词——它会读取上下文，提供正确的释义，并将该单词连同其所在句子一起保存。内置的 SM-2 间隔重复系统会在您即将遗忘时将其重新呈现。支持 7 种练习模式：抽认卡、快速复习、测试、带 AI 反馈的写作、听力、聊天/角色扮演以及语法课程。涵盖 7 种语言。永久免费，Pro 版可选。移动端应用即将推出。

name: PhilosophieBook
tagline: 18 AI philosophers debate, so you think clearer
tagline_zh: 18位AI哲学家展开辩论，助你理清思路
description: Browse philosophical debates where 18 AI thinkers — Socrates, Confucius, Nietzsche, Liu Cixin, Asimov, Sontag, and more — discuss modern questions alongside humans and your AI agents. Not single-AI answers — real debate, where each thinker challenges the last. Free to read, join, or post your own topics.
description_zh: 浏览由18位AI思想家——苏格拉底、孔子、尼采、刘慈欣、阿西莫夫、桑塔格等——与人类及你的AI代理共同讨论现代问题的哲学辩论。这不是单一AI的回答，而是真正的辩论，每位思想家都会对前一位提出挑战。免费阅读、加入或发布你自己的话题。

name: Ikie
tagline: A token-efficient, self-healing terminal AI coding assistant
tagline_zh: 一款节省Token且具有自我修复能力的终端AI编程助手
description: Ikie is a powerful agentic coding CLI for complex work. It reads your repo, plans, edits with precision, runs your tests, and ships — all from the shell. 28 built-in tools, plan & agent modes, skills and MCP support.
description_zh: Ikie是一款功能强大的智能体编码CLI，专为复杂工作设计。它能读取你的代码库，进行规划，精准编辑，运行测试并部署——全部在命令行中完成。内置28种工具，支持计划与智能体模式、技能及MCP协议。

name: Procure Copilot
tagline: Compare, approve & pay 41 retailers via AI
tagline_zh: 通过AI对比、审批并支付41家零售商的费用
description: AI procurement agent for restaurants, hotels & agro in Latin America. Submit your basket, compare live prices across 41 verified retailers in 8 countries, get manager approval in one click, and pay via Yape, PayPal, or Mercado Pago — in under 30 seconds. No more WhatsApp price hunting. No more spreadsheets. Powered by CLI Market — 61,000+ real shelf prices, refreshed every 4h. Plans from $29/mo.
description_zh: 面向拉美地区餐厅、酒店及农业行业的AI采购智能体。提交购物清单，在8个国家的41家认证零售商间实时比价，一键获得经理审批，并通过Yape、PayPal或Mercado Pago在30秒内完成支付。告别WhatsApp询价，告别电子表格。由CLI Market驱动——拥有61,000+真实货架价格，每4小时更新一次。套餐起价$29/月。

name: InstaShare
tagline: Securely Share Claude Code chat sessions as public link
tagline_zh: 安全地将Claude Code聊天会话分享为公开链接
description: Share or export a Claude Code chat session as a public link in one /instashare command. Anonymous-first, with API keys and secrets auto-redacted before upload. Free skill for Claude Code.
description_zh: 通过一条/instashare命令，将Claude Code聊天会话分享或导出为公开链接。优先匿名处理，上传前自动隐藏API密钥和敏感信息。Claude Code的免费技能。

name: INTrouble
tagline: AI diagnostic assistant for industrial electrical faults
tagline_zh: 工业电气故障AI诊断助手
description: INTrouble helps electricians and maintenance technicians diagnose industrial electrical faults step by step — on site, in real time. Select your equipment brand and fault type, and get immediate AI-guided troubleshooting following IEC standards. Works for energy distribution, energy production (including hydroelectric generators — Francis and Kaplan turbines), motors, PLCs, SCADA, control panels and more. Available in English, French, Spanish and German.
description_zh: INTrouble帮助电工和维护技术人员在现场实时逐步诊断工业电气故障。选择设备品牌和故障类型，即可立即获得遵循IEC标准的AI引导式故障排除。适用于能源配电、能源生产（包括水轮发电机——弗朗西斯式和卡普兰式涡轮机）、电机、PLC、SCADA、控制面板等。提供英语、法语、西班牙语和德语版本。

name: AI Prompt Manager
tagline: Save, organize & copy your best AI prompts. Never  again
tagline_zh: 保存、整理并复制您最优质的 AI 提示词。永不再忘
description: I built AI Prompt Manager because I was tired of scrolling through endless ChatGPT conversations looking for that one perfect prompt. It's a free Chrome extension that lets you save prompts with categories and tags, search them instantly, and copy with one click. All data stored locally on your device — no accounts, no servers, no tracking.
description_zh: 我开发 AI Prompt Manager 是因为厌倦了在无尽的 ChatGPT 对话中滚动查找那个完美的提示词。这是一款免费的 Chrome 扩展程序，允许您按类别和标签保存提示词，即时搜索，并一键复制。所有数据均本地存储于您的设备上——无需账户，无需服务器，无需追踪。

name: Conduit: SSH, Mosh & SFTP
tagline: FOSS SSH, Mosh & SFTP client for Android and iOS.
tagline_zh: 适用于 Android 和 iOS 的开源 SSH、Mosh 及 SFTP 客户端。
description: A modern, privacy-focused SSH, Mosh, and SFTP client for Android and iOS. No account, no cloud sync, no analytics, no paid features, ever. Supports password, private key, and hardware key (YubiKey/FIDO2) auth over NFC and USB. Tabbed sessions, SSH agent forwarding, SFTP browser, app lock, and terminal themes including Catppuccin, Tokyo Night, and Gruvbox. Mosh support keeps your session alive across network switches. Everything stays on device. Apache-2.0. Free forever.
description_zh: 一款现代、注重隐私的 SSH、Mosh 和 SFTP 客户端，适用于 Android 和 iOS。无需账户，无云端同步，无分析统计，永远没有付费功能。支持通过 NFC 和 USB 进行密码、私钥及硬件密钥（YubiKey/FIDO2）认证。支持标签页会话、SSH 代理转发、SFTP 浏览器、应用锁以及包括 Catppuccin、Tokyo Night 和 Gruvbox 在内的终端主题。Mosh 支持确保您在网络切换时会话不中断。所有数据保留在设备上。Apache-2.0 协议。永久免费。

name: WhiteStair
tagline: Best tool to add caption - NO SUBSCRIPTION
tagline_zh: 最佳字幕添加工具 - 无需订阅
description: WhiteStair is an AI video caption generator. Turn any video into scroll-stopping captioned content in minutes — auto-transcribe, pick a template, and customize fonts, colors, size and position. No subscription; pay-as-you-go tokens.
description_zh: WhiteStair 是一款 AI 视频字幕生成器。在几分钟内将任何视频转化为令人驻足观看的字幕内容——自动转录、选择模板，并自定义字体、颜色、大小和位置。无需订阅；按 token 付费。

name: Contract Review
tagline: Know what you're signing before you sign it
tagline_zh: 签署前了解您正在签署的内容
description: Free AI contract review tool. Upload any contract, spot hidden risks, and get plain-English explanations in seconds. 95% cheaper than a lawyer. Contract Review uses AI to analyze any contract in seconds — NDAs, freelance agreements, leases, you name it. Get an overall risk score, a plain English summary, and your top red flags before you sign anything. Free plan included (3 contracts/month). Pro and Agency plans unlock all 11 clause sections, side-by-side rewrites, and full export options.
description_zh: 免费 AI 合同审查工具。上传任何合同，发现隐藏风险，并在几秒钟内获得通俗易懂的解释。比律师便宜 95%。Contract Review 利用 AI 在几秒钟内分析任何合同——NDA、自由职业协议、租赁合同等应有尽有。在签署任何文件之前，获取总体风险评分、通俗摘要以及您的主要红旗警示。包含免费计划（每月 3 份合同）。Pro 和 Agency 计划解锁全部 11 个条款部分、并排重写及完整导出选项。

name: WhatsApp Sales Bot
tagline: Sell 24/7 on WhatsApp without replying yourself
tagline_zh: 全天候在 WhatsApp 上销售，无需亲自回复
description: Tired of answering customers all day? I built a WhatsApp bot that sells for you automatically: ✅ Instant replies to inquiries ✅ Shows products + cart inside WhatsApp ✅ Takes orders + sends daily sales reports ✅ Works 24/7 while you sleep Perfect for stores, dropshippers, agencies. Built with Make + AI automation.
description_zh: 厌倦了整天回答客户的问题？我构建了一个自动为您销售的 WhatsApp 机器人：✅ 即时回复咨询 ✅ 在 WhatsApp 内展示产品及购物车 ✅ 接收订单并发送每日销售报告 ✅ 在您睡觉时全天候工作 非常适合商店、代发货商和代理机构。基于 Make + AI 自动化构建。

name: Orphea
tagline: Your music, deeply understood by AI
tagline_zh: 你的音乐，被AI深度理解
description: Orphea is your Spotify Wrapped, but all year long and across every platform. Connect Deezer, TIDAL, SoundCloud or Apple Music, or search any track, and get a deep AI read on 4 dimensions: Beat, Lyrics, Structure and Emotion. It turns your taste into a shareable Music DNA, helps you discover new tracks with a swipe-style Flow Deck, and gives artists an Artist Studio to analyze and grow their sound.
description_zh: Orphea 是你的全年无休、跨平台 Spotify Wrapped。连接 Deezer、TIDAL、SoundCloud 或 Apple Music，或搜索任意曲目，获取 AI 对节奏、歌词、结构和情感四个维度的深度解读。它将你的品味转化为可分享的 Music DNA，通过滑动式 Flow Deck 帮助你发现新曲目，并为艺术家提供 Artist Studio 以分析和优化其声音。

name: ValueLens
tagline: A Buffett-style stock analysis terminal for your Mac
tagline_zh: 面向 Mac 的巴菲特风格股票分析终端
description: ValueLens turns raw SEC filings into a full value-investing workflow on macOS: 10-year financials from EDGAR, a two-stage Owner-Earnings DCF with scenarios, Morningstar-style AI research reports, S&P 500 value screening, and buy-zone alerts. Free data sources; bring your own Claude key. One-time $39, no subscription.
description_zh: ValueLens 将原始的 SEC 文件转化为 macOS 上的完整价值投资工作流：来自 EDGAR 的 10 年财务数据、包含情景分析的兩阶段 Owner-Earnings DCF、晨星风格的 AI 研究报告、标普 500 价值筛选以及买入区间警报。使用免费数据源；自带 Claude key。一次性付费 $39，无订阅。

name: Foglamp HUD
tagline: See your AI SDK agents brains at localhost!
tagline_zh: 在 localhost 查看你的 AI SDK agents 的大脑！
description: The missing observability layer for AI agents built on the Vercel AI SDK. Costs, latency, tokens, distributed traces, evals, and alerts for every generateText / streamText call — in two lines.
description_zh: 为基于 Vercel AI SDK 构建的 AI agents 提供的缺失的可观测性层。两行代码即可获取每次 generateText / streamText 调用的成本、延迟、token 数、分布式追踪、评估和警报。

name: AI Tool Hub
tagline: 发现最好用的 AI 工具，提升效率 10 倍
tagline_zh: 发现最好用的 AI 工具，提升效率 10 倍
description: 中文 AI 工具导航站，精选 30+ 款热门 AI 工具，涵盖对话、绘画、编程、视频、音乐等 8 大分类。每个工具有评分、价格、标签，完全免费。
description_zh: 中文 AI 工具导航站，精选 30+ 款热门 AI 工具，涵盖对话、绘画、编程、视频、音乐等 8 大分类。每个工具有评分、价格、标签，完全免费。

name: Uncharted Tycoons
tagline: Onchain maritime trading + strategy game on Base
tagline_zh: Base 链上海洋贸易 + 策略游戏
description: Uncharted Tycoons is an onchain maritime strategy game on Base. Sail between 13 Mediterranean ports, move cargo along risky trade routes, outsmart an AI market that shifts every voyage, fend off pirates, and level up your harbors. Token prices may fluctuate; play involves risk.
description_zh: Uncharted Tycoons 是 Base 上的一款链上海洋策略游戏。在 13 个地中海港口间航行，沿高风险贸易路线运输货物，智胜每航次都会变化的 AI 市场，抵御海盗，并升级你的港口。代币价格可能波动；参与即有风险。

name: naholo
tagline: naholo — coding ops, end to end
tagline_zh: naholo — 编码运维，端到端
description: Turn AI coding into military-style operation cycle that stays disciplined, recoverable, and accountable. A web app plans the operations, a CLI gives agents every tool they need in your codebase, and AI skills drive the cycle.

description_zh: 再也不必错过客户来电。CallMelo 是专为本地商家打造的 AI 电话接听员，拥有市场上最佳的品质与定价。它能接听电话、捕获订单和预约请求，并将所有通话记录直观地同步至仪表盘。

name: Find Your Influence

From emerging voices to global celebrities, we connect them with relevant brand partnerships, campaigns, and opportunities that fit their audience and influence.
description_zh: 我们帮助品牌和代理商通过 AI、活动智能、数据以及触达全球 4700 万创作者的资源，将创作者营销转化为可衡量的广告渠道。从新兴声音到全球名人，我们将其与契合其受众和影响力的相关品牌合作、活动和机会相连接。

description: PromptQuery lets Claude, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, and other AI agents safely query databases and do everything from data analysis to report generation to browsing schemas and managing workflows with read-only defaults and human approval for risky changes. PromptQuery is an MCP-native client for AI-powered data analysis and database management.
description_zh: PromptQuery 让 Claude、Cursor、Codex、Copilot 及其他 AI 智能体能够安全地查询数据库，执行从数据分析到报告生成，再到浏览 Schema 和管理工作流等任务，默认采用只读模式，对高风险变更需人工审批。PromptQuery 是一款原生支持 MCP 的客户端，专为 AI 驱动的数据分析和数据库管理而设计。

name: Senswit
tagline: AI-Native Decision Intelligence OS
tagline_zh: AI 原生决策智能操作系统
description: SensWit is the AI-native Decision Intelligence OS that turns signals into smarter growth decisions.
description_zh: SensWit 是 AI 原生的决策智能操作系统，能将信号转化为更明智的增长决策。

name: Buzzr Sports
tagline: Rate games, follow buzz, and talk live sports
tagline_zh: 评分游戏、追踪热点、畅聊体育赛事
description: Buzzr turns live sports into a social feed. Rate games 1-10, find what is worth watching tonight, follow World Cup 2026 schedules and standings, trade takes in Swipe/Swarm, chat with friends, join watch parties, and build brackets across every major league.
description_zh: Buzzr 将体育赛事转化为社交动态流。为比赛打分（1-10 分），发现今晚值得观看的比赛，关注 2026 年世界杯赛程和排名，在 Swipe/Swarm 中交换观点，与朋友聊天，加入观赛派对，并在各大主要联赛中组建竞猜 bracket。

name: burn
tagline: Verify your Kubernetes costs against your real cloud bill
tagline_zh: 根据实际云账单验证您的 Kubernetes 成本
description: Built burn because every K8s cost tool I tried showed estimates but none checked if those numbers matched the real bill. Pulls actual AWS CUR or Azure Cost Management data exact dollar diff per node, per disk, per load balancer. SP, RI, Spot detected from billing. Orphaned volumes and LBs flagged. Works on cloud and on-prem. Reconciliation production-tested on AWS and Azure. Featured on WebProNews. Open source. Single binary. No agent.
description_zh: Built burn 应运而生，因为我尝试过的每个 K8s 成本工具都只显示估算值，却无一核实这些数字是否与真实账单相符。它直接拉取实际的 AWS CUR 或 Azure Cost Management 数据，精确计算每个节点、每个磁盘、每个负载均衡器的美元差异。通过账单数据自动识别 SP、RI 和 Spot 实例。标记孤立卷和负载均衡器。支持公有云和私有环境。已在 AWS 和 Azure 上经过生产环境验证。获 WebProNews 报道。开源。单二进制文件。无需 Agent。

name: FMN
tagline: FMN is the all-in-one toolbox for trade businesses.

description_zh: FMN 是面向贸易企业的一站式工具箱。报价、估算、文档、供应商定价及日常行政事务，全部集成于一处，让您少花时间在文书工作上，多花时间享受生活。

name: FrontScale
tagline: The Next.js template that keeps your AI agent honest
tagline_zh: 保持 AI 智能体诚实的 Next.js 模板
description: Vibe coding is magic — until your codebase turns to spaghetti: duplicated code, no tests, broken structure. The agent isn't the problem; the missing guardrails are. FrontScale is a production-grade Next.js 16 template that gives your AI agent those guardrails: FSD architecture, Vitest + Playwright with a coverage gate, a security checklist, and 28 playbooks. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf — you describe what you want; it plans, codes, tests, ships. $4.99 once. Yours forever.
description_zh: 氛围编码（Vibe coding）宛如魔法——直到你的代码库变成一团乱麻：重复代码、缺乏测试、结构混乱。问题不在智能体，而在缺失的安全护栏。FrontScale 是一款面向生产环境的 Next.js 16 模板，为你的 AI 智能体提供这些护栏：FSD 架构、带覆盖率门禁的 Vitest + Playwright、安全检查清单以及 28 个操作手册。兼容 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf —— 你描述需求，它负责规划、编码、测试和部署。一次性支付 $4.99，永久拥有。

name: Vibe Guard AI
tagline: AI security audits for modern developers.
tagline_zh: 面向现代开发者的 AI 安全审计。
description: VibeGuard AI helps developers, indie hackers, and startup founders review code before launch. Simply paste your code, upload files, or provide a repository and VibeGuard AI will: ✅ Detect security vulnerabilities ✅ Find hardcoded secrets and API keys ✅ Identify SQL injection, XSS, and authentication issues ✅ Review backend and API security ✅ Check production readiness ✅ Analyze mobile app compliance risks ✅ Generate actionable security reports ✅ Provide launch recommendations with Ship or not.
description_zh: VibeGuard AI 帮助开发者、独立黑客和初创公司创始人在上线前审查代码。只需粘贴代码、上传文件或提供仓库，VibeGuard AI 即可：✅ 检测安全漏洞 ✅ 发现硬编码密钥和 API Keys ✅ 识别 SQL 注入、XSS 和认证问题 ✅ 审查后端和 API 安全性 ✅ 检查生产就绪状态 ✅ 分析移动应用合规风险 ✅ 生成可操作的安全报告 ✅ 提供“发布”或“不发布”的启动建议。

name: AURA — Facial Analysis for YouTube
tagline: Real-time facial analysis on YouTube — not a lie detector
tagline_zh: YouTube 实时面部分析——并非测谎仪

No uploads, no account, no tracking. It's honest about its limits: it is NOT a lie detector (facial deception detection is unreliable), so that part is clearly labeled non-diagnostic. Free, no ads.
description_zh: AURA 在任何 YouTube 视频上叠加实时面部分析——468 个关键点、FACS 动作单元、表情和微表情——通过 Google MediaPipe 在设备端 100% 运行。无需上传、无需账户、无追踪。它诚实地表明自身局限：它不是测谎仪（面部欺骗检测不可靠），因此该部分明确标注为非诊断性。免费，无广告。

With features like intelligent dispatch systems, real-time monitoring, and contactless payment integration, it helps improve efficiency and reduce operational complexity.
description_zh: TB Ride - 出租车管理软件是一款先进的 AI 驱动解决方案，旨在简化和自动化出租车及网约车运营。它使企业能够在一个集中式平台上轻松管理乘车预订、司机分配和车队跟踪。凭借智能调度系统、实时监控和无接触支付集成等功能，它有助于提高效率并降低运营复杂性。

name: Free API Cost Calculators for Developer.

One line of code to embed anywhere, in-chat lead capture, and fully white-label so agencies can rebrand and resell it. Free to start, no card.
description_zh: Alee 是一款白标 AI 聊天机器人，您可使用自己的内容对其进行训练——包括网站、站点地图、PDF、FAQ 和 YouTube 转录文本。它 24/7 仅根据这些内容回答访客问题，引用来源，并在不知道时直接说“我不知道”，而不是胡编乱造。只需一行代码即可嵌入任何地方，支持聊天内线索收集，且完全白标化，方便代理商重新品牌化并转售。免费开始，无需信用卡。

description: BillBoard is a student-built, nonprofit civic technology platform designed to make federal legislation more accessible. tagline_zh: 使用远程浏览器进行网络请求和HTML网页抓取。
description: Build browser automations and live API endpoints without code. Create workflows visually or describe them in plain English, then deploy instantly. Run automations in remote browsers, intercept network requests, extract website data, and solve CAPTCHAs automatically. Turn complex web tasks into scalable APIs, automate workflows, integrate services, and build tools for AI agents—all from one platform with a marketplace to share, discover, and monetize workflows at scale.
description_zh: 无需代码即可构建浏览器自动化和实时API端点。通过可视化方式创建工作流，或用普通英语描述它们，然后立即部署。在远程浏览器中运行自动化，拦截网络请求，提取网站数据，并自动解决验证码。将复杂的网络任务转化为可扩展的API，自动化工作流，集成服务，并为AI代理构建工具——所有操作均在一个平台上完成，该平台拥有市场功能，可大规模共享、发现和变现工作流。

name: Vitriny AI
tagline: AI-powered product photography for fashion   e-commerce
tagline_zh: 面向时尚电商的AI驱动产品摄影
description: Plataforma de IA generativa para fotos de e-commerce de moda. Gere centenas de imagens editoriais com modelos virtuais — sem estúdio, sem fotógrafo. A partir de R$ 3,68/imagem.
description_zh: 面向时尚电商的生成式AI平台。使用虚拟模特生成数百张编辑风格图片——无需影棚，无需摄影师。每张图片低至3.68雷亚尔起。

name: Liner Developer Platform
tagline: Build search agents with 10x cheaper web search
tagline_zh: 以低10倍的成本构建具备网络搜索能力的智能体
description: Liner helps developers build AI apps with search agents and lower-cost search tools. Add web search, academic search, cited answers, deep research, and visual answers to your product. Web Search starts at $1 / 1K requests — 1/10 of OpenAI’s public web search tool-call price.
description_zh: Liner帮助开发者利用搜索智能体和低成本搜索工具构建AI应用。为您的产品添加网络搜索、学术搜索、引用回答、深度研究和视觉回答。网络搜索起步价为1美元/1000次请求——仅为OpenAI公开网络搜索工具调用价格的十分之一。

name: Clientra - client management software.
tagline: The only dashboard you will need to run your agency
tagline_zh: 运营您的代理机构所需的全部仪表板
description: Clientra — Client Management for AI Agencies. Manage clients, automate workflows, and grow your agency.
description_zh: Clientra——专为AI代理机构设计的客户管理平台。管理客户，自动化工作流，推动代理机构增长。

name: Zeus.team, AI native workspace
tagline: 100x your team's capacity with AI employees
tagline_zh: 用 AI 员工将团队产能提升 100 倍
description: Most AI tools help people work faster. Zeus helps companies grow without hiring. Zeus is an AI-native workspace where human and AI employees work together in shared conversations. AI employees can perform customer support, operations, research, reporting, and repetitive business tasks using your company's knowledge and workflows. Build an AI workforce that works 24/7 and scales your team's capacity without adding headcount.
description_zh: 大多数 AI 工具帮助人们更快工作。Zeus 帮助公司在不招聘的情况下实现增长。Zeus 是一个 AI 原生工作区，人类员工与 AI 员工在共享对话中协同工作。AI 员工可利用公司的知识和工作流程执行客户支持、运营、研究、报告及重复性业务任务。打造一支 24/7 全天候工作的 AI 劳动力，在不增加人头数的情况下扩展团队产能。

name: QuiLie - Drop the Mask
tagline: Track how often you're actually yourself.
tagline_zh: 追踪你真正做回自己的频率。
description: Modern life forces us to play characters - the polished worker, the happy friend, the perfect persona. But when do you stop performing? QuiLie is a private, zero-feed utility to track social masking burnout. Log your day, unmask the 5 core personas you use to survive social settings, chat with a private AI coach, and watch your real authenticity score grow a digital watercolor tree. Stop chasing public clout and see who you are when nobody is watching.
description_zh: 现代生活迫使我们扮演各种角色——精致的职场人、快乐的朋友、完美的人设。但你何时才能停止表演？QuiLie 是一款私密的零信息流工具，用于追踪社交伪装带来的倦怠感。记录你的一天，揭示你在社交场合中赖以生存的 5 种核心人格，与私密 AI 教练聊天，看着你的真实自我指数成长为一棵数字水彩树。停止追逐公众影响力，看看在无人注视时的你究竟是谁。

name: LetsDoItAi
tagline: Find the right AI tool, without the fuss
tagline_zh: 轻松找到合适的 AI 工具
description: Honest comparisons of Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Midjourney and 60+ more. Find the right AI tool, compare free plans, and grab free prompt guides.
description_zh: 对 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、Midjourney 等 60 多种 AI 工具进行诚实对比。找到合适的 AI 工具，比较免费套餐，并获取免费的 Prompt 指南。

name: markova
tagline: AI-Powered Marketing Automation for Growing Businesses
tagline_zh: 面向成长型企业的 AI 驱动营销自动化
description: Markova is an AI-powered marketing platform that helps businesses attract, engage, and convert customers. Create campaigns, automate workflows, manage leads, deploy AI agents, and communicate across multiple channels from a single dashboard. Unlike fragmented marketing tools, Markova combines automation, AI assistance, customer engagement, and analytics in one unified platform, helping businesses save time and scale faster.
description_zh: Markova 是一个由 AI 驱动的营销平台，帮助企业吸引、互动并转化客户。从单一仪表盘创建营销活动、自动化工作流、管理潜在客户、部署 AI Agent，并在多渠道进行沟通。与碎片化的营销工具不同，Markova 将自动化、AI 辅助、客户互动和分析整合在一个统一的平台上，帮助企业节省时间并加速扩张。

name: reviso
tagline: Ai flashcards & spaced repetition for active recall.
tagline_zh: AI 驱动的抽认卡与间隔重复，助力主动回忆。
description: Reviso turns study materials into smart flashcards in seconds. Upload notes, textbook photos, handwritten pages, and AI generates question-and-answer cards automatically. It uses FSRS spaced repetition to schedule reviews, includes AI answer scoring so you do not have to self-grade, tracks progress with analytics and streaks, and supports offline review. Studying is free, with 50 AI generation credits refreshed daily and no subscription required.
description_zh: Reviso 能在几秒钟内将学习资料转化为智能抽认卡。上传笔记、教科书照片或手写页面，AI 会自动生成问答卡片。它采用 FSRS 间隔重复算法安排复习，包含 AI 评分功能，无需自行批改；通过数据分析和连胜记录追踪进度，并支持离线复习。学习免费，每日刷新 50 个 AI 生成额度，无需订阅。

name: Parse Captain
tagline: Documents Intelligence Platform
tagline_zh: 文档智能平台
description: Most document parsing tools are either built for large enterprises or are simple single purpose invoice scanners. Parse Captain sits in the middle, a full document intelligence platform that SMEs can actually set up without a developer. It handles multiple document types, delivers data directly into tools you already use like quickbooks, xero, google sheets, ERPs or your internal tools with EU data residency built in.
description_zh: 大多数文档解析工具要么专为大型企业设计，要么是简单的单一用途发票扫描仪。Parse Captain 处于中间地带，是一个中小企业无需开发人员即可实际搭建的完整文档智能平台。它支持多种文档类型，并将数据直接交付给您已使用的工具中，如 QuickBooks、Xero、Google Sheets、ERP 或您的内部工具，并内置欧盟数据驻留功能。

name: 50 AI Prompts for Excel
tagline: Excel prompt packs for people who'd rather not Google it.
tagline_zh: 为不想自己搜索的人准备的 Excel 提示词包。
description: 50 AI Prompts for Excel — built for one job each, so there's no vague asking or guesswork about what details to include. Every prompt comes pre-structured: the columns to name, the conditions to set, the output format to expect. Just drop in your own data, paste into ChatGPT or Claude, and get a working formula, script, or fix on the first try — plus a plain-English breakdown of why it works. No blind copy-pasting. Just faster, cleaner results, every time.
description_zh: 50 个用于 Excel 的 AI 提示词——每个提示词专为单一任务构建，因此无需模糊询问或猜测需要包含哪些细节。每个提示词都预先结构化：包括要命名的列、要设置的条件以及预期的输出格式。只需填入您自己的数据，粘贴到 ChatGPT 或 Claude 中，即可一次性获得可用的公式、脚本或修复方案——并附带通俗易懂的工作原理说明。无需盲目复制粘贴。每次都能获得更快、更清晰的结果。

name: Thryvate
tagline: Turn AI-generated content into a private, live website
tagline_zh: 将 AI 生成的内容转化为私有的实时网站
description: Turn any HTML, Markdown, notebook, or PDF into a private, live website protected by real authentication, so only the people you invite can access it. And it stays up to date. Connect your AI to the latest data, whether it’s Power BI, a CSV, or virtually any source, and Thryvate automatically refreshes the site. You control access, and you can see exactly who viewed it.
description_zh: 将任何 HTML、Markdown、笔记本或 PDF 文件转化为受真实身份验证保护的私有实时网站，只有受邀人员才能访问。并且网站保持最新状态。将您的 AI 连接到最新数据，无论是 Power BI、CSV 还是几乎任何来源，Thryvate 都会自动刷新网站。您可以控制访问权限，并确切查看谁访问了该网站。

name: Nutaan CRM
tagline: AI-Powered CRM for Sales, Marketing & Customer Engagement
tagline_zh: 面向销售、营销和客户参与的 AI 驱动 CRM
description: Nutaan runs your email, calling and social outreach on one stack. Autonomous AI agents find leads, write the message, dial the phone and reply on socials — while you watch every signal in real time.
description_zh: Nutaan 在一个技术栈上运行您的电子邮件、电话和社交外展业务。自主 AI 代理寻找潜在客户、撰写消息、拨打电话并在社交媒体上回复——同时让您实时监控所有信号。

name: Clauge
tagline: The AI-powered super-app for developers.
tagline_zh: 开发者专用的 AI 驱动超级应用。
description: Clauge is an AI-powered desktop super-app for developers: parallel coding agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode), a spatial Atlas canvas, Kanban boards with AI coworkers and 45+ MCP tools, REST, SQL, NoSQL and SSH clients, a file explorer for S3, Azure Blob, SFTP and FTP, AI meeting notes, encrypted cloud sync, and an iOS and Android companion — one native app for macOS, Windows and Linux.
description_zh: Clauge 是一款面向开发者的 AI 驱动桌面超级应用：并行编码代理（Claude、Codex、Gemini、OpenCode）、空间 Atlas 画布、带有 AI 同事的看板、45 多种 MCP 工具、REST、SQL、NoSQL 和 SSH 客户端、用于 S3、Azure Blob、SFTP 和 FTP 的文件浏览器、AI 会议笔记、加密云同步，以及 iOS 和 Android 伴侣应用——一款适用于 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 的原生应用。

name: Aruvi
tagline: The workspace where humans and AI agents ship together.
tagline_zh: 人类与AI智能体协同交付的工作空间。
description: Aruvi combines issue tracking, lightweight docs, structured knowledge, and MCP-powered agent workflows in one workspace. Assign work to humans or AI agents, give agents scoped API keys, keep every comment and status change attributed, and preserve reusable context for future work. There is also optional automatic code review on PRs with BYOK. Aruvi could be the perfect tool for you to assist in your loop engineering journey.
description_zh: Auvi将问题追踪、轻量级文档、结构化知识和基于MCP的智能体工作流整合于一个工作空间中。将任务分配给人类或AI智能体，为智能体提供受限范围的API密钥，保留每条评论和状态变更的归属记录，并保存可复用的上下文以供未来使用。还支持通过BYOK（自带密钥）对PR进行可选的自动代码审查。Auvi可能是你辅助循环工程之旅的完美工具。

name: Guau AI
tagline: AI veterinary assistant & virtual clinic for dog health
tagline_zh: 狗狗健康的AI兽医助手与虚拟诊所
description: Guau es tu asistente veterinario inteligente y clínica virtual con IA. Consulta con un veterinario especialista de inteligencia artificial, monitoriza la salud de tu perro y lleva su diario médico.
description_zh: Guau是你的智能AI兽医助手和虚拟诊所。与AI专家兽医咨询，监控你的狗狗健康，并记录其医疗日记。

name: Tinrec
tagline: One-click to generate meeting notes, actions, & docs.
tagline_zh: 一键生成会议纪要、行动项和文档。
description: Tinrec is a next-generation AI meeting assistant that quickly turns conversations, meetings, classes, and interviews into structured docs that are ready to read, share, and deliver. With smart AI transcription and generation, Tinrec supercharges info capture, content organizing, and team collaboration, ensuring every conversation delivers real value.
description_zh: Tinrec是一款下一代AI会议助手，能迅速将对话、会议、课程和访谈转化为结构化的文档，便于阅读、分享和交付。凭借智能AI转录与生成能力，Tinrec极大提升了信息捕获、内容整理及团队协作效率，确保每一次对话都能产生实际价值。

name: The Camel Calculator - AI Look Rater
tagline: AI rates your looks and tells you how to level up
tagline_zh: AI评估你的外貌并告诉你如何提升
description: Upload a selfie and an AI vision model rates your looks, style and clothing, then gives you specific, kind tips to level up your next photo. Your score is paid out in camels for fun. Free, no sign-up, in 30 languages. It also rates your overall vibe and fit.
description_zh: 上传一张自拍，AI视觉模型将对你的外貌、风格和着装进行评分，并提供具体、友善的提升建议，助你拍出更好的下一张照片。你的得分将以骆驼币形式发放，趣味十足。免费，无需注册，支持30种语言。它还能评估你的整体氛围感和穿搭契合度。

name: DeskTrust
tagline: AI daily work summaries for remote teams, not dashboards
tagline_zh: 面向远程团队的AI每日工作总结，而非数据仪表盘
description: DeskTrust uses AI to turn your team's daily activity into a plain-English work summary — what each person actually got done, not just hours logged. Get auto timesheets, an hour-by-hour breakdown, a live team dashboard, and client-ready reports. Built for agencies, staffing firms and remote teams who want clarity without micromanaging. Privacy-first with an employee pause control. Windows + macOS. 30-day free trial, from $4.99/seat.
description_zh: DeskTrust利用AI将团队成员的日常活动转化为通俗易懂的工作总结——展示每个人实际完成的工作，而不仅仅是记录的工时。提供自动生成的时间表、逐小时的工作分解、实时团队仪表盘以及面向客户的报告。专为希望在不微观管理的情况下获得清晰度的代理机构、人力资源公司和远程团队打造。隐私优先，员工可随时暂停记录。支持Windows和macOS。30天免费试用，起价$4.99/席位。

name: Swimio
tagline: AI swim coach with Apple Watch tracking & smart workouts
tagline_zh: AI 游泳教练，支持 Apple Watch 追踪与智能训练
description: Swimio combines AI coaching, advanced Apple Watch swim tracking, and personalized workout generation in one platform built specifically for swimmers. Create workouts tailored to your goals, follow them directly from your Apple Watch, track pace, SWOLF, stroke efficiency and heart rate, and get actionable performance insights after every session. Built for swimmers, coaches and teams who want more than a simple lap counter.
description_zh: Swimio 将 AI 教练、先进的 Apple Watch 游泳追踪和个性化训练生成整合于一款专为游泳者打造的平台。创建符合您目标的定制训练计划，直接从 Apple Watch 跟随执行，追踪配速、SWOLF、划水效率及心率，并在每次训练后获得可操作的性能洞察。专为寻求超越简单计圈功能的游泳者、教练和团队打造。

name: Buy by Agentcard
tagline: Order DoorDash from Claude
tagline_zh: 从 Claude 订购 DoorDash
description: you can now buy Doordash from Claude. connect Agentcard to your Openclaw, Claude or whatever you use, ask for what you want and we handle the rest. it feels magic. install from agentcard.sh and make your first order for free!
description_zh: 你现在可以通过 Claude 购买 Doordash。将 Agentcard 连接至你的 Openclaw、Claude 或其他工具，告知所需商品，剩下的交给我们。体验如魔法般便捷。从 agentcard.sh 安装，并免费完成首单！

name: prmpts
tagline: Save, organize and share AI prompts
tagline_zh: 保存、整理并分享 AI 提示词
description: prmpts.app is the fastest way to write, save, and share AI prompts. No sign-up. No bloat. Just open the editor, write (or let AI help), and get a shareable link that lasts 7 days (or forever with free signup). Perfect for prompt engineers, indie makers, developers, and heavy AI users who want to reuse their best prompts across Grok, Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, and more — without copying/pasting chaos. What’s different: Dead-simple, instant sharing, and focused purely on speed and collaboration.
description_zh: prmpts.app 是编写、保存和分享 AI 提示词的最快方式。无需注册，无冗余功能。只需打开编辑器，书写（或让 AI 协助），即可生成一个有效期为 7 天（免费注册可永久有效）的可分享链接。非常适合希望在 Grok、Claude、ChatGPT、Midjourney 等平台间复用最佳提示词的提示词工程师、独立开发者、开发人员及重度 AI 用户，告别复制粘贴的混乱。独特之处：极简、即时分享，专注于速度与协作。

name: ToneBridge
tagline: Rewrite work messages into the right tone, in 4 languages
tagline_zh: 将工作消息改写为合适的语气，支持 4 种语言
description: Working in a second language? The hard part isn't translation — it's tone. ToneBridge rewrites your draft into the right workplace tone across Korean, Japanese, English & Chinese, with 8 tone modes — and explains why. Free to start, right inside Gmail, Slack & LinkedIn.
description_zh: 使用第二语言工作？难点不在于翻译，而在于语气。ToneBridge 可将您的草稿改写为韩语、日语、英语和中文的恰当职场语气，提供 8 种语气模式并解释原因。在 Gmail、Slack 和 LinkedIn 内免费开始使用。

name: Selector
tagline: Copy precise UI context for AI coding agents
tagline_zh: 为 AI 编程代理复制精确的 UI 上下文
description: Selector is a tiny bookmarklet for people who build with AI coding agents. Click any UI element, copy one clean prompt, and paste it into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or any assistant. It captures the page route, stable locator, visible text, React component context when available, and just enough visual details to make the target unambiguous. No extension. No account. No backend. Just a small tool for pointing at the exact thing you want to change.
description_zh: Selector 是一款面向 AI 编程代理开发者的微型书签工具。点击任意 UI 元素，复制一条简洁的提示词，然后粘贴到 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 或任何助手程序中。它捕获页面路由、稳定定位器、可见文本以及可用的 React 组件上下文，并提供足够的视觉细节以确保目标明确无误。无需扩展程序，无需账户，无需后端。这是一款小巧的工具，用于精准指向您希望更改的目标。

name: ImmigrantA
tagline: UK immigration intelligence, grounded in official guidance.
tagline_zh: 英国移民情报，基于官方指南。
description: UK immigration rules are complex, fragmented, and constantly changing. Immigranta is an AI assistant that helps applicants, sponsors, lawyers, and recruiters get answers faster. Ask questions in plain English and receive responses grounded in official UK immigration sources, complete with citations and links you can verify. No guessing. No hallucinations. Just trusted, source-backed immigration guidance when you need it. 🚀
description_zh: 英国移民规则复杂、分散且不断变化。Immigranta 是一款 AI 助手，帮助申请人、担保方、律师和招聘人员更快获得答案。用通俗英语提问，即可获取基于英国官方移民来源的回答，并附带可验证的引用和链接。无需猜测，杜绝幻觉。为您提供值得信赖、有源可查的移民指导。🚀

name: Compliance AI
tagline: AI audit reports for SOX, SOC 2, and ISO 27001
tagline_zh: 适用于 SOX、SOC 2 和 ISO 27001 的 AI 审计报告
description: Codify Compliance AI analyzes any control description against SOX, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST 800-53, CIS Controls, and PCI-DSS — and returns a structured audit report in under 20 seconds. Every report includes: risk score, audit opinion, key risks, control gaps, remediation recommendations, and framework alignment. Free to start. Startup ($99/mo) and Enterprise ($499/mo) plans available.Compliance. Simplify Audits.
description_zh: Codify Compliance AI 将任何控制描述与 SOX、ISO 27001、SOC 2、NIST 800-53、CIS Controls 和 PCI-DSS 进行比对——并在 20 秒内返回结构化的审计报告。每份报告均包含：风险评分、审计意见、关键风险、控制缺口、整改建议及框架对齐情况。免费试用。提供初创版（$99/月）和企业版（$499/月）计划。合规。简化审计。

name: UGCBundle
tagline: 100s of UGC videos for promoting your app
tagline_zh: 数百条用于推广您应用的 UGC 视频
description: Download 100+ authentic human reaction clips for TikTok and Meta ads. No AI avatars. No creator wait times. From $19. Instant ZIP download with commercial license.
description_zh: 下载 100 多个真实的人类反应片段，用于 TikTok 和 Meta 广告。无 AI 虚拟形象。无创作者等待时间。低至 $19。即时 ZIP 下载，含商业授权。

name: check3000
tagline: AI analysis for your business idea — honest & fast
tagline_zh: 为您的商业创意提供 AI 分析——诚实且快速
description: AI-powered analysis for business ideas, products and markets. Evaluate opportunities, risks and competition over 5, 10 or 20 years – instantly, without an agency.
description_zh: AI 驱动的商业创意、产品和市场分析。在 5 年、10 年或 20 年的时间跨度内即时评估机会、风险和竞争——无需代理机构。

name: Joinways
tagline: The event CRM that fills itself out.
tagline_zh: 自动填充数据的活动 CRM。
description: Centralize event inquiries, plan bookings, send quotes and e-signatures from one platform built for venues. Book more events. Free 30-day trial, no card.
description_zh: 集中管理活动咨询、预订规划、报价发送和电子签名，专为场地打造的一站式平台。预订更多活动。免费 30 天试用，无需信用卡。

name: SherlockX
tagline: Reverse Image Search iPhone — Search by Image Online
tagline_zh: 反向图片搜索 iPhone — 在线以图搜图
description: Use SherlockX to run a reverse image search on iPhone. Upload a photo, find where it appears online, and check for reused images, possible AI fakes, and objects — no app required.
description_zh: 使用 SherlockX 在 iPhone 上进行反向图片搜索。上传照片，查找其在网上的出现位置，并检查是否有重复使用的图片、可能的 AI 伪造内容以及物体识别——无需安装任何应用。

name: Promptozia.ai
tagline: Ready to use workflows for real business tasks
tagline_zh: 开箱即用的工作流，满足真实业务需求
description: Access 1000+ AI prompts, templates and workflows for marketing, sales, operations, content creation and education. Free during early access.
description_zh: 访问 1000+ 个 AI 提示词、模板和工作流，涵盖营销、销售、运营、内容创作和教育领域。早期访问期间免费。

name: Formward
tagline: EU-hosted form backend — GDPR-clean, no data leaves Europe
tagline_zh: 欧盟托管的表单后端——符合 GDPR 标准，数据不出欧洲
description: Formward is an EU-hosted form backend for developer who care about privacy. Point your HTML form at a Frmward endpoint — it catches submissions, filters spm, sends email alerts, and stores results on Swedishinfrastructure. No data leaves Europe. GDPR-compliat by design. AI enrichment. No JavaScript required. ree tier available. Perfect for EU-based companies nd developers who can't send form data through US-baed services.
description_zh: Formward 是一款面向注重隐私的开发者的欧盟托管表单后端。将您的 HTML 表单指向 Formward 端点——它可捕获提交内容、过滤垃圾邮件、发送电子邮件警报，并将结果存储在瑞典基础设施上。数据不会离开欧洲。设计之初即符合 GDPR 规范。支持 AI 增强功能。无需 JavaScript。提供免费层级。非常适合无法通过美国服务发送表单数据的欧盟企业和开发者。

name: Aihoo.app
tagline: We are alunching the Aihoo.app Free GEO Audit
tagline_zh: 我们即将推出 Aihoo.app 免费 GEO 审计
description: Aihoo.app is the leading Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) platform. Automatically optimize your website to be discovered, cited, and recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude. Aihoo.app é a melhor plataforma em GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). Otimize seu site para aparecer no ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini e Claude de forma automática.
description_zh: Aihoo.app 是领先的生成式引擎优化（GEO）平台。自动优化您的网站，使其被 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini 和 Claude 发现、引用和推荐。Aihoo.app 是最佳的 GEO（生成式引擎优化）平台。自动优化您的网站，使其出现在 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini 和 Claude 中。

name: Blinx
tagline: Blinx: UX feedback in minutes from a synthetic user
tagline_zh: Blinx：几分钟内从合成用户处获得 UX 反馈
description: Drop in a URL or a screenshot, and Blinx sends a synthetic user through your interface, records a short video of them navigating and thinking aloud, and returns a heuristic findings report grounded in the Nielsen Norman heuristics. It's the UX feedback you get between research cycles: fast enough to run before a design review, and specific enough to act on. Works on live sites, gated pages (via screenshot), and Figma mockups.
description_zh: 输入一个 URL 或截图，Blinx 会派遣一个合成用户浏览您的界面，录制其导航过程及出声思考的短视频，并返回基于尼尔森诺曼启发式原则的发现报告。这是您在研究周期之间获得的 UX 反馈：足够快，可在设计评审前运行；足够具体，可立即采取行动。适用于实时网站、受保护页面（通过截图）和 Figma 原型。

name: Framecast
tagline: Turn Claude HTML animations into clean, watermark-free video
tagline_zh: 将 Claude HTML 动画转化为干净、无水印的视频
description: Turn Claude HTML animations into clean, watermark-free video — rendered frame-by-frame for YouTube, TikTok & Reels. One drop, every format. From $2.99.
description_zh: 将 Claude HTML 动画转化为干净、无水印的视频——逐帧渲染，适用于 YouTube、TikTok 和 Reels。一键投放，全格式支持。低至 $2.99。

name: onCall
tagline: One Stop Solulution For Meeting Analysis
tagline_zh: 会议分析一站式解决方案
description: onCall auto-joins your Zoom and Meet sales calls, researches prospects first, and scores every deal 0–100 with MEDDIC, SPIN, or BANT — minutes after you hang up.
description_zh: onCall 自动加入您的 Zoom 和 Meet 销售通话，提前调研潜在客户，并在您挂断后几分钟内使用 MEDDIC、SPIN 或 BANT 方法为每个商机打分（0-100）。

name: Streamr AI
tagline: Experience people treating you better with AI.
tagline_zh: 体验 AI 带来的更优人际对待。
description: Streamr AI is an app that lets you have a fake hyper-realistic AI live stream with an accurate AI live chat that can see and hear you, and you can change the number of viewers watching. Showing this to people will make them think you are a truly famous, therefore you get treated as a famous person. People will treat you differently in very extreme ways, extreme ways that the average person cannot experience. This project is currently viral on social media.
description_zh: Streamr AI 是一款应用，让您能够进行虚假但高度逼真的 AI 直播，并拥有能看能听的精准 AI 实时聊天，您还可以调整观看人数。向他人展示此功能会让他们以为您是真正的名人，从而以名人般的待遇对待您。人们会以极端且普通人无法体验的方式改变对待您的态度。该项目目前在社交媒体上病毒式传播。

name: Sotto
tagline: Never forget a memory again. Just speak.
tagline_zh: 从此不再遗忘记忆。只需开口说话。
description: Sotto is a private voice journal for people who think out loud. Press record, speak naturally, and Sotto transcribes and structures your thoughts into reflections, mood, and tags automatically. Choose Offline mode (Vosk, on-device, zero network) or Accurate mode (Groq Whisper, Zero Data Retention). Encrypted local storage. No ads, no tracking, no account. Built solo with Kotlin Multiplatform. English + Hindi supported, more languages coming.
description_zh: Sotto 是一款专为习惯自言自语的人设计的私密语音日记应用。按下录音键，自然表达，Sotto 会自动将您的想法转录并整理为反思、情绪和标签。可选择离线模式（Vosk，设备端运行，零网络）或高精度模式（Groq Whisper，零数据留存）。加密本地存储。无广告，无追踪，无需注册账号。由个人开发者使用 Kotlin Multiplatform 构建。支持英语和印地语，更多语言即将上线。

name: PulseAgent
tagline: The Analyst Who Never Sleeps
tagline_zh: 永不疲倦的分析师
description: PulseAgent is an autonomous AI analytics agent that watches your metrics 24/7, learns your baselines, and sends you a sharp daily briefing with "what changed and what to do about it." What it does: Monitors GA4, Stripe, and custom APIs 24/7 Learns your normal patterns no config needed Catches anomalies before users do Delivers a daily digest with ranked insights and suggested actions Pricing: Free forever for small teams. Pro at $29/mo (launch discount — 50% off for the first 100 signups)
description_zh: PulseAgent 是一个自主 AI 分析代理，全天候监控您的指标，学习您的基准线，并向您发送每日简报，明确指出“发生了什么变化”以及“该如何应对”。主要功能：全天候监控 GA4、Stripe 和自定义 API；无需配置即可学习您的正常行为模式；在用户之前发现异常；提供包含排名洞察和建议行动的每日摘要。定价：小型团队永久免费。专业版每月 $29（首发折扣：前 100 名注册用户享 50% 优惠）

name: PicRedo:AI Photo Editor
tagline: AI photo,photo editor,retouch
tagline_zh: AI 照片, 照片编辑器, 修图
description: Turn one photo into polished AI edits, portraits, product shots, headshots, styles, makeovers and creative images in seconds.
description_zh: 只需几秒，将一张照片转化为精美的 AI 编辑作品、人像、产品摄影、头像、风格化图像、造型改造和创意图片。

name: Vinkius
tagline: mcp, mcp servers, ai infrastructure, claude, ai agents
tagline_zh: mcp, mcp 服务器, AI 基础设施, claude, AI 智能体
description: 5,100+ MCP servers for Claude, Cursor, and every AI tool. One-click setup, built-in security, and full control over how your AI connects.
description_zh: 为 Claude、Cursor 及所有 AI 工具提供 5,100+ MCP 服务器。一键设置，内置安全性，全面掌控 AI 的连接方式。

name: Prospector by Synter
tagline: Your outbound agent, right inside Slack
tagline_zh: 您的外展智能体，就在 Slack 内
description: Nobody likes dashboards. So we built Prospector instead — an outbound agent that lives in Slack. Just ask: How are my campaigns doing? Who engaged with this post and is worth reaching out to? It reads your outbound, builds lists from real engagement, and answers in a sentence. Prospector runs outbound, Synter runs paid media, and they share the same audiences. Try it: /prospector /pipeline /campaigns /contacts /report
description_zh: 没人喜欢仪表盘。所以我们构建了 Prospector——一个驻留在 Slack 中的外展智能体。只需提问：我的活动表现如何？谁与这篇帖子互动且值得联系？它读取您的外展数据，基于真实互动构建名单，并用一句话回答。Prospector 负责外展，Synter 负责付费媒体，两者共享同一受众群。试试：/prospector /pipeline /campaigns /contacts /report

description_zh: ComplyAgent 帮助中小企业在不产生六位数咨询费的情况下，符合欧盟 AI 法案、NIST AI RMF 和 ISO 42001 标准。盘点您的 AI 资产，对每个系统进行一次性分类，获取审计就绪文档及 AI 素养培训。试用免费的风险分类器，无需注册。

name: Nexus Command™
tagline: AI leadership intelligence for restaurant managers
tagline_zh: 面向餐厅经理的 AI 领导力情报
description: Nexus Command is an AI-powered leadership platform built exclusively for restaurant operations professionals. The Helios Leadership Suite runs five intelligence modules that activate automatically based on what a manager describes — conflict resolution, accountability coaching, daily debriefs, operations analysis, and high-stakes decision support. No commands. No prompts. Just describe the situation. Built from 28 years in restaurant operations.
description_zh: Nexus Command 是专为餐厅运营专业人士打造的 AI 驱动领导力平台。Helios Leadership Suite 运行五个智能模块，根据经理描述的情况自动激活——包括冲突解决、问责辅导、每日复盘、运营分析和高风险决策支持。无需指令，无需提示词。只需描述情况。基于 28 年餐厅运营经验打造。

name: Sidenote
tagline: Chat with any doc in your browser — every answer cited
tagline_zh: 在浏览器中与任何文档对话——每个答案均附带引用
description: An AI reading assistant in your browser. Ask any PDF, doc or wiki a question — Confluence, Notion, Google Docs, arXiv — and every answer cites the exact passage. Click a citation, the page scrolls to it. If the doc doesn't answer, it says so.
description_zh: 浏览器中的AI阅读助手。向任何PDF、文档或Wiki提问——Confluence、Notion、Google Docs、arXiv——每个答案都会引用确切段落。点击引用，页面自动滚动至对应位置。如果文档无法回答，它会明确告知。

name: MartechAI by Derail Logic
tagline: AI-powered marketing workspace for growing teams
tagline_zh: 专为成长型团队打造的AI驱动营销工作区
description: MartechAI is an AI-powered marketing workspace for growing teams, agencies, and small businesses. It connects campaigns, CRM, content, email, landing pages, SEO, analytics, social workflows, tasks, and AI-assisted insights in one platform so teams can reduce tool sprawl, improve visibility, and manage marketing execution with more clarity.
description_zh: MartechAI是专为成长型团队、代理机构和小企业打造的AI驱动营销工作区。它将营销活动、CRM、内容、电子邮件、落地页、SEO、分析、社交工作流、任务和AI辅助洞察整合在一个平台中，帮助团队减少工具冗余，提高可见性，并更清晰地管理营销执行。

name: Regret Later
tagline: An AI lawyer that defends your worst ideas in court
tagline_zh: 一个在法庭上为你最糟糕的主意辩护的AI律师
description: Regret Later is the Court of Questionable Decisions. Type your bad idea — "text my ex at 2am", "put my savings into a memecoin" — and an AI lawyer argues FOR it (😈 defense) or AGAINST it (😇 prosecution), with a verdict, confidence score, and a dramatic closing statement. Free, no login. $2.99 unlocks the Full Brief: extra arguments, a closing statement, and a downloadable "Official Court Brief" PDF.
description_zh: Regret Later（事后后悔）是“可疑决定法院”。输入你的坏主意——比如“凌晨两点给前任发短信”、“把积蓄投入迷因币”——AI律师会为之辩护（😈 辩护方）或反对（😇 控诉方），并提供判决、置信度和一段戏剧性的结案陈词。免费，无需登录。2.99美元解锁完整简报：额外论点、结案陈词以及可下载的“官方法院简报”PDF。

tagline_zh: 24/7为您的美容客户预订服务的AI助手

Transparent: it says it's an AI and hands tricky cases to a person. Includes a commission-free booking page on your own domain.
description_zh: Cleo是专为美容院和培训机构打造的AI助手。它在Instagram、Messenger、WhatsApp、短信和电子邮件上在一分钟内回复客户私信，24/7全天候服务——了解您的优惠和日程安排，并将对话转化为预约报名或课程注册。透明公开：它会表明自己是AI，并将棘手案例转交人工处理。包含您自有域名上的免佣金预订页面。

name: Pura Vox: Private Offline Voice Diary
tagline: Record your daily thoughts and moods instantly with voice.
tagline_zh: 使用语音即时记录您的每日想法和情绪。
description: Built with full offline AI transcription, all your voice notes and text stay locally on your iPhone permanently.Noaccount sign up, no ads, no hidden data tracking. Core Features One-tap voice recording with built-in offline AI transcription Real-time voice emotion recognition while speaking Anytime voice playback to listen back to your inner thoughts Attach photos, generate exclusive journal stamps and build your personal stamp wall Your personal journal deserves full privacy.
description_zh: 内置全离线AI转录功能，所有语音笔记和文本永久保留在您的iPhone本地。无需注册账户，无广告，无隐藏数据追踪。核心功能：一键录音并内置离线AI转录；说话时实时识别语音情绪；随时回放语音以重温内心想法；可附加照片、生成专属日记印章并打造个人印章墙；您的私人日记值得拥有完全隐私。

tagline_zh: 签证申请AI代理
description: VisaPod is an AI agent for complex visa applications, starting with the U.S. DS-160. It turns documents into a complete, review-ready form, checks missing information upfront, and fills the real CEAC workflow end to end.
description_zh: VisaPod是一款面向复杂签证申请的AI代理，从美国DS-160表格开始。它将文档转化为完整且可供审查的表单，提前检查缺失信息，并端到端地填充真实的CEAC工作流程。

name: Tunect Labs

description_zh: Tunect Labs — 为全球组织提供企业级软件工程、QA自动化、AI解决方案及全栈开发服务。

Build collections, environments, mocks, assertions, and execution plans across Desktop, Web, VS Code, CLI, and MCP. Workspaces live as JSON you can diff, review, and sync through Git — while Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and ChatGPT can read, author, and run requests through MCP. Source-available, local-first, and built for API teams that want ownership.
description_zh: API Circle Studio是一个基于Git、原生AI的API工作区，专为开发者打造。可在桌面端、Web端、VS Code、CLI和MCP上构建集合、环境、模拟数据、断言和执行计划。工作区以JSON形式存在，可通过Git进行差异对比、审查和同步——同时Claude、Cursor、Copilot和ChatGPT可通过MCP读取、编写和执行请求。源码可用，本地优先，专为追求掌控权的API团队打造。

name: HiredSmartly
tagline: Brutally honest AI resume review in 60 seconds @ only $1
tagline_zh: 60秒内 brutally honest（直言不讳）的AI简历评估，仅需$1
description: Most resume tools either cost $50+ or give you generic tips that don't help. HiredSmartly gives you a real AI review, scored across 10 recruiter checkpoints, in just 60 seconds. Not just a spell check. A full breakdown: ATS score, impact score, formatting, keyword alignment, and 3 specific fixes ranked by priority. Built for US, UK, UAE, Australia, India job markets. Each review is calibrated for your target country's hiring norms. One dollar. No subscription. Download your results as PDF.
description_zh: 大多数简历工具要么收费50美元以上，要么仅提供无用的通用建议。HiredSmartly能在短短60秒内为您提供真正的AI评估，涵盖招聘人员关注的10个关键检查点。这不仅仅是拼写检查，而是全面分析：ATS评分、影响力评分、格式、关键词匹配度以及按优先级排序的3项具体修改建议。针对美国、英国、阿联酋、澳大利亚和印度就业市场量身定制。每次评估均根据目标国家的招聘规范进行校准。1美元，无订阅费。可将结果下载为PDF。

name: MusicAny

tagline_zh: MusicAny将文本提示转化为原创歌曲
description: MusicAny is an AI music generator and AI song generator for original songs, background music, and AI music videos. Try a free AI music generator online for creators.
description_zh: MusicAny是一款AI音乐生成器和AI歌曲生成器，可创作原创歌曲、背景音乐和AI音乐视频。为创作者提供免费在线AI音乐生成器试用。

name: NervoScan

tagline_zh: 通过MCP为任何AI智能体提供非接触式生命体征监测
description: Non-contact heart rate, HRV, blood pressure & more from a 10-second face scan. No wearables, works in your browser.
description_zh: 通过10秒面部扫描实现非接触式心率、HRV、血压等监测。无需穿戴设备，直接在浏览器中运行。

tagline_zh: 您探索快速增长的AI生态系统的指南

The platform continuously scans the AI ecosystem to surface emerging tools, use cases, and workflows. Submitted tools can gain visibility through directory listings, comparisons, rankings, news coverage, and editorial content, helping AI companies reach founders, marketers, developers, and early adopters.
description_zh: AiToolsObserver通过精选列表、洞察分析和趋势研究，帮助用户发现、比较和评估AI工具。该平台持续扫描AI生态系统，展示新兴工具、用例和工作流。提交的工具可通过目录列表、比较、排名、新闻报道和编辑内容获得曝光，帮助AI公司触达创始人、营销人员、开发人员和早期采用者。

name: Jaiton Technologies

tagline_zh: 班加罗尔网站开发服务
description: Jaiton Technologies provides AI solutions, IoT systems, cloud applications, UI/UX design, and custom software development services for startups and enterprises worldwide.
description_zh: Jaiton Technologies为全球初创企业和企业提供AI解决方案、物联网系统、云应用、UI/UX设计和定制软件开发服务。

name: NxtLure
tagline: AI Search Visibility Engine

description_zh: TicketReel 集成于您的 Intercom 收件箱中，自动将已解决的客服工单转化为带有品牌标识的 AI 虚拟人视频演示文稿——全自动完成。解决工单，点击“生成”，即可获得一段 60 秒的讲解视频，字幕已嵌入其中，随时可发送给客户或直接发布至帮助中心。无需屏幕录制，无需网络摄像头，无需剪辑，无需打开新标签页。您的团队继续在 Intercom 中按现有方式工作——TicketReel 确保每次解决方案都成为可复用的资产。

name: Meeyra
tagline: Real-time AI translator for your online meetings
tagline_zh: 在线会议实时 AI 翻译器
description: Meeyra translates live speech in meetings — no bots, no app switching, no delays. Just share a link. Guests join from any browser instantly. Your words translate across 42+ languages in real time as you speak. Built for global teams, educators, and anyone who's struggled with language barriers in meetings. ✓ Real-time speech-to-text translation ✓ Live captions & full transcription ✓ End-to-end encrypted sessions ✓ No download required for guests Small team. v1.0. 🌍
description_zh: Meeyra 在会议中实时翻译语音——无需机器人，无需切换应用，无需延迟。只需分享链接。宾客可从任何浏览器即时加入。您说话的同时，您的话语即可在 42 多种语言间实时互译。专为全球团队、教育工作者以及曾受会议语言障碍困扰的人士打造。✓ 实时语音转文字翻译 ✓ 实时字幕及完整转录 ✓ 端到端加密会话 ✓ 宾客无需下载 小型团队。v1.0。🌍

name: Germany Copilot AI
tagline: AI assistant for migrants in Germany
tagline_zh: 德国移民 AI 助手
description: 🇩🇪 AI Assistant for Life in Germany
description_zh: 🇩🇪 德国生活 AI 助手

name: Voxxhire
tagline: AI interviews, CV tools & career prep — speak your way in.
tagline_zh: AI 面试、简历工具与职业准备——用语言表达你的优势。
description: Most interview prep is passive. Voxxhire makes it active. Practice voice interviews with AI feedback, scan your CV against ATS filters, check your job-fit score before you apply, and generate cover letters that actually match the role. Built for candidates who want to walk into interviews prepared, not just hopeful. Coming soon: structured AI-assisted interviews for hiring teams, with every decision staying in the hands of your HR team.
description_zh: 大多数面试准备是被动式的。Voxxhire 使其变为主动式。通过 AI 反馈练习语音面试，根据 ATS 过滤器扫描您的简历，在申请前检查职位匹配度分数，并生成真正符合职位要求的求职信。专为希望带着充分准备而非仅凭希望走进面试的求职者打造。即将推出：为招聘团队提供结构化的 AI 辅助面试，所有决策权仍掌握在您的人力资源团队手中。

name: Baseline
tagline: The qualitative foundation for your thesis
tagline_zh: 你论文质的基础
description: Chatbot equity research is piecemeal, where you ask a tool about a company and receive an answer in isolation. Baseline, first developed internally by a family office, runs research across 3,500+ stocks and scores them on a comparable rubric. Research is pre-packaged, standardized, and built on optimized prompts, so you're not re-running the same analysis a chatbot makes you rebuild. For time constrained buy-side investors, it also highlights the long tail of overlooked quality SMID cap stocks.
description_zh: 聊天机器人的股票研究是零散的，你向工具询问一家公司的情况，得到的回答也是孤立的。Baseline最初由家族办公室内部开发，对3500多只股票进行研究，并使用可比标准对其进行评分。研究内容经过预打包和标准化，基于优化后的提示词构建，因此你无需像使用聊天机器人那样反复重建相同的分析。对于时间有限的买方投资者，它还突出了被忽视的优质中小盘股的长尾效应。

name: LocalBlox — Done
tagline: Done-for-you marketing kits for local businesses
tagline_zh: 为本地企业量身定制的营销套件
description: LocalBlox is a done-for-you marketing kit built specifically for local businesses. Unlike complex marketing software or expensive agencies, LocalBlox provides ready-to-use landing page copy, Instagram captions, and email marketing templates in one package. Designed for restaurants, salons, and gyms, it helps business owners launch campaigns faster, save time, and focus on growing their business.
description_zh: LocalBlox是专为本地企业打造的即用型营销套件。与复杂的营销软件或昂贵的代理商不同，LocalBlox在一个包中提供现成的落地页文案、Instagram配文和电子邮件营销模板。专为餐厅、美容院和健身房设计，它帮助企业主更快地启动营销活动，节省时间，并专注于业务增长。

name: Craft Widgets
tagline: Playable and custom widgets for your iPhone Home Screen
tagline_zh: iPhone主屏幕的可玩性和自定义小部件
description: Craft Widgets turns your iPhone and iPad Home Screen into something personal: 500+ ready-made widgets, playable widgets like 2048 and Sudoku, Lock Screen and StandBy widgets, plus a visual editor with layers, fonts, colors, and AI so you can design your own.
description_zh: Craft Widgets让你的iPhone和iPad主屏幕变得个性化：500多个现成小部件，包括2048和数独等可玩小部件，锁屏和StandBy小部件，以及带有图层、字体、颜色和AI功能的可视化编辑器，让你可以设计自己的小部件。

name: SerpDo
tagline: One click. Claude boosts your SEO.
tagline_zh: 一键点击，Claude提升你的SEO。
description: Connects to your Google Search Console and gives you an SEO-focused prompt to fix your site's biggest issues. I got tired of "unactionable" GSC data. So I made SerpDo to connect to your GSC, read your traffic, and tell you exactly what to fix today. Not some vague "report". A real task list. It finds pages losing clicks, spots low CTR issues, flags keyword cannibalization, scores your pages, and drafts the content fixes you need. Free to try. No GSC experience needed.
description_zh: 连接你的Google Search Console，并提供一个专注于SEO的提示词，以修复网站的最大问题。我对“无法操作”的GSC数据感到厌倦。所以我制作了SerpDo，它可以连接你的GSC，读取你的流量，并告诉你今天具体要修复什么。不是那种模糊的“报告”，而是一份真正的任务清单。它发现点击量下降的页面，指出低CTR问题，标记关键词自我竞争，对你的页面进行评分，并起草你需要的内容修复方案。免费试用。无需GSC经验。

name: Devpilot
tagline: A simpler way to manage infrastructure and DevOps workflows
tagline_zh: 更简单的基础设施和DevOps工作流管理方式
description: Devpilot is an AI-powered platform for managing deployments, infrastructure, and DevOps workflows from one place. It automates routine tasks, reduces manual setup, and helps teams scale without complex configurations. Built for founders and engineers who want to ship faster without handling infrastructure overhead.
description_zh: Devpilot是一个AI驱动的平台，用于从一处管理部署、基础设施和DevOps工作流。它自动化常规任务，减少手动设置，帮助团队在不进行复杂配置的情况下扩展规模。专为希望在不处理基础设施开销的情况下更快交付产品的创始人和工程师打造。

name: Investhesis
tagline: Value any stock by yourself — now inside your AI
tagline_zh: 亲自评估任何股票的价值——现在就在你的AI中
description: A real equity analysis — DCF, reverse-DCF, multiples, ROIC/WACC, forensic accounting, an institutional-grade thesis Retail investors just don't have that, so most "research" is a vibe and a headline. • A multi-method valuation where you control every assumption (growth, margins, WACC) — not a black box. • 160 forensic accounting checks — Altman Z (bankruptcy), Beneish M (earnings manipulation), Piotroski F — the stuff that flags the next blow-up. • An AI-written investment thesis
description_zh: 真正的股权分析——DCF、反向DCF、倍数法、ROIC/WACC、法务会计，以及机构级的投资论点。散户投资者通常不具备这些资源，因此大多数“研究”只是凭感觉和标题。• 多方法估值，由你控制所有假设（增长率、利润率、WACC）——而非黑箱。• 160项法务会计检查——Altman Z（破产风险）、Beneish M（盈余操纵）、Piotroski F——用于标记下一次崩盘的关键指标。• AI撰写的投资论点

name: LinkMagnet
tagline: Auto-deliver your lead magnet to everyone who comments
tagline_zh: 自动将你的引流内容发送给所有评论者
description: Someone comments your keyword on your LinkedIn post → LinkMagnet DMs them your resource in under 10 minutes, 24/7. Inbound and opt-in only (no cold DMs, no scraping). 5-min setup, account-safe pacing, real-time tracking.
description_zh: 有人在你的LinkedIn帖子中评论了你的关键词→LinkMagnet在10分钟内通过私信向他们发送你的资源，全年无休。仅限入站和自愿订阅（无冷私信，无抓取）。5分钟设置，账户安全节奏，实时跟踪。

name: Quorum — Multi-LLM Starter Kit
tagline: Ship AI that doesn't hallucinate. 11 LLMs vote.
tagline_zh: 交付不产生幻觉的AI。11个LLM投票决定。
description: Next.js boilerplate: 11-LLM semantic consensus, EU AI Act Art. 12+13 audit cert generator, opt-in HSP fail-closed gate. Stripe billing + magic-link auth + 4 vertical examples. Real code, not a demo — fork it Friday, ship Monday.
description_zh: Next.js样板代码：11个LLM语义共识、欧盟《人工智能法案》第12+13条审计证书生成器、自愿HSP故障关闭网关。Stripe计费+魔法链接认证+4个垂直领域示例。真实代码，而非演示——周五分叉，周一上线。

name: Voleeo
tagline: The local-first client for the AI era.
tagline_zh: AI时代的本地优先客户端。
description: Voleeo is the local-first API client built for the AI era. Native, private (data never leaves your machine), multi-protocol: HTTP, gRPC, WebSocket, GraphQL in one app. Built-in MCP server so AI agents drive your API testing. MIT-licensed, free.
description_zh: Voleeo是专为AI时代构建的本地优先API客户端。原生、私密（数据永不离开你的机器），支持多协议：HTTP、gRPC、WebSocket、GraphQL，一个应用搞定。内置MCP服务器，让AI代理驱动你的API测试。MIT许可，免费。

name: AXIS AI
tagline: Custom automation for B2B operations.
tagline_zh: 为B2B运营定制自动化方案。
description: AXIS AI builds custom automation systems for B2B companies on Make.com, n8n, and custom APIs. We handle the workflows your team repeats every day: lead response, CRM updates, follow-ups, onboarding, invoicing, reporting. Fixed-scope projects starting at $1,500, delivered in one to four weeks. No hourly billing, no bloated retainers. Every client works directly with the founder. Three free tools on our site if you want to see how we think before booking anything.
description_zh: AXIS AI在Make.com、n8n和自定义API上为B2B公司构建定制自动化系统。我们处理团队每天重复的工作流程：潜在客户响应、CRM更新、跟进、入职、发票开具、报告。固定范围项目起价1,500美元，一到四周内交付。无按小时计费，无臃肿的长期合同。每位客户都直接与创始人合作。我们的网站上提供三个免费工具，让你在购买前了解我们的思维方式。

name: OBaI
tagline: AI research desk to learn, backtest, and invest smarter.
tagline_zh: AI研究台，助力学习、回测与智能投资。
description: Retail investors don’t have an information problem. They have a research bottleneck. OBaI gives them a self-hosted AI research desk: eight specialist agents for technicals, fundamentals, options, quant research, screening, and backtesting. Ask one plain-English question from the CLI, watch agents work live in the Web UI, and get one coordinated answer. Open-source. Local-first. Your data stays on your machine except the APIs you configure.
description_zh: 散户投资者不缺信息，缺的是研究能力。OBaI为他们提供自托管的AI研究台：八个专业智能体分别负责技术分析、基本面分析、期权、量化研究、筛选和回测。通过命令行用自然语言提问，在Web界面实时观察智能体工作，并获得一份协调一致的答案。开源。本地优先。除你配置的API外，数据保留在你的设备上。

name: Qovlo
tagline: One Workflow for Every Team
tagline_zh: 一个工作流，适用于所有团队
description: Run planning, people operations, approvals, docs, payments, and decisions from one business-friendly workspace.
description_zh: 在一个对业务友好的工作空间中，统一管理规划、人事运营、审批、文档、付款和决策。

name: HearthNet
tagline: community AI mesh that works offline
tagline_zh: 可离线运行的社区AI网状网络
description: Imagine the internet cable in your neighbourhood gets cut. Right now, that means no Google, no ChatGPT, no maps, no marketplace, no messaging. The cloud goes silent. HearthNet changes that. It's a local AI mesh that turns local devices in your neighbourhood — your gaming PC, your neighbour's old laptop, the Pi in someone's attic — into a shared, resilient AI cooperative. The answer is generated locally, three streets away. The cloud owns AI today. Communities will own it tomorrow.
description_zh: 想象一下，你所在街区的互联网电缆被切断。现在，这意味着无法使用Google、ChatGPT、地图、市场或即时通讯。云端陷入沉寂。HearthNet改变了这一现状。它是一个本地AI网状网络，将街区内的本地设备——你的游戏PC、邻居的旧笔记本电脑、阁楼里的树莓派——转化为共享且具韧性的AI合作社。答案在三个街区外本地生成。如今，云端掌控AI；未来，社区将拥有它。

name: WarMap

tagline_zh: 带有AI风险情报的全球实时冲突地图
description: Track real-time military conflicts, country risk levels, and geopolitical events on an interactive map. Risk assessments for 90+ countries, military power comparison, and live event tracking.
description_zh: 在交互式地图上追踪实时军事冲突、国家风险级别和地缘政治事件。涵盖90多个国家的风险评估、军事实力对比以及实时事件跟踪。

Search jobs across 10+ portals worldwide 2. AI generates individual cover letters 3. Automatically attaches your resume, certificates & photo • International: USA, UK, EU, Remote • Multi-language: DE, EN, FR • 2FA & Quantum encryption • GDPR compliant Try it now: https://xsikom-bewerbungsbot.onrender.com
description_zh: 🤖 XsiKOM BewerbungBOT是首款配备3个专业AI机器人的求职助手：AALIYAH - 你的个人AI职业顾问，XSI - 自动发送申请并附带PDF文件✨1. 在全球10多个门户搜索职位 2. AI生成个性化求职信 3. 自动附上简历、证书和照片 • 国际覆盖：美国、英国、欧盟、远程办公 • 多语言支持：德语、英语、法语 • 双重认证与量子加密 • 符合GDPR规定 立即试用：https://xsikom-bewerbungsbot.onrender.com

name: AIQORA

tagline_zh: 为开发者精心策划的AI工具、提示词和实时信号。
description: The hand-curated AI intelligence hub for serious builders. Browse 166+ AI tools, copy from 225+ tested prompts, run an LLM cost calculator across 13 models, take a 5-Q quiz to find your stack, and stay current with live AI news. Free to start. EN / العربية / 中文.

name: Grade9Plus

tagline_zh: 为英国学生提供的免费AI驱动GCSE复习工具
description: Grade9Plus is a completely free GCSE revision app for UK students. Features: - Practice quizzes across 11 subjects - AI Examiner — essays marked like a real examiner instantly - Mock exams with real exam conditions - Flashcards and revision notes - Predicted 2027 exam questions - No signup required Built by IRA TECH SOLUTIONS LTD. Android app coming soon!
description_zh: Grade9Plus是一款完全免费的英国学生GCSE复习应用。功能包括：覆盖11个科目的练习测验、AI考官（即时按真实考官标准批改作文）、模拟真实考试条件的模拟考试、闪卡和复习笔记、预测2027年考题。无需注册。由IRA TECH SOLUTIONS LTD开发。Android版即将上线！

name: LogLens
tagline: No yapping. Clean python fix. Good for newbies
tagline_zh: 不废话。纯净Python修复。适合新手。
description: Point your phone at any Python error. Get a human-verified fix and a clear explanation - instantly. No login, no guesses, no AI nonsense.
description_zh: 将手机对准任何Python错误。即刻获取人工验证的修复方案和清晰解释——无需登录，无需猜测，拒绝AI胡扯。

name: Tutary
tagline: The calm home base for independent tutors
tagline_zh: 独立导师的宁静大本营
description: Tutary is the calm home base for independent tutors. The moment a lesson ends, one flow handles everything: a structured note, homework, payment, and an AI-drafted parent update you send on WhatsApp in a tap — all in under 2 minutes. Student profiles remember weak areas and what to focus on next. Payment tracking, prepaid packages, and a reusable lesson library round it out. Mobile-first, works offline. Free for up to 3 students, no card.
description_zh: Tutary是独立导师的宁静大本营。课程结束的那一刻，一个流程处理所有事务：结构化笔记、作业、付款，以及一键发送至WhatsApp的AI起草家长更新通知——全程不到2分钟。学生档案会记录薄弱环节及下一步重点。辅以付款追踪、预付套餐和可复用的课程库。移动优先，支持离线使用。最多支持3名学生，免费且无需绑定银行卡。

name: Product Canvas
tagline: Turn a greenfield product brief into a structured PRD
tagline_zh: 将全新产品构思转化为结构化的PRD
description: Product Canvas lets you turn a product brief into a structured PRD, generate feature and milestone definitions using AI, invite collaborators and reviewers, capture comments, and lock alignment decisions with an audit trail. For Product Managers and builders. The PRD can be exported to coding agents for implementation.
description_zh: Product Canvas让你能将产品构思转化为结构化的PRD，利用AI生成功能和里程碑定义，邀请协作者和审核者，收集评论，并通过审计轨迹锁定对齐决策。专为产品经理和开发者打造。PRD可导出至coding agent进行实施。

name: Meridian Institute of AI
tagline: Free AI courses with real certificates - 20+ courses
tagline_zh: 免费AI课程，附带真实证书 - 20多门课程
description: Free AI courses with certificates. Learn ChatGPT, Claude, machine learning, prompt engineering, AI in finance, law, healthcare & more. Earn credentials employers recognize. Great for students in school, and great for adults trying to find jobs and need to add to their resume.
description_zh: 免费AI课程，附带证书。学习ChatGPT、Claude、机器学习、提示工程、金融/法律/医疗等领域的AI应用。获取雇主认可的资质认证。非常适合在校学生，也适合正在求职并需要丰富简历的成年人。

name: Unstuck Anywhere
tagline: The AI accelerator you can run from your couch
tagline_zh: 躺在沙发上就能运行的AI加速器
description: Unstuck Anywhere gives founders AI-powered tools to validate ideas, build a business canvas, create pitch decks, and get a full launch package. No cohort. No waitlist. No equity. Just the structure of an accelerator, on your schedule.
description_zh: Unstuck Anywhere为创始人提供AI驱动的工具，用于验证创意、构建商业画布、制作演示文稿以及生成完整的启动包。无需加入集训营，无需等待名单，无需出让股权。只需按照你的时间表，享受加速器般的结构化支持。

name: Grass 2.0
tagline: The always-on computer for your coding agents
tagline_zh: 全天候在线的编程智能体计算机
description: Grass gives your coding agents their own always-on cloud computer. Run Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode on Grass, then monitor progress, approve decisions, and push changes from your iPhone. Version 2 is faster, redesigned, and now live on the App Store.
description_zh: Grass为你的编程智能体提供专属的全天候在线云计算机。在Grass上运行Claude Code、Codex或OpenCode，然后通过iPhone监控进度、审批决策并推送更改。V2版本速度更快、界面重新设计，现已在App Store上线。

name: DATA HIT Tools
tagline: Know when demand peaks and if AI is citing you
tagline_zh: 了解需求高峰何时出现，以及AI是否引用了你的内容
description: Dashboards give you numbers. They rarely show you the rhythm: when your traffic actually peaks, how a Google SERP shifts through the year, or whether AI names you. DATA HIT Tools is four small tools for exactly that: your GA4 or Search Console data as a year-long spiral, your peak day-and-hour windows, the top 10 Google results for a keyword across 12 months, and which brands ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews cite for your topics. For solo SEOs and small agencies, priced like it.
description_zh: 仪表盘只提供数据，却很少展示节奏：你的流量究竟何时达到峰值？Google搜索结果在全年中如何变化？AI是否会提及你？DATA HIT Tools包含四个小巧实用的工具，专门解决这些问题：将你的GA4或Search Console数据呈现为全年螺旋图，显示最高峰的具体日期和时段，展示某关键词在12个月内的前10名Google结果，以及列出哪些品牌被ChatGPT和Google AI Overviews引用以讨论你的主题。专为独立SEO从业者和小型机构设计，定价亲民。

name: Animegenius Hub
tagline: AI Manga Translator — AnimeGenius Hub
tagline_zh: AI漫画翻译器 — AnimeGenius Hub

name: PixellPeep

Transparent pricing Built by the team at AAROHII AI SOLUTION.
description_zh: PixellPeep的独特之处：• 6种比较算法——像素、感知和结构 • 6种可视化模式——叠加、滑块、热力图等 • 批量CSV比较，一次性处理数百对图像 • 原生SDK支持Playwright、Cypress和Puppeteer（npm install @pixellpeep/playwright） • AI驱动的diff解释，减少误报 • 支持CI/CD——在错误发布前阻止构建 免费套餐起步。透明定价 由AAROHII AI SOLUTION团队打造。

name: LumaNox

description: LumaNox is an ad-free private photo and video vault with on-device encryption, biometric lock, local AI privacy tools, and encrypted backup and restore.

name: Remove Watermark from Video
tagline: Clean watermarks off your own videos — no blur, no crop.
tagline_zh: 从您自己的视频中清除水印——无需模糊，无需裁剪。

Upload a short clip and download the result in your browser — nothing to install. 1 credit = 1 second; new accounts get 30 free credits, and failed jobs are refunded automatically.

name: Rizz Roast AI
tagline: Get brutally roasted or dangerously smooth in second with AI
tagline_zh: 在一秒钟内获得AI的犀利吐槽或丝滑撩妹
description: Rizz Roast AI is the ultimate AI-powered roast and rizz generator built for Gen Z. Upload a photo, type a message, or describe a situation and get savage roasts, smooth pickup lines, hilarious comebacks, and viral-worthy content instantly. Unlike generic AI chatbots, Rizz Roast AI specializes in humor, personality analysis, roasting battles, meme-style responses, and social sharing. Every result is designed to be screenshot-worthy and share
description_zh: Rizz Roast AI是专为Z世代打造的终极AI驱动吐槽和撩妹语录生成器。上传照片、输入消息或描述场景，即可立即获得犀利的吐槽、丝滑的搭讪台词、搞笑的回击以及值得病毒式传播的内容。与通用AI聊天机器人不同，Rizz Roast AI专注于幽默、性格分析、吐槽对决、迷因风格回复和社交分享。每个结果都旨在适合截图和分享。

name: Oxlo.ai
tagline: Scale across AI models without scaling your bill
tagline_zh: 扩展AI模型规模，而不增加账单负担
description: Most AI teams pick a model first and discover the bill later. We built Oxlo.ai to change that. Access 35+ frontier AI models including DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K2.6, GLM 5, Qwen, Llama, and Mistral through a single API. Compare models, calibrate responses, and choose the right model for each use case. Scale across AI models with predictable monthly subscriptions, benchmark-grade performance, generous usage limits, and we never train on your data.
description_zh: 大多数AI团队先选择模型，随后才发现账单高昂。我们开发Oxlo.ai就是为了改变这一现状。通过单一API访问35多种前沿AI模型，包括DeepSeek V4 Pro、Kimi K2.6、GLM 5、Qwen、Llama和Mistral。比较模型、校准响应，并为每种用例选择合适的模型。以可预测的月度订阅费扩展AI模型规模，提供基准级性能、慷慨的使用限额，且我们绝不会使用您的数据进行训练。

name: SelfShape AI
tagline: AI personal trainer for serious strength training
tagline_zh: AI个人力量训练教练
description: SelfShape AI is an AI-native strength training app that builds your workout plan from your real routine, goals and equipment — then explains the reasoning behind every set, rep and progression. Your 24/7 AI coach adapts each session as you evolve, grounded in modern exercise science (ACSM) and a 260+ exercise taxonomy. No generic templates, no guesswork — a coach that actually tells you why. 14-day free trial.
description_zh: SelfShape AI是一款原生AI力量训练应用，根据您的实际日常、目标和设备生成训练计划——并解释每组动作、次数和进阶背后的原理。您的24/7 AI教练会根据您的进步实时调整每次训练，基于现代运动科学（ACSM）和260多种动作分类。没有通用模板，无需猜测——一位真正告诉您“为什么”的教练。14天免费试用。

name: Wallbreak
tagline: Apply less. Apply better.
tagline_zh: 少一点申请，更精准地申请。
description: Wallbreak: UK job search built around one idea - apply less, apply better. Search pulls UK roles from public sources. Visa Sponsorship mode surfaces sponsor-register organisations with trust notes (register presence is a signal, not a guarantee). CV Intelligence gives deterministic rule-based feedback - not a trained model or opaque score. Gate B prevents job-description text becoming evidence about you. Watchlist, Contact Intelligence. Beta — AI features may have limits. Plans TBD.
description_zh: Wallbreak：围绕一个理念打造的英国求职工具——少一点申请，更精准地申请。搜索功能从公开来源抓取英国职位。签证赞助模式突出显示已注册赞助的机构，并提供信任备注（注册存在是信号，而非保证）。CV智能提供确定性的基于规则的反馈——不是训练模型或模糊评分。Gate B防止职位描述文本成为针对您的证据。支持Watchlist和Contact Intelligence功能。Beta版——AI功能可能存在限制。计划待定。

name: Shopify Product Video Generator (Prompt)

description: Upload product photos and get detailed AI video prompts designed for Shopify product galleries. Use them with Runway, Kling, Veo, SeeDance, Luma, Pika, or any AI video model. Most Shopify stores still rely on product photos alone. I noticed something while experimenting with AI video tools for e-commerce products: the difference between a great video and a terrible one usually wasn't the AI model. It was the prompt. So I built a tool around that idea.
description_zh: 上传产品照片，获取专为Shopify商品画廊设计的详细AI视频提示词。可与Runway、Kling、Veo、SeeDance、Luma、Pika或任何AI视频模型配合使用。大多数Shopify商店仍仅依赖产品照片。我在为电商产品实验AI视频工具时发现：优质视频与糟糕视频之间的差异通常不在于AI模型，而在于提示词。因此我基于这一理念构建了此工具。

name: Trace and Trade

Just take a picture and get accurate nutritional data instantly. Try it before signing up—guest scans map seamlessly to your account upon registration. Built for speed, accuracy, and zero friction. description_zh: 手动卡路里计算已成过去式。MealScan.ai是一款简洁的SaaS服务，通过单张照片即可计算您的宏量营养素和卡路里。无需繁琐数据库，无需称重食物。只需拍照，即刻获得准确的营养数据。注册前可先试用——访客扫描可在注册时无缝映射至您的账户。专为速度、准确性和零摩擦体验打造。停止打字，开始扫描。

name: EnigmaProxy

description: Atom Foundry is building the AI Commerce Intelligence platform. We help brands understand how AI systems discover, evaluate, trust and recommend products. Measure AI Visibility, Recommendation Intelligence, AI Trust and Decision Confidence across modern AI platforms. Our mission is to map the emerging AI Commerce Graph and help brands become recommendation-ready in the age of AI-driven commerce.
description_zh: Atom Foundry 正在构建 AI 商务智能平台。我们帮助品牌了解 AI 系统如何发现、评估、信任和推荐产品。衡量现代 AI 平台上的 AI 可见性、推荐智能、AI 信任和决策信心。我们的使命是绘制新兴的 AI 商务图谱，并帮助品牌在 AI 驱动的商务时代做好被推荐的准备。

description_zh: 转录、标准化音频、去除填充词并清理脏话，完全在设备端完成。快速搜索、整理，并干净地导出至 Final Cut Pro 或 DaVinci Resolve Studio。入选 Larry Jordan 的 Edit Smarter Newsletter。- 设备端转录（Parakeet V3）- 基于文本的编辑 - 跨项目和媒体搜索 - 填充词和脏话清理 - 移除静音片段 - 关键词生成（包括为 Final Cut Pro 导出的标签）- 适用于 Final Cut Pro 和 DaVinci Resolve 的导出工作流

name: Dockly
tagline: The OS Gateway & Command Center for AI Agents
tagline_zh: AI Agent 的操作系统网关与指挥中心
description: AI agents use expensive 4MB screenshots just to click a browser tab. Dockly 2.0 fixes this. For Humans: A sleek sidebar unifying tabs across all Chrome profiles. For AI: A local REST API that translates your browser into a 2KB JSON map to save 95% on token costs.
description_zh: AI Agent 仅为了点击浏览器标签页就使用昂贵的 4MB 截图。Dockly 2.0 解决了这个问题。面向人类：一个简洁的侧边栏，统一所有 Chrome 配置文件的标签页。面向 AI：一个本地 REST API，将你的浏览器转换为 2KB JSON 映射图，节省 95% 的 Token 成本。

name: Wire RN
tagline: Generative UI for React Native, rendered native
tagline_zh: React Native 的生成式 UI，原生渲染
description: Wire RN is an open-source (MIT) generative-UI SDK for React Native. An AI agent sends a UI payload over A2UI, Google's open protocol for agent-driven interfaces, and Wire RN renders it as schema-validated native components. Examples such as agent-driven onboarding, in-app coaching, and dynamic flows on mobile, where every other generative-UI SDK only does web.
description_zh: Wire RN 是一个开源（MIT）的 React Native 生成式 UI SDK。AI Agent 通过 A2UI（Google 推出的用于 Agent 驱动界面的开放协议）发送 UI 负载，Wire RN 将其渲染为经过 Schema 验证的原生组件。示例包括 Agent 驱动的引导流程、应用内辅导以及移动端动态流程，而其他所有生成式 UI SDK 仅支持 Web。

name: Is it Slop?
tagline: Free AI text checker based on the latest research
tagline_zh: 基于最新研究的免费 AI 文本检测器
description: Most AI detectors out there either miss obvious AI phrasing or are just top of funnels to get naive students to pay, offering "human rewrites". Isitslop catches the AI in your text, tells you your "reading grade" and gives you legit advice based on your patterns, so you can be confident your writing sounds like you, all of it without ever stealing your information!
description_zh: 市面上大多数 AI 检测器要么漏掉明显的 AI 用语，要么只是作为“漏斗”诱骗天真的学生付费购买“人工重写”服务。Isitslop 能捕捉你文本中的 AI 痕迹，告诉你你的“阅读年级”，并根据你的写作模式提供真正的建议，让你确信自己的写作风格独一无二，且绝不窃取你的信息！

name: Sello
tagline: Your AI stylist that knows your colors, closet & calendar
tagline_zh: 了解你的色彩、衣橱和日程的 AI 造型师
description: StyleAI solves "what should I wear?" — for good. It generates daily outfits using only clothes you own, filtered by your personal color season, today's weather, and your plans (office, date, gym, travel). Upload a garment photo → AI classifies it automatically. Set your plans → get 3–5 ranked outfits with color reasoning. Plus a marketplace where every listing is pre-filtered to match your palette. Your closet, finally working for you.
description_zh: StyleAI 彻底解决“今天穿什么？”的问题。它仅使用你拥有的衣物，结合个人色彩季节、今日天气和你的计划（办公室、约会、健身房、旅行）生成每日穿搭。上传衣物照片 → AI 自动分类。设定你的计划 → 获得 3-5 套按优先级排序的穿搭及色彩推理。此外还有市场板块，每个 listings 都经过预筛选以匹配你的调色板。让你的衣橱真正为你服务。

name: Mimir Systems
tagline: The research answer tool that can't fake a citation

description: Mimir answers a research question with a cited source in seconds, drawn from millions of papers in materials science, chemistry, and physics. Every citation points to a real paper you can open. The system retrieves from indexed literature instead of generating text, so it cannot invent a reference. Free foredu andgov. Start your 7 free trial now.
description_zh: Mimir 能在几秒钟内引用来源回答研究问题，内容源自数百万篇材料科学、化学和物理学论文。每个引用都指向您可以打开的真实论文。该系统从索引文献中检索而非生成文本，因此不会捏造参考文献。免费供 edu 和 gov 使用。立即开始 7 天免费试用。

name: VocaEasy

name: NotebookLM 2.0 Is a Game Changer

Clients get a portal to approve, pay, and see photos of the finished work. Built-in invoicing, AI follow-ups, online booking, and a door-knocking lead map round it out. No app, flat $29/mo, free to start.
