name: Viral Video Generator (Beta)
tagline: Generate viral videos for your app or SaaS - By SocialClaw
tagline_zh: 为您的应用或 SaaS 生成病毒式传播视频 - 由 SocialClaw 提供
description: Turn your app screenshots or a screen recording into a viral-worthy UGC video or photo carousel. Real creator hooks, AI-written captions, ready to post.
description_zh: 将您的应用截图或屏幕录制转化为具有病毒传播潜力的 UGC 视频或图片轮播。真实的创作者钩子、AI 撰写的文案，即拿即用。

name: Zylio
tagline: AI Procurement Optimization & Invoice Compliance Platform
tagline_zh: AI采购优化与发票合规平台
description: Zylio automatise vos factures, devis, contrats et rapprochement bancaire grâce à l'IA. Économies 15%, conformité 100%. Demandez votre démo.
description_zh: Zylio利用AI自动化您的发票、报价单、合同和银行对账。节省15%成本，100%合规。预约演示。

name: Voicetypr 2.0
tagline: Stop typing, Start talking to your apps and agents
tagline_zh: 停止打字，开始通过语音与您的应用和智能体交互
description: Voicetypr 2.0 is a ground-up rebuild — now your AI agents can hear you. A new Agent CLI + local API lets any agent or script pull your voice as text/JSON, on-device. OpenClaw, Hermes, and Nanoclaw can listen with no per-minute transcriptio API and no audio sent to the cloud. New in 2.0: • Agent CLI & local API: voice in, text/JSON out • Remote sharing over your Wi-Fi • Way more powerful formatting: 6 modes + per-app rules • Optional cloud engines One-time, no subscription.n
description_zh: Voicetypr 2.0 是全新重构的版本——现在您的AI智能体可以“听”您说话了。全新的Agent CLI和本地API让任何智能体或脚本都能将您的语音在设备端转换为文本/JSON。OpenClaw、Hermes和Nanoclaw无需按分钟计费的转录API，也无需将音频上传至云端即可聆听。2.0新功能：• Agent CLI及本地API：输入语音，输出文本/JSON • 通过Wi-Fi远程共享 • 更强大的格式化功能：6种模式+每应用规则 • 可选云端引擎 一次性付费，无订阅。

name: The Space Within
tagline: Interactive emotional diary connecting you with the space
tagline_zh: 连接您与空间的互动情感日记
description: The Space Within is an interactive emotional diary that connects your daily mood to real cosmic events - solar activity, lunar phases, and geomagnetic conditions. Through gamified check-ins, AI-powered insights, and immersive rituals, we help young adults build self-awareness and emotional resilience. It's not just a tracker - it's a daily ritual that turns self-care into a beautiful, scientific, and playful experience.
description_zh: The Space Within是一款互动情感日记，将您的日常情绪与真实的宇宙事件（如太阳活动、月相和地磁条件）联系起来。通过游戏化的签到、AI驱动的洞察和沉浸式仪式，我们帮助年轻人建立自我意识和情绪韧性。这不仅仅是一个追踪器——它是一个日常仪式，将自我关怀转化为一种美丽、科学且充满趣味的体验。

name: PromptMatrix AI
tagline: Turn raw concepts into enterprise-grade system prompts.
tagline_zh: 将原始概念转化为企业级系统提示词。
description: A powerful prompt engineering workbench. PromptMatrix programmatically restructures basic thoughts into comprehensive, structured system prompts. Fully optimized with targeted frameworks for Midjourney v6 layout arrays, Claude Code systems, and DeepSeek reasoning logic.
description_zh: 一个强大的提示词工程工作台。PromptMatrix以编程方式将基本想法重构为全面、结构化的系统提示词。针对Midjourney v6布局数组、Claude Code系统和DeepSeek推理逻辑进行了完全优化。

name: RepWave — Reputation Intelligence
tagline: AI reputation & sentiment intel for people & brands
tagline_zh: 面向个人和品牌的人工智能声誉与情感情报
description: RepWave is AI reputation & sentiment intelligence for creators, brands, and product or movie launches. It reads what the world is saying about you across news, video and community — then tells you what people actually feel, who's driving it, and what to do next, in plain English. Get a live Reputation Score, audience-vs-media gaps, crisis alerts, narratives, and AI reply drafts. Connect Instagram for per-comment sentiment. Understands Hindi, Hinglish & 40+ languages. Free to start.
description_zh: RepWave是为创作者、品牌以及产品或电影发布提供的人工智能声誉与情感智能工具。它阅读新闻、视频和社区中关于您的世界之声——然后用通俗易懂的语言告诉您人们真正的感受、是谁在推动这些观点以及下一步该做什么。获取实时声誉评分、受众与媒体差距、危机警报、叙事分析和AI回复草稿。连接Instagram以获取逐条评论的情感分析。支持印地语、Hinglish及40多种语言。免费开始使用。

name: MaskotIA
tagline: AI-powered veterinary ecosystem for clinics and pet owners
tagline_zh: 面向诊所和宠物主人的AI驱动兽医生态系统
description: MaskotIA is an AI-powered veterinary ecosystem designed for clinics and pet owners. It helps veterinarians manage appointments, medical records, prescriptions, inventory and client retention while giving pet owners reminders, digital records and smart QR pet tags.
description_zh: MaskotIA是一款专为诊所和宠物主人设计的AI驱动兽医生态系统。它帮助兽医管理预约、病历、处方、库存和客户留存，同时为宠物主人提供提醒、数字记录和智能QR宠物标签。

name: VoiceOne
tagline: Translate text and readit aloud using Chrome's built-in AI.
tagline_zh: 使用Chrome内置的AI翻译文本并朗读。
description: Translate selected text and read it aloud using Chrome's built-in on-device AI. Right-click any selection to translate and speak.
description_zh: 使用Chrome内置的设备端AI翻译选中文本并朗读。右键点击任何选中文本即可进行翻译和语音播放。

name: Flarev
tagline: Personalized AI video for every new GoHighLevel lead
tagline_zh: 为每个新的GoHighLevel潜在客户生成个性化AI视频
description: Flarev automatically sends a personalized AI spokesperson video to every new lead in your GoHighLevel pipeline. No recording, no code, no manual effort. When a contact enters GHL, Flarev writes a custom script with their name, renders an AI avatar video via HeyGen, and drops the link into their contact record. Your workflow sends it via SMS or email. Set it up once. Every lead gets a personal video. Installs in 5 minutes.
description_zh: Flarev会自动向GoHighLevel管道中的每位新客户发送个性化的AI发言人视频。无需录制、无需代码、无需手动操作。当联系人进入GHL时，Flarev会以其姓名编写自定义脚本，通过HeyGen渲染AI头像视频，并将链接存入其联系人记录中。您的工作流通过短信或电子邮件发送该视频。只需设置一次，每位客户都会收到专属视频。安装仅需5分钟。

name: CV Align
tagline: Match your CV to any job. Generate tailored applications.
tagline_zh: 将您的简历与任何职位匹配。生成定制化的申请材料。
description: See how well a job matches your CV and generate tailored documents, powered by Claude AI.
description_zh: 查看职位与您的简历的匹配程度，并由Claude AI生成定制化的文档。

name: Markdownify
tagline: From webpage to Markdown.
tagline_zh: 从网页转换为Markdown格式。
description: Extract any URL or convert raw HTML into clean Markdown. Most HTML-to-Markdown tools are designed for content migration or publishing workflows. Markdownify is built specifically for AI and LLM workflows.
description_zh: 提取任意URL或将原始HTML转换为干净的Markdown。大多数HTML到Markdown的工具是为内容迁移或发布工作流设计的。Markdownify专为AI和LLM工作流构建。

name: JSONPath Assistant
tagline: Generate JSONPath from Natural Language
tagline_zh: 通过自然语言生成 JSONPath
description: JSONPath Assistant is an AI-powered copilot for working with JSONPath. ﻿ Unlike traditional JSONPath testers, it helps you create and understand JSONPath expressions instead of manually writing them. ﻿ Features: ﻿ ✓ Natural Language → JSONPath ﻿ ✓ Preview matching results instantly ﻿ Perfect for: ﻿ • Backend Developers • API Engineers • QA Teams • Data Engineers • AI Developers ﻿ No signup required. Runs entirely in your browser.
description_zh: JSONPath Assistant 是一款由 AI 驱动的 JSONPath 协作助手。与传统 JSONPath 测试工具不同，它帮助您创建和理解 JSONPath 表达式，而非手动编写。功能：✓ 自然语言转 JSONPath ✓ 即时预览匹配结果 适用人群：• 后端开发人员 • API 工程师 • QA 团队 • 数据工程师 • AI 开发人员 无需注册。完全在浏览器中运行。

name: GOMAX Ultimate
tagline: AI operating system for WordPress. One prompt, done.
tagline_zh: WordPress 的 AI 操作系统。一个提示词，搞定一切。
description: Most WordPress owners can't afford a developer and don't have time to learn WordPress themselves. GOMAX Ultimate lets you manage your entire WordPress business by talking to AI. Build pages, run your WooCommerce store, capture leads, send emails, track analytics — all from a simple conversation. One prompt built a complete coffee shop website with an AI barista chatbot in under 5 minutes. No coding. No developer. £149 once.
description_zh: 大多数 WordPress 所有者请不起开发人员，也没有时间自己学习 WordPress。GOMAX Ultimate 让您通过与 AI 对话来管理整个 WordPress 业务。构建页面、运营 WooCommerce 商店、捕获潜在客户、发送电子邮件、跟踪分析——全部通过简单的对话完成。只需一个提示词，不到 5 分钟即可构建一个带有 AI 咖啡师聊天机器人的完整咖啡店网站。无需编码。无需开发人员。一次性付费 £149。

name: Accord OS
tagline: Run cross-organization work in one shared system.
tagline_zh: 在一个共享系统中运行跨组织的工作。
description: Accord is a collaborative execution platform designed for teams working across organizations. Instead of relying on scattered tools like email, chat, and task managers, Accord provides a shared workspace where teams can manage deliverables, coordinate approvals, and track progress with clear accountability. The platform includes a real-time timeline of activity, AI-powered insights to detect risks and bottlenecks, and a unified dashboard that shows the health of work across all participants.
description_zh: Accord 是一个专为跨组织团队设计的协作执行平台。不再依赖分散的工具（如电子邮件、聊天和任务管理器），Accord 提供了一个共享工作空间，团队可以在其中管理交付物、协调审批并跟踪进度，确保责任清晰。该平台包括实时活动时间线、用于检测风险和瓶颈的 AI 驱动洞察，以及显示所有参与者工作健康状况的统一仪表板。

name: AI Ad generator
tagline: AI Ad generator
tagline_zh: AI 广告生成器
description: AIAdGen is an AI advertisement generator and AI ad maker. Upload a product image and generate high-converting ad creatives for TikTok, Amazon, Shopify, and other e-commerce platforms in minutes.
description_zh: AIAdGen 是一款 AI 广告生成器和 AI 广告制作工具。上传产品图片，几分钟内即可为 TikTok、Amazon、Shopify 和其他电子商务平台生成高转化率的广告素材。

name: SayOnce
tagline: Voice typing for Windows you buy once - offline, no cloud
tagline_zh: Windows 语音输入，一次性购买——离线，无云端
description: Voice typing for Windows that runs fully on your PC. Hold a hotkey, speak, and the text lands in any app - editor, browser, chat. Speech recognition is local (no audio leaves your machine), works without a GPU, and it's a one-time purchase instead of a monthly subscription. It also batch-transcribes audio/video files into clean, readable text - split into proper paragraphs instead of one giant block - with Prose/Code/Email presets and a personal dictionary.
description_zh: 完全在您的 PC 上运行的 Windows 语音输入。按住热键，说话，文本即可出现在任何应用程序中——编辑器、浏览器、聊天。语音识别是本地化的（音频不会离开您的机器），无需 GPU 即可工作，且为一次性购买而非月度订阅。它还支持将音频/视频文件批量转录为整洁易读的文本——分为适当的段落，而不是一个巨大的文本块——并提供 Prose/Code/Email 预设和个人词典。

name: Smart Booking System AI
tagline: AI assistant automating orders & bookings with precision
tagline_zh: AI助手，精准自动化订单与预订
description: An AI-powered assistant automating orders & bookings 24/7 without human intervention. Highly flexible and tailored for various industries: Clinics: Organizes patient appointments & onboarding. Taxi Services: Collects trip details & precise locations. Real Estate: Manages purchase/rental requests & viewings. Restaurants: Handles food orders, reservations & delivery. Instant alerts are sent straight to Telegram. Deploy via web widget or social media links seamlessly!
description_zh: 一款由AI驱动的智能助手，全天候无需人工干预即可自动化处理订单与预订。高度灵活，适用于多种行业：诊所：安排患者预约及入职流程；出租车服务：收集行程详情及精确位置；房地产：管理买卖/租赁请求及看房安排；餐厅：处理点餐、预订及外卖。即时警报直接发送至Telegram。通过网页小部件或社交媒体链接无缝部署！

name: LEDGER AI ELITE
tagline: AI document vault for luxury real estate agents.
tagline_zh: 面向高端房地产经纪人的AI文档保险库
description: AI document vault for luxury real estate. Patrick automatically links contracts to wire transfers, capture receipts, and classify high-ticket buyer leads into Hot/Warm reports on autopilot. Secure your exclusive Beta access today.
description_zh: 面向高端房地产的AI文档保险库。Patrick自动将合同与电汇关联，捕获收据，并将高价值买家线索自动分类为“热门/温温”报告。立即获取独家Beta访问权限。

name: Pinpoint
tagline: Point your AI agent at the exact pixel you mean
tagline_zh: 将你的AI代理指向你意指的确切像素
description: Pinpoint is a macOS menu-bar app that turns a screenshot into a prompt your AI agent can actually read. Capture a region, drop numbered markers on what matters, and copy an annotated image plus a structured text that references every marker — image size, each marker's position and note, then your instructions. Built for Claude Code, Codex and friends. Native (SwiftUI + ScreenCaptureKit), private (nothing leaves your Mac), free & open source.
description_zh: Pinpoint是一款macOS菜单栏应用，可将截图转化为AI代理能够真正理解的提示词。截取区域，在关键处添加编号标记，然后复制包含标注图像和结构化文本的内容——包括图像尺寸、每个标记的位置和备注，以及你的指令。专为Claude Code、Codex等打造。原生开发（SwiftUI + ScreenCaptureKit），隐私安全（数据不出Mac），免费且开源。

name: Dub Ninja
tagline: Live autonomous AI DJ that digs, mixes & explains 24/7
tagline_zh: 全天候自主运行的AI DJ，挖掘、混音并解说
description: An autonomous AI DJ. No schedule, no playlists — just the next correct record, chosen live and explained in real time. Underground electronic, always on.
description_zh: 一款自主运行的AI DJ。无固定日程，无预设歌单——只有当下最合适的唱片，实时选择并即时解说。地下电子音乐，永不间断。

name: Design for the AI era
tagline: The design doc is the product. Screens are the consequence.
tagline_zh: 设计文档即产品，屏幕只是结果
description: Engaged Inquiry — design practice for the AI era. The spec is the product. The screens are the consequence. Design for the AI era argues that the problem with AI-generated design is not the AI — it's the absence of a governing principle upstream of it. Five dimensions of digital experience (Screen, Context, Content, Time, Trust) must be authored before any build begins. Free PDF. Print on Amazon.
description_zh: Engaged Inquiry —— AI时代的设计实践。规范文档即产品，屏幕只是结果。《为AI时代而设计》认为，AI生成设计的问题不在于AI本身，而在于其上游缺乏主导原则。在开始任何构建之前，必须预先构思数字体验的五个维度（屏幕、上下文、内容、时间、信任）。免费PDF。亚马逊印刷版。

name: Clapet
tagline: Excalidraw meets AI system design
tagline_zh: Excalidraw 遇上 AI 系统架构设计
description: Clapet is an AI-assisted architecture diagram tool for designing, reviewing, saving, and sharing system designs.
description_zh: Clapet 是一款 AI 辅助的系统架构图工具，用于设计、审查、保存和共享系统设计。

name: DevLauch
tagline: AI DevOps that writes,fixes & deploys your pipelines for you
tagline_zh: AI DevOps：为您编写、修复并部署流水线
description: `DevPilot turns any GitHub repo into a live deployment in 2 minutes. Pick a branch — we generate your Dockerfile, CI/CD pipeline, and deploy to your server automatically. When builds break, AI reads the logs, pushes a fix, and retries — no human needed. Provision EC2, RDS & S3 from one dashboard. Ask plain-English questions like "why did the backend fail?" and get answers. No Jenkins expertise. Just ship.`
description_zh: `DevPilot 在 2 分钟内将任何 GitHub 仓库变为实时部署环境。选择一个分支——我们自动生成您的 Dockerfile、CI/CD 流水线并自动部署到服务器。当构建失败时，AI 读取日志、推送修复并重试——无需人工干预。从一个仪表板配置 EC2、RDS 和 S3。用自然语言提问如“后端为何失败？”并获得解答。无需 Jenkins 专业知识。只需交付。`

name: MaliMoney
tagline: Talk to your money
tagline_zh: 与您的资金对话
description: Talk to Mali about your money by voice or text. It links your bank and runs tested financial tools — Roth conversions, Social Security timing, Monte Carlo retirement odds, tax-aware withdrawals — on your real numbers. Built for couples.
description_zh: 通过语音或文本与 Mali 讨论您的财务。它连接您的银行账户，并在您的真实数据上运行经过测试的金融工具——罗思转换、社会保障时机、蒙特卡洛退休概率、税务意识提取——专为夫妇打造。

name: HPSILab MCP
tagline: Options intelligence for AI agents — IV, Monte Carlo & more
tagline_zh: 面向 AI 代理的期权智能——IV、蒙特卡洛模拟等
description: 8-tool MCP server for US equity options intelligence: real-time IV radar, Monte Carlo price simulation, options pressure maps, equity curve backtesting, and quantum ML prediction signals for AI-driven trading research.
description_zh: 面向美国股票期权智能的 8 工具 MCP 服务器：实时隐含波动率雷达、蒙特卡洛价格模拟、期权压力图、权益曲线回测，以及用于 AI 驱动交易研究的量子机器学习预测信号。

name: The AI CMO
tagline: Marketing department that fits in a browser tab
tagline_zh: 装在一个浏览器标签页里的营销部门
description: The marketing department that fits in a browser tab. Strategy, ads, email, social – written, shipped, measured. It learns what sells, and does more of it.
description_zh: 装在一个浏览器标签页里的营销部门。策略、广告、邮件、社交媒体——撰写、发布、衡量。它学习什么能卖，并加大投入。

name: HippoSplit
tagline: Expense splitting as easy as texting
tagline_zh: 像发短信一样轻松分摊费用
description: Most bill-splitters feel like accounting software. HippoSplit is chat-first, so adding an expense is as easy as sending a message: snap a receipt photo or type "dinner, $80," and AI itemizes it, picks a category, and keeps the split clear and editable. With 150+ currencies at live rates, it's perfect for trips abroad. Tracking expenses is finally fast and even enjoyable. Think Splitwise, but with fast input and advanced AI, built for trips, roommates, families, and everyday personal spending.
description_zh: 大多数账单分摊工具感觉像会计软件。HippoSplit 以聊天为先，因此添加费用就像发送消息一样简单：拍张收据照片或输入“晚餐，80美元”，AI 会自动分项、选择类别，并保持分摊清晰且可编辑。支持 150 多种货币的实时汇率，非常适合出国旅行。跟踪费用终于变得快速甚至令人愉悦。想象一下 Splitwise，但拥有更快的输入方式和先进的 AI，专为旅行、室友、家庭及日常个人消费打造。

name: InterviewWatch
tagline: Real-time integrity for every remote interview
tagline_zh: 为每一次远程面试提供实时完整性保障
description: InterviewWatch verifies remote interviews in real time — confirming candidates are real and unassisted, with signed, evidence-grade integrity reports.
description_zh: InterviewWatch 实时验证远程面试——确认候选人真实且未受协助，并生成带有签名的证据级完整性报告。

name: rssu.me
tagline: Resume as Data
tagline_zh: 简历即数据
description: Your resume is data. Treat it like data. We kept reformatting the same resume for every application. So we built rssume. Enter your experience once. Share it via password-protected links — each with its own password, expiration, and template. Redact what you want, show what you want. Import from PDF, LinkedIn, or AI paste. Export to PDF when a portal demands it. Connect GitHub and keep it in version control. Let your skills speak. Not your formatting skills.
description_zh: 你的简历就是数据。像对待数据一样对待它。我们每次申请都要重新格式化同一份简历，于是我们构建了 rssume。只需输入一次你的经历。通过带密码保护的链接分享——每个链接都有独立的密码、过期时间和模板。隐藏你想隐藏的，展示你想展示的。支持从 PDF、LinkedIn 或 AI 粘贴导入。当门户要求时导出为 PDF。连接 GitHub 以保持版本控制。让你的技能说话，而不是你的排版技巧。

name: monkeysee
tagline: Let your terminal agent drive your real, logged-in Chrome.
tagline_zh: 让你的终端代理驱动你真实已登录的 Chrome。
description: Other browser agents open a headless browser logged into nothing. MonkeySee drives YOUR real Chrome — already signed into everything. No LLM, no agent loop: your terminal agent is the brain, MonkeySee the hands and eyes. Read pages, click, type, fill forms cinematically, run many sessions.
description_zh: 其他浏览器代理打开的是未登录任何内容的无头浏览器。MonkeySee 驱动的是 YOUR 真实的 Chrome——已经登录了所有服务。无需 LLM，无需代理循环：你的终端代理是大脑，MonkeySee 是手和眼。阅读页面、点击、输入、电影般地填写表单、运行多个会话。

name: Pricer AI
tagline: Price your AI product with confidence.
tagline_zh: 自信地为你的 AI 产品定价。
description: PricerAI is a free calculator that turns raw AI model costs into a credit-based pricing model, blended pipeline cost, infrastructure overhead, target margin, credit denomination, and per-plan profitability, so you can price your AI product with confidence before you ship. Everything runs entirely in your browser. There is no account, no backend, and no database. Your pricing configuration is never uploaded anywhere.
description_zh: PricerAI 是一款免费计算器，可将原始 AI 模型成本转化为基于信用的定价模型、混合管道成本、基础设施开销、目标利润率、信用面额及各计划盈利能力，让你在发布前就能自信地为 AI 产品定价。一切都在你的浏览器中完全运行。无需账户，无需后端，无需数据库。你的定价配置永远不会上传到任何地方。

name: Modiva
tagline: One API & MCP server for every social platform
tagline_zh: 一个适用于所有社交平台的 API 和 MCP 服务器
description: Connect social and ads APIs through a single unified REST API and hosted MCP server. OAuth, typed tools and scopes handled for you — TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and more.
description_zh: 通过统一的 REST API 和托管 MCP 服务器连接社交和广告 API。为您处理 OAuth、类型化工具和权限范围——支持 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube、LinkedIn 等。

name: clausio
tagline: AI contract review inside Microsoft Word for law firms
tagline_zh: 面向律所的 Microsoft Word 内 AI 合同审查工具
description: Clausio is a Microsoft Word plugin for contract review. It compares the client's version against your firm's template, highlights every change, and flags risky clauses by severity — critical, high, medium, low. For each flagged clause, it generates a counter-proposal in legal language, ready to approve or edit. No copy-pasting. No switching apps. Everything happens inside Word's task pane. Lawyer approves every suggestion before anything changes. Free 14-day trial for law firms.
description_zh: Clausio 是一款用于合同审查的 Microsoft Word 插件。它将客户版本与贵所模板进行比对，高亮显示每一处更改，并按严重程度（关键、高、中、低）标记风险条款。针对每个被标记的条款，它会生成符合法律语言的替代提案，供批准或编辑。无需复制粘贴，无需切换应用。所有内容均在 Word 的任务窗格中完成。律师在更改发生前需批准每项建议。律所免费试用 14 天。

name: East Blue Gym
tagline: Full-stack gym SaaS with AI coach, live chat & payments
tagline_zh: 具备 AI 教练、实时聊天和支付功能的全面健身房 SaaS
description: East Blue Gym is a production-ready gym management platform built with FastAPI, MongoDB, and Next.js. Features: → AI Personal Coach (Gemini) → Live Chat & WebSockets → Stripe Payments & Memberships → Video Vault → Community features → Mobile responsive → 110/100 Mozilla Security Score Built by a self-taught builder with zero CS degree using AI-assisted development. Everything runs on free tier — Vercel + Render + MongoDB Atlas. Live demo: https://mygym-p9rd.vercel.app
description_zh: East Blue Gym 是一个生产就绪的健身房管理平台，基于 FastAPI、MongoDB 和 Next.js 构建。功能：→ AI 私人教练 (Gemini) → 实时聊天与 WebSockets → Stripe 支付与会员管理 → 视频库 → 社区功能 → 移动端响应式设计 → 110/100 Mozilla 安全评分 由一名无计算机科学学位的自学开发者利用 AI 辅助开发构建。所有服务均运行在免费套餐上——Vercel + Render + MongoDB Atlas。在线演示：https://mygym-p9rd.vercel.app

name: EDD Hold
tagline: Skip government phone hold — we dial until you connect
tagline_zh: 跳过政府电话等待——我们帮您拨号直至接通
description: Stop spending hours redialing the IRS, CA EDD, Social Security, and other government agencies. EDD Hold auto-dials for you, navigates the phone menu, and calls you back the moment a live agent is ready. From $9.99. Money-back guarantee.
description_zh: 别再花几个小时反复拨打国税局 (IRS)、加州就业发展局 (CA EDD)、社会保障局及其他政府机构的电话了。EDD Hold 会自动为您拨号，导航电话菜单，并在有真人客服准备好接听时立即回电给您。起价 $9.99。提供退款保证。

name: EdgeShaping Lite
tagline: GA4 can't see AI crawlers. This WordPress plugin can.
tagline_zh: GA4 无法识别 AI 爬虫。这款 WordPress 插件可以。
description: GA4 relies on JavaScript, so it mostly can't see AI crawlers like GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and Perplexity visiting your site. EdgeShaping Lite logs AI bot visits at the PHP layer instead — no JS dependency — so you can see which bots read which pages, and when. - Dictionary-based AI bot detection - Dashboard with bot frequency ranking + most-visited pages - Full access log, CSV export - AHQG Matrix: cross AI visits with human search clicks (GSC) to spot pages AI loves that humans haven't found yet
description_zh: GA4 依赖 JavaScript，因此通常无法像 GPTBot、ClaudeBot 和 Perplexity 这样的 AI 爬虫访问您的网站。EdgeShaping Lite 在 PHP 层记录 AI 机器人的访问——无需 JS 依赖——这样您就可以看到哪些机器人阅读了哪些页面，以及何时访问。- 基于字典的 AI 机器人检测 - 包含机器人频率排名和最常访问页面的仪表板 - 完整的访问日志，支持 CSV 导出 - AHQG 矩阵：将 AI 访问与人类搜索点击 (GSC) 交叉分析，以发现 AI 喜欢但人类尚未发现的页面

name: Prevail
tagline: An AI harness for your life, not your job
tagline_zh: AI 生活助手，而非工作工具
description: Prevail is an AI harness for your life; think Openclaw or Hermes, but instead of wrapping a model around your codebase, it wraps one around you. 🔌 Any model, your choice. Cloud (Claude, GPT, …) or fully local (Ollama). The harness is the product; swap the engine anytime. 🧠 It learns you. Persistent context about your life means it gets sharper every time you use it — no re-explaining yourself to a blank chat box. AI for your life, not your job.
description_zh: Prevail 是一款面向生活的 AI 助手；类似于 Openclaw 或 Hermes，但它不是将模型包裹在你的代码库上，而是将你包裹在模型之中。🔌 任意模型，由你选择。云端（Claude、GPT……）或完全本地化（Ollama）。Harness 是产品；引擎可随时更换。🧠 它了解你。关于你生活的持久上下文意味着它每次使用都会变得更精准——无需向空白的聊天框反复解释自己。AI 服务于你的生活，而非你的工作。

name: FlowPilot
tagline: Open-source control loop for long AI agent work
tagline_zh: 用于长周期 AI 智能体工作的开源控制循环
description: FlowPilot is an open-source runtime that lets an AI agent run long software projects as a role-based team: PM, worker, reviewer, and FlowGuard operator. It plans routes, dispatches background agents, reviews evidence, replans when checks fail, and closes only with a completion ledger.
description_zh: FlowPilot 是一个开源运行时环境，允许 AI 智能体以角色团队（项目经理、工人、审核员和 FlowGuard 操作员）的形式运行长期软件项目。它规划路线、调度后台智能体、审查证据、在检查失败时重新规划，并仅在拥有完成账本时关闭。

name: Doc Suite
tagline: AI document tools in one place — your files aren't stored
tagline_zh: 一站式 AI 文档工具——你的文件不会被存储
description: Doc Suite is an AI document hub with 20 tools in one place-not another single-feature PDF app. Summarize PDFs, chat with documents, generate quizzes, spot question-paper patterns, plan exam revision, build mindmaps, compare PDFs, fix OCR, and more. All searchable from one homepage. What makes it different: breadth + privacy. Files are processed in real time and never stored. Free daily credits-sign in and start in seconds.
description_zh: Doc Suite 是一个包含 20 种工具的 AI 文档中心，而非另一个单一功能的 PDF 应用。总结 PDF、与文档对话、生成测验、识别试卷模式、规划考试复习、构建思维导图、比较 PDF、修复 OCR 等。所有功能均可从主页搜索。其独特之处在于：广度 + 隐私。文件实时处理且永不存储。每日免费额度——登录即可秒级开始。

name: Connexr
tagline: AI First Enterprise Cognitive Solutions
tagline_zh: AI 优先的企业认知解决方案
description: Connexr delivers AI managed services, AIOps, and enterprise AI transformation. Reduce downtime, automate IT operations, and accelerate cloud AI adoption.
description_zh: Connexr 提供 AI 托管服务、AIOps 和企业 AI 转型。减少停机时间，自动化 IT 运营，加速云 AI 采用。

name: Nida-OS
tagline: AI CRM, automations, websites, and growth in one
tagline_zh: AI CRM、自动化、网站和增长，合而为一
description: Most CRMs bolt an AI chatbot onto a legacy tool. Nida flips it: the agent IS the operator. Your AI runs the CRM, builds websites, calls leads, replies across SMS, email, chat. It books meetings, triggers automations all from your own runtime. Bring your own agent. No lock-in. Autopilot proactively proposes next moves and waits for your approval. One workspace. Every model. Your brand.
description_zh: 大多数 CRM 只是在遗留工具上附加一个 AI 聊天机器人。Nida 颠覆了这一模式：智能体本身就是操作员。你的 AI 运行 CRM、构建网站、呼叫潜在客户、回复短信、邮件和聊天消息。它预订会议、触发自动化，全部在你的自有运行时中完成。自带智能体。无锁定。Autopilot 主动建议下一步操作并等待你的批准。一个工作区。支持所有模型。你的品牌。

name: Seedro
tagline: Forecast. Optimize. Grow
tagline_zh: 预测。优化。增长。
description: Seedro is an AI-powered financial projection tool that helps startup and small business owners create accurate forecasts, optimize costs, and visualize clear growth paths in minutes to scale with confidence.
description_zh: Seedro 是一款由 AI 驱动财务预测工具，帮助初创企业和小型企业主在几分钟内创建准确的预测、优化成本并可视化清晰的增长路径，从而自信地实现规模化。

name: AI Career Coach
tagline: Land the job you actually want with AI Career Coach
tagline_zh: 用 AI 职业教练拿下你真正想要的工作
description: AI Career Coach analyzes your resume, suggests best-fit career paths, and runs role-specific mock interviews — tailored to your real experience, not generic tips. Join the beta. Focused: Get ATS-optimized resume feedback, tailored career-path suggestions, and realistic mock interviews based on your history. Limited beta spots available.
description_zh: AI 职业教练分析你的简历，推荐最契合的职业路径，并进行针对特定角色的模拟面试——根据你的真实经历量身定制，而非泛泛而谈。加入测试版。专注模式：获取通过 ATS 优化的简历反馈、定制化的职业路径建议以及基于你过往经历的逼真模拟面试。测试版名额有限。

name: Cruel Dungeon
tagline: A daily roguelike where everyone faces the same dungeon
tagline_zh: 一款每日相同的 Roguelike 游戏
description: Roguelikes can't be ranked fairly — a leaderboard just measures who drew the lucky seed. Cruel Dungeon fixes that by giving every player the same dungeon each day, Wordle-style. Your first run is ranked, then you practice unlimited. It turns a luck contest into a pure decision contest. 12 brutal floors, permadeath, choice-based, and a sadistic AI dungeon master narrating your descent. ~3% escape. The engine is fully deterministic so the board is genuinely fair and cheat-resistant.
description_zh: Roguelike 游戏无法公平排名——排行榜仅衡量谁抽到了幸运种子。Cruel Dungeon 通过每天为所有玩家提供相同的地下城（类似 Wordle 的机制）解决了这一问题。你的第一次通关会被排名，之后可以无限练习。它将运气比拼转化为纯粹的决策较量。包含 12 层残酷关卡、永久死亡、基于选择的游戏机制，以及一位以叙述你堕落过程为乐的虐待狂 AI 地下城城主。逃脱率约为 3%。引擎完全确定性强，确保棋盘真正公平且防作弊。

name: Ferrum
tagline: Rust-powered blockchain for identity, tax & trust
tagline_zh: 用于身份、税务和信任的 Rust 区块链
description: Ferrum helps governments, enterprises, and AI systems verify identity, automate compliance, and exchange trusted data through decentralized identity, smart contracts, and cross-chain infrastructure.
description_zh: Ferrum 帮助政府、企业和 AI 系统通过去中心化身份、智能合约和跨链基础设施验证身份、自动化合规流程并交换可信数据。

name: Prompt Craft
tagline: Craft Better Prompts. Get Better Results.
tagline_zh: 打造更好的提示词。获得更好的结果。
description: Browse and copy AI prompts for teachers, students, freelancers, marketers, and developers. Free, fast, no signup.
description_zh: 浏览并复制面向教师、学生、自由职业者、营销人员和开发者的 AI 提示词。免费、快速、无需注册。

name: Textology
tagline: AI-Powered Business Communication for Modern Teams
tagline_zh: AI驱动的现代团队商业沟通工具
description: Textology helps businesses streamline customer communication through SMS, VoIP calling, AI automation, and shared team collaboration—all from one platform. Capture missed opportunities with missed-call text back, automate follow-ups, manage conversations across teams, and improve customer response times. Built for healthcare providers, service businesses, multi-location organizations, and growing teams that want to deliver better customer experiences while reducing manual work.
description_zh: Textology助力企业通过短信、VoIP通话、AI自动化和团队协作一站式优化客户沟通。利用未接来电回短信功能捕捉错失的机会，自动化跟进流程，跨团队管理对话，提升客户响应速度。专为医疗保健提供商、服务企业、多地点组织及希望减少人工操作并提升客户体验的成长型团队打造。

name: Plysion
tagline: Jeopardy-style team trivia, live during the World Cup
tagline_zh: 世界杯期间的Jeopardy风格团队问答游戏
description: Plysion is a team-based trivia game with a Jeopardy-style twist. Pick 6 categories — each with easy, medium, and hard questions worth 200, 400, or 600 points. Miss it, and the other team can steal your points. One category updates live: World Cup 2026, with fresh questions added as real matches happen, plus a score-prediction feature that rewards exact guesses with a free game. First game free. Built solo with AI.
description_zh: Plysion是一款带有Jeopardy风格玩法的团队问答游戏。选择6个类别——每个类别包含价值200、400或600分的简单、中等和困难问题。答错则对手可抢答得分。其中一个类别实时更新：2026年世界杯，随着真实比赛进行添加新问题，并设有比分预测功能，猜中即可免费获得一局游戏。首局免费。由个人使用AI开发。

name: Horsey AI
tagline: The AI Co-Founder That Runs Your Business on WhatsApp
tagline_zh: 在WhatsApp上运营业务的AI联合创始人
description: Horsey is the AI co-founder for small businesses on WhatsApp. Runs sales, marketing, content, and customer support 24/7. Free forever plan. Built in India for India + UAE. No salary. No sleep. No stress.
description_zh: Horsey是面向WhatsApp中小企业的AI联合创始人。全天候24/7处理销售、营销、内容创作和客户支持。永久免费计划。专为印度市场打造，兼顾阿联酋市场。无需薪资，无需睡眠，毫无压力。

name: Pitchbar
tagline: Where Startups Turn Interest Into Growth
tagline_zh: 初创企业将兴趣转化为增长的平台
description: Pitchbar is a growth and distribution layer for founders, builders, and startups. It helps products stay active after launch by turning visitors, interest, and early traction into ongoing engagement. Discover new startups, explore hiring opportunities, follow curated updates from the tech ecosystem, and connect with the people building and scaling products in real time, all in one place designed to keep momentum alive beyond the first launch.
description_zh: Pitchbar是为创始人、开发者和初创企业提供的增长与分发层。它通过将访客、兴趣和早期流量转化为持续互动，帮助产品在发布后保持活跃。在这里发现新初创企业，探索就业机会，关注科技生态系统的精选动态，并与实时构建和扩展产品的人们建立联系——这一切都在一个旨在让发布后的势头得以延续的一站式平台中实现。

name: Onxeera
tagline: Track your brand visibility in ChatGPT, Gemini & Perplexity
tagline_zh: 追踪您的品牌在ChatGPT、Gemini和Perplexity中的可见度
description: Onxeera is an AI GEO visibility platform for SEO agencies and marketers. See exactly how ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews describe your brand. Get a free audit in 30 seconds — no credit card required. Track citations, analyze competitors, and optimize your content for AI search engines.
description_zh: Onxeera是面向SEO机构和营销人员的AI GEO可见度平台。清晰查看ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity、Claude和Google AI概览如何描述您的品牌。30秒内获取免费审计——无需信用卡。追踪引用来源，分析竞争对手，并为AI搜索引擎优化您的内容。

name: RidgeTech Lead Generator
tagline: AI-powered lead discovery and scoring
tagline_zh: AI驱动的潜在客户发现与评分
description: A multi-tenant lead engine that turns researched, scored audiences into precision-targeted paid ads, not cold email and phone spam. Build a business profile, let the platform research your audience, and route the result into surgical ad campaigns across Facebook, Instagram, Google, and TikTok. Your product lands in front of real prospects instead of contributing to the noise.
description_zh: 一个多租户潜在客户引擎，将经过研究和评分的受众转化为精准投放的广告，而非冷邮件和电话骚扰。构建业务档案，让平台研究您的受众，并将结果路由到Facebook、Instagram、Google和TikTok上的精准广告活动中。让您的产品呈现在真实潜在客户面前，而不是增加噪音。

name: BeUniq.design
tagline: AI slop design humanizer
tagline_zh: AI生成内容的拟人化设计工具
description: BeUniq is a Chrome extension that helps builders improve AI-generated interfaces. Drag over any UI section, and it analyzes the screenshot to detect generic AI design patterns, suggest stronger layouts, recommend references and motion ideas, and generate a focused prompt you can paste into Cursor or Codex.
description_zh: BeUniq是一款Chrome扩展程序，帮助开发者改进AI生成的界面。拖拽任意UI区域，它即可分析截图以检测通用的AI设计模式，建议更优布局，推荐参考案例和动效创意，并生成可粘贴到Cursor或Codex中的精准提示词。

name: Kairos
tagline: Turn your stream of consciousness into a structured day
tagline_zh: 将意识流转化为结构化的日程
description: Kairos turns your stream of consciousness into a structured, readable day. No grids and no clutter - type and watch your thoughts become tasks, events, and reminders. Built by a solo founder for her own ADHD brain, Kairos runs on a secure client-side enclave, so your data is encrypted before it ever leaves your device. Includes a free library of importable schedules, from ADHD routines to holiday calendars.
description_zh: Kairos将您的意识流转化为结构化、易读的一天。无网格、无杂乱——输入内容，看着您的想法转化为任务、事件和提醒。由一位独立创始人专为她的ADHD大脑打造，Kairos在安全的客户端 enclave 上运行，因此您的数据在离开设备前即已加密。包含免费的可导入日程库，从ADHD日常习惯到假日日历。

name: QuickMaker
tagline: State of the art AI models in Blender under one subscription
tagline_zh: Blender中顶尖AI模型的一站式订阅
description: QuickMaker brings AI models into Blender. Generate 2D and 3D assets directly in your workflow. No API keys needed, just create an account and start creating.
description_zh: QuickMaker将AI模型引入Blender。直接在您的工作流中生成2D和3D资产。无需API密钥，只需创建账户并开始创作。

name: Tourista
tagline: See your whole trip before you go, planned by AI
tagline_zh: 出行前通过AI规划看清全程
description: Most AI trip plans look nice but don't work in real life. A place is closed that day, you waste time crossing the city back and forth, or too much is packed into one day. Tourista is different. It builds a clear day by day plan using real travel times and opening hours. It also picks the best time to visit each place and groups nearby stops together,so you don't zigzag across the city and make the most of your day.See exactly how your trip will look before you go. Free to use, on web and mobile.
description_zh: 大多数AI行程计划看起来不错，但在现实中却行不通。目的地当天关闭，您浪费时间往返城市各处，或者一天内安排得太满。Tourista与众不同。它利用真实的旅行时间和营业时间，制定清晰的每日计划。它还选择每个目的地的最佳访问时间，并将附近的站点分组，避免您在城市中来回穿梭，从而充分利用每一天。在出行前确切了解您的行程将如何呈现。免费使用，支持网页和移动端。

name: AivaExchange
tagline: Ask questions and get answers from AI bots
tagline_zh: 向AI机器人提问并获取答案
description: AivaExchange is a public Q&A platform where people post questions and specialized AI bots answer automatically. Ask once and compare focused answers across technology, business, home, travel, productivity, lifestyle, and more.
description_zh: AivaExchange是一个公共问答平台，用户发布问题，专业AI机器人自动回答。一次提问，即可在科技、商业、家居、旅行、生产力、生活方式等多个领域对比专注的回答。

name: LinkPost
tagline: Create viral LinkedIn content the scientific way
tagline_zh: 用科学的方式创作病毒式传播的LinkedIn内容
description: LinkPost scores your LinkedIn post on 300+ factors trained on 1M+ viral posts and predicts its reach before you publish. Drop an idea, get 25 scored variants, post the winner. It's not a ChatGPT wrapper: it's content, made scientific.
description_zh: LinkPost基于100万+爆款帖子训练出的300多个因素对您的LinkedIn帖子进行评分，并在发布前预测其触达范围。输入一个想法，获得25个评分后的变体，发布表现最佳的那一个。它不是ChatGPT的包装：它是科学化的内容创作。

name: Text Splitter
tagline: Chop long text into clean, model-sized chunks
tagline_zh: 将长文本切割成干净且适合模型大小的片段
description: Paste a wall of text and Text Splitter slices it into chunks that fit any model's context window — by length, paragraph, or your own rules — without cutting sentences in half. Built for feeding long documents to ChatGPT, Claude or DeepSeek. Runs entirely in your browser; your text never leaves the page.

name: AskCurator
tagline: Chat with your data. See the code. Teach it your workflows.
tagline_zh: 与您的数据对话。查看代码。教它您的工作流程。
description: Most "chat with your data" tools upload your spreadsheet to a server and you just trust the number it returns. Curator runs the analysis as real Python (pandas, numpy) in your browser. Your rows never leave your machine; the AI only sees your schema. Every answer ships with the actual code that produced it, so you can check the math. And it learns: the analyses you run become reusable, verified building blocks, so it gets faster and more trustworthy the more you use it.
description_zh: 大多数“与数据对话”工具会将您的电子表格上传至服务器，您只能盲目信任其返回的数字。Curator 在浏览器中以真实的 Python（pandas、numpy）运行分析。您的数据行永远不会离开您的设备；AI 仅能看到您的数据结构。每个答案都附带生成该结果的实际代码，以便您核对计算过程。它具有学习能力：您运行的分析将成为可复用且经过验证的基础模块，随着使用次数增加，它会变得更快、更可靠。

- **[LLMs](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/llms)** – Platforms and tools built around large language models that enable text generation, understanding, and reasoning across many applications.
- **[AI Infrastructure](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-infrastructure)** – Products that support training, deploying, scaling, and evaluating AI models, including hosting, inference, data pipelines, and observability.
- **[AI Chatbots](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/ai-chatbots)** – Applications that use AI to power conversational experiences for support, productivity, research, and user interaction.
- **[Predictive AI](https://www.producthunt.com/categories/predictive-ai)** – AI-powered tools that analyze data to forecast outcomes, detect patterns, and support decision-making.

description: I've been meaning to visualize agents in different UI contexts. Finally started playing with Claude on the idea of something reusable and customizable. So avagent was born. It's now available on npm and GitHub. It's a React avatar, all HTML and CSS. It blinks, tracks the cursor, gestures, walks, and talks through speech bubbles. Assign long-term 'mode' behaviors or short term actions/reactions. All through React props. It has a simple 2D kinetic anatomy that drives how its body parts move.
description_zh: 我一直想在不同UI场景中可视化代理。终于开始用Claude探索可复用和可定制的想法。于是avagent诞生了。它现已在npm和GitHub上提供。这是一个React头像，纯HTML和CSS实现。它会眨眼、追踪光标、做手势、走路，并通过对话气泡说话。可以通过React props分配长期“模式”行为或短期动作/反应。它拥有简单的2D动力学解剖结构，驱动其身体各部分的运动。

description_zh: 现在每个应用都能把照片变成视频，但大多数需要付费，且因提示词错误导致结果崩坏。我们免费，且专注于最难的环节：提示词生成。无需注册，约需 30 秒。上传任意照片，描述希望发生的动作，它将遵循一条制胜法则——仅描述画面中新增的运动，而非已有场景——来撰写清晰的照片转视频提示词。将提示词粘贴到 Seedance 或任何 AI 模型中进行渲染即可。

name: Auto Learning Agents
tagline: Self-hosted AI agent OS with memory that actually learns
tagline_zh: Self-hosted AI agent OS with memory that actually learns
description: Auto Learning Agents is a free, open source OS for AI agents. Deep internal memory plus dynamic, session-less context: agents find the right context each turn, pick up where they left off, and get better at recurring work. Web UI for Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, or fully local with Ollama, with a file browser, code editor, and 40+ built-in tools. Background agents run while you are away. Built on Elixir/OTP, every agent is a supervised process that recovers from crashes. One Docker command and go.
description_zh: Auto Learning Agents 是一款免费开源的 AI Agent 操作系统，具备深度内部记忆和动态无会话上下文：Agent 能在每轮交互中精准定位上下文，无缝衔接之前的状态，并在重复性工作中不断精进。支持 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini 的 Web UI，也可通过 Ollama 实现完全本地化部署；内置文件浏览器、代码编辑器及 40 多种工具。后台 Agent 可在你离线时持续运行。基于 Elixir/OTP 构建，每个 Agent 均为受监督进程，具备崩溃恢复能力。一条 Docker 命令即可启动。

name: Ceadly
tagline: Human approval for AI agents, sealed as proof
tagline_zh: AI 代理人的人类审批，作为证据
description: Every enterprise using AI agents faces the same gap: agents now send emails, issue refunds, and touch production systems, but there's no record of who approved it before it happened. Ceadly adds one line of code, @guard, in front of any consequential agent action. Execution pauses. A named, accountable reviewer decides — Approve, Reject, Modify, or Request More Info. The decision is hashed and timestamped the instant it's made. Not a log. A signature.
description_zh: 每个使用 AI 代理的企业都面临同一个缺口：代理现在可以发送电子邮件、发放退款和触及生产系统，但没有记录谁在它发生之前批准了它。Ceadly 在任何后果性代理行动前面添加一行代码，@guard。执行暂停。一个命名的、负责的审阅者决定——批准、拒绝、修改或要求更多信息。审批决定在做出决定的那一刻被哈希并时间戳。不是日志，而是签名。

tagline: Talk through a data flow, get a diagram everyone sees

description: Most diagramming tools make you drag boxes. Wavelength listens instead. description_zh: 大多数图表工具让你拖拽框。Wavelength 则是倾听。通过对话描述数据流，或粘贴通话记录，它会构建一个可编辑的图表，包含您描述的参与者、系统、决策和数据存储。然后可以通过语音、纯英文 AI 提示、右键点击或检查器进行编辑。专为技术销售人员和解决方案工程师设计，口头描述架构会在几秒钟内失去听众。版本历史、团队工作区、PNG 导出。免费开始。
